question_text: Four people are talking about their exercise preferences. Match each person to the correct information.
explanation:
Speaker A: My weekends belong to the hills. I load the bike onto the car on Friday night, and by eight the next morning I am flying down a forest trail with mud everywhere. My friends think I am mad — the bruises, the repairs, the cold. But nothing else empties my head like picking a line between the trees at speed. I have tried gentler hobbies, honestly. None of them ever made me feel so completely awake.
Speaker B: For me it has to be simple, so I just go for a run before work. No equipment, no bookings, no team — shoes on, door shut, and thirty minutes later I am back, red-faced and happy. In summer I follow the river; in winter I do loops around my block under the streetlights. People keep inviting me to fancy gyms, and I always say the same thing: the pavement is free and it never closes.
Speaker C: My doctor told me to stay active without stressing my knees, so every evening after dinner my husband and I head out on foot and do a slow hour through the neighbourhood. We have done it so long that the neighbours joke they can set their clocks by us. It is gentle, it costs nothing, and we talk more in that hour than in the rest of the day. Not dramatic, I know — but at my age, steady beats spectacular.
Speaker D: Mine started with a birthday gift: one lesson at the stables outside town. Ten years later I am there every Saturday, brushing, saddling, and taking my favourite mare across the fields. Being carried by a living animal is nothing like any machine — you learn to listen with your whole body. It is not a cheap pastime, and my boots are permanently filthy, but walking into that yard is still the best moment of my week.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = Mountain biking (keyword "bike... forest trail"). B = Going for a run (keyword "go for a run"). C = Walking (PARAPHRASE: "head out on foot... slow hour through the neighbourhood" — không có chữ walk). D = Horse riding (PARAPHRASE: "stables... favourite mare... carried by a living animal" — không có chữ horse/riding). Nhiễu: Hiking, Swimming — không ai nói.

question_text: What is one of the main criticisms of the Regional Development Plan?
options: It will remove several public parks in the area
It makes public transportation more expensive for residents
It doesn't do enough to promote alternatives to driving
explanation:
Welcome back to our community forum. Tonight we are discussing the proposed Regional Development Plan, and I want to begin by clearing up some rumours. Some residents heard that the plan would remove several public parks in the area. That is not in the document — every existing park stays. Others worried that it would make public transportation more expensive. Again, not true; ticket prices are not part of this plan at all. The criticism that people are actually making, and making loudly, is different: the plan does not do enough to promote alternatives to driving. Look through the pages and you will see new roads, wider roads, and more parking. What you will hardly find are new bus routes, safe cycle lanes, or streets designed for walking. For a city that says it wants cleaner air, that balance seems wrong, and I understand why residents keep raising their hands at every meeting to say so.
The city council has its own worry, and it is a practical one. You might expect strong opposition from local businesses, but in fact most shop owners support the plan, hoping it brings more customers. Nor is money the issue — so far the project remains inside its budget. The real challenge is land. There are large empty areas in the city centre, old warehouses and unused plots, that could be developed first. Instead, the plan spreads outward into the countryside. Several council members argue this means the plan is simply not making efficient use of the land we already have, and until that changes, they will not vote for it.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: It doesn't do enough to promote alternatives to driving. Bẫy: "remove public parks" là tin đồn bị bác ("not in the document"), "public transportation more expensive" bị bác ("not part of this plan").
2. Đáp án: The plan is not making efficient use of existing land. Bẫy: "opposition from local businesses" bị phủ định ("most shop owners support"), "exceeded budget" bị phủ định ("remains inside its budget").

extra_data.sampleAnswerBasic: Both pictures show children playing games at home. In the first picture, a family of three is playing chess at a wooden table. The father is sitting on the left with a small child on his lap holding a chess piece. The mother is sitting on the right in a light blue shirt, holding a piece too. There is a vase of pink flowers and a green plant behind them. In the second picture, a boy in a blue and white striped shirt is playing a video game alone. He is holding a black controller with both hands and looking at the screen. There is a white sofa behind him. So one picture shows a family game, while the other shows a child playing by himself.
extra_data.sampleAnswerAdvanced: Both pictures show indoor games, but one is social and the other is solitary. In the first picture, a family is playing chess at a wooden table. The father sits on the left with a young child on his lap, and the child is holding a chess piece and studying the board. Across the table, the mother, wearing a light blue shirt, is laughing and moving a piece of her own. A vase of pink flowers and a green plant make the room feel cheerful. The second picture shows a boy in a blue and white striped shirt playing a video game on his own. He grips a black controller with both hands and stares straight ahead at the screen, with a white sofa behind him. So one game brings the family together, while the other is between a child and a machine. Both children look completely absorbed.

question_text: What are the benefits of viewing artworks?
explanation: Viewing artworks has many benefits. First, it helps us to relax and reduce stress. When we look at beautiful paintings or sculptures, it can calm our minds and make us feel peaceful. Art also encourages creativity, as it can inspire new ideas or ways of thinking. Additionally, art allows us to learn about different cultures and histories, giving us a deeper understanding of the world. Lastly, viewing art can be an emotional experience, helping us connect with our feelings and express ourselves better.

extra_data.imageDesc: Nhóm người đứng xem tranh trong phòng triển lãm
extra_data.sampleAnswerBasic: Viewing artworks has many benefits. First, it helps us to relax and reduce stress. When we look at beautiful paintings or sculptures, it can calm our minds and make us feel peaceful. Art also encourages creativity, as it can inspire new ideas or ways of thinking. Additionally, art allows us to learn about different cultures and histories, giving us a deeper understanding of the world. Lastly, viewing art can be an emotional experience, helping us connect with our feelings and express ourselves better.
extra_data.sampleAnswerAdvanced: The benefit I notice first is pace. A gallery forces me to stand still for an hour, which nothing else in my week does. Beyond that, art shows you how somebody else saw the world, and often that person has been dead for a century. Some would call that a history lesson, and it does change your sense of proportion. There's a practical side too. Friends who studied design say exhibitions give them ideas they can't get online, because size and texture disappear on a screen.

question_text: Linda is talking about what she likes to eat. What does she have for lunch?
options: Tea
Coffee
Juice
explanation:
My eating day is a bit unusual, people say. Breakfast is my big coffee moment — two cups, no negotiation, or I'm useless all morning. For lunch, though, I keep things gentle: just a large pot of tea with my sandwiches, green tea usually, sometimes with a little honey. Coffee after midday makes my heart race. And juice? Only at weekends, fresh orange with breakfast, when there's time to squeeze it properly. Simple habits, happy stomach!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Tea.
• Vì sao đúng: "For lunch, though, I keep things gentle: just a large pot of tea with my sandwiches, green tea usually".
• Coffee sai: đó là đồ uống bữa SÁNG, và cô tránh cà phê sau trưa ("Breakfast is my big coffee moment... Coffee after midday makes my heart race").
• Juice sai: chỉ uống cuối tuần cùng bữa sáng ("Only at weekends, fresh orange with breakfast").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi giới hạn bữa ăn ("for lunch") — nghe các mốc breakfast / lunch / at weekends rồi chỉ lấy đồ uống gắn đúng mốc được hỏi.

question_text: Two people are talking about meeting for dinner. What time does Ahmed meet Rose?
options: half past seven
quarter past seven
quarter to eight
explanation:
Hello Rose, Ahmed here. About dinner tonight — I know we first said half past seven, but my meeting now finishes late, so that's impossible for me. I thought about quarter past seven for a moment, but that's even earlier, silly me. Let's make it quarter to eight instead, same restaurant. The table is already changed to quarter to eight, so see you then!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – quarter to eight.
• Vì sao đúng: "Let's make it quarter to eight instead" và được xác nhận lại "The table is already changed to quarter to eight".
• half past seven sai: đó là giờ hẹn BAN ĐẦU, đã bỏ vì cuộc họp kết thúc muộn ("I know we first said half past seven, but my meeting now finishes late").
• quarter past seven sai: chính người nói nghĩ tới rồi tự bác bỏ vì còn sớm hơn ("I thought about quarter past seven for a moment, but that's even earlier, silly me").
👉 Mẹo: trong tin nhắn đổi lịch, giờ đúng nằm sau "instead" hoặc "let's make it"; giờ đứng sau "we first said / originally" luôn là bẫy.

question_text: Why is it appealing to eat at different places?

A new place can make a meal feel special.

question_text: What are the difficulties of these 2 sports?
explanation: Both rowing and cycling are difficult sports. Rowing requires strong arms, shoulders, and teamwork because all members must row at the same rhythm. Bad weather or strong waves can make it even harder. Cycling requires strong legs, balance, and concentration, especially on long roads or during races. Cyclists must keep their speed and avoid accidents. Both sports are physically demanding and need regular training, strong discipline, and patience.

extra_data.sampleAnswerBasic: Both rowing and cycling are difficult sports. Rowing requires strong arms, shoulders, and teamwork because all members must row at the same rhythm. Cyclists must keep their speed and avoid accidents. Both sports are physically demanding and need regular training, strong discipline, and patience.
extra_data.sampleAnswerAdvanced: Rowing hurts everywhere at once. Arms, back and legs all work together, and the crew has to match each other exactly, or the boat loses speed immediately. Wind and rough water make that far harder. Cycling is a longer kind of suffering: hours in the same position, hills that never end, and constant attention to the road. A cyclist who has trained for months can still lose everything to a flat tyre. Both sports punish a missed week. Recovery takes days for both.

question_text: What does the expert say being professional is all about?

explanation:
Good morning, everyone. Today I want to talk about professionalism and how it has changed over the years. If you ask people what being professional is really about, you will hear different answers. Some will tell you it is about creating a good working environment. Others will say it is about making a good impression on clients and colleagues. Those things matter, of course, but I see them as results, not as the starting point. In my view, being professional is, above all, about maintaining a positive attitude. When you stay friendly, open-minded and willing to help, even on difficult days, the good impression and the pleasant working environment follow naturally. A positive attitude is the engine; everything else is what the engine produces.
Now let me turn to how the idea of professionalism has developed. Forty years ago, being professional often meant little more than wearing a smart suit and following strict rules. Some people still believe the meaning has stayed the same all this time, but that is clearly not true. Technology and global business have changed what employers expect. Today, a professional also needs to be flexible, to understand people from different cultures, and to use new tools with confidence. And I want to be clear about one more thing: this process is not finished. Anyone who thinks the definition is now fixed and will not change any more is going to be surprised. Our definition of professionalism is still changing, and the professionals who succeed will be the ones who keep changing with it. Thank you.

question_text: What does she say about working at home?

explanation:
Working from home — everyone seems to have an opinion about it, and after a full year of doing it, I have mixed feelings too. Let me start with the good side. There are no colleagues chatting next to my desk, so on paper it sounds like a world without distractions. The truth is different: the office noise simply gets replaced by the dirty laundry, the unwashed dishes and the doorbell. I can set my own hours and take a break when I need one, which I do enjoy. And video calls are useful — but anyone who tells you they are better than sitting across a table from a real person has never tried to solve a difficult problem through a screen. Some days I feel quite lonely, and that surprised me. So if you ask me for an honest summary, I would say working from home is not as good as I expected. It has real advantages, but the picture people paint of it is too rosy.
Let me finish with some practical points. You do not need a big home office — a small corner of a room works perfectly fine. What you do need is self-motivation, because nobody is watching you, and the sofa is always calling. And the most important lesson of all: there is no single answer that fits everybody. How well working from home goes really depends on your situation and your personality. Some people do their best work this way; others need the energy of an office. Know which type you are before you decide.

question_text: What happened to the TV series?

explanation:
Have you been watching Mystery City? If not, you are one of the few. When the series began, some journalists claimed it had not received enough money in its early stage, and others expected the critics to overlook it completely. Both predictions turned out to be wrong. The network actually invested heavily from day one, and the reviews have been warm from the very first week. Most importantly, the show caught the audience's attention from the start. The opening episode was full of tension and surprises, and within days social media was full of theories about the characters. People connected with the story immediately, and that early excitement is exactly what every new series dreams of.
But I want to look at this as a business story, because that is where it gets really interesting. Fans are already asking for new seasons, though nothing has been confirmed yet. Some film teachers even say the series will inspire young filmmakers to copy its style. Maybe so — but in my opinion, the real potential lies somewhere else: this series can help the network reach new customers. Younger viewers who never watched traditional television have signed up just to follow this one show, and once they arrive, they discover everything else on the platform. A single strong series, supported by clever promotion, can grow a network's audience in a way that ordinary advertising never could. That is the lesson other companies will take from Mystery City, and I expect many will try to copy it next year.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: It caught the audience's attention from the start. Bẫy: "didn't receive enough investment" và "overlooked by critics" đều là dự đoán bị chứng minh SAI ("Both predictions turned out to be wrong").

Team sports also help people improve communication, cooperation, and leadership skills. They are suitable for outgoing people who like social activities. Individual sports can be rewarding, but they may feel lonely. For many people, the friendship and teamwork in team sports make them more enjoyable.

extra_data.sampleAnswerAdvanced: Partly it is the pressure. In a team a bad day gets absorbed by everyone else, whereas in an individual sport your mistake is the whole story. Teams also solve the motivation problem, since people turn up when others are waiting for them. Then there is what happens afterwards: the food, the arguing about the match, the group chat. For sociable people that is half the reason they play. I have always preferred those evenings. The sport itself is only half of it.

question_text: What is the expert's opinion about sport competitions?
options: Provide school with external investments
Nurture potential sportsmen for the country.
They can cause harmful effects
explanation:
Are sports good or bad for children? As a child development researcher, I hear this question every week, and my answer always starts the same way: it depends on what kind of sport we mean. Let me first mention two arguments you often hear from school boards. Some say sports programmes provide schools with external investments, since local companies love putting their names on a young team's shirts. Others believe school sports exist to nurture future champions for the country. Both things can happen, but neither is the point, and chasing them can actually cause damage. Because here is my honest view about sport competitions for young children: they can cause harmful effects. When every game ends with a ranking, children are constantly compared with each other — who is better, who is worse. For a nine-year-old, losing week after week in front of friends can hurt confidence far more than adults realise. Many children do their best learning in friendly, active environments where cooperation matters more than winning.
So what is my advice for schools? Some head teachers want to make sport a mandatory subject with grades and exams; others quietly push children to focus only on their academic subjects and treat sport as wasted time. I disagree with both. The real value of sport in school is that it provides children with a balance in their lives. After hours of sitting, reading and memorising, the playground is where the body wakes up and the mind rests. Schools that protect that balance — without turning it into another competition — raise healthier and, in the end, better-performing students.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: They can cause harmful effects. Bẫy: "external investments" và "nurture sportsmen" đều được nhắc là lập luận của người khác rồi bị gạt ("neither is the point").
2. Đáp án: Provides them with a balance in their lives. Bẫy: "mandatory subject" và "focus on academic subjects" đều bị phản đối trực tiếp ("I disagree with both").

question_text: What part of the movie is disappointing?
options: The dialogue seems unrealistic.
The settings do not make sense.
The original cast was replaced.
explanation:
As someone who has watched the film industry for twenty years, I left the cinema after The Silver Horizon with mixed feelings. Let me start with what the film gets right, because the rumours you may have heard are not true. Some fans claimed the original cast had been replaced at the last minute — they were not; every main actor stayed. And the settings are actually beautiful and completely believable, from the mountain villages to the night markets. Visually, the film makes perfect sense. The real disappointment is the dialogue, which simply seems unrealistic. The characters speak as if they came from another century. There is one long conversation between the hero and his teacher that should feel emotional, but the words are so stiff that it sounds like a school play instead of two real people talking. Every time the film starts to pull you in, another awkward line pushes you straight back out.
Why does this keep happening in modern films? Some people blame technology and even fear it will soon replace human actors, but I think that fear misses the point. Others say the studios should simply invent newer, fresher story plots. Also not the heart of it. The real problem is that the new industry demand for speed is negatively influencing script production. Studios want films finished quickly to follow market trends, so writers are not given the time to build believable characters and natural conversations. Until that pressure changes, we will keep seeing beautiful films that sound wrong the moment the characters open their mouths.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: The dialogue seems unrealistic. Bẫy: "settings do not make sense" bị phủ định ("completely believable"), "original cast was replaced" bị phủ định ("they were not").
2. Đáp án: The new industry demand is negatively influencing script production. Bẫy: "technology will replace actors" bị gạt ("misses the point"), "new story plots should be invented" bị gạt ("Also not the heart of it").

👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi về thứ tự chương trình — bám ba từ khóa vị trí: opens with (đầu), in the middle (giữa), the ending / final curtain (cuối). Câu hỏi hỏi phần nào thì lấy đúng từ khóa đó.

question_text: Listen to an auction man talking about a cabinet. Which part of the cabinet is original?
options: The drawer
The doors
The handles
explanation:
Ladies and gentlemen, lot number twelve: this fine oak cabinet from around 1890. Now, let me be honest about its condition, as always. The doors were replaced in the nineteen-sixties — you can see the newer wood. The brass handles are also modern reproductions, fitted by the last owner. But the drawer — please, come closer — the drawer is completely original, dovetail joints and all, exactly as the craftsman made it. A beautiful piece of history. Shall we start at two hundred?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The drawer.
• Vì sao đúng: "the drawer is completely original, dovetail joints and all, exactly as the craftsman made it".
• The doors sai: đã bị thay trong thập niên 1960 ("The doors were replaced in the nineteen-sixties — you can see the newer wood").
• The handles sai: là đồ phục chế hiện đại do chủ trước lắp ("The brass handles are also modern reproductions, fitted by the last owner").
👉 Mẹo: bài đấu giá/nhà cổ luôn xoay quanh cặp từ original ↔ replaced/reproduction. Chỉ cần nghe được cặp này là khoanh đúng, không cần hiểu hết phần mô tả.

question_text: What is the expert comment on the movie industry?
options: Technology will soon replace human actors.
The new industry demand is negatively influencing script production
New story plots should be invented to capture the audience's interest

question_text: What is the expert's advice for schools?
options: Should consider sports as a mandatory subject.
Provides them with a balance in their lives.
Keep students focus on academic subjects

question_text: According to the expert, what is the series' potential?
options: New seasons will be produced due to great demand.
It inspires young filmmakers to follow a new movie-making style.
It can help reach new customers.

question_text: A woman is talking about her vacation. What is the relationship between the speaker and Lisa?
options: Best friends
Mother and daughter
Teacher and student
explanation:
I have just come back from the most wonderful two weeks by the sea, and of course I went with Lisa — who else? We have shared everything since we sat next to each other on our very first day of school, thirty years ago now. Our husbands joke that we speak our own language. Every summer, wherever life has taken us, the two of us find one week for a trip together, just like when we were girls.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Best friends.
• Vì sao đúng: "We have shared everything since we sat next to each other on our very first day of school, thirty years ago" — ngồi cạnh nhau từ ngày đầu đi học nghĩa là bạn thân cùng lứa.
• Mother and daughter sai: hai người cùng tuổi và mỗi người đều có chồng riêng ("Our husbands joke that we speak our own language"), không thể là mẹ con.
• Teacher and student sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi quan hệ hiếm khi nói thẳng từ "best friend". Bắt các chi tiết định tuổi và bối cảnh như "first day of school", "just like when we were girls" để suy ra vai vế ngang hàng.

question_text: Competitions between universities should be encouraged
options: Man
Woman
Both

question_text: More women pursue politics.
options: Man
Woman
Both

question_text: A receptionist is checking the client list of a clinic. How many clients are Americans?
options: One
Two
Three
explanation:
Right, let me check tomorrow's client list before I go home. Nine o'clock, Mrs. Schneider — she's German. Ten thirty, Mr. Lopez from Spain. Then after lunch we have Mr. Miller — he's the American gentleman, the only one this week actually. And finally Madame Dubois from France at four. So that's four clients tomorrow, and I must remember Mr. Miller prefers to pay in dollars.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – One.
• Vì sao đúng: "Mr. Miller — he's the American gentleman, the only one this week actually" — chỉ đúng một khách người Mỹ.
• Two sai: hai cái tên nước ngoài khác được nhắc là Mr. Lopez from Spain và Madame Dubois from France, đều không phải người Mỹ.
• Three sai: tổng số khách ngày mai là bốn ("that's four clients tomorrow"), không có con số ba nào gắn với khách Mỹ.
👉 Mẹo: câu "how many" theo quốc tịch — đừng đếm tổng số người. Nghe cụm giới hạn "the only one", "just one of them" là ra đáp án ngay.

question_text: Linda is talking about her mother. What do mother and daughter have in common?
options: Similar appearance
Similar interests
Similar personalities
explanation:
People who meet my mother and me always look for the resemblance and give up — she's tall and fair, I'm small and dark, nothing alike on the outside. And our characters? Complete opposites: she's calm as a lake, I explode like a kettle. But spend one Sunday with us and you'll see what we truly share: the same passions. Gardening, old detective novels, hill walking, terrible historical films — we love every one of them together. Same interests, different everything else!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Similar interests.
• Vì sao đúng: "you'll see what we truly share: the same passions. Gardening, old detective novels, hill walking, terrible historical films".
• Similar appearance sai: ngoại hình hoàn toàn khác ("she's tall and fair, I'm small and dark, nothing alike on the outside").
• Similar personalities sai: tính cách trái ngược ("Complete opposites: she's calm as a lake, I explode like a kettle").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "have in common" — quét các cụm tương phản (nothing alike, complete opposites) để loại, rồi bắt cụm khẳng định "what we truly share is...".

question_text: Julie is asking her professor about the assignment. When is the work due?
options: On Thursday morning
On Friday morning
On Saturday morning
explanation:
Professor, quick question about the essay before you go — when exactly do you need it? I heard some people say Thursday morning and I panicked a little. No? Oh, thank goodness. And it's not Friday either? I see — so we hand everything in on Saturday morning, before ten o'clock, in your office or by email. Saturday morning, got it. That gives me two more evenings than I thought. Thank you so much, Professor!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – On Saturday morning.
• Vì sao đúng: "so we hand everything in on Saturday morning, before ten o'clock" và cô nhắc lại "Saturday morning, got it".
• On Thursday morning sai: chỉ là tin đồn cô nghe được, đã bị thầy phủ nhận ("I heard some people say Thursday morning and I panicked a little. No? Oh, thank goodness").
• On Friday morning sai: cũng bị loại ngay sau đó ("And it's not Friday either?").
👉 Mẹo: bài chỉ nghe một phía hội thoại — các câu hỏi lại kiểu "No? / It's not... either?" chính là dấu hiệu phương án vừa bị loại. Đáp án nằm ở câu "so..." tiếp theo.

question_text: Anne is calling her daughter Sally. What does Anne need?
options: Eggs
Bread
Milk
explanation:
Sally, love, it's mum. Are you still at the supermarket? Perfect timing. I'm in the middle of baking and I've just realised I'm completely out of eggs — the recipe needs four and the box in the fridge is empty. Don't worry about bread, your father bought two loaves this morning, and we still have plenty of milk. Just the eggs, a dozen if they have the free-range ones. You're a lifesaver, darling. See you soon!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Eggs.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm completely out of eggs — the recipe needs four and the box in the fridge is empty... Just the eggs, a dozen".
• Bread sai: bố đã mua sáng nay ("your father bought two loaves this morning").
• Milk sai: trong nhà vẫn còn nhiều ("we still have plenty of milk").
👉 Mẹo: dạng nhờ mua đồ, hai món nhiễu luôn đi kèm cụm "đã có": already bought, we still have, plenty of. Món cần mua đi kèm "out of / we need / just the...".

question_text: How long does it take to get to the station?
options: 20 minutes
15 minutes
25 minutes
explanation:
If you're coming to visit me, let me explain the way from the station properly, because people always misjudge it. The taxi drivers will tell you it takes twenty-five minutes — they mean by the ring road, with traffic, in their interest. On the town map it says fifteen minutes, but that's measured for some Olympic walker, I swear. Realistically, with a suitcase, at a human pace, it takes twenty minutes from my door to the station. Twenty minutes — plan for that and you'll be exactly on time.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 20 minutes.
• Vì sao đúng: "Realistically, with a suitcase, at a human pace, it takes twenty minutes from my door to the station".
• 15 minutes sai: là con số ghi trên bản đồ, tính cho người đi bộ siêu nhanh ("On the town map it says fifteen minutes, but that's measured for some Olympic walker").
• 25 minutes sai: là con số tài xế taxi nói, đi vòng đường vành đai vì lợi ích của họ ("The taxi drivers will tell you it takes twenty-five minutes").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi thời lượng — mỗi con số nhiễu gắn với một NGUỒN không đáng tin (bản đồ, taxi). Đáp án đi kèm "realistically", "actually", "in fact".

question_text: Listen to a voice message. How does Even feel?
options: Sick
Happy
Tired
explanation:
Hi, it's Even, leaving a message for the whole team. Sorry for the strange voice. I know everyone thinks I've been overworking and I'm just tired — honestly, I wish that were it. And no, despite the holiday photos I posted, this is not a happy call. The doctor confirmed it this morning: proper flu, high fever, the lot. I'm staying in bed the rest of the week, so please move my meetings. Don't visit — you don't want what I have!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Sick.
• Vì sao đúng: "The doctor confirmed it this morning: proper flu, high fever, the lot. I'm staying in bed the rest of the week".
• Happy sai: chính anh phủ nhận dù có đăng ảnh đi chơi ("despite the holiday photos I posted, this is not a happy call").
• Tired sai: đó là suy đoán của đồng nghiệp và anh bác bỏ ("everyone thinks I've been overworking and I'm just tired — honestly, I wish that were it").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi cảm xúc/tình trạng — người nói thường bác hai suy đoán bằng "I wish that were it", "this is not...". Đáp án là điều được nguồn xác thực (bác sĩ) khẳng định.

question_text: Who does she live with? / A woman is talking about her vacation. What is the relationship between Lisa and the speaker?
options: Best friends
Cousins
Sisters
explanation:
Everyone at the beach kept asking if Lisa and I were sisters — apparently we laugh the same way. We're not, though people also guess cousins because we call each other's mothers auntie. The truth is simpler and, I think, lovelier: we met on the first day of primary school, aged six, when she shared her crayons with me, and we've been inseparable ever since. Thirty years of shared holidays, secrets and terrible haircuts. Best friends — the family you choose yourself!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Best friends.
• Vì sao đúng: "we met on the first day of primary school, aged six, when she shared her crayons with me, and we've been inseparable ever since... Best friends — the family you choose yourself!".
• Cousins sai: chỉ là phỏng đoán của người ngoài vì hai người gọi mẹ của nhau là dì ("people also guess cousins because we call each other's mothers auntie").
• Sisters sai: cũng là phỏng đoán ở bãi biển và đã bị phủ nhận ("Everyone at the beach kept asking if Lisa and I were sisters... We're not, though").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi quan hệ — mọi phương án đi kèm "people ask if / everyone guesses" đều là phỏng đoán sai. Sự thật nằm sau "The truth is".

question_text: Listen to a tour guide. Where is the office located?
options: Next to the park
Opposite the hotel
Above a restaurant
explanation:
Good morning, group! Before we set off, please memorise where our tour office is, in case anyone gets separated today. People often look for us next to the park — that's our old address, we moved last spring. And no, we're not above a restaurant anymore either, thank goodness; the kitchen smells were unbearable. The office now sits directly opposite the Grand Hotel — big blue sign, you cannot miss it. Opposite the hotel. If you get lost, go there and wait for us.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Opposite the hotel.
• Vì sao đúng: "The office now sits directly opposite the Grand Hotel — big blue sign, you cannot miss it. Opposite the hotel".
• Next to the park sai: đó là địa chỉ CŨ, đã chuyển từ mùa xuân ("that's our old address, we moved last spring").
• Above a restaurant sai: cũng là quá khứ, đã bỏ vì mùi bếp ("we're not above a restaurant anymore either; the kitchen smells were unbearable").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi địa điểm hiện tại — từ khóa vàng là "now". Mọi vị trí đi kèm "old address", "not... anymore" đều bị loại.

question_text: A tour guide is introducing a tourist destination. How many people live in the town?
explanation:
Welcome to Millbrook, everyone! Before we walk into the old town, a few facts. People often guess this is a tiny village, but exactly ten thousand people live here today. The number was smaller a generation ago, and the mayor expects it to keep growing thanks to the new railway link. Most residents work in the pottery workshops you'll see on our left. Now, follow me across the square — and mind the cobblestones!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 10,000.
• Vì sao đúng: "exactly ten thousand people live here today".
• 8,000 sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• 9,000 sai: cũng không được nhắc tới; bài chỉ nói dân số trước đây ít hơn ("The number was smaller a generation ago") mà không đưa con số.
👉 Mẹo: với số liệu dân số, bám từ khóa xác nhận "exactly", "today". Các câu kiểu "smaller before / expected to keep growing" chỉ là thông tin nền, không phải đáp án.

question_text: Listen to the speaker talking on the radio. What is she talking about?
options: Her favorite hobby
Her journey to work
Her weekend plans
explanation:
Good morning, listeners! Today I want to share something ordinary that changed my mornings completely: the way I get to work. For years it was forty grumpy minutes on a packed bus. Then I moved, and now my journey is a walk along the canal, past the boats and the fishermen, twenty-five minutes door to door. I arrive calmer than any meditation app ever made me. Tomorrow I'll talk about my weekend plans, but today — it's all about that daily journey.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Her journey to work.
• Vì sao đúng: "Today I want to share something ordinary that changed my mornings completely: the way I get to work" và chốt "today — it's all about that daily journey".
• Her weekend plans sai: đó là chủ đề của NGÀY MAI ("Tomorrow I'll talk about my weekend plans").
• Her favorite hobby sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "what is she talking about" — bám mốc thời gian today/tomorrow. Chủ đề gắn với "tomorrow I'll talk about" luôn là bẫy.

question_text: Listen to Anna talking about her routine. Where does Anna go for a walk every morning?
options: park
neighborhood
college
explanation:
My mornings are the same all year round. I get up at six, make myself a pot of tea, and spend half an hour reading before anyone else wakes up. Then I put on my trainers and go for my walk around the college — it is quiet at that hour, and the old buildings look beautiful in the morning light. By the time I get back home, I feel ready for anything the day may bring.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – college.
• Vì sao đúng: "Then I put on my trainers and go for my walk around the college — it is quiet at that hour".
• park sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• neighborhood sai: cũng không được nhắc tới; bài chỉ nói cô đi bộ xong thì về nhà ("By the time I get back home").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "where" trong bài độc thoại thường chỉ có một địa điểm thật. Bám vào danh từ đứng ngay sau động từ của câu hỏi ("go for my walk around the...") thay vì mọi danh từ nơi chốn nghe được.

question_text: A mom is talking to her son. What does he like to study?
options: Art
Science
History
explanation:
Sweetheart, your report card came today and I want to talk about it, calmly, I promise. Your marks are fine, but your teacher wrote something interesting: she says the only lessons where you truly come alive are the art classes. The drawing, the painting, the projects — apparently you stay after class to finish them. Is that true? Because if art is what you love studying, then art is what we will support. Maybe those Saturday classes at the gallery?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Art.
• Vì sao đúng: "the only lessons where you truly come alive are the art classes. The drawing, the painting, the projects — apparently you stay after class to finish them".
• Science sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• History sai: cũng không được nhắc tới trong bài.
👉 Mẹo: khi chỉ một môn học được nêu tên, câu hỏi thực chất kiểm tra bạn có bắt được từ đó không. Chú ý các từ mở rộng cùng chủ đề (drawing, painting, gallery = art) để chắc chắn.

question_text: A tour guide is making an announcement. Why was the tour canceled
options: Not enough people
Bad weather
Transportation problems
explanation:
Good morning, everyone, and I'm afraid I have disappointing news about today's castle tour. I know you're all ready to go — the sun is finally out after yesterday's rain, and our bus is parked outside with a full tank. Unfortunately, the tour requires a minimum of twelve participants, and this morning only five of you signed up. With so few people, the company cannot run the trip. Everyone will receive a full refund at reception, and I'm truly sorry.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Not enough people.
• Vì sao đúng: "the tour requires a minimum of twelve participants, and this morning only five of you signed up. With so few people, the company cannot run the trip".
• Bad weather sai: hôm nay trời đẹp, mưa là chuyện hôm qua ("the sun is finally out after yesterday's rain").
• Transportation problems sai: xe buýt vẫn sẵn sàng và đầy xăng ("our bus is parked outside with a full tank").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "why cancelled" luôn nêu trước những thứ KHÔNG phải nguyên nhân để loại trừ. Đáp án đứng ngay sau "Unfortunately..." hoặc "The problem is...".

question_text: A man is talking about his jobs. What does the man want to do next?
options: Become a history teacher
Become a writer
Become a chef
explanation:
My CV confuses everyone, I know. Ten years as a chef — good years, but standing fourteen hours a day finally broke my back, so that door is closed for good. Then history teaching, which I loved until the paperwork swallowed my evenings. Friends keep betting on which career I'll return to. Neither! All those kitchens and classrooms left me full of stories, and I've already started typing them. My next job title, if everything goes well: writer. The first three chapters are done.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Become a writer.
• Vì sao đúng: "My next job title, if everything goes well: writer. The first three chapters are done".
• Become a chef sai: nghề cũ, đã đóng lại vĩnh viễn vì lưng hỏng ("standing fourteen hours a day finally broke my back, so that door is closed for good").
• Become a history teacher sai: cũng là quá khứ, bỏ vì giấy tờ ngốn hết buổi tối ("which I loved until the paperwork swallowed my evenings").
👉 Mẹo: cụm "My next job title is / my next chapter is" chính là câu trả lời cho "what next". Mọi nghề kèm số năm kinh nghiệm đều là chuyện đã qua.

question_text: Listen to a girl calling the cafe. What did she forget, and where did she leave it?
options: on the counter
in the corner
near the door
explanation:
Hello, is that the Riverside Café? I was sitting at your place about an hour ago and I think I left my scarf behind. I've looked everywhere in my bag. Could you check for me, please? I remember taking it off when I sat down — we were at the little table in the corner, by the bookshelf. Yes, the corner table. If you find it, I'll come by this evening to collect it. Thank you so much!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – in the corner.
• Vì sao đúng: "we were at the little table in the corner, by the bookshelf. Yes, the corner table" — cô để quên khăn ở bàn góc.
• on the counter sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• near the door sai: cũng không được nhắc tới trong bài.
👉 Mẹo: dạng gọi điện tìm đồ thất lạc, vị trí đúng hay được nhắc hai lần liên tiếp để nhấn mạnh ("in the corner... the corner table"). Nghe câu lặp lại là chốt.

question_text: A man is talking about his routine after work. What is the man going to do after work?
options: Goes running
Cycles home
Meets his client
explanation:
My colleagues think I rush home after work, but my routine is different. The moment I leave the office, I change into my sports clothes and go running along the river — five kilometres, every single day, rain or shine. It clears my head completely after all those meetings. Only after the run do I cycle slowly home, shower, and cook dinner. My doctor says it's the best habit I've ever built, and I agree.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Goes running.
• Vì sao đúng: "The moment I leave the office, I change into my sports clothes and go running along the river — five kilometres, every single day".
• Cycles home sai: việc này có thật nhưng xảy ra SAU khi chạy xong ("Only after the run do I cycle slowly home, shower, and cook dinner").
• Meets his client sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài; anh chỉ nói tới các cuộc họp đã qua ("after all those meetings").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi trình tự ("after work") — bám mốc thời gian "the moment I...", "only after..." để xếp thứ tự. Đừng chọn một việc chỉ vì nó có xuất hiện trong bài.

question_text: Listen to the announcement. When does the train leave?
explanation:
Good morning, passengers. This is an announcement regarding the express service to London. Due to engineering work completed earlier than planned, this train will now leave at nine fifteen, not nine thirty as printed in your timetable. I repeat: departure is at nine fifteen. Passengers should be on platform four at least five minutes early. The following service departs at nine forty-five for those who miss this one. Thank you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – At 9:15.
• Vì sao đúng: "this train will now leave at nine fifteen, not nine thirty as printed in your timetable. I repeat: departure is at nine fifteen".
• At 9.30 sai: là giờ in trên lịch trình cũ, đã được sửa ("not nine thirty as printed in your timetable").
• At 9.45 sai: là chuyến SAU, dành cho ai lỡ tàu này ("The following service departs at nine forty-five for those who miss this one").
👉 Mẹo: thông báo nhà ga hay dùng cấu trúc "now X, not Y as printed" kèm một chuyến kế tiếp. Chọn số ngay sau "now", bỏ số sau "as printed" và "the following service".

question_text: Listen to the woman talking about her holiday plans. Where is she going next?
options: The east
The north
The south
explanation:
My holiday map is filling up nicely this year! In spring I did the east coast — the fishing villages, the morning markets, wonderful seafood. Last month I went north for the mountain festivals, and nearly froze, but the views repaid every shiver. Now I'm packing again: next week I'm heading to the south, finally. Everyone praises the southern beaches and the little islands, and I've booked a boat trip between them. The south in September — they say it's perfect!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The south.
• Vì sao đúng: "next week I'm heading to the south, finally... The south in September — they say it's perfect!".
• The east sai: chuyến đi mùa xuân, đã xong ("In spring I did the east coast — the fishing villages, the morning markets").
• The north sai: chuyến tháng trước, cũng đã xong ("Last month I went north for the mountain festivals").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "where next" — lọc theo thì của động từ: did / went = đã đi (loại); I'm heading, next week = sắp đi (chọn).

question_text: Helen is calling a friend about the place her whole family is standing while seeing her off to college. Where are they standing?
options: library complex
university area
Residential area
explanation:
Hi! Yes, we've just arrived — the whole family came to see me off, even grandma! Where are we standing? Well, we couldn't park near the main gate, so we're in the residential area behind the campus, you know, where all the little houses are. It's actually quieter here. Dad is unloading my boxes and mum is already crying. Come and find us — the street with the red postboxes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Residential area.
• Vì sao đúng: "we couldn't park near the main gate, so we're in the residential area behind the campus, you know, where all the little houses are".
• library complex sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• university area sai: khuôn viên trường có được nhắc, nhưng chỉ để nói họ KHÔNG đỗ xe được ở đó, và chỗ đứng nằm phía SAU campus ("behind the campus").
👉 Mẹo: chú ý giới từ chỉ vị trí (behind, next to, opposite). Nghe thấy "campus/university" đừng vội chọn phương án có chữ university — "behind the campus" là bên ngoài khuôn viên.

question_text: Listening to a woman's announcement. Where will they wait for the bus?
options: Behind the hotel's main entrance
By the hotel's main entrance
By the hotel's side entrance
explanation:
Good morning, everyone, your attention please for tomorrow's departure. About the bus: I know some groups wait behind the hotel where the staff car park is — not us, the coach cannot turn there. And please don't gather at the side entrance either; it will be locked before breakfast. We will all wait by the hotel's main entrance, under the big clock, at eight sharp. By the main entrance, luggage ready. The driver will not wait for latecomers!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By the hotel's main entrance.
• Vì sao đúng: "We will all wait by the hotel's main entrance, under the big clock, at eight sharp. By the main entrance, luggage ready".
• Behind the hotel's main entrance sai: phía sau khách sạn là bãi đỗ xe nhân viên, xe khách không quay đầu được ("not us, the coach cannot turn there").
• By the hotel's side entrance sai: cửa hông sẽ bị khóa trước bữa sáng ("please don't gather at the side entrance either; it will be locked before breakfast").
👉 Mẹo: các phương án chỉ khác nhau ở giới từ (behind / by) và bộ phận (main / side). Phải nghe trọn cụm giới từ + danh từ, đừng dừng ở từ "entrance".

question_text: Two friends are talking about their favorite activities. What is the woman's favorite form of entertainment?
options: Reading books
Going to the theatre
Playing chess with her cousin
explanation:
You know me — my brother reads his thick novels every evening, and my cousin keeps inviting me to play chess with her, which I politely survive about once a month. But my heart belongs somewhere else entirely: the theatre. I go almost every Saturday — plays, musicals, even the small student performances above the pub. There is nothing like the moment the lights go down and the curtain rises. I've kept every ticket since I was twenty.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Going to the theatre.
• Vì sao đúng: "my heart belongs somewhere else entirely: the theatre. I go almost every Saturday".
• Reading books sai: đó là sở thích của ANH TRAI cô ("my brother reads his thick novels every evening").
• Playing chess with her cousin sai: cô chỉ miễn cưỡng chiều em họ mỗi tháng một lần ("my cousin keeps inviting me to play chess with her, which I politely survive about once a month").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "favorite" — tìm cụm bộc lộ cảm xúc mạnh như "my heart belongs to", "there is nothing like". Sở thích gắn với người khác (my brother, my cousin) luôn là bẫy.

question_text: Listening to Sarah leaving a message for her friend. When does she want to meet?
options: Two o'clock
Three o'clock
One o'clock
explanation:
Hi, it's Sarah! Listen, about tomorrow — I need to change our plan a little. I know we said one o'clock, but my dentist appointment got moved and I won't be free by then. I first thought two o'clock would work, but the buses at that hour are terrible. So let's meet at three o'clock instead, same café, corner table. Three o'clock, okay? Text me if that's a problem, otherwise I'll see you there. Kisses!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Three o'clock.
• Vì sao đúng: "So let's meet at three o'clock instead, same café, corner table. Three o'clock, okay?".
• One o'clock sai: giờ hẹn ban đầu, phải hủy vì lịch nha sĩ bị dời ("I know we said one o'clock, but my dentist appointment got moved and I won't be free by then").
• Two o'clock sai: cô có nghĩ tới nhưng loại vì xe buýt giờ đó rất tệ ("I first thought two o'clock would work, but the buses at that hour are terrible").
👉 Mẹo: tin nhắn đổi hẹn đi theo trình tự "giờ cũ → giờ cân nhắc → giờ mới". Giờ đúng luôn đi kèm "instead" và được nhắc lại lần hai để xác nhận.

question_text: A man is talking about his job. What does the man want to do next?
options: Become a writer
Become a chef again
Start teaching history again
explanation:
My working life has been a strange journey. I trained as a chef and spent ten years in restaurant kitchens — good years, but my back finally said no. Then I retrained and taught history at the secondary school, which I enjoyed until the marking buried me. People keep asking which one I'll go back to. Neither, actually. All those kitchens and classrooms gave me stories, and I want to write them down properly — my next chapter is a book.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Become a writer.
• Vì sao đúng: "Neither, actually. All those kitchens and classrooms gave me stories, and I want to write them down properly — my next chapter is a book".
• Become a chef again sai: nghề cũ, đã bỏ vì lưng không chịu nổi ("I trained as a chef and spent ten years in restaurant kitchens... but my back finally said no").
• Start teaching history again sai: cũng là quá khứ, bỏ vì chấm bài quá nhiều ("I enjoyed until the marking buried me").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "what next" — bắt thì tương lai (I want to / my next...). Mọi động từ chia quá khứ (trained, taught, spent ten years) đều là bẫy nghề cũ.

question_text: What will she do?
options: Go to work
Go for a drive
Stay home
explanation:
What a strange Saturday this is turning out to be! The office called asking if I could come in for a few hours — on my day off, imagine — and I said absolutely not, Saturdays are sacred. Then I thought about just staying home with a book, but the sun through the window kept teasing me. So, decision made: I'm taking the car out for a drive along the coast road, windows down, my playlist on. Maybe lunch in that fishing village. The book can wait for a rainy day!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Go for a drive.
• Vì sao đúng: "So, decision made: I'm taking the car out for a drive along the coast road, windows down, my playlist on".
• Go to work sai: cô đã từ chối lời đề nghị đi làm ngày nghỉ ("I said absolutely not, Saturdays are sacred").
• Stay home sai: có nghĩ tới nhưng bỏ vì trời quá đẹp ("I thought about just staying home with a book, but the sun through the window kept teasing me").
👉 Mẹo: kế hoạch thật luôn nằm sau cụm chốt "So, decision made / So that's settled". Hai ý trước đó, dù nghe rất hợp lý, đều đã bị loại.

question_text: Listen to a woman talking about what she has just bought. What is Dress she wears like?
options: black and white
long and white
long and red
explanation:
You will not believe what I found at the market this morning! You know I've been hunting for a dress for Mai's wedding for weeks. I almost bought that black and white one from the shop window last month — glad I waited. Today, there it was: long, deep red, exactly my size, half price because of a tiny loose thread grandma can fix in five minutes. Long and red, like something from a film! I'm wearing it tonight just to practise walking in it.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – long and red.
• Vì sao đúng: "there it was: long, deep red, exactly my size" và cô nhắc lại "Long and red, like something from a film!".
• black and white sai: đó là chiếc cô SUÝT mua tháng trước và may là đã không mua ("I almost bought that black and white one from the shop window last month — glad I waited").
• long and white sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu ghép nửa đúng nửa sai.
👉 Mẹo: đáp án mô tả đồ vật thường gồm hai đặc điểm (dáng + màu) và phải khớp CẢ HAI. Phương án nhiễu hay giữ một đặc điểm đúng rồi đổi đặc điểm còn lại.

question_text: Listen to a woman giving advice on saving money. What advice does she give to save money?
options: Buy in bulk
Use the public transport
Put money into the bank
explanation:
Today's money tip for my listeners, and it's the one I repeat the most! People expect me to say buy in bulk — but half those giant packets go stale before you finish them, I've wasted more rice than I can admit. And putting money into the bank? Sensible, but with today's interest it's storage, not saving. My real advice: use public transport! Add up petrol, parking, insurance and repairs — a monthly travel card costs a fraction of all that. Hundreds saved, every month, guaranteed.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Use the public transport.
• Vì sao đúng: "My real advice: use public transport! Add up petrol, parking, insurance and repairs — a monthly travel card costs a fraction of all that".
• Buy in bulk sai: bị bác vì đồ mua nhiều hay hỏng trước khi dùng hết ("half those giant packets go stale before you finish them").
• Put money into the bank sai: lãi suất hiện tại quá thấp, chỉ là cất giữ chứ không sinh lời ("with today's interest it's storage, not saving").
👉 Mẹo: bài tư vấn trên radio thường mở đầu bằng "People expect me to say..." — mọi thứ sau cụm đó là bẫy. Đáp án nằm sau "My real advice is".

question_text: How much are the eggs?
options: 2 pounds
3 pounds
1.50 pounds
explanation:
Welcome to the market, dear! You're asking about my eggs? Let me tell you honestly, because prices jumped everywhere this month. The supermarket wants two pounds for their pale little things, and the organic shop across the road — three pounds, daylight robbery! Mine are from my own hens, fresh this morning, and I charge one pound fifty for the box. One fifty, best eggs in the market. Take two boxes and I'll add a little honey jar for your tea!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 1.50 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "Mine are from my own hens, fresh this morning, and I charge one pound fifty for the box. One fifty, best eggs in the market".
• 2 pounds sai: đó là giá của siêu thị ("The supermarket wants two pounds for their pale little things").
• 3 pounds sai: là giá cửa hàng thực phẩm hữu cơ bên kia đường ("the organic shop across the road — three pounds, daylight robbery!").
👉 Mẹo: khi người bán so sánh giá, mỗi con số gắn với một nơi bán khác nhau. Câu hỏi hỏi giá của NGƯỜI ĐANG NÓI thì lấy số đi kèm "Mine / I charge".

question_text: An expert is talking about the lack of satisfaction at work. What should be the solution?
options: Raise the salary
Seek a new job
Request a transfer
explanation:
Many employees write to me saying the joy has gone out of their work. Let me clear away two popular wrong answers first. A raise? Money soothes for a month or two, then the same emptiness returns. Quitting for a completely new job sounds brave, but you throw away your reputation and often import the same boredom into a new office. The solution my research supports: request a transfer. Same company, new department — fresh faces and fresh problems, while your history and security stay with you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Request a transfer.
• Vì sao đúng: "The solution my research supports: request a transfer. Same company, new department — fresh faces and fresh problems".
• Raise the salary sai: chuyên gia nói tiền chỉ xoa dịu tạm thời ("Money soothes for a month or two, then the same emptiness returns").
• Seek a new job sai: bị loại vì mất uy tín đã tích lũy và thường mang theo chính sự chán nản ("you throw away your reputation and often import the same boredom into a new office").
👉 Mẹo: bài chuyên gia tư vấn luôn "clear away the wrong answers first". Đáp án nằm sau từ hiệu lệnh "The solution is / What actually works is"; mọi ý trước đó đều là phương án bị bác.

question_text: Listen to a man talking about their train journey. What time did the train depart?
explanation:
What a morning we had! Our train was timetabled for nine o'clock sharp, and we were on the platform early like good tourists. Then came the announcement: a signal problem, everything delayed. Some passengers heard ten o'clock and started queuing for refunds. In the end the train actually left at nine thirty — only half an hour late, which these days almost counts as punctual. We still made our connection, just barely.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 9:30.
• Vì sao đúng: "In the end the train actually left at nine thirty — only half an hour late".
• 9:00 sai: đó là giờ theo LỊCH in trên vé ("Our train was timetabled for nine o'clock sharp"), tàu không chạy đúng giờ đó.
• 10:00 sai: chỉ là tin đồn giữa hành khách ("Some passengers heard ten o'clock and started queuing for refunds").
👉 Mẹo: với giờ tàu/máy bay, tách ba lớp thông tin: giờ theo lịch (timetabled/scheduled), giờ đồn (some passengers heard), giờ thật (actually left). Chỉ giờ đi kèm "actually" mới là đáp án.

question_text: A finance expert is giving advice to young people. What shouldn't they do?
options: Spend too much on clothes.
Ask for more money.
Save for emergencies.
explanation:
A word to the young people in the room about money. Buying nice clothes now and then is perfectly fine — enjoy your salary, you earned it. And saving for emergencies is not just allowed, it is essential: three months of expenses in a separate account, always. But here is the habit that ruins independence: whenever the month runs long, calling home and asking for more money. Don't. Learn to live inside what you earn, and your confidence will grow with your savings.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Ask for more money.
• Vì sao đúng: câu hỏi hỏi điều KHÔNG nên làm — "here is the habit that ruins independence: whenever the month runs long, calling home and asking for more money. Don't".
• Spend too much on clothes sai: mua quần áo đẹp thỉnh thoảng được chuyên gia cho phép ("Buying nice clothes now and then is perfectly fine — enjoy your salary").
• Save for emergencies sai: đây là việc BẮT BUỘC phải làm ("saving for emergencies is not just allowed, it is essential").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi phủ định ("What shouldn't they do?") — tìm mệnh lệnh cấm "Don't", "never", "the habit that ruins...". Những gì đi kèm "fine", "essential" là điều NÊN làm.

question_text: A man is talking to a shop assistant. What does the man buy in the shop?
options: Mugs
Candles
Clothes
explanation:
Woman: Good afternoon! Looking for anything special?
Man: A birthday present for my wife. I saw those printed mugs in your window — she collects them, but honestly she has forty already.
Woman: Then perhaps not mug number forty-one! What about clothes? We have lovely scarves.
Man: I never get her size right — last time was a disaster. What are those on the shelf there?
Woman: Our handmade candles — lavender, vanilla, sea salt. They burn for sixty hours, and the jars are reusable.
Man: She lights candles every single evening, actually. Perfect. I'll take the lavender set, gift-wrapped please.
Woman: Wonderful choice. She'll love them.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Candles.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'll take the lavender set, gift-wrapped please" — ngay sau khi nhân viên giới thiệu "Our handmade candles — lavender, vanilla, sea salt".
• Mugs sai: vợ anh đã có bốn mươi chiếc ("she collects them, but honestly she has forty already").
• Clothes sai: anh sợ chọn sai size như lần trước ("I never get her size right — last time was a disaster").
👉 Mẹo: trong hội thoại mua quà, hãy đợi câu có động từ mua thật ("I'll take..."). Mọi món trước đó chỉ là bước sàng lọc, dù được khen nhiều đến đâu.

question_text: A man is calling his wife. Where will they meet?
options: At home
In the garden
Outside the shop
explanation:
Man: Hi darling, I've finished at the bank early. Where shall we meet?
Woman: Oh good! I'm still at the market. Shall I just see you at home?
Man: I'd rather not sit around waiting — I'm already in town. What about the garden café near the fountain?
Woman: It's closed on Mondays, remember? We found that out last week.
Man: Ah, you're right. Then let's keep it simple: I'll wait for you outside the shop — the big bookshop on the corner, our usual spot.
Woman: Outside the shop it is. Give me fifteen minutes. If I'm late, start browsing without me!
Man: I always do. See you soon.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Outside the shop.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'll wait for you outside the shop — the big bookshop on the corner, our usual spot" và cô đồng ý "Outside the shop it is".
• At home sai: người chồng không muốn ngồi chờ vì đã ở trong phố rồi ("I'd rather not sit around waiting — I'm already in town").
• In the garden sai: quán cà phê sân vườn đóng cửa thứ Hai ("It's closed on Mondays, remember?").
👉 Mẹo: nghe cấu trúc đảo ngữ xác nhận "... it is" (Outside the shop it is) — đây là dấu hiệu chốt phương án rất hay gặp trong hội thoại Part 1.

question_text: Lalia is talking to her friend about her upcoming trip. How much does she think the bus fare will be?
explanation:
Man: So, Lalia, is everything ready for your trip tomorrow?
Woman: Almost! I'm just working out my money for the day. The big cost is the bus to the coast.
Man: My cousin did that route last month — he paid four fifty, I think.
Woman: That was the express with the reserved seats! I'm taking the ordinary morning bus.
Man: Ah. Someone told me that one costs three pounds now, after the price rise.
Woman: They raised it, yes, but only on weekends. Tomorrow is Tuesday, so I think the fare will be two pounds fifty, same as always. I've kept the exact coins ready!
Man: Organised as ever. Send me photos from the beach!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – £2.5.
• Vì sao đúng: câu hỏi hỏi cô ấy NGHĨ giá bao nhiêu — "Tomorrow is Tuesday, so I think the fare will be two pounds fifty, same as always".
• £3 sai: đó là giá sau khi tăng nhưng chỉ áp dụng cuối tuần ("They raised it, yes, but only on weekends").
• £4.5 sai: là giá xe express có ghế đặt trước, không phải xe buýt thường cô đi ("That was the express with the reserved seats!").
👉 Mẹo: đọc kỹ câu hỏi — "how much does she THINK" nên đáp án phải là con số cô ấy nói kèm "I think", không phải con số do người khác đưa ra.

question_text: Pierre and Emma are talking together about the picnic on the weekend. What will they bring to the picnic?
options: Drinks
Salads
Food
explanation:
Woman: Pierre! Are you coming to the picnic on Saturday?
Man: Of course, Emma. I'm trying to work out what we should bring. Marie already claimed the drinks — she's bringing lemonade and juice for everyone.
Woman: And I heard Tom's girlfriend is making her big salads, the ones with the walnuts.
Man: Right, so drinks and salads are taken. That leaves us the main food — sandwiches, the chicken, maybe those little pies from the bakery you like.
Woman: Perfect, we'll handle the food then. I'll cook the chicken Friday night, you get the bread and pies Saturday morning.
Man: Done. Food from us, and we take your car. Nine o'clock?
Woman: Nine o'clock. Don't oversleep, Pierre!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Food.
• Vì sao đúng: "That leaves us the main food — sandwiches, the chicken, maybe those little pies" và cô chốt "Perfect, we'll handle the food then".
• Drinks sai: Marie đã nhận phần này ("Marie already claimed the drinks — she's bringing lemonade and juice for everyone").
• Salads sai: bạn gái của Tom lo ("Tom's girlfriend is making her big salads, the ones with the walnuts").
👉 Mẹo: dạng phân công đồ mang đi — nghe cụm "already claimed / is making" gắn với TÊN NGƯỜI KHÁC để loại. Phần của người nói đứng sau "That leaves us...".

question_text: Two colleges talk about meeting. When do they want to meet?
options: On Tuesday
On Sunday
On Saturday
explanation:
Man: We really need to sit down about the project. When works for you?
Woman: This week is madness. Saturday? I'm free after lunch.
Man: Saturday I'm at my nephew's birthday, sadly. Sunday then?
Woman: Sunday my parents visit, it's sacred. What about next week, early?
Man: Tuesday? The office is quiet on Tuesdays, we'd have the meeting room to ourselves.
Woman: Tuesday... yes, actually. Nine o'clock, before the phones start ringing?
Man: Perfect. Tuesday at nine, meeting room, coffee on me.
Woman: Deal. I'll bring the folders.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On Tuesday.
• Vì sao đúng: "Tuesday? The office is quiet on Tuesdays, we'd have the meeting room to ourselves" – "Tuesday... yes, actually" – "Perfect. Tuesday at nine".
• On Saturday sai: anh bận dự sinh nhật cháu ("Saturday I'm at my nephew's birthday, sadly").
• On Sunday sai: cô có bố mẹ tới thăm, không thể đổi ("Sunday my parents visit, it's sacred").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "when do they meet" — theo dõi tới khi thấy một mốc được CẢ HAI đồng ý và kèm chi tiết bổ sung (giờ cụ thể, phòng họp). Đó mới là chốt.

question_text: A man is talking to a shopping assistant. What color top is he going to buy?
options: Green
Blue
Black
explanation:
Woman: Good morning! Are you looking for anything special today?
Man: Yes, I need a new top — something for the office, but not too formal.
Woman: Of course. This green one is very popular at the moment. The colour suits most people, and it's twenty percent off this week.
Man: Hmm, green is a bit bright for me, to be honest. My wife says it doesn't match anything else I own. What about that blue one on the shelf?
Woman: Good choice — that one is pure cotton. But I should tell you we only have it in large, and I think you need a medium.
Man: Ah, that's a shame, it's a lovely colour. What's that darker one hanging at the back?
Woman: The black one? That's the same style as the blue, and we have every size.
Man: Perfect. Black goes with everything anyway. I'll take it in a medium, please.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Black.
• Vì sao đúng: "Black goes with everything anyway. I'll take it in a medium, please" — động từ mua thật nằm ở câu này.
• Green sai: anh chê màu quá chói và vợ nói không hợp đồ ("green is a bit bright for me... My wife says it doesn't match anything else I own").
• Blue sai: hết cỡ vừa, chỉ còn size lớn ("we only have it in large, and I think you need a medium").
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại mua sắm luôn duyệt đủ 3 món. Món đúng là món đi kèm hành động mua ("I'll take it", "I'll have that one"), không phải món được nhân viên khen nhiều nhất.

question_text: Nate is on the phone with his friend. How long does Nate stay in India?
options: 3 days
1 week
2 weeks
explanation:
Woman: Nate! I heard you're finally doing the India trip. How long will you be gone?
Man: It's happening! You know, the original plan was just three days for the wedding in Delhi.
Woman: Three days for India? That would be criminal.
Man: Exactly what my cousin said! So I looked at one week — wedding plus the Taj Mahal and Jaipur.
Woman: And? I hear something bigger in your voice.
Man: My boss approved all my remaining leave this morning. So it's official: two weeks! Wedding, the golden triangle, and five days in Kerala on the backwaters.
Woman: Two weeks in India! I'm officially jealous. Bring me tea from the mountains!
Man: A whole box, promised.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 2 weeks.
• Vì sao đúng: "My boss approved all my remaining leave this morning. So it's official: two weeks!".
• 3 days sai: là kế hoạch ban đầu, chỉ để dự đám cưới ("the original plan was just three days for the wedding in Delhi").
• 1 week sai: là phương án trung gian anh từng cân nhắc ("So I looked at one week — wedding plus the Taj Mahal and Jaipur").
👉 Mẹo: dạng kế hoạch "nở dần" (3 ngày → 1 tuần → 2 tuần) — đáp án là con số cuối cùng, thường đi kèm "it's official", "in the end", "so it's settled".

question_text: A man is calling his sister. Where will they meet?
options: At the station
At the park
At the university
explanation:
M: Hi, how are you?
W: Oh! Are you calling from America?
M: No, I've been visiting the London office for a few days. Do you want to meet up? I have to catch a train at three.
W: Yes! There's a park near my flat. The weather's lovely and sunny, and there are lots of people around. Do you want to meet there?
M: Sure. Then I can walk you to your university afterwards — I don't have to be at the station until three.
W: OK, see you soon.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – At the park.
• Vì sao đúng: cô đề nghị "There's a park near my flat... Do you want to meet there?" và anh đồng ý "Sure".
• At the station sai: đó là nơi anh phải đến lúc 3 giờ SAU khi gặp.
• At the university sai: anh chỉ đi bộ đưa cô đến đó sau, không phải điểm hẹn.
👉 Mẹo: cả 3 địa điểm đều xuất hiện — chọn nơi có "meet there" + "Sure".

question_text: A man is calling his friend, Maria. When will he see her?
options: at 9 am on Sunday
at 10 am on Saturday
at 8 am on Sunday
explanation:
Man: Maria! It's been months! When can I finally see you?
Woman: I know, I know. This weekend? Saturday I'm free after ten in the morning.
Man: Saturday's no good for me — I work until evening. What about Sunday?
Woman: Sunday works. But not too late, I have dinner with my parents.
Man: Early then. Eight in the morning? There's that breakfast place by the lake.
Woman: Eight is brutal, let's say nine. Nine on Sunday, the lake café.
Man: Nine on Sunday it is. I'll book the table by the window. So good to hear your voice!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – at 9 am on Sunday.
• Vì sao đúng: "Nine on Sunday, the lake café" và anh xác nhận "Nine on Sunday it is".
• at 10 am on Saturday sai: thứ Bảy anh phải làm tới tối ("Saturday's no good for me — I work until evening").
• at 8 am on Sunday sai: cô chê quá sớm và đẩy lùi một tiếng ("Eight is brutal, let's say nine").
👉 Mẹo: đáp án dạng "ngày + giờ" phải khớp CẢ HAI yếu tố. Chốt được ngày rồi vẫn phải nghe tiếp, vì giờ thường bị dời thêm một lần ở lượt thoại cuối.

question_text: A man is talking on the phone. What did the man lose?
options: Jacket
Glasses
Books
explanation:
Man: Hi love, it's me. Quick question — have you seen my things anywhere at home?
Woman: Which things? Your jacket is here, hanging by the door where you left it.
Man: No no, the jacket I have — I'm wearing it. And my books are in the car, I already checked.
Woman: Then what's missing?
Man: My glasses! I've searched the whole office, my bag, everywhere. I can't read a single document without them.
Woman: Did you check the bathroom shelf? You left them there yesterday too.
Man: The bathroom... of course. Can you look? I'll wait.
Woman: Found them! Next to your razor, as always. Honestly, you'd lose your own head.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Glasses.
• Vì sao đúng: "My glasses! I've searched the whole office, my bag, everywhere" — và vợ tìm thấy trên kệ nhà tắm ("Found them! Next to your razor, as always").
• Jacket sai: áo khoác anh đang mặc trên người ("the jacket I have — I'm wearing it").
• Books sai: sách nằm trong xe và anh đã kiểm tra ("my books are in the car, I already checked").
👉 Mẹo: dạng tìm đồ thất lạc — hai món nhiễu bị loại rất nhanh bằng "I have it / I already checked". Món đúng đi kèm câu than phiền dài và dấu chấm than.

question_text: A man is calling his teacher to meet for the assignment. When is the meeting?
options: On Thursday afternoon
On Tuesday morning
On Thursday morning
explanation:
Man: Good afternoon, Professor. I'm calling about my assignment — could we meet to discuss it?
Woman: Of course. Let me look at my diary. Tuesday morning I have a faculty meeting, so that's out.
Man: I understand. What about Thursday? I'm free all day.
Woman: Thursday afternoon I teach until six... but Thursday morning is open. Ten o'clock?
Man: Thursday morning at ten, perfect. Your office?
Woman: My office, third floor. Bring your draft and the reading list.
Man: I will. Thank you, Professor — see you Thursday morning!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – On Thursday morning.
• Vì sao đúng: "Thursday morning is open. Ten o'clock?" – "Thursday morning at ten, perfect".
• On Tuesday morning sai: cô giáo có họp khoa ("Tuesday morning I have a faculty meeting, so that's out").
• On Thursday afternoon sai: chiều thứ Năm cô dạy đến 6h ("Thursday afternoon I teach until six").
👉 Mẹo: khi các phương án cùng một ngày nhưng khác buổi, phải nghe trọn cụm "ngày + morning/afternoon". Chỉ nghe được chữ "Thursday" là dính bẫy ngay.

question_text: A teacher and a student are talking about transportation. How does the teacher go to school?
options: He drives
He takes the bus
He walks
explanation:
Man: You look surprised to see me on foot, Minh!
Woman: Sorry, teacher! I always imagined you driving to school. Most teachers park in the yard.
Man: I used to drive, actually, years ago. Then the parking became impossible and petrol got so expensive.
Woman: So you take the bus now, like us students?
Man: I tried the bus for one term — twenty minutes of squeezing and pushing every morning. No, thank you. These days I simply walk. It's forty minutes each way, my doctor is delighted, and I arrive with a clear head.
Woman: Forty minutes! Every day?
Man: Every day, rain or shine. Best decision I've made. You should try it — you live closer than I do!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – He walks.
• Vì sao đúng: "These days I simply walk. It's forty minutes each way, my doctor is delighted" — và ông xác nhận "Every day, rain or shine".
• He drives sai: đó là chuyện quá khứ, đã bỏ vì khó đỗ xe và xăng đắt ("I used to drive, actually, years ago").
• He takes the bus sai: chỉ thử một học kỳ rồi bỏ ("I tried the bus for one term — twenty minutes of squeezing and pushing every morning. No, thank you").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi phương tiện đi lại hiện tại — bám cụm chỉ thời gian "these days / now", loại mọi thứ đi kèm "used to / I tried... for one term".

question_text: A man is calling his colleague about a meeting with clients. When will the meeting start?
explanation:
Man: Hi Anna, about tomorrow's meeting with the clients — is everything confirmed?
Woman: Almost. They first suggested nine fifteen, but their flight only lands at nine.
Man: That's tight. So we pushed it back?
Woman: Yes. I offered eleven fifteen, but Mr. Chen has a lunch appointment, so that was too late for him.
Man: So where did we land?
Woman: Ten fifteen. It gives them time from the airport, and we finish well before lunch. Meeting room two, projector's already booked.
Man: Ten fifteen, room two. I'll bring the printed contracts. Thanks, Anna — you think of everything.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – at 10.15.
• Vì sao đúng: "Ten fifteen. It gives them time from the airport, and we finish well before lunch" — người kia nhắc lại "Ten fifteen, room two".
• at 9.15 sai: là giờ khách đề xuất ban đầu, nhưng máy bay 9h mới hạ cánh nên quá gấp ("They first suggested nine fifteen, but their flight only lands at nine").
• at 11.15 sai: quá muộn vì ông Chen có hẹn ăn trưa ("I offered eleven fifteen, but Mr. Chen has a lunch appointment").
👉 Mẹo: khi ba mốc giờ chỉ lệch nhau đúng một tiếng (9.15/10.15/11.15), đừng cố nghe con số — nghe LÝ DO loại trừ đi kèm mỗi mốc thì chắc hơn nhiều.

question_text: Tom is calling his friend. What time will they meet?
options: 6 PM
5 PM
7 PM
explanation:
Man: Hey, it's Tom! Are we still on for tonight?
Woman: Definitely. What time were you thinking?
Man: Well, I finish work at five, so five o'clock is impossible for me — I'd still be at my desk.
Woman: And I have my yoga class until six, so six doesn't work for me either.
Man: Right. Then let's say seven? That gives you time to shower and me time to cross town.
Woman: Seven is perfect. The new noodle place on Green Street?
Man: Exactly the one. I'll book a table for seven o'clock. See you there!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 7 PM.
• Vì sao đúng: "Then let's say seven?" – "Seven is perfect" – "I'll book a table for seven o'clock".
• 5 PM sai: giờ đó anh vẫn còn ở bàn làm việc ("I finish work at five, so five o'clock is impossible for me").
• 6 PM sai: cô có lớp yoga đến 6h ("I have my yoga class until six, so six doesn't work for me either").
👉 Mẹo: trong hội thoại hẹn giờ, mỗi mốc bị loại đều kèm lý do cá nhân ("impossible for me", "doesn't work for me either"). Giờ đúng là giờ được cả hai đồng ý và có hành động đặt bàn kèm theo.

question_text: Two friends are discussing a movie they recently watched. What elements of the film do they agree on?
options: The music
The ending
The characters
explanation:
M: So — last night's film! Give me your honest review.
W: Mixed, honestly. The music first: that piano theme carried the whole story for me.
M: Really? The music kept drowning the dialogue — I missed half the lines because of it.
W: Philistine. The characters, then? The old captain was wonderful.
M: He mumbled for two hours! I couldn't warm to any of them, honestly.
W: We agree on nothing, as usual. Except... admit it about the ending.
M: Ah, the ending. The silent scene on the bridge? I sat through the credits without moving.
W: Same! I actually gasped. So: music no, characters no — but the ending, we both loved.
M: The ending was perfect. One out of three — that's harmony for us!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The ending.
• Vì sao đúng: cả hai cùng khen phần kết — "The silent scene on the bridge? I sat through the credits without moving" / "Same! I actually gasped", và tổng kết "the ending, we both loved".
• The music sai: hai người trái ngược — cô khen chủ đề piano, anh chê nhạc át lời thoại ("The music kept drowning the dialogue — I missed half the lines").
• The characters sai: cô khen ông thuyền trưởng, anh chê lí nhí và không thấy gần gũi ("He mumbled for two hours! I couldn't warm to any of them").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "agree on" — nghe các dấu hiệu bất đồng (Really? / I couldn't...) để loại, rồi bắt cụm đồng thuận: "Same!", "Exactly", "we both loved".

question_text: A woman is talking about her house. What is she going to change in their house?
options: The window
The car
The computer
explanation:
Woman: I've been thinking about the house again. Something has to change this year.
Man: Here we go. The car? You said the engine sounds tired.
Woman: The car is fine, it just needs a service. And before you ask — no, not the computer either. It's slow, but it works, and the children barely use it now anyway.
Man: Then what?
