--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – She walks.
• Vì sao đúng: "So now I simply walk. Thirty-five minutes through the old town, past the bakery that gives me the day's first smile".
• She drives sai: cô đã bán xe hồi mùa xuân vì phí đỗ xe quá đắt ("I sold the car in spring, parking near the school was theft in slow motion").
• She takes the bus sai: chỉ thử một học kỳ rồi bỏ vì phải đổi tuyến và chờ lâu ("I tried it for a term: two changes, twenty minutes of waiting, packed like sardines").
👉 Mẹo: dạng phương tiện đi lại — từ khóa "now / these days" chỉ hiện tại; "sold", "I tried it for a term" là quá khứ đã bỏ.

question_text: What is the man going to do?
options: Get something to eat
Go to sleep
Get something to drink
explanation:
What a marathon of a day — three meetings, zero breaks, and my stomach has filed a formal complaint! The sofa is calling for a nap, I know, but if I sleep now I'll be awake at three in the morning, no thank you. And I did think about just pouring a big cold drink first... but honestly, liquid won't silence this hunger. No — straight to the kitchen, I'm getting something to eat. There's leftover noodles with my name on them. Food first, world later!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Get something to eat.
• Vì sao đúng: "straight to the kitchen, I'm getting something to eat. There's leftover noodles with my name on them. Food first, world later!".
• Go to sleep sai: bị gạt vì ngủ giờ này sẽ tỉnh lúc 3h sáng — "if I sleep now I'll be awake at three in the morning, no thank you".
• Get something to drink sai: có nghĩ tới nhưng không giải quyết được cơn đói — "I did think about just pouring a big cold drink first... but honestly, liquid won't silence this hunger".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "What is he going to do?", bám thì hiện tại tiếp diễn chỉ tương lai gần ("I'm getting..."). Ý đi kèm "I did think about... but" là bị loại.

question_text: Listen to a student explaining the project. Why did the students do the experiment on the tree?
options: To study the effects of pollution
To measure the speed of the plant's growth
To observe how trees absorb water
explanation:
For our science project this term, our group worked with the old oak tree behind the school. Let me explain what we were trying to find out. We put special filters on the leaves and collected samples every week, because we wanted to study the effects of pollution — our school is right next to the main road, and we wanted to see what the traffic is doing to the tree. The results surprised everyone, and our teacher has sent them to the town council.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To study the effects of pollution.
• Vì sao đúng: "we wanted to study the effects of pollution — our school is right next to the main road, and we wanted to see what the traffic is doing to the tree".
• To measure the speed of the plant's growth sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• To observe how trees absorb water sai: cũng không được nhắc tới; bài chỉ nói đặt màng lọc lên lá và lấy mẫu hằng tuần — "We put special filters on the leaves and collected samples every week".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi mục đích thí nghiệm, bám cụm "because we wanted to...". Đừng suy diễn từ chi tiết dụng cụ (lá, mẫu) sang một mục đích khác.

question_text: Vincent is calling James. Why does Vincent call James?
options: Invite him to a party
Suggest a drink
Ask for help
explanation:
James, it's Vincent! Don't panic, I'm not calling to ask for help with moving the furniture again — that's all done, my back survived. And before you ask, no, this is not about Sarah's party either, I know you already said you can't come to that. This is much simpler: it's been months since we properly talked, so how about a drink on Thursday evening? The little place near the bridge, seven o'clock, first round on me. Call me back!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Suggest a drink.
• Vì sao đúng: "This is much simpler: it's been months since we properly talked, so how about a drink on Thursday evening? The little place near the bridge, seven o'clock".
• Ask for help sai: bị phủ định ngay đầu, việc chuyển đồ đã xong — "I'm not calling to ask for help with moving the furniture again — that's all done".
• Invite him to a party sai: cũng bị loại vì James đã từ chối tiệc của Sarah — "this is not about Sarah's party either, I know you already said you can't come to that".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi mục đích cuộc gọi, người gọi hay loại trừ 2 khả năng trước. Đáp án nằm ngay sau "This is much simpler:" hoặc "The real reason I'm calling".

question_text: A woman is talking about her old manager. Why did she like George?
options: He looked after his staff
He was friendly
He taught her a lot
explanation:
A lot of people don't like their managers, but that wasn't the case for me. My manager George was really good at his job — he helped me know what to do in difficult times. He was a friendly manager, and he looked after his staff, too. But those aren't the main reasons I liked him. He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – He taught her a lot.
• Vì sao đúng: "He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most".
• He was friendly / He looked after his staff sai: đều được nhắc nhưng bị gạt — "those aren't the main reasons".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "nhắc cả 3 rồi loại 2" — đáp án nằm sau "But... the main reason" / "That's what mattered most".

question_text: A man is talking about his daily routine. What does he do after work?
options: Go home
Go to the coffee shop
Play football
explanation:
My daily routine has one golden hour, and it happens right after work. My colleagues always head to the coffee shop downstairs — I skip it; coffee after five keeps me staring at the ceiling till two in the morning. And going straight home? I did that for years: sofa, screen, sleep, repeat. Never again. Now, every evening at five thirty, I play football — five-a-side on the pitch behind the depot, ninety minutes of running and shouting with the lads. Cheapest therapy in town, and I sleep like a baby.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Play football.
• Vì sao đúng: "Now, every evening at five thirty, I play football — five-a-side on the pitch behind the depot, ninety minutes of running and shouting with the lads".
• Go to the coffee shop sai: đó là thói quen của đồng nghiệp, anh bỏ qua vì cà phê sau 5h làm mất ngủ — "My colleagues always head to the coffee shop downstairs — I skip it".
• Go home sai: là thói quen CŨ đã bỏ hẳn — "And going straight home? I did that for years: sofa, screen, sleep, repeat. Never again".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi thói quen hiện tại, bám mốc "Now", "every evening". Ý gắn với "I did that for years", "never again" là quá khứ đã bỏ.

question_text: Listen to the announcement. When does the train leave the station?
explanation:
Your attention please, passengers for the coastal express. There has been a platform change and a small schedule correction this morning. The departure board still shows nine o'clock — that was cancelled after the engineering delay. And ignore the nine thirty rumour circulating in the waiting hall; that is tomorrow's schedule. Today, the train leaves the station at nine fifteen precisely, from platform six. Nine fifteen, platform six. Please board at least five minutes early. Thank you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 9:15.
• Vì sao đúng: "Today, the train leaves the station at nine fifteen precisely, from platform six. Nine fifteen, platform six".
• 9:00 sai: là giờ trên bảng điện tử nhưng đã bị hủy ("The departure board still shows nine o'clock — that was cancelled after the engineering delay").
• 9:30 sai: là lịch của NGÀY MAI, chỉ là tin đồn trong phòng chờ ("ignore the nine thirty rumour circulating in the waiting hall; that is tomorrow's schedule").
👉 Mẹo: thông báo nhà ga có ba lớp thông tin: bảng điện tử (cũ), tin đồn, và giờ thật. Chọn giờ đi kèm "Today... precisely" và được lặp lại cùng số sân ga.

question_text: How much can Max pay for the computer?
options: 200 pounds
250 pounds
300 pounds
explanation:
Hey, it's Max again about the computer! I've done my sums properly this time, so here's my honest offer. Three hundred, like you're asking — I simply don't have it, not this month. And forget my first silly offer of two hundred, that was before payday, I apologise. Right now, cash in hand, I can pay two hundred and fifty pounds. Two fifty, final and real. If that works, I'll collect it tonight and even bring the pizza. Let me know!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "Right now, cash in hand, I can pay two hundred and fifty pounds. Two fifty, final and real".
• 200 pounds sai: là lời trả giá đầu tiên đã bị chính Max rút lại ("forget my first silly offer of two hundred, that was before payday, I apologise").
• 300 pounds sai: là giá người bán đưa ra, Max không kham nổi ("Three hundred, like you're asking — I simply don't have it, not this month").
👉 Mẹo: phân biệt ba vai của con số: giá người bán đòi (you're asking), giá trả hụt (my first offer), giá thật (I can pay). Câu hỏi "how much can he pay" chỉ lấy vai thứ ba.

question_text: Where does she go shopping?
options: at a new shopping mall
at a department store
at a local market
explanation:
My shopping routine changed completely this spring! For years I dragged myself to the old department store in the centre — decent, but the same tired brands on every floor. My neighbour swears by the local market, and I do buy vegetables there, but for clothes and homeware? No. Since they opened the new shopping mall by the river, that's my place: eighty shops, a cinema, that glass roof! I go every Saturday morning now, before the crowds. My husband calls it my second home!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – at a new shopping mall.
• Vì sao đúng: "Since they opened the new shopping mall by the river, that's my place: eighty shops, a cinema... I go every Saturday morning now".
• at a department store sai: đó là thói quen CŨ nhiều năm trước, hàng hóa nhàm chán ("For years I dragged myself to the old department store in the centre — the same tired brands").
• at a local market sai: cô chỉ mua rau ở đó, không mua quần áo và đồ gia dụng ("I do buy vegetables there, but for clothes and homeware? No").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi thói quen hiện tại — bám cụm "since... now", loại "for years / used to". Cũng cảnh giác phương án đúng một phần (chợ: chỉ mua rau) vì vẫn tính là sai.

question_text: A woman is talking about her job. How is being an artist different from other jobs?
options: She works 9 to 5
She works at irregular times
She works at a desk all day
explanation:
Being an artist confuses my family endlessly. My brother clocks in nine to five, sees his desk, knows his lunch hour — my mother wishes I had that. Others imagine I sit at some desk all day sketching; in truth I barely own a desk, I paint standing, walking, on trains. The real shape of my job? There is none. When a commission burns, I work eighteen-hour days; between projects, I wander galleries on a Tuesday noon. Irregular hours — that's the artist's clock.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – She works at irregular times.
• Vì sao đúng: "When a commission burns, I work eighteen-hour days; between projects, I wander galleries on a Tuesday noon. Irregular hours — that's the artist's clock".
• She works 9 to 5 sai: đó là giờ giấc của em trai cô ấy, không phải của cô — "My brother clocks in nine to five, sees his desk, knows his lunch hour".
• She works at a desk all day sai: cô bác bỏ — "Others imagine I sit at some desk all day sketching; in truth I barely own a desk, I paint standing, walking, on trains".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "How is X different from...", cẩn thận thông tin gán cho NGƯỜI KHÁC (my brother, others imagine). Đáp án luôn là câu nói về chính người kể.

question_text: Anna is calling her brother Max. What does Anna do later in the afternoon?
options: Pick up the kids
Stay late at the office
Hang out with friends
explanation:
Max, it's Anna. Small change of plan for today, so listen carefully. The big project is due tomorrow morning, and my part isn't finished, so this afternoon I'll be staying late at the office — probably until eight or nine. That means I can't do the school run, so could you collect the kids at four? Their bags are already packed, and dinner is in the fridge. I'll make it up to you at the weekend, I promise. You're the best, thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Stay late at the office.
• Vì sao đúng: "The big project is due tomorrow morning, and my part isn't finished, so this afternoon I'll be staying late at the office — probably until eight or nine".
• Pick up the kids sai: đó là việc cô NHỜ Max làm, không phải việc của Anna — "I can't do the school run, so could you collect the kids at four?".
• Hang out with friends sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "AI làm gì", tách rõ chủ ngữ. Việc đi sau "could you...?" là việc của người NGHE, không phải người nói.

question_text: What's the main change managers are going to do?
options: Adjust the schedule
Reduce the budget
Relocate the meeting
explanation:
Team, quick summary of what the managers decided yesterday, so nobody is surprised on Monday. First — the budget stays exactly as it is; the rumours about cuts are wrong. Second — the meeting stays in our usual building; moving it across town was discussed and rejected. The real change is the schedule: the weekly meeting moves from Monday morning to Wednesday afternoon, and the deadlines shift with it. Check the new calendar tonight, and update your diaries. That's all — enjoy the weekend!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Adjust the schedule.
• Vì sao đúng: "The real change is the schedule: the weekly meeting moves from Monday morning to Wednesday afternoon, and the deadlines shift with it".
• Reduce the budget sai: ngân sách giữ nguyên, tin đồn cắt giảm là sai — "the budget stays exactly as it is; the rumours about cuts are wrong".
• Relocate the meeting sai: phương án chuyển địa điểm đã bị bác — "moving it across town was discussed and rejected".
👉 Mẹo: dạng thông báo "thay đổi chính là gì", nghe cụm "The real change is...". Ý đi kèm "stays exactly as it is", "was rejected" nghĩa là KHÔNG đổi.

question_text: What is the new health center next to?
options: A bus station
A train station
An airport
explanation:
Residents, quick update from the town council newsletter — the new health centre location is confirmed! I know the early plans put it beside the airport, but the noise studies buried that idea fast, imagine hearing jets during a check-up! Others swore it would rise next to the bus station downtown — wrong again, that plot stays a car park. The final decision: the health centre will stand right next to the train station. Perfect for commuters, five minutes from every platform. Construction starts in spring!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A train station.
• Vì sao đúng: "The final decision: the health centre will stand right next to the train station. Perfect for commuters, five minutes from every platform".
• A bus station sai: chỉ là tin đồn, khu đất đó vẫn để làm bãi đỗ xe — "Others swore it would rise next to the bus station downtown — wrong again, that plot stays a car park".
• An airport sai: là kế hoạch ban đầu, bị bỏ vì tiếng ồn máy bay — "the early plans put it beside the airport, but the noise studies buried that idea fast".
👉 Mẹo: dạng thông báo địa điểm, bám cụm "The final decision". Nơi đi kèm "the early plans", "others swore", "wrong again" đều bị loại.

question_text: A girl is talking about a show she will attend. What will it end with?
options: A surprise performance
A speech
A firework display
explanation:
Saturday's show is going to be special — my sister helped organise it, so I know the secrets! People assume it closes with the mayor's speech, but no, they moved all the talking to the very start, mercifully short. Others expect a firework display; the theatre's roof says absolutely not, fire regulations. What actually ends the night — and keep this between us — is a surprise performance. All the teachers, in costume, doing a full dance number they've rehearsed in secret for months. Last year's finale made the front page!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – A surprise performance.
• Vì sao đúng: "What actually ends the night — and keep this between us — is a surprise performance. All the teachers, in costume, doing a full dance number".
• A speech sai: phần phát biểu đã được chuyển lên ĐẦU chương trình — "they moved all the talking to the very start, mercifully short".
• A firework display sai: bị cấm vì quy định phòng cháy của nhà hát — "the theatre's roof says absolutely not, fire regulations".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "end with" là hỏi TRẬT TỰ thời gian, không chỉ nghe từ khóa. "Moved to the very start" nghĩa là mục đó không còn nằm ở cuối.

question_text: A woman is talking about her usual Saturday routine. What does she usually do on Saturdays?
options: Goes shopping
Sees her family
Goes to a birthday party
explanation:
My Saturdays follow a sacred pattern, ask anyone who knows me! People assume I spend them shopping — wrong, I do all that online on Wednesday nights, crowds terrify me. Birthday parties happen maybe monthly, hardly a routine. No, every Saturday, without fail, I see my family. Morning coffee at grandma's, lunch at my parents', afternoon chaos with my sister's twins. Three houses, one street, forty years of tradition. Saturday is family day — the world can wait until Monday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Sees her family.
• Vì sao đúng: "every Saturday, without fail, I see my family. Morning coffee at grandma's, lunch at my parents', afternoon chaos with my sister's twins".
• Goes shopping sai: cô mua online vào tối thứ Tư vì sợ đám đông — "wrong, I do all that online on Wednesday nights, crowds terrify me".
• Goes to a birthday party sai: khoảng một lần mỗi tháng, không phải thói quen — "Birthday parties happen maybe monthly, hardly a routine".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi có "usually/routine" thì loại mọi việc đi kèm "maybe", "hardly a routine", hoặc gắn với ngày khác trong tuần.

question_text: Where does he want to go tomorrow?
options: The park
The cinema
The town hall
explanation:
Tomorrow is my precious day off, and I've been negotiating with myself all evening! The park was the first idea — but they're forecasting rain from noon, and wet grass is nobody's friend. Then the new cinema crossed my mind; tempting, but the film I want only starts next Friday. So the decision is made, and it's the sensible one: the town hall. The photography exhibition upstairs closes this week, free entry, and the building itself is beautiful. Town hall tomorrow — culture wins!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The town hall.
• Vì sao đúng: "So the decision is made, and it's the sensible one: the town hall. The photography exhibition upstairs closes this week, free entry".
• The park sai: dự báo mưa từ trưa ("they're forecasting rain from noon, and wet grass is nobody's friend").
• The cinema sai: bộ phim anh muốn xem tuần sau mới chiếu ("the film I want only starts next Friday").
👉 Mẹo: nghe thấy "So the decision is made" thì tập trung tối đa — địa điểm ngay sau đó là đáp án, mọi thứ trước đó chỉ là ý tưởng đã bị loại.

question_text: What is her favorite thing to do in her spare time?
options: watching a movie at home
going to the theatre
playing sports
explanation:
My free time is precious, so I spend it carefully. My husband is happiest watching films on the sofa, and I join him sometimes, but falling asleep before the ending every single time tells me something. Sports? My knees retired before I did. No — my heart belongs to the theatre. Every second Saturday, the red seats, the programme in my hand, that moment when the lights dim. Live actors, live mistakes, live magic. Films can wait at home; the stage cannot.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – going to the theatre.
• Vì sao đúng: "my heart belongs to the theatre. Every second Saturday, the red seats, the programme in my hand, that moment when the lights dim".
• watching a movie at home sai: đó là sở thích của CHỒNG cô, còn cô thì toàn ngủ gật ("My husband is happiest watching films on the sofa... falling asleep before the ending every single time").
• playing sports sai: cô đã bỏ vì đầu gối ("My knees retired before I did").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi sở thích cá nhân — loại ngay hoạt động gắn với người thân (my husband, my brother) và hoạt động nói ở thì quá khứ.

question_text: A woman is chatting with a friend about her afternoon plans. What is she going to do this afternoon?
options: Sleep at home
Go to the cinema
Go on a city tour
explanation:
My afternoon plans? Finally, something to look forward to! My flatmate voted for the cinema, but the only decent film starts at nine tonight — too late for an afternoon. And sleeping at home, tempting after this week, felt like wasting the first sunny day in ages. So I've booked the two o'clock city tour instead! The old walls, the cathedral roof walk, the guide with all the scandalous historical gossip. Two hours of being a tourist in my own city — camera charged, comfortable shoes on!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Go on a city tour.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I've booked the two o'clock city tour instead! The old walls, the cathedral roof walk, the guide with all the scandalous historical gossip".
• Go to the cinema sai: là ý của bạn cùng phòng, bị loại vì phim 9h tối, quá muộn cho buổi chiều — "the only decent film starts at nine tonight — too late for an afternoon".
• Sleep at home sai: có hấp dẫn nhưng cô thấy phí ngày nắng đầu tiên — "sleeping at home, tempting after this week, felt like wasting the first sunny day in ages".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi kế hoạch, bám động từ đã chốt: "I've booked", "I've decided". Ý gắn với "my flatmate voted for" là ý người khác.

question_text: A woman is talking about her favorite film on the radio. What film did she recommend?
options: Action film
Romantic film
Comedy film
explanation:
Welcome back to Film Corner! A listener asked me what to watch this weekend, and here is my honest answer. Everyone keeps talking about that new romantic film by the sea — I found it slow, and I nearly fell asleep. The comedy that opened last week? A few good jokes, but you'll forget it by Monday. No — the one I really recommend is the action film about the mountain rescue team. Two hours, my heart never stopped racing. Don't miss it!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Action film.
• Vì sao đúng: "the one I really recommend is the action film about the mountain rescue team. Two hours, my heart never stopped racing. Don't miss it!".
• Romantic film sai: bị chê chậm, xem suýt ngủ gật — "I found it slow, and I nearly fell asleep".
• Comedy film sai: chỉ được vài câu đùa rồi quên ngay — "A few good jokes, but you'll forget it by Monday".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "giới thiệu phim nào", bám đúng động từ "recommend". Phim gắn với "slow", "you'll forget it" là nhiễu dù được nhắc trước.

question_text: A man is talking about his day. What did he do in the morning?
options: Look at a view
Have breakfast at a cafe
Go for a walk in the park
explanation:
What a perfect start to the day I had! I woke up before six, while the whole house was still asleep, and drove up the coast road to the top of the cliffs. I just stood there and looked at the view — the sea, the islands, the morning light on the water. I must have stayed an hour without checking my phone once. Only after that did I think about food and the rest of the day. Everyone should try a morning like that.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Look at a view.
• Vì sao đúng: "I just stood there and looked at the view — the sea, the islands, the morning light on the water. I must have stayed an hour without checking my phone once".
• Have breakfast at a cafe sai: anh chỉ nghĩ tới đồ ăn SAU đó — "Only after that did I think about food and the rest of the day".
• Go for a walk in the park sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài; anh lái xe lên vách đá rồi đứng yên ngắm cảnh — "drove up the coast road to the top of the cliffs".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "làm gì buổi sáng", chú ý trật tự thời gian. Việc nằm sau cụm "Only after that..." là việc làm SAU, không phải đáp án.

question_text: Doctor’s office is calling about a change in the appointment. When is the new appointment?
options: Thursday 13th
Friday 14th
Wednesday 12th
explanation:
Good afternoon, this is Doctor Mitchell's surgery calling about your appointment change. Your original slot on Friday the fourteenth has to move, as the doctor will be at a medical conference. We know Wednesday the twelfth was mentioned as a possibility earlier — please disregard that, the morning is fully booked. Your new confirmed appointment is Thursday the thirteenth at nine thirty. Thursday the thirteenth, half past nine. Please arrive ten minutes early with your insurance card. Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Thursday 13th.
• Vì sao đúng: "Your new confirmed appointment is Thursday the thirteenth at nine thirty. Thursday the thirteenth, half past nine".
• Friday 14th sai: là lịch CŨ, phải dời vì bác sĩ đi hội thảo — "Your original slot on Friday the fourteenth has to move, as the doctor will be at a medical conference".
• Wednesday 12th sai: từng được nhắc nhưng buổi sáng đã kín chỗ — "We know Wednesday the twelfth was mentioned as a possibility earlier — please disregard that, the morning is fully booked".
👉 Mẹo: tin nhắn đổi lịch luôn nêu đủ 3 ngày. Bám cụm "new confirmed appointment" và ngày được LẶP LẠI hai lần; bỏ ngày có "original", "disregard".

question_text: A man is talking about his family trip. What does the man’s wife enjoy?
options: Photography
Shopping
Hiking
explanation:
Our family trips are a delicate diplomatic operation! My daughter lives for the shopping streets — every city, every market, her suitcase returns pregnant. I'm the hiking madman, dragging everyone up hills for views they claim not to need. And my wife? Her camera is her passport. Photography — that's her whole holiday! She rises before dawn for the light, photographs fishermen, doorways, strangers' laundry. Our house is a gallery of her trips. We walk; she captures. Everyone's happy!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Photography.
• Vì sao đúng: "And my wife? Her camera is her passport. Photography — that's her whole holiday! She rises before dawn for the light".
• Shopping sai: đó là sở thích của con gái — "My daughter lives for the shopping streets — every city, every market".
• Hiking sai: đó là sở thích của chính người kể — "I'm the hiking madman, dragging everyone up hills".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi chỉ đích danh một người (the man's WIFE). Đợi câu đổi chủ ngữ "And my wife?" rồi mới lấy đáp án — ba sở thích thuộc ba người khác nhau.

question_text: What is the way to exercise? / What is she going to do? / What does she do on her holidays?
options: Cycling
Running
Walking
explanation:
My holiday exercise plan, since you're curious! The hotel rents bicycles, and I did consider cycling the island — until I saw those hills and remembered my knees' opinion. Running on the beach looks romantic in films; in reality, sand in the shoes and sweat before breakfast, no thank you. So my choice, every single morning: walking. Two slow hours along the cliff path, camera in hand, coffee stop halfway. Walking — the holiday pace of champions!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Walking.
• Vì sao đúng: "So my choice, every single morning: walking. Two slow hours along the cliff path, camera in hand, coffee stop halfway".
• Cycling sai: mới chỉ cân nhắc rồi bỏ vì đồi dốc và đầu gối — "I did consider cycling the island — until I saw those hills and remembered my knees' opinion".
• Running sai: bị chê là chỉ đẹp trên phim — "Running on the beach looks romantic in films; in reality, sand in the shoes and sweat before breakfast, no thank you".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi hoạt động sẽ làm, khoanh cụm "my choice", "every single morning". Hai phương án kia hay đi kèm "did consider", "until", "no thank you".

question_text: In which room will the director's presentation happen?
options: The bedroom
The meeting room
The living room
explanation:
Team, logistics for the director's big presentation tomorrow, please read twice! The living room of the guest house — where we did last year's — is being repainted, fumes included, so that's out. And someone booked the small bedroom upstairs as an option; a presentation among pillows, imagine the photos! No. The director will present in the meeting room, main building, second door — projector installed, twenty chairs, coffee station ready. The meeting room at nine sharp. Dress accordingly!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The meeting room.
• Vì sao đúng: "The director will present in the meeting room, main building, second door — projector installed, twenty chairs, coffee station ready".
• The living room sai: đang sơn lại, còn nồng mùi sơn — "The living room of the guest house — where we did last year's — is being repainted, fumes included, so that's out".
• The bedroom sai: có người đặt nhưng bị bác thẳng — "someone booked the small bedroom upstairs as an option; a presentation among pillows, imagine the photos! No".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi phòng, chọn nơi được tả kèm TRANG THIẾT BỊ phù hợp (projector, chairs). Nơi đi kèm "so that's out", "No" là loại.

question_text: A person calls a friend about his new car. What is the price of the small car?
options: 3,250 pounds
3,550 pounds
3,000 pounds
explanation:
Hello, it's me! The car saga is finally over — I signed this afternoon! So, prices, since you love details. The dealer's first sticker said three thousand five hundred and fifty, take it or leave it. I countered with three thousand flat, which he called an insult to the vehicle. One coffee and much sighing later, we shook hands at three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds. Three two five zero — my new little car! Pick you up Saturday for the maiden voyage?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 3,250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "we shook hands at three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds. Three two five zero — my new little car!".
• 3,550 pounds sai: là giá niêm yết ban đầu của người bán ("The dealer's first sticker said three thousand five hundred and fifty, take it or leave it").
• 3,000 pounds sai: là giá người mua trả xuống và bị chê ("I countered with three thousand flat, which he called an insult to the vehicle").
👉 Mẹo: bài mặc cả có ba con số theo thứ tự: giá chào (first sticker) – giá trả (I countered) – giá chốt (we shook hands). Luôn lấy con số đi kèm cái bắt tay.

question_text: What color top is he going to buy?
options: Green
Red
Black
explanation:
Woman: Back again! Still thinking about that top for the party?
Man: Still torn, honestly. The green one fits well...
Woman: It does! Although — between us — green does wash you out a little under evening lights.
Man: My sister said the same, wonderful. What about the red one in the window?
Woman: Bold choice! But red at a work party... your colleagues will find you before you find the snacks.
Man: Fair point, I'd rather not glow. That leaves the quiet option.
Woman: The black. Classic, slimming, and it forgives every spilled drink.
Man: Sold. The black one, medium, and a bag I can hide it in until payday is forgotten!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Black.
• Vì sao đúng: "Sold. The black one, medium" — sau khi nhân viên gợi ý "The black. Classic, slimming, and it forgives every spilled drink".
• Green sai: nhân viên nói màu này làm anh trông nhợt nhạt dưới đèn buổi tối ("green does wash you out a little under evening lights").
• Red sai: quá nổi cho tiệc công ty ("your colleagues will find you before you find the snacks").
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại chọn màu — nghe từ chốt giao dịch "Sold", "I'll take it", kèm cỡ áo. Màu đi cùng câu đó chính là đáp án.

question_text: Which room will they study in? / Where will the first lesson of computer science take place?
options: Room 301
Room 101
Room 203
explanation:
Woman: Excuse me, are you also looking for the computer science lesson?
Man: Yes! First day chaos. The email said Room 203, I think?
Woman: That was the old email — 203 flooded last week, there's still a fan drying the carpet.
Man: Lovely. Someone in the corridor mentioned Room 101?
Woman: That's the maths lecture — I peeked in, whiteboards full of equations, definitely not us.
Man: So where do we actually go?
Woman: The notice board says Room 301, third floor, the new lab with the fast machines. I just checked it.
Man: Room 301 it is. Stairs or do we trust that elevator?
Woman: Stairs. Always stairs on the first day!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Room 301.
• Vì sao đúng: "The notice board says Room 301, third floor, the new lab with the fast machines. I just checked it" — và chốt lại "Room 301 it is".
• Room 203 sai: là phòng ghi trong email CŨ, đã bị ngập nước — "That was the old email — 203 flooded last week, there's still a fan drying the carpet".
• Room 101 sai: đó là lớp toán, không phải lớp của họ — "That's the maths lecture — I peeked in, whiteboards full of equations, definitely not us".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi phòng/địa điểm, tin nào MỚI NHẤT và đã được kiểm chứng ("notice board", "I just checked") thì đúng; số nào gắn với "the old email", "last week" thì loại.

question_text: How many weeks have they been in India?
options: 2 weeks
4 weeks
3 weeks
explanation:
Woman: You're back from India! You look transformed! How long were you actually there?
Man: The eternal question! Everyone assumes a month.
Woman: Well, your photos felt like four weeks of adventures, honestly.
Man: Four weeks was the original fantasy — the boss laughed at that leave request. Then we trimmed it to three.
Woman: And three didn't survive either?
Man: The project deadline moved, so three collapsed too. Final answer: two weeks, exactly fourteen days. Delhi, Agra, and five days in the south.
Woman: Two weeks that look like a lifetime! The photos fooled us all.
Man: Good packing and no sleep, my friend. Worth every second!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 2 weeks.
• Vì sao đúng: "Final answer: two weeks, exactly fourteen days. Delhi, Agra, and five days in the south".
• 4 weeks sai: chỉ là dự tính ban đầu, bị sếp bác — "Four weeks was the original fantasy — the boss laughed at that leave request".
• 3 weeks sai: rút xuống ba tuần rồi cũng đổ vì hạn dự án dời — "The project deadline moved, so three collapsed too".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi độ dài chuyến đi, các con số thường giảm dần theo trình tự kể. Chỉ lấy số sau "Final answer", "in the end"; bỏ số gắn với "original", "we trimmed it to".

question_text: What time is the meeting?
options: 4pm
3pm
2pm
explanation:
Man: Hi Susan, about the project meeting tomorrow — I have conflicting notes. Is it at two?
Woman: It was at two originally, but the clients' train doesn't arrive until half past.
Man: Ah. Someone in the office said three, then?
Woman: That was the backup plan, but the meeting room is booked by accounts at three.
Man: So where did we land?
Woman: Four o'clock, final answer. Room B, projector booked, and I've ordered coffee for five people.
Man: Four it is. I'll print the reports in the morning. Thanks, Susan!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 4pm.
• Vì sao đúng: người phụ nữ chốt cuối cùng "Four o'clock, final answer" — và người đàn ông xác nhận lại "Four it is".
• 2pm sai: đó là giờ họp BAN ĐẦU, đã bị hủy vì tàu của khách hàng 2h30 mới tới ("It was at two originally, but...").
• 3pm sai: chỉ là phương án dự phòng, bị loại vì phòng họp đã có bộ phận kế toán đặt ("That was the backup plan, but...").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi giờ/ngày luôn nhắc đủ 3 mốc. Bám vào từ chốt hạ như "final answer", "let's go with", "so we land at" và bỏ qua mốc nào đi kèm "originally", "backup", "but".

question_text: What do they decide to write about?
options: politic
historian
economy
explanation:
M: So, the history essay — we still haven't picked a person to write about. Any ideas?
W: I was thinking about a politician at first. There's plenty of material about their speeches and elections.
M: Mmm, honestly, politics bores me. And half the class will choose a politician anyway.
W: True. What about someone from economics, then? A famous banker, maybe?
M: That sounds even drier, all those numbers... Wait — what about a historian? Someone who wrote about the past themselves?
W: Oh, that's clever! We'd be writing history about a historian. The professor will love that.
M: Exactly. Let's decide on the historian, then. I'll find the books tonight.
W: Deal. I'll start on the introduction tomorrow.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – historian.
• Vì sao đúng: "Wait — what about a historian? Someone who wrote about the past themselves?" và chốt "Let's decide on the historian, then" — cô đồng ý "Deal".
• politic sai: bị loại vì chán và cả nửa lớp cũng chọn — "politics bores me. And half the class will choose a politician anyway".
• economy sai: bị chê còn khô khan hơn — "That sounds even drier, all those numbers...".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hai người chọn đề tài, đáp án là ý nêu SAU CÙNG kèm câu đồng thuận ("Let's decide on...", "Deal").

question_text: A woman is talking about her job. What encouraged her to become a scientist?
options: Her computer
Her mother
A large stone
explanation:
Man: Doctor, our listeners love origin stories. What pushed you toward science? A brilliant teacher? Your mother?
Woman: Ha! My mother campaigned hard for law school, actually — science horrified her. Not her doing at all.
Man: The family computer, then? Every scientist my age says the computer.
Woman: I only touched a computer at university — far too late to light any fires.
Man: So what was it?
Woman: A large stone. I was seven, on holiday, and found this rock packed with spiral shells. Fossils! I demanded explanations from every adult on the beach.
Man: And nobody could answer?
Woman: Nobody. So I decided I would become the person who could. That stone still sits on my desk, forty years later.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – A large stone.
• Vì sao đúng: "A large stone. I was seven, on holiday, and found this rock packed with spiral shells. Fossils!" — và "That stone still sits on my desk, forty years later".
• Her mother sai: mẹ cô còn hướng cô học luật và ghét khoa học — "My mother campaigned hard for law school, actually — science horrified her. Not her doing at all".
• Her computer sai: cô chỉ chạm vào máy tính khi đã vào đại học, quá muộn — "I only touched a computer at university — far too late to light any fires".
👉 Mẹo: dạng phỏng vấn hỏi "điều gì thúc đẩy", người dẫn thường đoán sai hai lần trước. Đáp án là câu trả lời cuối của khách mời kèm kỷ niệm cụ thể.

question_text: What does her sister drink?
options: Water
Tea
Coffee
explanation:
M: Right, drinks before the film — what shall I get everyone?
W: A glass of water for me, please, I'm still full from lunch.
M: Water, easy. And your sister? Coffee, I'm guessing? She looks like she needs one.
W: Oh no, definitely not coffee — she stopped drinking it last year, it kept her awake all night.
M: Really? So what does she have these days?
W: Tea. Always tea now — she's completely mad about it, green in the morning, black in the afternoon.
M: One water, one tea, and a coffee for me. Anything to eat?
W: Just the drinks — the film starts in ten minutes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Tea.
• Vì sao đúng: "Tea. Always tea now — she's completely mad about it, green in the morning, black in the afternoon".
• Water sai: đó là đồ uống của chính người phụ nữ đang nói, không phải của em gái — "A glass of water for me, please, I'm still full from lunch".
• Coffee sai: em gái đã bỏ cà phê từ năm ngoái vì mất ngủ — "definitely not coffee — she stopped drinking it last year, it kept her awake all night".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi hỏi đồ uống của MỘT người cụ thể (her sister). Ghép nhanh cặp người–đồ uống khi nghe; món gắn với "for me" là của người khác.

question_text: When do they meet each other?
options: On Thursday morning
On Wednesday morning
On monday morning
explanation:
Woman: We need to go through the contract together. When are you free this week?
Man: Let me look... Monday morning I'm at the dentist, sadly. Nothing moves that appointment.
Woman: And I fly to the conference on Wednesday, so Wednesday morning is gone for me.
Man: That leaves Thursday. My morning is completely clear — nine, ten, whenever suits.
Woman: Thursday morning works! Nine thirty at my office? I'll have the papers ready.
Man: Nine thirty, Thursday morning. I'll bring my reading glasses and my patience!
Woman: You'll need both. See you then!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On Thursday morning.
• Vì sao đúng: "That leaves Thursday. My morning is completely clear" – "Thursday morning works! Nine thirty at my office?".
• On Monday morning sai: anh có hẹn nha sĩ không thể dời ("Monday morning I'm at the dentist, sadly. Nothing moves that appointment").
• On Wednesday morning sai: cô bay đi dự hội nghị ("I fly to the conference on Wednesday, so Wednesday morning is gone for me").
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại sắp lịch loại dần từng ngày. Nghe cụm "That leaves..." là biết ngày còn lại chính là đáp án, không cần chờ hết bài.

question_text: What time do they arrange the meeting?
explanation:
Woman: About tomorrow's project review — I need to lock the time before I book the room.
Man: Right. My notes say three thirty?
Woman: That was the first suggestion, but the finance call runs till four, we'd be walking in mid-sentence.
Man: Then four thirty? Clean gap after the call...
Woman: Almost — but the director joins us, and his train only lands at five.
Man: So five thirty it is? Last slot before the building empties.
Woman: Five thirty, small conference room, one focused hour. I'll send the invite tonight.
Man: Five thirty confirmed. I'll bring the numbers and the biscuits!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 5:30 pm.
• Vì sao đúng: "Five thirty, small conference room, one focused hour. I'll send the invite tonight" — và "Five thirty confirmed".
• 3:30 pm sai: là đề xuất đầu tiên, vướng cuộc gọi tài chính kéo dài tới 4h — "That was the first suggestion, but the finance call runs till four".
• 4:30 pm sai: bị loại vì tàu của giám đốc 5h mới tới — "the director joins us, and his train only lands at five".
👉 Mẹo: dạng chốt giờ họp, các mốc tăng dần và mốc nào cũng vướng một trở ngại. Lấy mốc cuối đi kèm "confirmed", "I'll send the invite".

question_text: A man is talking to a waiter. What drink does the man choose?
options: Milk tea
Hot tea
Iced tea
explanation:
Woman: Good afternoon! Ready to order drinks?
Man: More than ready — what a heat wave! What do you recommend?
Woman: Our milk tea is famous — sweet, creamy, with the tapioca pearls.
Man: Tempting, but milk and this weather argue in my stomach, sadly.
Woman: Understood! Hot tea, then? We have a beautiful jasmine.
Man: Hot tea in thirty-five degrees? You're testing me!
Woman: Ha! Then the obvious hero: fresh iced tea, lemon and mint, crushed ice to the top.
Man: Now we're talking. Iced tea, large, extra mint — and mercy on the sugar.
Woman: One large iced tea, gentle sugar. Rescue is coming!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Iced tea.
• Vì sao đúng: sau gợi ý "fresh iced tea, lemon and mint, crushed ice to the top", anh chốt "Now we're talking. Iced tea, large, extra mint".
• Milk tea sai: anh từ chối vì sữa không hợp bụng khi trời nóng — "milk and this weather argue in my stomach, sadly".
• Hot tea sai: bị gạt vì trời 35 độ — "Hot tea in thirty-five degrees? You're testing me!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng gọi đồ uống, phục vụ gợi ý 3 món theo thứ tự; đáp án là món khách CHỐT kèm size/yêu cầu riêng ("large, extra mint").

question_text: Where do they go when they travel to India?
options: Go to the mountains
Go to the park
Go to the beach
explanation:
W: India in three weeks! Have you two planned the days yet?
M: Almost. Everyone keeps telling us to go to the mountains in the north...
W: The Himalayas! Surely that's the dream?
M: It was — until we counted the travel: two extra days on trains each way. Our week is just too short.
W: The beaches in the south, then? Palm trees, warm sea...
M: In THIS season? Forty degrees and full of jellyfish, my cousin warned us off completely.
W: So what's left?
M: The famous city park! The huge old gardens with the monuments and the parrots — we'll go to the park every single morning, it's ten minutes from the hotel.
W: A week of gardens and parrots... actually, that sounds perfect.
M: Exactly. The park is the plan!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Go to the park.
• Vì sao đúng: "The famous city park! The huge old gardens with the monuments and the parrots — we'll go to the park every single morning" và chốt "Exactly. The park is the plan!".
• Go to the mountains sai: bị loại vì mất thêm hai ngày tàu mỗi chiều, chuyến đi chỉ có một tuần ("It was — until we counted the travel: two extra days on trains each way. Our week is just too short").
• Go to the beach sai: mùa này quá nóng và nhiều sứa ("In THIS season? Forty degrees and full of jellyfish, my cousin warned us off completely").
👉 Mẹo: dạng chọn điểm đến — mỗi nơi bị loại đều kèm một trở ngại cụ thể (thời gian di chuyển, thời tiết). Nơi đúng đi kèm câu chốt "... is the plan" hoặc "that's settled".

question_text: Which door do they need to take to get to Edinburgh?
options: Two
Three
Four
explanation:
W: Here we are — now, which door do we need for the Edinburgh coach?
M: The screen says... hmm, door four. No wait, that's the Glasgow service, look, it leaves ten minutes before ours.
W: Careful! And someone in the queue said door three earlier.
M: Door three is London — see the sign above it? Half the queue is going the wrong way.
W: So where is ours, then? We've got eight minutes!
M: There — door two, on the left, past the coffee stand. Edinburgh, ten fifteen, door two.
W: Door two it is. Come on, grab your bag!
M: Told you we should have arrived earlier!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Two.
• Vì sao đúng: "There — door two, on the left, past the coffee stand. Edinburgh, ten fifteen, door two".
• Four sai: cửa 4 là chuyến đi Glasgow, khởi hành sớm hơn 10 phút — "that's the Glasgow service, look, it leaves ten minutes before ours".
• Three sai: cửa 3 là chuyến đi London — "Door three is London — see the sign above it? Half the queue is going the wrong way".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi cửa/bến, mỗi số gắn với một ĐIỂM ĐẾN. Chỉ chốt khi số đó đi kèm đúng tên thành phố trong câu hỏi (Edinburgh).

question_text: How long does it take to get to the station?
options: 20 minutes
15 minutes
25 minutes
explanation:
Man: You're coming Saturday, right? Tell me how long you need from your place to the station.
Woman: That's the eternal debate! My mother swears it's fifteen minutes, but she walks like an athlete.
Man: And your brother said twenty-five when he visited?
Woman: He got lost twice and stopped for coffee — twenty-five is HIS record, not the route's.
Man: So realistically?
Woman: Twenty minutes, measured by me, with a suitcase, at human speed. Twenty exactly.
Man: Then leave at nine forty for the ten o'clock train, and breathe.
Woman: Nine forty, noted. And I'm leaving my brother's navigation genes at home!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 20 minutes.
• Vì sao đúng: "Twenty minutes, measured by me, with a suitcase, at human speed. Twenty exactly" — chính cô ấy tự đo.
• 15 minutes sai: là con số của mẹ cô, người đi bộ nhanh như vận động viên — "My mother swears it's fifteen minutes, but she walks like an athlete".
• 25 minutes sai: là của ông anh, người bị lạc hai lần và dừng uống cà phê — "He got lost twice and stopped for coffee — twenty-five is HIS record, not the route's".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi mất bao lâu, mỗi con số gắn với một NGƯỜI. Chọn số mà chính người trả lời tự đo — nghe cụm "realistically", "measured by me".

question_text: Listen to Marry talking to Jane while waiting for James. What did they decide to do?
options: Cancel the meeting
Having the meeting without him
Wait for him longer
explanation:
W1: Jane, it's already twenty past. Any message from James?
W2: Nothing, Marry. His phone just rings and rings. Should we cancel the whole meeting?
W1: Cancelling seems a waste — everyone else is here, and the room is only ours until twelve.
W2: We could wait another ten minutes, I suppose. He might just be stuck in traffic.
W1: We've waited long enough, honestly. And the first two points on the agenda don't even involve him.
W2: That's true. He can read the notes afterwards for the parts he missed.
W1: Right, decision made — we'll have the meeting without him. Can you close the door?
W2: Done. Okay, everyone, let's begin with point one.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Having the meeting without him.
• Vì sao đúng: "Right, decision made — we'll have the meeting without him. Can you close the door?".
• Cancel the meeting sai: bị gạt vì mọi người đã có mặt và phòng chỉ đặt tới 12h — "Cancelling seems a waste — everyone else is here, and the room is only ours until twelve".
• Wait for him longer sai: có đề xuất chờ thêm mười phút nhưng bị bác — "We've waited long enough, honestly".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "họ quyết định làm gì", bám cụm "decision made". Ý đi kèm "seems a waste", "we've waited long enough" là ý bị loại.

question_text: What elements of the film do they agree on?
options: the soundtrack
the characters
the ending
explanation:
Man: So, verdict time — the film. I say the soundtrack was the weakest part. Those drums!
Woman: Funny, I loved the drums! We'll never agree on music, we never do.
Man: True. And the characters — I found the sister completely unbelievable.
Woman: The sister was my favourite! Written exactly like my own sister, actually. So that's two disagreements.
Man: Then let me try the last card: the ending. The lights on the empty pier, no words, just the waves —
Woman: Perfect. Absolutely perfect. I cried, you went silent — I heard you stop chewing!
Man: I did. Finest ending in years. So we agree on exactly one thing: that ending.
Woman: One thing is enough for a second date at the cinema!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – the ending.
• Vì sao đúng: "So we agree on exactly one thing: that ending" — cả hai đều khen cảnh cuối trên cầu tàu ("Perfect. Absolutely perfect. I cried, you went silent").
• the soundtrack sai: hai người trái ngược — anh chê tiếng trống, cô lại thích ("I say the soundtrack was the weakest part. Those drums!" / "Funny, I loved the drums!").
• the characters sai: anh thấy nhân vật người chị vô lý, cô lại coi đó là nhân vật yêu thích ("I found the sister completely unbelievable" / "The sister was my favourite!").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "agree on" — đếm các cụm bất đồng ("Funny, I...", "we'll never agree"). Bài thường tự tổng kết ở cuối bằng "we agree on exactly one thing".

question_text: What time does the party start?
options: 5 o'clock
4 o'clock
3 o'clock
explanation:
Man: Little sister! Your graduation party Saturday — when do the doors actually open?
Woman: Finally someone asks! Mum keeps telling everyone four o'clock, which was the OLD plan.
Man: So not four. Auntie swears she heard five?
Woman: Auntie hears what suits her nap schedule! Five is when we cut the cake — arriving then means missing everything.
Man: So the real start is...?
Woman: Three o'clock! Three sharp — speeches at half past, cake at five, dancing till they throw us out.
Man: Three o'clock, got it. I'll come at two to help with chairs — and to guard the cake from Auntie.
Woman: My hero! Bring the good camera!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 3 o'clock.
• Vì sao đúng: "Three o'clock! Three sharp — speeches at half past, cake at five, dancing till they throw us out".
• 4 o'clock sai: là kế hoạch CŨ mà mẹ vẫn báo nhầm cho mọi người — "Mum keeps telling everyone four o'clock, which was the OLD plan".
• 5 o'clock sai: đó là giờ cắt bánh, đến lúc đó là lỡ gần hết — "Five is when we cut the cake — arriving then means missing everything".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "What time does the party START?" — cẩn thận giờ của một MỤC trong chương trình (cắt bánh, phát biểu). Bám từ "sharp", "the real start".

question_text: Louis is calling his friend Standar. Where will Luis meet Standar?
options: Outside the station
At the cafe
Near the ticket counter
explanation:
Man: Standar! It's Louis. Confirming tomorrow before I sleep — where do we meet?
Woman: I was about to text you! You said the café first, right?
Man: I did, but I checked — the café doesn't open till nine, and our train is at nine fifteen. Too tight.
Woman: True. Near the ticket counter then? Central, easy to find...
Man: Have you seen the counter queues on a Saturday? We'd lose each other in the crowd instantly.
Woman: Fair. So — outside the station? The main steps, by the flower stall?
Man: Outside the station, by the flowers, eight forty-five. Tickets already in my pocket!
Woman: Eight forty-five. Bring coffee, the café won't!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Outside the station.
• Vì sao đúng: "Outside the station, by the flowers, eight forty-five. Tickets already in my pocket!".
• At the cafe sai: quán 9h mới mở trong khi tàu chạy 9h15 — "the café doesn't open till nine, and our train is at nine fifteen. Too tight".
• Near the ticket counter sai: thứ Bảy quầy vé đông, dễ lạc nhau — "Have you seen the counter queues on a Saturday? We'd lose each other in the crowd instantly".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hẹn địa điểm, chốt nằm ở lượt nói cuối kèm mốc giờ cụ thể. Nơi đi kèm "doesn't open till", "too tight", "queues" là loại.

question_text: Where do they go when they travel to India?
options: Go to the mountains
Go to the park
Go to the beach
explanation:
M: The India tickets are booked! Now the big question — what do we actually do there?
W: My vote was always the mountains. Cool air, tea gardens...
M: I checked — the mountain trains are sold out for the whole month. Completely full.
W: No! Okay... the beach then? Everyone posts those beach photos.
M: In monsoon season? The waves are dangerous and half the beach cafés close. My colleague was there last July — rain every day.
W: So mountains impossible, beach miserable... what does that leave?
M: The park! The enormous royal gardens in the city — fountains, ruins, those green parrots everywhere. Locals say sunrise there is magic.
W: Sunrise walks in a royal garden... fine, you win. The park it is!
M: Every morning, before the heat. It'll be the best part of the trip, promise.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Go to the park.
• Vì sao đúng: "The park! The enormous royal gardens in the city — fountains, ruins, those green parrots everywhere" — cô đồng ý "fine, you win. The park it is!".
• Go to the mountains sai: tàu lên núi hết vé cả tháng — "the mountain trains are sold out for the whole month. Completely full".
• Go to the beach sai: đang mùa mưa, sóng nguy hiểm, quán đóng cửa — "In monsoon season? The waves are dangerous and half the beach cafés close".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hai người bàn kế hoạch, đáp án là nơi được nêu SAU CÙNG và có câu đồng thuận ("you win", "it is"). Nơi đi kèm "sold out", "dangerous", "close" thì loại.

question_text: Listen to the speaker talking about their weekly schedule. When is the meeting scheduled?
options: Monday morning
Friday afternoon
Wednesday afternoon
explanation:
Woman: Before you run off — the project meeting this week. When is it again? My calendar shows three different colours.
Man: The app struck again! What does Monday morning say?
Woman: Nine o'clock, big room?
Man: That's the sales huddle, ten minutes of shouting numbers. Not ours.
Woman: Then someone told me Friday afternoon...
Man: Pure legend. Half the office vanishes after Friday lunch and management knows it.
Woman: So our meeting is...?
Man: Wednesday afternoon, two thirty, same as all quarter. Agenda by Tuesday, coffee provided.
Woman: Wednesday, two thirty. I'm writing it in pen this time — on paper!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Wednesday afternoon.
• Vì sao đúng: "Wednesday afternoon, two thirty, same as all quarter. Agenda by Tuesday, coffee provided".
• Monday morning sai: 9h thứ Hai là buổi họp nhanh của bộ phận sales — "That's the sales huddle, ten minutes of shouting numbers. Not ours".
• Friday afternoon sai: chỉ là tin đồn, chiều thứ Sáu nửa văn phòng đã về — "Pure legend. Half the office vanishes after Friday lunch".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi lịch họp, đáp án là mốc kèm chi tiết cụ thể (giờ, agenda) và cụm "same as all quarter". Mốc bị gán "that's the...", "pure legend" là nhiễu.

question_text: How many weeks did they spend in India?
options: Three weeks
Two weeks
One week
explanation:
Man: The India photos are finally sorted! Want to hear how the plan grew?
Woman: I remember you originally booked just one week, right?
Man: One week, yes — Delhi and the Taj, the classic. Then my brother said one week for India is like one minute in a museum.
Woman: So you stretched it. To three weeks? You were gone forever!
Man: Everyone thinks that! No — three weeks was the dream, but my leave didn't stretch that far.
Woman: So how long was it in the end?
Man: Two weeks exactly. Delhi, Jaipur, then five days in the south. Two packed, perfect weeks — and honestly, my feet needed the flight home.
Woman: Two weeks well spent. The photos prove it!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Two weeks.
• Vì sao đúng: "Two weeks exactly. Delhi, Jaipur, then five days in the south. Two packed, perfect weeks".
• One week sai: là kế hoạch đặt vé ban đầu ("I remember you originally booked just one week, right?" – "One week, yes — Delhi and the Taj, the classic").
• Three weeks sai: chỉ là mong ước, số ngày phép không đủ ("three weeks was the dream, but my leave didn't stretch that far").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "how long" ở thì quá khứ — bỏ con số đi kèm "originally booked" và "was the dream", lấy con số đi kèm "exactly / in the end".

question_text: When did they decide to meet?
options: 7am on Friday
9am on Sunday
9am on Saturday
explanation:
M: So, the trip to the flower market — when are we actually going?
W: I first thought seven in the morning on Friday, before work. The flowers are freshest then.
M: Seven am on a work day? I'd fall asleep among the roses. What about the weekend?
W: Saturday at nine, then? That was my second idea.
M: Ah, Saturday I can't — I promised to help my brother move house, remember?
W: That's right, you told me. Okay — Sunday at nine? Nothing happens on Sunday.
M: Sunday at nine is perfect. Coffee first, flowers after.
W: Deal. Nine o'clock Sunday, at the main gate!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 9am on Sunday.
• Vì sao đúng: "Sunday at nine is perfect. Coffee first, flowers after" — chốt "Deal. Nine o'clock Sunday, at the main gate!".
• 7am on Friday sai: quá sớm vào ngày đi làm — "Seven am on a work day? I'd fall asleep among the roses".
• 9am on Saturday sai: anh bận giúp anh trai chuyển nhà — "Saturday I can't — I promised to help my brother move house".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hẹn giờ mà các phương án khác nhau cả GIỜ lẫn THỨ thì phải nghe đủ cặp, đừng bắt mỗi số 9. Chốt ở lượt có "perfect", "Deal".

question_text: Where did they meet?
options: The back entrance
The front entrance
The side entrance
explanation:
Woman: There you are! I nearly froze waiting — where were you hiding?
Man: Me? I was exactly where we agreed... I thought. The back entrance, by the car park.
Woman: The back?! That's for deliveries! I said the doors with the flags!
Man: Well, first I actually tried the side entrance, the little one — locked, with a grumpy notice.
Woman: Of course it was locked, it's winter! So how did we find each other?
Man: I finally walked around and there you were, arms crossed, at the front entrance, exactly like a statue of disappointment.
Woman: The front entrance — where every normal person meets! Next time I'm drawing you a map.
Man: Next time, pin the map to my coat!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The front entrance.
• Vì sao đúng: "I finally walked around and there you were, arms crossed, at the front entrance" — cô xác nhận "The front entrance — where every normal person meets!".
• The back entrance sai: đó là chỗ anh ta chờ nhầm, vốn chỉ dành cho giao hàng — "The back?! That's for deliveries!".
• The side entrance sai: anh có thử nhưng cửa khóa — "first I actually tried the side entrance, the little one — locked, with a grumpy notice".
👉 Mẹo: "Where did they meet?" hỏi nơi họ THỰC SỰ gặp nhau, không phải nơi từng đứng chờ. Bám câu có "there you were", "I found you".

question_text: A man is reading the news about a housing development plan. How many new houses are going to be built?
explanation:
Man: Have you seen today's paper? The housing plan is finally approved!
Woman: The famous plan! Remind me — they wanted two and a half thousand houses originally?
Man: They did, until the flood survey killed that dream. Too much wetland.
Woman: And the protest group swears only fifteen hundred will ever get built.
Man: That's their pessimism, not the document. It says here, black on white: two thousand new houses over six years.
Woman: Two thousand! With schools? A clinic?
Man: Both promised, page four. Whether promises survive construction — that's next decade's news.
Woman: Two thousand houses... our quiet street is about to get very interesting.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 2000.
• Vì sao đúng: văn bản chính thức ghi rõ — "It says here, black on white: two thousand new houses over six years".
• 2500 sai: là con số dự kiến ban đầu, bị bỏ sau khảo sát ngập lụt — "They did, until the flood survey killed that dream. Too much wetland".
• 1500 sai: là dự đoán bi quan của nhóm phản đối, không phải của văn bản — "That's their pessimism, not the document".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi số liệu tin tức, tin nguồn CHÍNH THỨC ("it says here", "the document"). Số gắn với "originally", "they swear", nhóm phản đối đều bị loại.

question_text: Jane is calling her friend Martha. What time are they going to meet?
explanation:
Woman: Martha! It's Jane. About tonight — what time works?
Woman2: I was thinking four? We'd catch the whole afternoon.
Woman: Four is impossible for me, I'm at the dentist until quarter to five, remember?
Woman2: Oh right, the tooth saga! Six, then? After all the traffic dies?
Woman: Six is too late — the restaurant stops serving the early menu at six, and I want that discount!
Woman2: Ha! The truth comes out. So we split it: five thirty?
Woman: Five thirty is perfect. Dentist done, discount alive, traffic bearable.
Woman2: Five thirty at the corner table. Bring your appetite and your new tooth!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 5.30.
• Vì sao đúng: "So we split it: five thirty?" — "Five thirty is perfect. Dentist done, discount alive, traffic bearable", chốt "Five thirty at the corner table".
• 4.00 sai: cô ở phòng nha đến gần 5h — "Four is impossible for me, I'm at the dentist until quarter to five".
• 6.00 sai: nhà hàng ngừng phục vụ thực đơn giá ưu đãi lúc 6h — "the restaurant stops serving the early menu at six, and I want that discount!".
👉 Mẹo: khi hai người đưa hai mốc trái ngược (quá sớm / quá muộn), đáp án thường nằm Ở GIỮA. Nghe cụm thỏa hiệp "So we split it".

question_text: What time is the meeting?
options: 4pm
3pm
2pm
explanation:
Man: Quick check about tomorrow's meeting — my calendar says two, my memory says otherwise.
Woman: Your memory wins. Two o'clock was the original slot, but the director flies in from Munich at one thirty.
Man: Cutting it close. Someone mentioned three as the backup?
Woman: We tried three, but the sales team owns the big room at three, and we need the screen.
Man: So we land at...?
Woman: Four o'clock. Room A, screen booked, and the director gets time to breathe after landing.
Man: Four it is. I'll move my dentist. The things I do for quarterly reports!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 4pm.
• Vì sao đúng: người phụ nữ chốt "Four o'clock. Room A, screen booked, and the director gets time to breathe after landing" — người đàn ông xác nhận lại "Four it is".
• 2pm sai: đó là giờ họp BAN ĐẦU, bị bỏ vì giám đốc 1h30 mới bay từ Munich về — "Two o'clock was the original slot, but the director flies in from Munich at one thirty".
• 3pm sai: chỉ là phương án dự phòng, bị loại vì phòng lớn đã bị bộ phận sales đặt — "We tried three, but the sales team owns the big room at three, and we need the screen".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi giờ luôn nhắc đủ 3 mốc. Bám mốc cuối cùng đi kèm chi tiết cụ thể (phòng, thiết bị) hoặc cụm "so we land at"; loại mốc có "original", "backup", "but".

question_text: Why does Douglas call Kay?
options: to ask for a favor
to say thank you
to discuss ideas
explanation:
W: Douglas! Twice in one week — what's going on?
M: Nothing bad, Kay, I promise. Quite the opposite.
W: Let me guess: your printer died and you need mine again?
M: No favours today! The printer lives, everything works.
W: Then you want to talk about the project ideas? I haven't finished reading them yet...
M: Not that either — the ideas can wait. Kay, I'm calling to say thank you. Properly.
W: Thank me? For what?
M: For last week — you drove my mother to the hospital while I was stuck abroad. She told me you stayed the whole afternoon. I'll never forget that.
W: Oh Douglas, anyone would have done it.
M: Nobody else did. Dinner's on me Friday — no arguments!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – to say thank you.
• Vì sao đúng: "Kay, I'm calling to say thank you. Properly... For last week — you drove my mother to the hospital while I was stuck abroad".
• to ask for a favor sai: anh phủ nhận ngay ("No favours today! The printer lives, everything works").
• to discuss ideas sai: cũng bị loại, để bàn sau ("Not that either — the ideas can wait").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi mục đích cuộc gọi — người gọi thường bác bỏ hai suy đoán của người nghe trước. Đáp án luôn nằm sau "I'm calling to...".

question_text: A woman is talking to her coworker. When does the meeting start?
explanation:
W: Morning, Paul! Quick question — the team meeting today, is it still at half past ten?
M: Ah, you haven't seen the email? It changed this morning.
W: Again? Last month they even tried to put it at quarter to ten, which was impossible with the school run.
M: I remember. No, this time it moved the other way — the boss has a call at ten thirty now.
W: So when do we actually start?
M: Quarter past ten. Ten fifteen sharp, same room as always.
W: Ten fifteen... that's fine, I can make that easily.
M: Bring your report — you're second on the agenda!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 10.15.
• Vì sao đúng: "Quarter past ten. Ten fifteen sharp, same room as always".
• 10.30 sai: là giờ CŨ, đã đổi vì sếp có cuộc gọi đúng lúc đó — "the boss has a call at ten thirty now".
• 9.45 sai: là lần đổi giờ của tháng trước, bất khả thi vì còn phải đưa con đi học — "Last month they even tried to put it at quarter to ten, which was impossible with the school run".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi giờ họp, phải quy đổi cách nói giờ: "quarter past ten" = 10.15, còn "quarter to ten" = 9.45. Nghe nhầm past/to là mất điểm ngay.

question_text: On which floor is the French class?
options: Third
First
Second
explanation:
Man: Excuse me, I'm here for the French class — the evening course? This building is a maze!
Woman: You're not the first lost linguist tonight! Which floor did they tell you?
Man: The first floor, I thought — but that's clearly the gym, unless French involves treadmills now.
Woman: Ha! No, the first floor schedule changed last month. And don't try the third — that's Spanish tonight, you'd leave with the wrong language entirely!
Man: So French is...?
Woman: Second floor, room 204, the door with the little Eiffel Tower poster. Monsieur Girard, he starts precisely on time.
Man: Second floor, 204, running now — merci!
Woman: Bonne chance! The stairs are faster than the lift!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Second.
• Vì sao đúng: "Second floor, room 204, the door with the little Eiffel Tower poster. Monsieur Girard, he starts precisely on time".
• First sai: tầng một là phòng gym, lịch đã đổi từ tháng trước — "that's clearly the gym"; "the first floor schedule changed last month".
• Third sai: tối nay tầng ba là lớp tiếng Tây Ban Nha — "don't try the third — that's Spanish tonight, you'd leave with the wrong language entirely!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi tầng/phòng, đáp án luôn kèm dấu hiệu nhận diện cụ thể (room 204, poster). Tầng gắn với môn hay hoạt động khác là nhiễu.

question_text: A man is ordering a drink. What does he want?
options: Water
Iced tea
Beer
explanation:
Woman: Good evening! What can I get you to drink?
Man: What a day... My friend says your beer selection is excellent.
Woman: It is! We have six kinds on tap, very popular tonight.
Man: Tempting, but I'm driving, so beer is off the table, sadly. What else?
Woman: Plain water? Sparkling or still, with lemon.
Man: Water feels a bit sad after the day I've had. That drink on the next table, with the mint —
Woman: The iced tea! House special, brewed fresh, peach and mint. Big glass?
Man: The iced tea, big glass, extra ice. Exactly what this evening needs.
Woman: One iced tea coming up!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Iced tea.
• Vì sao đúng: "The iced tea, big glass, extra ice. Exactly what this evening needs" — nhân viên xác nhận "One iced tea coming up!".
• Water sai: anh thấy nước lọc quá buồn tẻ sau một ngày mệt ("Water feels a bit sad after the day I've had").
• Beer sai: anh phải lái xe nên loại ("Tempting, but I'm driving, so beer is off the table, sadly").
👉 Mẹo: gọi đồ uống/đồ ăn — món đúng nằm ở lượt thoại chốt kèm chi tiết cụ thể (big glass, extra ice) và thường được nhân viên nhắc lại.

question_text: Where did they meet?
options: The back entrance
The front entrance
The side entrance
explanation:
Woman: You found the theatre alright last night? I looked for you at the interval!
Man: We nearly missed each other completely! I waited at the back entrance first — someone said the tickets were collected there.
Woman: Oh no, the back is only for the actors! And the side entrance?
Man: Locked, with a little sign pointing around the building. Very helpful in the rain!
Woman: Ha! So where did you finally find them?
Man: The front entrance, of course — under the big lights, where any sensible person would look first. My cousin was already there laughing at me, holding both tickets.
Woman: The front entrance, like every theatre since Shakespeare. You explorer!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The front entrance.
• Vì sao đúng: "The front entrance, of course — under the big lights... My cousin was already there laughing at me, holding both tickets".
• The back entrance sai: lối đó chỉ dành cho diễn viên ("Oh no, the back is only for the actors!").
• The side entrance sai: bị khóa, chỉ có tấm biển chỉ vòng ra chỗ khác ("Locked, with a little sign pointing around the building").
👉 Mẹo: các phương án chỉ khác nhau một tính từ (back/front/side). Nghe kỹ tính từ ngay trước danh từ chung, và bám vào nơi họ THỰC SỰ gặp nhau chứ không phải nơi tìm hụt.

question_text: Jack is calling to invite a friend to his house. What color is Jack’s house??
options: Black
Red
Green
explanation:
Man: Hello! Jack here — you're coming Saturday, yes? Let me describe the house so you don't wander the whole street.
Woman: Please do! Your street has forty identical houses, I've seen it.
Man: Identical except mine! Now — my neighbour's house is black, very dramatic, don't knock there, the dog is loud.
Woman: Noted. Avoid the black one and its opera dog.
Man: And across the road there's a green one — also not me, that's the retired teacher.
Woman: Black no, green no... so yours is...?
Man: Red! Bright red with white windows — my wife's choice, visible from space. You can't miss it.
Woman: A red beacon among the grey. Saturday at six, I'll follow the colour!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Red.
• Vì sao đúng: "Red! Bright red with white windows — my wife's choice, visible from space. You can't miss it".
• Black sai: là nhà hàng xóm, có con chó sủa to — "my neighbour's house is black, very dramatic, don't knock there, the dog is loud".
• Green sai: là nhà thầy giáo về hưu bên kia đường — "across the road there's a green one — also not me, that's the retired teacher".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi màu/đặc điểm, mỗi màu gắn với một CHỦ NHÀ. Bám sở hữu cách: "mine", "my house" mới là đáp án; "my neighbour's", "that's the..." là nhiễu.

question_text: Listen to two friends talking about their plans for the holiday. What are they going to do on this holiday?
options: Going camping
Traveling abroad
Teaching
explanation:
W: Only three weeks until the holiday! Have you decided what we're doing?
M: Well, my first idea was camping in the hills — tents, campfires, all of that.
W: In the rainy season? We'd float away in our sleeping bags!
M: True. Then I looked at flights — we could travel abroad, maybe Italy?
W: I'd love that, but honestly, after fixing the car, my savings are gone.
M: Which brings me to my last idea: the volunteer centre needs people to teach English at the summer camp. Free food, free rooms, and the kids are great.
W: Teaching at the camp... you know what, I really like that. Let's do it!
M: Excellent! I'll sign us both up tonight.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Teaching.
• Vì sao đúng: "the volunteer centre needs people to teach English at the summer camp. Free food, free rooms, and the kids are great" — cô đồng ý "I really like that. Let's do it!".
• Going camping sai: bị loại vì đang mùa mưa — "In the rainy season? We'd float away in our sleeping bags!".
• Traveling abroad sai: hết tiền tiết kiệm sau khi sửa xe — "after fixing the car, my savings are gone".
👉 Mẹo: dạng bàn kế hoạch, đáp án là ý CUỐI ("my last idea") kèm câu đồng thuận "Let's do it". Ý gắn với lý do cản trở (thời tiết, tiền bạc) là nhiễu.

question_text: Samia is going to meet her friend. What time are they going to meet?
explanation:
M: Samia! Are we still on for coffee tomorrow?
W: Of course! I was going to suggest half past nine, right when the café opens.
M: Ooh, that's early for a Saturday... I only get back from the gym around then.
W: Fair enough. Then how about eleven? The morning rush is over by then.
M: Eleven is a bit late, though — I promised Mum I'd drive her to the market at midday.
W: Okay, let's meet in the middle. Ten o'clock?
M: Ten is perfect. That gives us a whole two hours.
W: Ten it is, then. The usual table by the window!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 10:00.
• Vì sao đúng: "Okay, let's meet in the middle. Ten o'clock?" — "Ten is perfect. That gives us a whole two hours" và chốt "Ten it is, then".
• 9:30 sai: quá sớm cho thứ Bảy, lúc đó anh mới từ phòng gym về — "that's early for a Saturday... I only get back from the gym around then".
• 11:00 sai: hơi muộn vì trưa anh phải chở mẹ đi chợ — "Eleven is a bit late, though — I promised Mum I'd drive her to the market at midday".
👉 Mẹo: một người đưa giờ sớm, người kia chê muộn thì đáp án gần như luôn là mốc GIỮA. Bắt cụm "let's meet in the middle".

question_text: A man is calling his wife. Where do the couple meet?
options: At the restaurant
At the station
Outside a shop
explanation:
Man: Hi love, I've escaped the office early! Where shall we meet for the evening?
Woman: Wonderful! I thought the new restaurant — but I called, they're fully booked until nine.
Man: Nine is too late, I'm starving already. The station, then? It's halfway for both of us.
Woman: The station at rush hour? We'd spend the evening being bumped by suitcases, no thank you.
Man: Then our old classic: outside the bookshop — I mean the big shop on Market Street, by the blue doors.
Woman: Outside the shop, like our first date! I'll be there at six, don't get lost in the crime section before I arrive.
Man: No promises. Six o'clock, blue doors!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Outside a shop.
• Vì sao đúng: "outside the bookshop — I mean the big shop on Market Street, by the blue doors" và cô đồng ý "Outside the shop, like our first date!".
• At the restaurant sai: nhà hàng kín chỗ tới 9h, mà 9h thì quá muộn ("they're fully booked until nine" – "Nine is too late, I'm starving already").
• At the station sai: giờ cao điểm quá đông ("The station at rush hour? We'd spend the evening being bumped by suitcases, no thank you").
👉 Mẹo: địa điểm chốt thường đi kèm mô tả nhận diện (by the blue doors) và một câu hồi tưởng ("like our first date"). Đó là dấu hiệu chắc chắn nhất.

question_text: Two colleagues talk about meeting. When do they want to meet?
options: Monday
Wednesday
Tuesday
explanation:
Woman: We really must sit down about the budget before month-end. What suits you?
Man: This week is a minefield. Monday I'm training the new interns all day.
Woman: And Wednesday I'm out — the supplier visit in Birmingham, remember, whole day gone.
Man: That squeezes us. What about Tuesday? My calendar shows... actually nothing before noon.
Woman: Tuesday morning! Perfect — the office is quiet, the coffee machine has no queue.
Man: Tuesday at nine, small meeting room, spreadsheets and pastries?
Woman: Pastries are mandatory. Tuesday at nine, done!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Tuesday.
• Vì sao đúng: "Tuesday at nine, small meeting room, spreadsheets and pastries?" — cô ấy chốt "Tuesday at nine, done!".
• Monday sai: người đàn ông bận đào tạo thực tập sinh cả ngày — "Monday I'm training the new interns all day".
• Wednesday sai: người phụ nữ đi gặp nhà cung cấp ở Birmingham — "Wednesday I'm out — the supplier visit in Birmingham, remember, whole day gone".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hẹn lịch, gạch ngay ngày đi kèm "I'm out", "all day", "whole day gone". Ngày còn lại được CẢ HAI xác nhận ("perfect", "done") mới là đáp án.

question_text: Aman is ordering a drink. What does he want?
options: Beer
Water
Iced tea
explanation:
Woman: Evening! What are we drinking tonight?
Man: Something cold, I beg you. What's popular?
Woman: The beer garden selection just arrived — six new kinds, very proud of them.
Man: On any other night, yes! But I'm on antibiotics this week, so beer and I are on a break.
Woman: Sensible! Sparkling water then? Doctor-approved, with lime?
Man: Water while everyone celebrates feels like punishment... What's in that tall frosty glass over there?
Woman: Our fresh iced tea — peach, mint, mountains of ice. House recipe.
Man: That's the one. Iced tea, the biggest glass the law allows!
Woman: One legal maximum iced tea, coming up!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Iced tea.
• Vì sao đúng: sau khi nghe "Our fresh iced tea — peach, mint, mountains of ice", anh chốt "That's the one. Iced tea, the biggest glass the law allows!".
• Beer sai: anh phải kiêng vì đang uống kháng sinh — "I'm on antibiotics this week, so beer and I are on a break".
• Water sai: anh chê là như bị phạt giữa lúc mọi người ăn mừng — "Water while everyone celebrates feels like punishment".
👉 Mẹo: dạng gọi đồ uống, đáp án nằm ở lượt nói CUỐI của khách kèm mô tả cụ thể (cỡ ly, topping). Món có "on a break", "feels like punishment" là món bị từ chối.

question_text: Where is she taking the staff to?
options: To a different country
To a different city
To a village
explanation:
Man: I heard the boss is planning the annual staff trip! Any inside news?
Woman: Fresh from this morning's briefing! And it's bigger than the rumours.
Man: Bigger than the mountain village they mentioned in spring? The quiet cabins?
Woman: The village idea died — too small for forty people, only one restaurant.
Man: So the backup — that city break? Museums, hotels, the usual?
Woman: Also cancelled! Too similar to last year, people groaned. No — she's taking us to a different country! Portugal, four days, flights included!
Man: A different COUNTRY? Our boss has upgraded dramatically!
Woman: Passports ready by October. Start practising your obrigado!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To a different country.
• Vì sao đúng: "she's taking us to a different country! Portugal, four days, flights included!" — và "Passports ready by October".
• To a village sai: ý làng miền núi đã bị bỏ vì quá nhỏ cho 40 người — "The village idea died — too small for forty people, only one restaurant".
• To a different city sai: phương án dự phòng cũng bị hủy vì trùng kiểu năm ngoái — "Also cancelled! Too similar to last year, people groaned".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi điểm đến, nghe cụm đảo hướng "No — she's taking us to...". Nơi đi kèm "died", "cancelled" thì gạch; tên riêng (Portugal) là bằng chứng chốt.

question_text: What time do they meet?
explanation:
Man: Dinner tonight is confirmed! Now — the time. Eight o'clock like last month?
