👉 Mẹo: hỏi nơi mua sắm, đáp án nằm sau "No — I do my shopping at..."; hai nơi trước đó luôn kèm một lời chê.

question_text: A man is talking on the phone. What did the man lose?
options: Jacket
Glasses
Books
explanation:
Hi, yes — I'm calling about your lost property box, fingers crossed! I was on the six fifteen bus from the harbour last night, upstairs, front seat. This morning's inventory: my jacket, safe — I was wearing it home, thankfully, cold as it was. My books made it too, both of them, still in my bag. But my glasses — my reading glasses in the brown leather case — are gone. I think they slid off the seat when the bus braked at the bridge. Small, gold frames, quite scratched. Please say someone handed them in — I'm reading my newspaper at arm's length here!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Glasses (kính).
• Vì sao đúng: anh nói "But my glasses — my reading glasses in the brown leather case — are gone", còn mô tả thêm "Small, gold frames, quite scratched".
• Jacket sai: áo khoác vẫn còn "my jacket, safe — I was wearing it home".
• Books sai: sách cũng còn đủ "My books made it too, both of them, still in my bag".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MẤT ĐỒ GÌ khi gọi lost property, người nói sẽ điểm danh từng món. Bỏ mọi món đi kèm "safe", "made it too", "still in my bag"; lấy món đi kèm "gone", "missing", "I can't find".

question_text: According to the passage, what is the significance of 'profitability'?
options: It proves the company can cover costs and strengthen the company's position in the market.
It signals that the company has no further need for market research.
It suggests that the company can disregard the activities of its competitors.

question_text: A teacher is talking to her students. Where are the students now?
options: At school
In a townhouse
In a museum
explanation:
Gather round, everyone, and put your worksheets away for a moment! I know we usually have this lesson at school, but today is special. We are standing in a real Victorian townhouse — an actual family home from a hundred and fifty years ago, kept exactly as it was. This is not a museum, remember — a family still owns it, and they've kindly let our class visit. So no touching, gentle voices, and look at the kitchen first — see how they cooked without electricity!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – In a townhouse.
• Vì sao đúng: "We are standing in a real Victorian townhouse — an actual family home from a hundred and fifty years ago".
• At school sai: cô giáo nói rõ hôm nay khác lệ thường ("I know we usually have this lesson at school, but today is special").
• In a museum sai: bị phủ định thẳng ("This is not a museum, remember — a family still owns it").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "Where are they now", bám động từ hiện tại "We are standing in..."; nơi đi với "usually" hay "not a..." đều bị loại.

question_text: How many people live in the town?
explanation:
Let me tell you a bit about our town, because the numbers surprise people. If you read the old guidebook, it says five thousand people — but that was written forty years ago, before the new factory and the housing estates. Some locals proudly claim we've reached twenty thousand, which is... optimistic, let's say. The latest census gives the real figure: ten thousand people live here now. Exactly the right size, if you ask me — big enough for two supermarkets, small enough that the baker knows your name.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 10,000.
• Vì sao đúng: "The latest census gives the real figure: ten thousand people live here now."
• 5,000 sai: là số trong sách hướng dẫn viết cách đây 40 năm, trước khi có nhà máy và khu dân cư mới.
• 20,000 sai: là con số dân địa phương nói quá ("which is... optimistic, let's say").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi số liệu dân số, chọn con số gắn với nguồn chính thức: "the latest census", "the real figure".

question_text: What is the problem of the productivity strategies?
options: Using them effectively requires effort
They are not suitable for every kind of job
They are too complicated for beginners to follow

question_text: What is the way to exercise? / What is she going to do? / What does she do on her holidays?
options: Cycling
Running
Walking
explanation:
The doctor said I need regular exercise, and I've finally found my thing! Everyone had suggestions, of course. Cycling first — but the city traffic terrifies me on two wheels, I lasted exactly one day. Then running, which looks so easy when other people do it... my knees disagreed loudly after a week. What actually stuck is walking. An hour every evening, fast enough to feel it, slow enough to enjoy it. Three months now without missing a day, and I've never felt better!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Walking.
• Vì sao đúng: "What actually stuck is walking. An hour every evening" — ba tháng liền không bỏ ngày nào.
• Cycling sai: sợ giao thông trong thành phố, chỉ trụ đúng một ngày ("I lasted exactly one day").
• Running sai: đầu gối phản đối sau một tuần ("my knees disagreed loudly after a week").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi cách tập hiện tại, chọn ý đi với "what actually stuck"; hoạt động kèm mốc ngắn (one day, a week) là đã bỏ.

question_text: Listen to the chef announce to students. When is lunch ready?
explanation:
Students, your attention in the dining hall, please — today's lunch schedule has changed, so listen up! I know the notice board still says half past twelve; that was written before the delivery truck decided to break down this morning. And no, we cannot do quarter past one either, as some of you hopefully suggested — the ovens simply need their time. Lunch will be ready at two pm. Two o'clock sharp, and to apologise for the wait, there's apple pie for everyone. Two pm — spread the word!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 2:00 p.m.
• Vì sao đúng: thông báo chốt "Lunch will be ready at two pm. Two o'clock sharp" và nhắc lại "Two pm — spread the word!".
• 12:30 p.m sai: là giờ ghi trên bảng tin trước khi xe giao hàng hỏng "the notice board still says half past twelve; that was written before the delivery truck decided to break down".
• 1:15 p.m sai: bị bác bỏ vì lò nướng cần thời gian "we cannot do quarter past one either... the ovens simply need their time".
👉 Mẹo: dạng thông báo ĐỔI GIỜ, mốc gắn với "notice board", "still says" luôn là giờ cũ. Đáp án đi kèm thì tương lai "will be ready at" và thường được lặp lại 2 lần ở cuối.

question_text: Listen to a man talking. What is not working?
options: The Wifi
The computer
The printer
explanation:
Morning, Jenny — before you get here, a report from the front line. Mixed news. The wifi, miracle of miracles, is working perfectly — full signal in every room, even the kitchen. The printer behaved too: I printed the whole agenda without a single paper jam, first time this year. But the computer — the big one in the meeting room — is another story. It starts up, shows the logo, and then freezes solid. I've restarted it four times. The computer is properly broken, so bring your laptop, we'll present from that.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The computer.
• Vì sao đúng: "It starts up, shows the logo, and then freezes solid... The computer is properly broken, so bring your laptop."
• The Wifi sai: chạy hoàn hảo, phủ sóng cả bếp ("working perfectly — full signal in every room").
• The printer sai: in trọn bản chương trình mà không kẹt giấy ("I printed the whole agenda without a single paper jam").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi thứ KHÔNG hoạt động, dùng các cụm khen ("working perfectly", "behaved") để loại; đáp án nằm sau "But".

question_text: A mom is calling her son to remind him about picking up groceries. How much is an egg?
options: £1.50 (One pounds fifty)
£2.50 (Two pounds fifty)
£3.50 (Three pounds fifty)
explanation:
Sweetheart, it's Mum — grocery reminder, and this time with prices, because last week you came home with the fancy everything! Listen: we need a dozen eggs from the farm stall at the market. They're one pound fifty each — one fifty, the brown ones from the happy chickens, the lady knows me. Do NOT buy the golden organic ones at the deli, those cost nearly double and taste exactly the same. One pound fifty per egg, a dozen of them, and bring the change home. Love you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – £1.50 (one pound fifty).
• Vì sao đúng: mẹ nói rõ giá trứng ở quầy chợ "They're one pound fifty each", rồi nhắc lại chắc nịch "One pound fifty per egg, a dozen of them".
• £2.50 sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• £3.50 sai: cũng không có con số này; bài chỉ nói loại organic ở deli "cost nearly double" (đắt gần gấp đôi) chứ không đọc ra giá cụ thể.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIÁ hay bẫy bằng hai mặt hàng khác nhau. Bám vào món mà người nói yêu cầu mua (eggs from the farm stall) và bỏ qua giá của món bị cấm mua ("Do NOT buy...").

question_text: Listen to a woman explaining why she was late. What is the main reason she gets late?
options: Car broke down
Heavy traffic
Missed the train
explanation:
I'm so sorry everyone had to wait — let me explain this disaster of a morning. No, the car didn't break down, before anyone asks; it's in the garage all week anyway, that's old news. And the traffic was actually fine for once — the roads were practically empty. The truth is simpler and more embarrassing: I missed the train. By THIRTY seconds. I was on the platform watching it leave, and the next one wasn't for forty minutes. So here I am, with apologies and pastries for everybody!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Missed the train.
• Vì sao đúng: "The truth is simpler and more embarrassing: I missed the train. By THIRTY seconds." — chuyến sau 40 phút mới có.
• Car broke down sai: xe nằm gara cả tuần rồi, không liên quan hôm nay ("the car didn't break down... that's old news").
• Heavy traffic sai: đường hôm đó vắng ("the traffic was actually fine for once — the roads were practically empty").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lý do đi trễ, bám cụm "The truth is..."; các lý do kinh điển (xe hỏng, tắc đường) thường bị phủ định ngay đầu bài.

question_text: What is the speaker's advice in general?
options: Knowing the people and cultures in the different countries.
Only visit places with good weather conditions.
Cycle at your own pace without worrying about the destination.

question_text: Advanced technology could put many workers out of a job.
options: Man
Woman
Both

question_text: Listen to a nutrition expert. What time is the best for children to eat fruit?
options: In the morning
In the afternoon
In the evening
explanation:
A parent wrote in this week asking when children should eat fruit, and it's a lovely question. The answer from our research is clear: the morning is the best time. After a night's sleep, the body takes in the natural sugars and vitamins most effectively, and the energy carries the child through the school day. So put the banana or the apple on the breakfast table, not in the evening snack box. A simple change, and it makes a real difference.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – In the morning.
• Vì sao đúng: "The answer from our research is clear: the morning is the best time. After a night's sleep, the body takes in the natural sugars and vitamins most effectively".
• In the evening sai: bị loại thẳng — "So put the banana or the apple on the breakfast table, not in the evening snack box".
• In the afternoon sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "thời điểm tốt nhất", bắt cụm "the best time is". Câu "on the breakfast table, not in the evening" là bằng chứng kép: vừa xác nhận đáp án vừa loại nhiễu.

question_text: Globalisation is changing local traditions and ways of life
options: Man
Woman
Both

question_text: Lily is talking about her daily routine. What does she do in the evening?
options: Does yoga
Goes for a walk
Watches TV
explanation:
My daily routine is quite ordinary until the evening — that's when I have my little ritual. After dinner, I change into comfortable clothes, put my phone in the drawer, and go for a walk. Every single evening, forty minutes, the same loop through the quiet streets and along the canal. Summer or winter, rain or clear sky — the walk happens. It clears my head after work better than anything else I've tried. My neighbours say they could set their clocks by me!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Goes for a walk.
• Vì sao đúng: "After dinner, I change into comfortable clothes, put my phone in the drawer, and go for a walk. Every single evening, forty minutes".
• Does yoga sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Watches TV sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài; bài chỉ nói cô cất điện thoại vào ngăn kéo trước khi ra ngoài.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi thói quen, khóa mốc thời gian trong câu hỏi (evening) rồi bắt động từ đứng ngay sau mốc đó trong bài.

question_text: A man is describing his school. What color is the teacher's building?
options: Green
Blue
White
explanation:
Let me describe my school, because it's surprisingly colourful! The main building where we have lessons is green — bright green, you can spot it from the bus stop. Behind it stands the sports hall, painted blue like our team shirts. And then there's the teachers' building, the neat little one by the garden — that one is white. Completely white, with a red roof; the teachers say it stays cool in summer. White walls, quiet rooms — and woe to any student who leaves fingerprints on them!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – White.
• Vì sao đúng: "there's the teachers' building, the neat little one by the garden — that one is white. Completely white, with a red roof".
• Green sai: đó là màu tòa nhà học chính ("The main building where we have lessons is green").
• Blue sai: đó là màu nhà thể thao, sơn theo áo đội tuyển ("the sports hall, painted blue like our team shirts").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi màu sắc, mỗi màu được gán cho một tòa nhà khác nhau. Nghe kỹ DANH TỪ đứng trước màu, đừng chộp màu nghe được đầu tiên.

question_text: Listen to a saleswoman talking about a property. Which room is the largest?
options: Living room
Bedroom
Kitchen
explanation:
Come in, come in — let me show you around this lovely property! The living room here is a good size, comfortable for a sofa and two armchairs, and the bedroom upstairs is cosy — perfect for a good night's sleep, though I'll admit it's the smallest room in the house. But the real surprise is through here: the kitchen. It's the largest room in the whole house — the owners knocked two rooms together, so there's space for a big family table and all the cupboards you could want.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Kitchen.
• Vì sao đúng: "the kitchen. It's the largest room in the whole house — the owners knocked two rooms together, so there's space for a big family table".
• Bedroom sai: ngược lại, đây là phòng nhỏ nhất — "the bedroom upstairs is cosy... though I'll admit it's the smallest room in the house".
• Living room sai: chỉ ở mức khá rộng, không phải lớn nhất — "The living room here is a good size, comfortable for a sofa and two armchairs".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi so sánh nhất (largest), phải nghe hết cả ba phòng rồi mới chọn. Bám đúng cụm so sánh nhất "the largest room"; "a good size" chỉ là lời khen chung.

question_text: What difficulties is the city council having with this plan?
options: It has faced strong opposition from local businesses
The plan has already exceeded its budget by a large margin
The plan is not making efficient use of existing land

question_text: A teacher is talking to her students. Where are the students now?
options: At school
In a townhouse
In a museum
explanation:
Eyes on me for a moment, class — and yes, you may take your coats off! I can see the confusion: this doesn't look like our classroom because it isn't one. Nor is it a museum, despite the old paintings — no glass cases, no tickets, look around. We are guests today in a genuine Georgian townhouse — a private home, three centuries old, lived in by the same family for five generations. The lady of the house will join us upstairs. Notebooks out: everything you see — the stairs, the fireplaces — is your worksheet today!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – In a townhouse (trong một ngôi nhà phố cổ).
• Vì sao đúng: cô giáo nói "We are guests today in a genuine Georgian townhouse — a private home, three centuries old, lived in by the same family for five generations".
• At school sai: bị phủ định ngay "this doesn't look like our classroom because it isn't one".
• In a museum sai: cũng bị loại dù có tranh cổ "Nor is it a museum, despite the old paintings — no glass cases, no tickets".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐANG Ở ĐÂU, người nói thường loại trừ hai nơi dễ nhầm trước bằng "it isn't", "Nor is it". Đáp án đi kèm "We are... in" và mô tả đặc trưng (nhà riêng, ba thế kỷ, năm đời).

question_text: A man is talking about how he goes to work. Why does he prefer traveling by train?
options: It’s cheaper
It’s comfortable
Practical
explanation:
Everyone at the office drives, and they tease me about taking the train every day. Let me explain my choice. It's not about money — with the yearly ticket, the train actually costs me about the same as petrol and parking would. And comfort? Honestly, the seats are hard and in winter the heating is a lottery. No — the reason is that it's practical. The station is five minutes from my house, the train stops right by the office, and I answer all my emails on the way. Simple as that.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Practical (tiện lợi).
• Vì sao đúng: "the reason is that it's practical" — ga cách nhà 5 phút, tàu dừng ngay cạnh văn phòng, anh còn trả lời hết email trên đường.
• It's cheaper sai: anh phủ nhận thẳng ("It's not about money") — vé năm tính ra ngang tiền xăng cộng phí gửi xe.
• It's comfortable sai: ghế cứng, mùa đông hệ thống sưởi hên xui ("the seats are hard and in winter the heating is a lottery").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "Why does he prefer...", hãy săn cụm "the reason is" và gạch bỏ mọi ý bị phủ định bằng "It's not about..." hay "Honestly...".

question_text: A man is calling his sister. Where will they meet?
options: At the station
At the park
At the university
explanation:
M: Hi, how are you?
W: Oh! Are you calling from America?
M: No, I've been visiting the London office for a few days. Do you want to meet up? I have to catch a train at three.
W: Yes! There's a park near my flat. The weather's lovely and sunny, and there are lots of people around. Do you want to meet there?
M: Sure. Then I can walk you to your university afterwards — I don't have to be at the station until three.
W: OK, see you soon.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – At the park.
• Vì sao đúng: cô đề nghị "There's a park near my flat... Do you want to meet there?" và anh đồng ý "Sure".
• At the station sai: đó là nơi anh phải đến lúc 3 giờ SAU khi gặp.
• At the university sai: anh chỉ đi bộ đưa cô đến đó sau, không phải điểm hẹn.
👉 Mẹo: cả 3 địa điểm đều xuất hiện — chọn nơi có "meet there" + "Sure".

question_text: Using the Internet requires skills
options: Man
Woman
Both

question_text: Nate is on the phone with his friend. How long does Nate stay in India?
options: 3 days
1 week
2 weeks
explanation:
Mate, it's Nate — calling from Delhi, can you believe it, the connection is actually decent! Quick update since you asked about my plans. The original booking was just three days, you remember — the conference and straight home. Then the client meetings multiplied, so I stretched it to a week... and THEN my cousin here insisted I stay for the wedding. Long story short: I'm staying in India two weeks total. Two whole weeks! Back on the twentieth. Water my plants, feed my fish, and I'll bring you the good tea. Bye!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 2 weeks (hai tuần).
• Vì sao đúng: Nate chốt "Long story short: I'm staying in India two weeks total. Two whole weeks! Back on the twentieth".
• 3 days sai: là lịch đặt ban đầu "The original booking was just three days, you remember — the conference and straight home".
• 1 week sai: là lần gia hạn thứ nhất, sau đó còn kéo dài thêm "so I stretched it to a week... and THEN my cousin here insisted I stay for the wedding".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi Ở BAO LÂU, thời lượng bị nới dần theo trình tự. Đừng chọn mốc nghe được đầu tiên — bắt cụm tổng kết "in total", "Long story short" ở cuối bài.

question_text: An artist is talking about her job. What is the difference in her job?
options: She works from 9 to 5
She doesn't work on weekends
She works irregular hours
explanation:
People imagine being an artist is like any other job, and then they see my calendar and gasp! Here's the honest difference. My office friends work nine to five — I never do; some days I don't touch a brush until midnight, when the idea finally arrives. And weekends off? There's no such thing — if the light is beautiful on a Sunday morning, I'm painting on Sunday morning. That's the real difference: I work completely irregular hours. The painting decides my schedule, not the clock. Chaos — but I chose it, and I love it.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – She works irregular hours (giờ giấc thất thường).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "That's the real difference: I work completely irregular hours. The painting decides my schedule, not the clock".
• She works from 9 to 5 sai: đó là bạn bè làm văn phòng, không phải cô "My office friends work nine to five — I never do".
• She doesn't work on weekends sai: ngược lại, cô vẫn làm cuối tuần "And weekends off? There's no such thing — if the light is beautiful on a Sunday morning, I'm painting on Sunday morning".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐIỂM KHÁC BIỆT, bám đúng câu có từ "difference"/"the real difference is". Cẩn thận phương án lấy thông tin của NGƯỜI KHÁC (office friends) gán cho người nói.

question_text: How many pages of the assignment?
explanation:
One moment before the bell — the geography assignment, because I keep getting the same question! Yes, the cover sheet from the department says six pages, but that sheet is for the advanced class, not you. And no, Milo, five pages is not 'the usual' — I don't know where that number came from. For this class, the assignment is four pages. Exactly four: introduction, two pages of analysis, one page of conclusions. Four pages, double-spaced, Friday morning. Now off you go — and Milo? FOUR.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 4 trang.
• Vì sao đúng: "For this class, the assignment is four pages. Exactly four: introduction, two pages of analysis, one page of conclusions."
• 6 sai: là yêu cầu của lớp nâng cao, ghi trên tờ bìa của khoa ("that sheet is for the advanced class, not you").
• 5 sai: chỉ là con số truyền miệng, giáo viên không biết từ đâu ra ("I don't know where that number came from").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi số lượng, đáp án thường được nhắc lại rồi bẻ nhỏ ra ("Exactly four: introduction, two pages... one page").

question_text: A woman tells her friend about her plans for the day. What is the woman going to do?
options: Have coffee
Have lunch
Drink tea
explanation:
My day is planned to the minute, let me tell you — Fridays are precious! People assumed I'd do the big lunch thing with the office crowd, but I've begged off — two hours of work gossip isn't rest, it's overtime. And my aunt invited me for her afternoon tea ritual, bless her, but the tiny sandwiches never fill me and I always knock something over. No — today I'm going to have coffee. Proper coffee, at the little roastery by the canal, with my book and the corner armchair. Two uninterrupted hours. Heaven!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Have coffee (đi uống cà phê).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "today I'm going to have coffee. Proper coffee, at the little roastery by the canal, with my book and the corner armchair".
• Have lunch sai: cô đã từ chối bữa trưa với đồng nghiệp "I've begged off — two hours of work gossip isn't rest, it's overtime".
• Drink tea sai: lời mời của bà dì cũng bị từ chối "the tiny sandwiches never fill me and I always knock something over".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HÔM NAY LÀM GÌ, hai phương án nhiễu thường là lời mời của người khác đã bị từ chối ("People assumed...", "my aunt invited me"). Đáp án đi sau "No — today I'm going to...".

question_text: The younger generation does not care as much about their traditional culture
options: Man
Woman
Both

question_text: James is talking about his family members. In what way does his mother and his aunt alike?
options: They had similar hair styles
They had similar eye colors
They were thin
explanation:
Looking at these old family photos always makes me smile. Here's my mother and my aunt at the seaside, years before I was born. Funny thing — people never guessed they were sisters. Different hairstyles their whole lives: Mum short and curly, Auntie with the long plait. Different eyes too — one brown pair, one grey. But one thing they shared completely: both were remarkably thin. Thin as reeds, all their lives, however much grandma fed them. In every photo they look like two elegant matchsticks!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – They were thin.
• Vì sao đúng: "one thing they shared completely: both were remarkably thin. Thin as reeds, all their lives".
• They had similar hair styles sai: tóc khác nhau cả đời ("Different hairstyles their whole lives: Mum short and curly, Auntie with the long plait").
• They had similar eye colors sai: mắt cũng khác nhau ("Different eyes too — one brown pair, one grey").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi điểm GIỐNG nhau thì săn cụm "one thing they shared", "both were"; mọi chi tiết đi sau "Different" đều là bẫy.

question_text: What is the key to a long career in music?
options: Having a large number of fans.
Believing in her musical instincts.
Winning many awards early.
explanation:
People imagine that a long career in music is built on luck, but after twenty years managing artists, I can tell you what actually keeps a singer on stage. It is tempting to point at the obvious things. A large number of fans looks like security — yet I have watched artists with millions of followers disappear within two years because they chased whatever those fans wanted. Winning many awards early looks even better — but early trophies can be a trap, freezing a young artist in the style that won them. The real key, in my experience, is that a singer believes in her own musical instincts. The artists who last are the ones who trust their taste, choose songs that feel true to them, and politely ignore advice that pulls them away from their own sound. Audiences forgive a strange album; they never forgive a fake one.
Now, I will not pretend the industry is kind at the moment. Some outsiders think performers today have a lot of control over their careers, with all these digital platforms. Others complain that modern performers only care about money. Neither matches what I see every week. The honest truth is that performers find it very hard to get started. There are more talented people than ever competing for the same attention, and without strong support behind them, even remarkable voices go unheard. So when a new artist does break through, remember — you are watching someone who survived the hardest entrance exam in entertainment.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: Believing in her musical instincts. Bẫy: "large number of fans" và "winning awards early" đều được nhắc rồi bị loại (fan triệu người vẫn biến mất, giải sớm là cái bẫy).
2. Đáp án: Performers find it hard to get started. Bẫy: "have a lot of control" và "only care about money" là ý kiến người ngoài bị bác ("Neither matches what I see").

question_text: A man is calling his mother. How long will he be late?
options: 10 minutes
15 minutes
20 minutes
explanation:
Hi Mum, it's me — don't take the roast out yet! I'm still at the office; the printer decided to die exactly five minutes before my report was due, typical. The good news: everything is sent now and I'm packing my bag as I speak. The traffic app says the roads are clear, so I'll only be about ten minutes late — ten, no more, I promise. Keep my plate warm and don't let Dad eat my potatoes! See you very soon!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 10 minutes.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'll only be about ten minutes late — ten, no more, I promise" — đường đang thông thoáng.
• 15 minutes sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• 20 minutes sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi số phút trễ, đừng chộp con số đầu tiên; người nói thường nhắc lại con số đúng ngay sau đó ("ten, no more").

question_text: Doctor's office is calling to change the appointment. When is the new appointment?
options: On Friday 14th
On Thursday 30th
On Thursday 13th
explanation:
Good morning, this is a message from Doctor Hansen's office regarding your check-up appointment. Unfortunately the doctor must attend a conference, so we need to reschedule. Your original slot on Friday the fourteenth is cancelled. We first offered you Thursday the thirtieth, but a nearer slot has just opened, so please ignore that. Your new appointment is Thursday the thirteenth — one day EARLIER than the original, at the same time, ten thirty. Thursday the thirteenth, ten thirty. Please call reception to confirm. Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – On Thursday 13th (thứ Năm ngày 13).
• Vì sao đúng: tổng đài phòng khám nói "Your new appointment is Thursday the thirteenth — one day EARLIER than the original, at the same time, ten thirty".
• On Friday 14th sai: là lịch cũ đã bị hủy "Your original slot on Friday the fourteenth is cancelled".
• On Thursday 30th sai: là lịch được đề nghị trước đó rồi bỏ "We first offered you Thursday the thirtieth, but a nearer slot has just opened, so please ignore that".
👉 Mẹo: dạng ĐỔI LỊCH HẸN, bài cho 3 mốc theo thứ tự cũ → đề nghị → chính thức. Chỉ khoanh mốc đi sau "Your new appointment is", và cảnh giác hai ngày cùng là "Thursday" nhưng khác số (13 vs 30).

question_text: Why did the new podcast fail?
options: The content was too long.
The creators did not promote their show effectively.
It had too many listeners.
explanation:
You may have heard about the podcast that started here last spring with a lot of excitement — and quietly disappeared six months later. People have given different reasons for this. Some listeners felt the episodes were too long, and it is true that a few of them lasted over an hour. But the numbers show that people who started an episode usually listened to the end, so length was not the real problem. Others say there was too much competition, with thousands of shows fighting for attention. Competition is real, of course, but plenty of small podcasts in even busier areas have grown steadily. No — the reason this one failed is simpler: the creators hardly told anyone it existed. There was nothing on social media, no visits to other shows, no attempt to reach the people who might have been interested. However good your episodes are, an audience cannot find a show it has never heard of. Promotion is not an extra — it is half the job.
Still, one failed show should not change our view of podcasting itself. I know some people say podcasting is a waste of time, and others see it as nothing more than light entertainment for the journey to work. I see it differently. A good podcast brings people together around something they share, lets them hear each other's ideas, and slowly builds a loyal community that few other formats can create. That, to me, is its real value.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: The creators did not promote their show effectively. Bẫy: "content too long" bị bác bằng số liệu, "too much competition" (phương án mới thay cho "too many listeners" vô lý) bị bác bằng ví dụ.
2. Đáp án: It is a great way to build a community. Bẫy: "waste of time" và "only useful for entertainment" đều là ý người khác bị phản bác.

question_text: What is not original?
options: Furniture
Home
Bicycle
explanation:
Welcome to my little historical corner! Everyone who visits asks the same question: is it all really original? Mostly, yes! The home itself is completely authentic — these walls went up in the eighteen sixties, and even the floorboards are the ones the first family walked on. The old bicycle in the hallway is genuine too — my great-grandfather's, still with his initials. But the furniture, I must confess, is not original. The real pieces were sold long before my time, so these are careful copies, made from old photographs.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Furniture.
• Vì sao đúng: "But the furniture, I must confess, is not original... these are careful copies, made from old photographs."
• Home sai: ngôi nhà là đồ thật, xây từ thập niên 1860 ("The home itself is completely authentic").
• Bicycle sai: xe đạp của cụ cố, còn nguyên chữ khắc tên ("The old bicycle in the hallway is genuine too").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi dạng phủ định ("What is NOT original") thì chọn thứ DUY NHẤT bị chê; săn cụm "But... is not" ở cuối bài.

question_text: Anne is calling her daughter Sally. What does Anne need?
options: Eggs
Bread
Milk
explanation:
Sally, darling, it's Mum — please listen to this before you drive over! You asked what to bring for the baking afternoon. We're actually fine for most things: I bought two loaves of bread this morning, still warm from the bakery, and the milk delivery came yesterday, the fridge is full of it. What I DO need is eggs — I'm six short for the sponge cakes. Half a dozen eggs, the fresher the better. Just the eggs, sweetheart, nothing else! Drive safely, see you at three!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Eggs (trứng).
• Vì sao đúng: bà mẹ nói rõ "What I DO need is eggs — I'm six short for the sponge cakes. Half a dozen eggs" và nhấn mạnh "Just the eggs, nothing else!".
• Bread sai: đã mua rồi "I bought two loaves of bread this morning, still warm from the bakery".
• Milk sai: cũng đã có sẵn "the milk delivery came yesterday, the fridge is full of it".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CẦN MUA GÌ, nghe cụm nhấn giọng "What I DO need is..." và các dấu hiệu "we're fine for", "I already bought" (đã đủ, loại). Số lượng đi kèm (six short, half a dozen) là bằng chứng phụ xác nhận đáp án.

question_text: Why does Douglas call Kay?
options: to ask for a favor
to say thank you
to discuss ideas
explanation:
Kay, it's Douglas — please don't delete this message before hearing it all! I'm not calling to ask for anything, I promise — no favours this time, your car and your ladder are safe from me. And no, it's not about the project ideas either, we can talk about those any day. I'm calling to say thank you. Properly. What you did for my family last week, taking Mum to the hospital when I was stuck abroad — I will never forget it. Dinner is on me, any restaurant you choose. Thank you, Kay.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – To say thank you.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm calling to say thank you. Properly." — cảm ơn vì Kay đã đưa mẹ anh đi viện khi anh kẹt ở nước ngoài.
• To ask for a favor sai: anh phủ nhận ngay ("I'm not calling to ask for anything, I promise — no favours this time").
• To discuss ideas sai: cũng bị gạt ("no, it's not about the project ideas either, we can talk about those any day").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi mục đích cuộc gọi, bắt đúng cụm "I'm calling to..."; những ý đi với "I'm not calling to" là bẫy đặt ngay đầu bài.

question_text: A woman is talking about her vacation. What is the relationship between the speaker and Lisa?
options: Best friends
Mother and daughter
Teacher and student
explanation:
Everyone keeps asking about my vacation photos, especially about Lisa — who is this woman in every single picture? So let me clear it up! No, she's not my daughter, though she does steal my chips like one. And people at the hotel kept assuming she was my old teacher because she lectures me about sunscreen. The truth: Lisa and I are best friends — thirty years now, since we sat together on the first day of secondary school. Every summer, one trip, just the two of us. Same again next year, Lisa!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Best friends.
• Vì sao đúng: "The truth: Lisa and I are best friends — thirty years now, since we sat together on the first day of secondary school."
• Mother and daughter sai: bị phủ định thẳng ("No, she's not my daughter, though she does steal my chips like one").
• Teacher and student sai: chỉ là người ở khách sạn tưởng vậy vì Lisa hay nhắc bôi kem chống nắng ("people at the hotel kept assuming").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi quan hệ giữa hai người, bám cụm "The truth:"; quan hệ đi với "people assumed" hoặc "she's not" đều là bẫy.

question_text: What is the strength of the book?
options: It is a very short story.
It has a good description of a specific period of time.
It focuses only on famous people.
explanation:
This new biography has been getting a lot of attention, so let me tell you what I think after reading it twice. First, do not be fooled by what you may have heard. Some people call it a very short story — in fact it runs to six hundred pages. Others complain that books like this focus only on famous people, but the author gives just as much space to the subject's unknown childhood friends and forgotten colleagues as to the celebrities he later met. The genuine strength of the book is its description of a specific period of time. The author rebuilds the nineteen-fifties in extraordinary detail — the prices in the shops, the songs on the radio, the fears people carried through the decade. Reading it, you do not just learn about one man's life; you walk through the world he lived in, street by street.
The critics have had plenty to say as well, and their discussion is interesting. A few worried at first that the book would be too difficult to understand, and one reviewer even suspected it contained too many fictional details. Both concerns faded once they read it carefully — the language is clear and every scene is supported by documents. What the critics actually agree on is this: it is an unconventional biography. It ignores the traditional rules of the genre, jumps through time, and sometimes lets minor characters tell whole chapters. That unusual structure is exactly what makes it stand out from every other biography this year.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: It has a good description of a specific period of time. Bẫy: "very short story" bị phủ định ("six hundred pages"), "focuses only on famous people" bị phủ định.
2. Đáp án: It is an unconventional biography. Bẫy: "too difficult to understand" và "too many fictional details" là lo ngại ban đầu đã bị xóa ("Both concerns faded").

question_text: A man is calling his wife. Where will they meet?
options: At home
In the garden
Outside the shop
explanation:
Love, it's me — change of plan for this afternoon, listen before you leave! I know I said I'd come home first and we'd go together, but the meeting is running long and I'd never make it. And waiting in the garden makes no sense now — the forecast says rain from four. So: meet me outside the shop — the big furniture place on Kings Road where we're choosing the sofa. I'll be by the main entrance at half past four. Bring the measurements! And the umbrella, apparently. See you there!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Outside the shop (trước cửa hàng).
• Vì sao đúng: anh chồng chốt "meet me outside the shop — the big furniture place on Kings Road", hẹn cụ thể "by the main entrance at half past four".
• At home sai: đó là kế hoạch cũ đã bỏ "I said I'd come home first and we'd go together, but the meeting is running long and I'd never make it".
• In the garden sai: bị loại vì thời tiết "waiting in the garden makes no sense now — the forecast says rain from four".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐỊA ĐIỂM luôn có tín hiệu đổi kế hoạch ("change of plan", "but", "makes no sense now"). Nơi đúng là nơi xuất hiện SAU các từ này và đi kèm chi tiết cụ thể (tên đường, cửa chính, giờ hẹn).

question_text: What is the woman doing?
options: Cleaning
Swimming
Crying
explanation:
Don't come into the kitchen with your shoes on — I'm warning you! I've been cleaning since eight this morning and I'm not done yet. The windows are washed, the shelves are dusted, the oven — oh, the oven took me two whole hours, I nearly gave up. Now I'm scrubbing this floor, and when it dries, the whole room has to shine. Your mother is visiting tomorrow, and this time she will NOT find a single spot of dust. Hand me that bucket, please!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Cleaning.
• Vì sao đúng: "I've been cleaning since eight this morning and I'm not done yet" — lau cửa sổ, phủi kệ, cọ lò nướng, giờ đang cọ sàn.
• Swimming sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Crying sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "What is she doing", bắt các thì đang tiếp diễn ("I've been ...ing", "Now I'm ...ing") — đó là hành động thực sự đang xảy ra.

question_text: A man is calling his friend to meet for coffee. Where is the coffee shop located?
options: Opposite the gift shop
In the shopping center
Next to the bookstore
explanation:
Hey Marco, it's Ben! Coffee this afternoon, yes? Let me tell you exactly where the place is, because everyone gets lost the first time. It's NOT the one inside the shopping centre — that one closed last month. You know the little gift shop on King Street, with the postcards in the window? Our coffee shop is directly opposite the gift shop — green door, tables outside. Cross the road from the gift shop and you're there. Four o'clock? First coffee is on me!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Opposite the gift shop.
• Vì sao đúng: "Our coffee shop is directly opposite the gift shop — green door, tables outside" — đối diện tiệm quà lưu niệm trên phố King Street.
• In the shopping center sai: người nói phủ định ngay ("It's NOT the one inside the shopping centre") và quán đó đã đóng cửa tháng trước.
• Next to the bookstore sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi vị trí, nghe nguyên cụm giới từ (opposite / next to / inside) gắn với mốc, đừng chộp mỗi tên cửa hàng nghe được.

question_text: Machines will only support people rather than replace them at work.
options: Man
Woman
Both

question_text: The Internet is changing the way we think
options: Man
Woman

question_text: Listening to a tour guide talking about Rock City. How old is the city?
options: 1000 years
2000 years
1500 years
explanation:
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Rock City, one of the oldest places you will ever stand in! Now, how old is it? The first guidebooks, a century ago, guessed one thousand years — far too careful. Some local legends even claim two thousand, which makes a better story than it does history. The real answer, confirmed by the archaeologists who worked here for a decade: this city is one thousand five hundred years old. Fifteen centuries of lives lived between these stones. Follow me through the gate!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 1500 years.
• Vì sao đúng: "The real answer, confirmed by the archaeologists who worked here for a decade: this city is one thousand five hundred years old. Fifteen centuries".
• 1000 years sai: là phỏng đoán trong sách hướng dẫn cách đây một thế kỷ — "The first guidebooks, a century ago, guessed one thousand years — far too careful".
• 2000 years sai: chỉ là truyền thuyết địa phương — "Some local legends even claim two thousand, which makes a better story than it does history".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi tuổi/niên đại, chọn con số gắn với NGUỒN KHOA HỌC ("confirmed by the archaeologists"). Số đi kèm "guessed", "legends claim" là nhiễu.

question_text: What is Mary's number?
explanation:
Hello dear, it's Auntie June — you asked for Mary's telephone number for the wedding invitations, so grab a pencil! Ready? It's five five five, three nine two zero. I'll say it once more, slowly, because you know what happened with the last invitations: five, five, five... three, nine, two, zero. That's her home line — she gave up the mobile, says it rings too much. Call her before Thursday, she's off to her sister's after that. Good luck with the planning, sweetheart!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 555 3920.
• Vì sao đúng: bà đọc rõ hai lần "It's five five five, three nine two zero" rồi lặp lại chậm "five, five, five... three, nine, two, zero" — tức 555 3920.
• 335 3902 sai: đảo thứ tự chữ số, không khớp dãy được đọc.
• 333 3029 sai: bài không hề có chuỗi "three three three".
👉 Mẹo: dạng số điện thoại luôn được đọc lại lần hai chậm hơn. Ghi lần một, đối chiếu lần hai, chú ý cụm lặp "five five five" và chữ "zero" ở cuối.

question_text: A man is calling his mother. How long will he be late?
options: 10 minutes
15 minutes
20 minutes
explanation:
Mum, it's me — small delay alert, don't panic! The pharmacy queue was endless — Mrs. Patel's prescriptions take a committee, apparently. I've got your medicine, everything on the list, plus those biscuits you pretend not to like. I'm at the bus stop now and the next one is due any second. So: I'll be ten minutes late, just ten — quarter past instead of five past. Keep the tea warm and don't start the crossword without me! See you in a bit!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 10 minutes (muộn 10 phút).
• Vì sao đúng: anh báo rõ "I'll be ten minutes late, just ten — quarter past instead of five past" (5 giờ 05 dời thành 5 giờ 15, đúng 10 phút).
• 15 minutes sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu — con số "quarter past" là chỉ GIỜ đến (15 phút hơn), không phải số phút muộn.
• 20 minutes sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MUỘN BAO LÂU, phân biệt "ten minutes late" (khoảng thời gian) với "quarter past" (điểm giờ). Câu hỏi hỏi độ dài thì chỉ lấy con số đi liền với "late/delay".

question_text: A woman is talking about her holiday plan. Where is she going on holidays?
options: The beach
The mountains
The city
explanation:
Everyone at work is asking about my holiday, so here's the plan! For years we always went to the beach — the same crowded sand, the same sunburn — and this year I finally said no more. I'm going to the mountains! Two weeks in a little wooden cabin, walking trails straight from the front door, cool air, and not a beach umbrella in sight. I've already bought proper boots. Honestly, I've never looked forward to a holiday this much.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The mountains.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm going to the mountains! Two weeks in a little wooden cabin, walking trails straight from the front door" — cô còn "already bought proper boots".
• The beach sai: là thói quen của NHIỀU NĂM TRƯỚC, năm nay đã dứt khoát bỏ — "For years we always went to the beach... and this year I finally said no more".
• The city sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi điểm đến, phân biệt thói quen cũ ("For years we always...") với kế hoạch mới ("I'm going to..."). Chi tiết chuẩn bị (mua giày) là bằng chứng chốt.

question_text: When is the assignment due?
options: on Friday
on Saturday
on Sunday
explanation:
One moment before you all disappear — the essay deadline, because the corridor rumours have gone wild! Some of you are panicking about Friday: relax, Friday is only when the topic list closes, nothing is due then. And whoever invented Sunday — no. I do not read essays on Sundays, ever. The assignment is due on Saturday. Saturday, by ten in the morning, printed on my desk or uploaded to the portal. Saturday at ten. Plan your week backwards from there — and Milo, write it down!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – On Saturday.
• Vì sao đúng: "The assignment is due on Saturday. Saturday, by ten in the morning, printed on my desk or uploaded to the portal."
• On Friday sai: thứ Sáu chỉ là hạn chốt danh sách đề tài ("Friday is only when the topic list closes, nothing is due then").
• On Sunday sai: giáo viên bác thẳng ("I do not read essays on Sundays, ever").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi hạn nộp, cẩn thận với các mốc khác trong bài (chốt đề tài, phát đề); chỉ chọn ngày đi kèm từ "due".

question_text: A woman is calling her son. What time will the mother meet the son?
options: Six o’clock
Two o’clock
Three o'clock
explanation:
Danny, it's Mum — pick-up plan for today, memorise this! Your football practice was supposed to end at two, but Coach messaged all the parents: the other team needs the field early, so everything moved. And no, I can't do six either, love — Grandma's dinner starts at five, we'd be shamefully late. So: I will meet you at three o'clock. Three, at the school side gate, the usual spot by the bike racks. Three o'clock, Danny — showered and READY, not 'just five more minutes'. Love you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Three o'clock (3 giờ).
• Vì sao đúng: mẹ chốt "So: I will meet you at three o'clock. Three, at the school side gate, the usual spot by the bike racks".
• Two o'clock sai: là giờ tan tập ban đầu nhưng đã đổi "Your football practice was supposed to end at two, but Coach messaged all the parents... so everything moved".
• Six o'clock sai: bị loại vì bữa tối nhà bà "I can't do six either, love — Grandma's dinner starts at five, we'd be shamefully late".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MẤY GIỜ ĐÓN, cẩn thận với "was supposed to" (dự kiến cũ). Đáp án đi sau "So:" và luôn kèm địa điểm đón cụ thể.

question_text: Listen to an auction man talking about a cabinet. Which part of the cabinet is original?
options: The drawer
The doors
The handles
explanation:
Lot forty-two, ladies and gentlemen — this handsome oak cabinet, and let me be precise about its history, as you'd expect from this house. Much has been replaced over two centuries, I won't pretend otherwise. The doors you see are Victorian replacements — well made, but a hundred years younger than the body. The brass handles are newer still, nineteen twenties at best. But the drawer — the central drawer is completely original! Note the hand-cut joints and the maker's stamp inside. That drawer alone justifies the estimate. Shall we start at four hundred?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The drawer (ngăn kéo).
• Vì sao đúng: người điều hành đấu giá nhấn mạnh "the central drawer is completely original! Note the hand-cut joints and the maker's stamp inside".
• The doors sai: là đồ thay thế thời Victoria "The doors you see are Victorian replacements — well made, but a hundred years younger than the body".
• The handles sai: còn mới hơn nữa "The brass handles are newer still, nineteen twenties at best".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi BỘ PHẬN NÀO NGUYÊN BẢN, quét từ khóa đối lập: "replacements", "newer", "younger" = loại; "completely original", "genuine" = chọn. Bằng chứng đi kèm (dấu thợ, mộng gỗ đục tay) xác nhận đáp án.

question_text: What will this musician do in the near future?
options: He will probably retire from singing
He plans to release a new album
He wants to collaborate with younger artists
explanation:
Welcome back to Music Legends. Tonight we look at a singer who has stood on the world's stages for more than forty years — and at the question everyone is asking: what comes next? The rumours have been flying. Several young artists have said publicly how much they would love to collaborate with him, and his fan clubs are convinced a new album is on the way. I have to disappoint both groups. In his interview last week, the singer said clearly that he has no plans to return to the studio and no interest in new projects. He wants a quieter life away from the lights. His farewell concert takes place next month, and after that, he will most probably retire from singing completely. He admits his voice is no longer what it was, and he would rather stop at a high point than fade slowly.
Looking back at his career, how does he judge it himself? Here his honesty surprised me. He does not regret choosing this profession — music, he says, gave him everything. And he laughed at the suggestion that he reached his peak too early; in his own view, his best albums came in his forties. But he admits one quiet thought that stays with him: he believes he could have been more successful. There were offers he turned down, tours he cancelled, years he wasted on arguments with record labels. Fame at his level, he says, is a wonderful thing — but the thought of what might have been never fully leaves an artist.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: He will probably retire from singing. Bẫy: "new album" là niềm tin của fan, "collaborate with younger artists" là mong muốn của nghệ sĩ trẻ — cả hai bị chính ca sĩ bác bỏ.
2. Đáp án: He could have been more successful. Bẫy: "regrets choosing his profession" bị phủ định ("music gave him everything"), "reached the peak too early" bị phủ định ("he laughed at the suggestion").

question_text: What is the speaker's opinion about the current music industry?
options: Performers find it hard to get started.
Performers have a lot of control.
Performers only care about money.

question_text: A man is ordering a drink. What does he want?
options: Water
Iced tea
Beer
explanation:
Good evening! Give me a second, it's been a long hot day... Right, drinks. My wife would tell me to just have water, and normally I would, but tonight deserves better than water, honestly. And before you suggest it — no beer for me, I'm driving the whole family home later, so that's completely out. What I'd really love is your iced tea — the homemade one with lemon I saw on the board outside? A tall glass, lots of ice, please. Actually, make it two — I'll be quick with the first!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Iced tea.
• Vì sao đúng: "What I'd really love is your iced tea — the homemade one with lemon... A tall glass, lots of ice, please."
• Water sai: vợ anh sẽ bảo uống nước lọc nhưng tối nay anh muốn hơn thế ("tonight deserves better than water").
• Beer sai: anh phải lái xe chở cả nhà về ("no beer for me, I'm driving the whole family home later").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi món gọi, bắt câu có động từ đặt hàng ("I'd love...", "make it two"); món gắn với lý do từ chối (đang lái xe) luôn sai.

question_text: What do the critics say about the book?
options: It is an unconventional biography.
It is too difficult to understand.
It contains too many fictional details.

question_text: The Internet has made people less patient
options: Man
Woman
Both

question_text: Listen to the instructions of a university. Where is the main office?
options: in the basement
on the first floor
on the second floor
explanation:
Welcome to the university, everyone — a few practical directions before we start the tour. The most important place for you this week is the main office, where you'll register and collect your student cards. You'll find it on the first floor of this building, directly at the top of the main stairs — you can't miss the blue sign. It's open from eight thirty to five. Registration takes about ten minutes if you bring your documents. Right — let's begin!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – on the first floor.
• Vì sao đúng: "You'll find it on the first floor of this building, directly at the top of the main stairs — you can't miss the blue sign".
• in the basement sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• on the second floor sai: cũng không được nhắc tới; bài chỉ nêu duy nhất tầng một.
👉 Mẹo: bài hướng dẫn không cài bẫy thì chỉ cần bắt cụm chỉ vị trí ngay sau "You'll find it..." và giữ lại chi tiết xác nhận (top of the stairs, blue sign).

question_text: Stronger measures are needed to keep personal data private.
options: Man
Woman
Both

question_text: Visiting places in person is the most effective way to learn about different cultures
options: Man
Woman
Both

question_text: Jack is calling to invite a friend to his house. What color is Jack’s house??
options: Black
Red
Green
explanation:
Hey Omar, it's Jack — you're really coming Saturday! Let me describe the house so you don't wander the whole street like Ben did. Number fourteen, Cherry Lane. Now, careful: my NEIGHBOUR's house is the black one with the iron gates — very dramatic, not mine, don't ring that bell, the dog is theatrical. Across the road there's a green one — also not me, that's the retired sea captain. Mine is the red house! Brick red, white windows, lemon tree by the door. The red one, number fourteen. Party starts at six!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Red (màu đỏ).
• Vì sao đúng: Jack nói "Mine is the red house! Brick red, white windows, lemon tree by the door. The red one, number fourteen".
• Black sai: đó là nhà hàng xóm "my NEIGHBOUR's house is the black one with the iron gates — very dramatic, not mine, don't ring that bell".
• Green sai: là nhà đối diện của ông thuyền trưởng về hưu "Across the road there's a green one — also not me".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MÀU NHÀ/ĐỒ VẬT, bài cố tình gán màu cho hàng xóm và nhà đối diện trước. Chỉ khoanh màu đi kèm đại từ sở hữu "Mine is...", "my house is...".

question_text: Listen to a man talking about his journey to work. How does the man usually go to work?
options: By motorbike
By car
By train
explanation:
My journey to work — everyone asks because I live so far out. When I was younger I rode a motorbike, rain or shine, but after two winters of frozen fingers I sold it and never looked back. People say take the train, and I would, but the nearest station is a thirty-minute walk from my house, which defeats the point. So these days I usually go by car. Forty minutes with my podcasts and my coffee in the holder — honestly, it's the calmest part of my day.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By car.
• Vì sao đúng: "So these days I usually go by car. Forty minutes with my podcasts and my coffee in the holder".
• By motorbike sai: đã bán sau hai mùa đông tê cóng tay ("I sold it and never looked back").
• By train sai: ga gần nhất cách nhà 30 phút đi bộ nên đi tàu là vô nghĩa ("which defeats the point").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi có "usually" thì chọn phương tiện gắn với hiện tại ("these days I usually..."), bỏ mọi thứ chia ở quá khứ.

question_text: A woman is going to the cinema with her husband. What time does the movie begin?
explanation:
Darling, it's me — change of plan for the cinema tonight, listen carefully! I know we talked about the nine twenty show, but that finishes after midnight and you have your early meeting tomorrow. And the seven o'clock one is completely sold out — I just checked, not a single pair of seats together. So I've booked the early show instead: it begins at six forty. Six forty sharp, so leave the office by six at the latest. I'll get the popcorn — see you there!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 6:40.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I've booked the early show instead: it begins at six forty. Six forty sharp".
• 7:00 sai: suất đó đã bán hết vé, không còn hai ghế cạnh nhau ("completely sold out").
• 9:20 sai: là suất bàn ban đầu nhưng kết thúc sau nửa đêm, trong khi chồng có họp sớm hôm sau.
👉 Mẹo: giờ tiếng Anh hay đọc rời "six forty"; nghe từng chữ số và bám động từ quyết định "I've booked".

question_text: Listen to a voice message. How does Even feel?
options: Sick
Happy
Tired
explanation:
Hey, it's Even — returning your three missed calls, sorry about that! And apologies for this croaky voice you're hearing. Before you ask: no, I'm not just tired — I actually cancelled everything and slept twelve hours last night, so rest isn't the issue. And I wish I could say I'm happy, but this week has other plans for me. Truth is, I'm sick — proper flu, the doctor confirmed it this morning: fever, aching bones, the lot. So Friday's hike is off for me, I'm afraid. I'll ring you when I'm back among the living!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Sick (bị ốm).
• Vì sao đúng: Even nói "Truth is, I'm sick — proper flu, the doctor confirmed it this morning: fever, aching bones, the lot".
• Happy sai: bị phủ định "I wish I could say I'm happy, but this week has other plans for me".
• Tired sai: cũng bị loại trực tiếp "no, I'm not just tired — I actually cancelled everything and slept twelve hours last night, so rest isn't the issue".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CẢM THẤY THẾ NÀO, đừng đoán theo giọng nói (croaky voice). Bắt cụm "Truth is, I'm..." và loại trạng thái đi sau "I'm not just...", "I wish I could say...".

question_text: Listen to Sarah talking about her hobby. What does she do in her free time?
options: Go to the beach and swim
Go to theater and play sports
Watch TV and read books
explanation:
People think I just sit at home because I work in a library, but my free time is the opposite! Two things fill my evenings and weekends. First, the theatre — I never miss a new play, I've seen everything our city theatre has staged this year, even the strange modern ones. And second, sports — tennis on Tuesdays, volleyball with the girls on Fridays. Going to the theatre and playing sports — one for the mind, one for the body, as my grandmother used to say!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Go to theater and play sports.
• Vì sao đúng: cô tự tổng kết đúng hai việc: "Going to the theatre and playing sports — one for the mind, one for the body".
• Go to the beach and swim sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Watch TV and read books sai: bài chỉ nói người ta TƯỞNG cô ngồi nhà vì làm ở thư viện, rồi bác ngay ("my free time is the opposite").
👉 Mẹo: phương án có HAI hoạt động thì phải đúng cả hai. Bám cụm đếm "Two things fill my evenings... First... And second...".

question_text: A tour guide is talking about the group's traveling schedule. Where will the group wait for the bus?
options: By the hotel's main entrance
In the lobby
At the train station
explanation:
Good evening, everyone — important details for tomorrow's excursion, so listen carefully! Now, about the meeting point. It is NOT the lobby — I know we met there today, but tomorrow the lobby is closed for cleaning until nine. And please don't go to the train station like the group last week; our tour doesn't use the train at all. The bus will collect us by the hotel's main entrance — the big glass doors facing the fountain — at eight o'clock sharp. Main entrance, eight o'clock. Sleep well!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – By the hotel's main entrance.
• Vì sao đúng: "The bus will collect us by the hotel's main entrance — the big glass doors facing the fountain — at eight o'clock sharp".
• In the lobby sai: hôm nay có gặp ở đó nhưng mai sảnh đóng cửa để dọn dẹp — "It is NOT the lobby — I know we met there today, but tomorrow the lobby is closed for cleaning until nine".
• At the train station sai: tour không dùng tàu, đó là nhầm lẫn của nhóm tuần trước — "our tour doesn't use the train at all".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi điểm hẹn, hướng dẫn viên hay nhấn mạnh "It is NOT...". Chốt ở nơi có mô tả nhận diện cụ thể (cửa kính lớn, đài phun nước) kèm giờ.

question_text: What is his opinion about the musician?
options: He regrets choosing his profession
He could have been more successful
He believes he reached the peak too early

question_text: A woman is going to the cinema with her husband. What time does the movie begin?
explanation:
Sweetheart, cinema update, listen before you plan your evening! The romantic comedy we wanted — three showings today. Forget the nine twenty; we're not those night people anymore, we'd sleep through the ending. The seven o'clock had exactly two seats left — in the FIRST row, our necks would never forgive us. So I grabbed the early one: the movie begins at six forty. Six forty! Which means leave work at six, no dawdling, no 'one last email'. Popcorn duty is mine. Don't be late, love!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 6:40.
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "So I grabbed the early one: the movie begins at six forty. Six forty! Which means leave work at six".
• 7:00 sai: chỉ còn hai ghế hàng đầu nên bị loại "The seven o'clock had exactly two seats left — in the FIRST row, our necks would never forgive us".
• 9:20 sai: quá muộn "Forget the nine twenty; we're not those night people anymore, we'd sleep through the ending".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi SUẤT CHIẾU MẤY GIỜ, bài luôn nêu đủ 3 suất. Chọn suất đi kèm hành động đã mua vé ("I grabbed", "I booked") và có mốc phụ (giờ rời cơ quan) xác nhận.

question_text: Tom is calling his mom. Who is visiting Tom this weekend?
options: His aunt and uncle
His sister and her children
His cousin
explanation:
Hi Mum, it's Tom! Quick call about the weekend, because my plans just changed completely. You remember I thought Auntie Rose and Uncle Jim might come? They've moved their visit to next month — Jim's back is playing up again. And no, it's not cousin Danny either, he's still working abroad until Christmas. It's actually my sister and her children! All three of them, Saturday to Monday. So I need your lasagne recipe, urgently — the kids won't eat anything else. Call me back!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – His sister and her children.
• Vì sao đúng: "It's actually my sister and her children! All three of them, Saturday to Monday" — nên Tom mới cần gấp công thức lasagne.
• His aunt and uncle sai: đã dời chuyến thăm sang tháng sau vì lưng chú Jim ("They've moved their visit to next month").
• His cousin sai: Danny vẫn làm việc ở nước ngoài đến Giáng sinh ("he's still working abroad until Christmas").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "Who...", chờ cụm bẻ hướng "It's actually..." hoặc "No, it's..." — người xuất hiện ngay sau đó mới là đáp án.

question_text: A woman is talking about her house. What is she going to change in their house?
options: The window
The car
The computer
explanation:
We finally decided what to change in the house this year — the budget allows exactly one big project, so the family voted! My husband campaigned hard for a new car, but the old one passed its inspection fine, so that argument died. The kids demanded a new computer — of course they did — but theirs is barely three years old. The winner is the window! The big one in the living room: it's single glass from the seventies, rattles in every storm, and lets all our heating money fly outside. New window before winter!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The window.
• Vì sao đúng: "The winner is the window! The big one in the living room: it's single glass from the seventies... New window before winter!"
• The car sai: chồng vận động mạnh nhưng xe cũ vẫn qua đăng kiểm nên lý lẽ đó không còn ("the old one passed its inspection fine").
• The computer sai: máy của bọn trẻ mới dùng chưa đầy ba năm ("theirs is barely three years old").
👉 Mẹo: dạng bình chọn trong gia đình, bám cụm "The winner is"; mỗi đề xuất còn lại đều bị bác bằng một lý do cụ thể.

question_text: A girl is calling her mother. Which dress does she want?
options: Short and blue
Long and white
Long and red
explanation:
Mum? It's me, I'm at the dress shop for the graduation — I need your card details and your blessing! Okay, so they have three that fit me. There's a short blue one — cute, but Grandma would faint, it's VERY short. Then a long white one, which is elegant, but white at a graduation? One drop of juice and it's over. The one I actually want is the long red one — deep red, floor-length, and it fits like it was made for me. The red one, Mum. Please say yes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Long and red.
• Vì sao đúng: "The one I actually want is the long red one — deep red, floor-length, and it fits like it was made for me."
• Short and blue sai: quá ngắn, bà sẽ ngất ("Grandma would faint, it's VERY short").
• Long and white sai: màu trắng quá rủi ro ở lễ tốt nghiệp ("One drop of juice and it's over").
👉 Mẹo: khi phương án ghép ĐỘ DÀI + MÀU thì phải khớp cả hai; nghe kỹ "long/short" đứng ngay trước màu chứ đừng chỉ bắt màu.

question_text: A mom is talking to her son. What does he like to study?
options: Art
Science
History
explanation:
My son and I had the big what-do-you-love talk last night — every parent knows that one! For years we assumed he'd follow his father into science; the truth is, the boy only liked the lab because of the coloured liquids. And history, my own favourite — he says the dates fall straight out of his head, poor thing. But art! Give that child a pencil and he disappears for hours — portraits, buildings, our cat in seventeen positions. He likes studying art, really studying it. So art classes it is, twice a week from September!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Art (mỹ thuật).
• Vì sao đúng: bà mẹ khẳng định "He likes studying art, really studying it" — đưa bút chì là cậu bé vẽ hàng giờ, và bà chốt "So art classes it is, twice a week from September".
• Science sai: cậu chỉ thích bề ngoài chứ không thích môn học "the boy only liked the lab because of the coloured liquids".
• History sai: cậu không nhớ nổi mốc thời gian "he says the dates fall straight out of his head" — đó là môn mẹ thích, không phải cậu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi THÍCH HỌC MÔN GÌ, phân biệt sở thích của người nói với sở thích của nhân vật được nói tới (history là "my own favourite" của mẹ). Đáp án đi kèm động từ "likes/loves" gắn trực tiếp với người được hỏi.

question_text: Max is calling his friend. How much can Max pay for the computer?
options: 150 pounds
250 pounds
350 pounds
explanation:
Hey, it's Max — you asked about my computer budget before we hit the second-hand fair, so here are my numbers! I originally hoped to keep it at one hundred and fifty, but let's be honest, at that price we'd be buying someone's problems. And the shiny ones your brother keeps sending me are all three fifty plus — completely outside my universe. So here's the real figure: I can pay two hundred and fifty pounds. Two fifty, cash, final ceiling — savings plus what I got for the old bike. Guard me from temptation on Saturday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: Max chốt "here's the real figure: I can pay two hundred and fifty pounds. Two fifty, cash, final ceiling".
• 150 pounds sai: là mức anh từng mong nhưng tự loại "I originally hoped to keep it at one hundred and fifty, but... at that price we'd be buying someone's problems".
• 350 pounds sai: là giá máy mới, ngoài tầm với "the shiny ones your brother keeps sending me are all three fifty plus — completely outside my universe".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi TRẢ ĐƯỢC BAO NHIÊU, phân biệt "hoped/originally" (mong muốn cũ) với "I can pay" (khả năng thật). Đáp án đi kèm từ chốt như "the real figure", "final ceiling", "budget".

question_text: Linda is talking about her mother. What do mother and daughter have in common?
options: Similar appearance
Similar interests
Similar personalities
explanation:
Everyone asks if I take after my mother, and the answer always surprises them! Looks? Not at all — she's tall and fair, I'm small and dark like Dad's side; strangers never believe we're related. Personalities? Even less — she's calm as a lake, I explode over lost keys. But our interests! That's where we're twins. We both collect old maps, we both grow orchids on every windowsill, we both watch detective series and guess the villain out loud. Same hobbies, same passions — every weekend together is a joint project!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Similar interests (sở thích giống nhau).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "But our interests! That's where we're twins" và liệt kê bằng chứng: cùng sưu tầm bản đồ cổ, cùng trồng lan, cùng xem phim trinh thám — "Same hobbies, same passions".
• Similar appearance sai: ngoại hình khác hẳn "Looks? Not at all — she's tall and fair, I'm small and dark like Dad's side".
• Similar personalities sai: tính cách còn trái ngược hơn "Even less — she's calm as a lake, I explode over lost keys".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐIỂM CHUNG, bài đi theo cấu trúc "Looks? No. Personalities? No. But...". Đáp án luôn nằm sau chữ "But" và có ít nhất hai ví dụ minh họa.

question_text: What is the speaker's opinion about podcasting?
options: It is a waste of time.
It is a great way to build a community.
It is only useful for entertainment.

question_text: Listen to a man calling his friend. Why does he make the call?
options: To ask for directions
To invite her out
To tell her he will be late
explanation:
Nadia, hi, it's Sam — don't hang up, this is a thirty-second call! First: no, I haven't got lost again, I know exactly where the theatre is this time, I even checked the parking. And I'm not calling with another invitation — we're already set for tonight, aren't we, no changes there. It's just... the client meeting is running over, badly. I'll be late — maybe twenty-five minutes. Go in without me, leave my ticket at the desk, and I'll slide into my seat at the interval if I must. Sorry!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – To tell her he will be late.
• Vì sao đúng: "the client meeting is running over, badly. I'll be late — maybe twenty-five minutes. Go in without me."
• To ask for directions sai: anh khẳng định đã biết đường ("I know exactly where the theatre is this time, I even checked the parking").
• To invite her out sai: hai người đã hẹn sẵn tối nay ("I'm not calling with another invitation — we're already set for tonight").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi mục đích cuộc gọi, hai câu mở đầu thường phủ định đúng 2 phương án; đáp án nằm sau "It's just...".

question_text: What type of location does the speaker enjoy living in most?
options: The countryside
The suburbs
The city
explanation:
Where do I love living? People assume the answer is the countryside, because I paint landscapes — but two summers in a village taught me that I need more than cows for conversation. The suburbs seemed like a good middle path once: nice lawns, friendly neighbours... and absolutely nothing happening after eight pm. The truth is, I'm a city person to my bones. Give me the crowded markets, the late-night galleries, the noise, the mess, all of it. The city is where I feel alive.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The city.
• Vì sao đúng: "The truth is, I'm a city person to my bones... The city is where I feel alive."
• The countryside sai: hai mùa hè ở làng cho thấy cô cần người để trò chuyện ("I need more than cows for conversation").
• The suburbs sai: từng có vẻ là lựa chọn trung dung nhưng "absolutely nothing happening after eight pm".
👉 Mẹo: hỏi nơi thích sống, "People assume the answer is..." là dấu hiệu ý đó SAI; đáp án nằm sau "The truth is".

question_text: A tour guide is introducing a tourist destination. How many people live in the town?
explanation:
As our bus rolls into the valley, let me introduce the little town where we'll spend the afternoon! Now, the numbers — because our brochure is embarrassingly out of date. It still prints eight thousand residents, but that count is from before the riverside district was built. Last year a newspaper claimed nine thousand, also wrong — they missed the two new apartment blocks entirely. The town hall's official register, updated this spring, says ten thousand people live here now. Ten thousand — and one very good chocolate shop, which we will visit!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 10,000.
• Vì sao đúng: hướng dẫn viên dẫn nguồn chính thức "The town hall's official register, updated this spring, says ten thousand people live here now".
• 8,000 sai: là số in trong tờ rơi đã lỗi thời "It still prints eight thousand residents, but that count is from before the riverside district was built".
• 9,000 sai: là số báo đăng năm ngoái và bị bác bỏ "Last year a newspaper claimed nine thousand, also wrong — they missed the two new apartment blocks".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi SỐ LIỆU dân số/số lượng luôn cho 3 con số kèm nguồn khác nhau. Chọn con số gắn với nguồn mới nhất và chính thức nhất ("official", "updated this spring"), loại ngay số đi cùng "out of date", "wrong", "claimed".

question_text: What did she like best about the film?
options: the mountain scenes
the action scenes
the ending
explanation:
I finally saw that film everyone's been recommending, and I have opinions! People kept raving about the action scenes, but honestly, they were too loud and far too long — my ears needed a holiday afterwards. The ending? Predictable, I saw it coming an hour away. But what I truly loved — what made the whole ticket worth it — were the mountain scenes. Filmed in real snow, with that golden morning light on the peaks... I actually forgot to eat my popcorn. I'd watch it again just for those mountains.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The mountain scenes.
• Vì sao đúng: "what I truly loved — what made the whole ticket worth it — were the mountain scenes. Filmed in real snow".
• The action scenes sai: quá ồn và quá dài ("they were too loud and far too long").
• The ending sai: dễ đoán, cô biết trước cả tiếng ("Predictable, I saw it coming an hour away").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "liked best", tìm cụm cực cấp "what I truly loved"; mọi thứ đi với "too + tính từ" đều là lời chê.

question_text: Listen to the speaker talking on the radio. What is she talking about?
options: Her favorite hobby
Her journey to work
Her weekend plans
explanation:
Welcome back to Morning Radio, and today, dear listeners, I want to tell you about something I do every single day — my journey to work! You might expect me to talk about my weekend plans, they're certainly more glamorous, or my beloved pottery hobby — another day, I promise. No, today it's the journey, because mine is special: a ferry! Every morning I cross the bay — twenty minutes of seagulls, salt air and sunrise before the microphone. The best commute in radio, and I'll tell you all about it after this song!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Her journey to work (hành trình đi làm của cô).
• Vì sao đúng: MC mở đầu "I want to tell you about something I do every single day — my journey to work!" và nhấn lại "today it's the journey, because mine is special: a ferry!".
• Her favorite hobby sai: nghề gốm chỉ được hẹn dịp khác "or my beloved pottery hobby — another day, I promise".
• Her weekend plans sai: cũng chỉ được nhắc để loại "You might expect me to talk about my weekend plans... No, today it's the journey".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐANG NÓI VỀ CHỦ ĐỀ GÌ, người dẫn hay liệt kê những thứ họ KHÔNG nói hôm nay ("You might expect me to...", "another day"). Chủ đề thật đi kèm "today it's...".

question_text: A man is talking about his daily routine. What does he do after work?
options: Go home
Go to the coffee shop
Play football
explanation:
My after-work routine — people assume it's boring, but it's the highlight of my day! Five o'clock hits, laptop closes. Now, my colleagues head straight to the coffee shop downstairs — I skip that, caffeine after five turns me into an owl. And going straight home? That's what I did for years: sofa, screen, sleep, repeat — never again. What I do now: I play football! Five-a-side, every single evening after work, the pitch behind the depot. Ninety minutes of running and shouting with the lads — best therapy money can't buy!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Play football (chơi bóng đá).
• Vì sao đúng: anh nói "What I do now: I play football! Five-a-side, every single evening after work, the pitch behind the depot".
• Go to the coffee shop sai: đó là việc đồng nghiệp làm, anh bỏ qua "my colleagues head straight to the coffee shop downstairs — I skip that, caffeine after five turns me into an owl".
• Go home sai: là thói quen cũ đã từ bỏ "That's what I did for years: sofa, screen, sleep, repeat — never again".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi SAU GIỜ LÀM LÀM GÌ, phân biệt ba mốc: việc của đồng nghiệp, việc mình từng làm ("for years", "never again"), và việc hiện tại ("What I do now"). Chỉ lấy vế thứ ba.

question_text: Listen to a voice message. How does Evan feel?
options: Happy
Tired
Sick
explanation:
Hey, it's Evan, returning your call. Sorry I couldn't pick up — and sorry in advance for this voice. Yes, I sound terrible, and no, it's not because I'm tired — I've actually slept about eleven hours a day since Tuesday. That's kind of the problem. The doctor says it's a proper flu: fever, cough, the whole package. I'm sick as a dog, mate. So the gym plan this week is cancelled, and you should probably keep your distance for a few days. I'll call when I'm human again!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Sick.
• Vì sao đúng: "The doctor says it's a proper flu: fever, cough, the whole package. I'm sick as a dog, mate."
• Happy sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Tired sai: anh phủ nhận vì đã ngủ 11 tiếng mỗi ngày ("it's not because I'm tired — I've actually slept about eleven hours a day").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi cảm giác, đừng đoán theo giọng nói; bám triệu chứng cụ thể (fever, cough) và thành ngữ "sick as a dog".

question_text: How does he travel?
options: By car
By plane
By train
explanation:
My work takes me across the country twice a month, and people always assume I fly. I did try the plane for a while — but between getting to the airport two hours early and the delays, it's honestly no faster door to door. Driving?
