Five hours behind the wheel and I arrive useless, fit only for a nap. So now I always travel by train. Three and a half hours, a table to myself, wifi that mostly works — I finish my reports on the way and arrive fresh. The train wins every time.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – By train.
• Vì sao đúng: "So now I always travel by train. Three and a half hours, a table to myself" — anh làm xong báo cáo trên tàu.
• By car sai: lái 5 tiếng thì đến nơi kiệt sức ("I arrive useless, fit only for a nap").
• By plane sai: đã thử nhưng cộng thời gian chờ và trễ chuyến thì không nhanh hơn ("it's honestly no faster door to door").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi phương tiện hiện tại, bám trạng từ tần suất "always / now"; phương tiện đi với "I did try... but" là thứ đã bỏ.

question_text: Listen to the director talking about sales of his company. How many copies of Freeze Frame magazine were sold?
options: Over 200,000 copies
Over 300,000 copies
Over 500,000 copies
explanation:
Good morning, everyone, and thank you for coming to our annual results meeting. Let me start with the number you're all waiting for: Freeze Frame magazine. Some of you will remember we sold just over two hundred thousand copies two years ago, and our target for this year was half a million — ambitious, I admit, and no, we didn't quite reach it. But we did sell over three hundred thousand copies — our best result ever, and fifty percent growth. Congratulations to the whole team!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Over 300,000 copies.
• Vì sao đúng: "But we did sell over three hundred thousand copies — our best result ever, and fifty percent growth".
• Over 200,000 copies sai: là kết quả của HAI NĂM TRƯỚC — "we sold just over two hundred thousand copies two years ago".
• Over 500,000 copies sai: chỉ là mục tiêu đặt ra và chưa đạt — "our target for this year was half a million — ambitious, I admit, and no, we didn't quite reach it".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi doanh số, tách rõ ba loại số: kết quả cũ, mục tiêu, kết quả thật. Chỉ con số sau "we did sell" mới là đáp án.

question_text: A tour guide is talking about birds' behaviors. What do birds do in the winter?
options: They stay together in groups for protection
They fly south
They hunt for food
explanation:
If you look up at the tall trees on your left, you'll see dozens of small nests — and this brings me to a question I get on every tour: what do these birds do in the winter? People expect me to say they fly south, but not these ones. These birds stay right here through the coldest months, and they survive by staying together in groups — sometimes fifty or sixty birds sharing one tree, keeping each other warm and safe from the hawks. Protection in numbers. Nature is clever, isn't it?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – They stay together in groups for protection.
• Vì sao đúng: "These birds stay right here through the coldest months, and they survive by staying together in groups" — hướng dẫn viên chốt lại "Protection in numbers".
• They fly south sai: chính hướng dẫn viên bác bỏ ("People expect me to say they fly south, but not these ones").
• They hunt for food sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi về tập tính động vật hay gài đáp án "ai cũng nghĩ" ở đầu bài. Nghe "People expect me to say... but" là biết ý đó sai.

question_text: A tour guide is making an announcement. Why was the tour canceled
options: Not enough people
Bad weather
Transportation problems
explanation:
Ladies and gentlemen, an announcement about tomorrow's castle tour, and I'm afraid it's disappointing news: the tour has been cancelled. Now, let me stop the theories I've heard in the lobby! It is NOT the weather — tomorrow is forecast sunny and mild, perfect walking conditions, which makes this all the more painful. Nor is it the coach; our transport is booked, fuelled and ready. The plain truth: not enough people signed up. We need twelve for the castle to open its doors, and we have five. Refunds at reception — or recruit seven friends by tonight!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Not enough people (không đủ người đăng ký).
• Vì sao đúng: hướng dẫn viên nói thẳng "The plain truth: not enough people signed up. We need twelve for the castle to open its doors, and we have five".
• Bad weather sai: bị phủ định trực tiếp "It is NOT the weather — tomorrow is forecast sunny and mild, perfect walking conditions".
• Transportation problems sai: xe đã sẵn sàng "Nor is it the coach; our transport is booked, fuelled and ready".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi LÝ DO HỦY, người nói thường chủ động dập tin đồn ("let me stop the theories"). Bỏ mọi thứ đi sau "It is NOT..." / "Nor is it...", lấy thứ đi sau "The plain truth is...".

question_text: A receptionist is checking the client list of a clinic. How many clients are Americans?
options: One
Two
Three
explanation:
Right, doctor — quick summary of tomorrow's client list before you go home. Eight appointments in total. The Silva family, that's three of them, they're Brazilian — the little one needs the translator again. Then we have two Canadians, the couple from the ski accident. The gentleman at four o'clock, Mr. Miller — people always assume he's American, but he corrected me twice: Australian. So of all eight, exactly one is American: Mrs. Baker at ten, the knee check-up. Just the one American. See you at eight!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – One.
• Vì sao đúng: "So of all eight, exactly one is American: Mrs. Baker at ten, the knee check-up. Just the one American."
• Two sai: hai người Canada là cặp đôi bị tai nạn trượt tuyết ("we have two Canadians"), không phải người Mỹ.
• Three sai: ba người nhà Silva là người Brazil ("The Silva family, that's three of them, they're Brazilian").
👉 Mẹo: dạng đếm theo điều kiện, kẻ nhanh bảng quốc tịch–số người; các số 3 và 2 trong bài thuộc nhóm khác, đừng chộp bừa. Chú ý bẫy "people always assume he's American" (ông Miller thực ra là người Úc).

question_text: Listen to a student explaining the project. Why did the students do the experiment on the tree?
options: To study the effects of pollution
To measure the speed of the plant's growth
To observe how trees absorb water
explanation:
For the science fair, our group chose the big pine tree by the car park — and everyone asks why. Simple: we wanted to study the effects of pollution. The tree stands right where all the parents' cars idle every morning, so we compared its needles with a tree from the quiet side of the school. We measured, photographed, and tested for six weeks. The difference was bigger than we expected — you can literally see the traffic in the needles. Our poster is in the main hall if you want the details!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To study the effects of pollution.
• Vì sao đúng: "we wanted to study the effects of pollution" — nhóm so lá thông cạnh bãi đỗ xe với cây ở phía yên tĩnh của trường.
• To measure the speed of the plant's growth sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• To observe how trees absorb water sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi mục đích thí nghiệm, bắt cụm "we wanted to..." / "the aim was"; phần mô tả đo đạc, chụp ảnh chỉ là phương pháp.

question_text: How does she go to school?
options: She drives
She takes the bus
She walks
explanation:
People ask how I get to school, expecting something boring — and my answer surprises them! Mum offered to drive me every morning, but sitting in the school traffic queue makes me carsick, honestly. The bus? It's fine in winter, but it takes the long route through three villages and I'd rather sleep those extra minutes. So I walk! Twenty-five minutes through the fields, every single day, rain or shine. My friends think I'm mad, but I arrive awake, and I know every cat on the route by name.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – She walks.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I walk! Twenty-five minutes through the fields, every single day, rain or shine."
• She drives sai: mẹ đề nghị chở nhưng xếp hàng vào trường khiến cô say xe ("makes me carsick").
• She takes the bus sai: xe buýt đi vòng qua ba ngôi làng nên cô thà ngủ thêm.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi cách di chuyển, đề nghị của người khác ("Mum offered to drive me") luôn là nhiễu; chọn động từ chủ ngữ "I" ở hiện tại đơn.

question_text: A man is calling his friend. Where will they meet?
options: At school
By the park
In the cafe
explanation:
Marco! It's Jules — Sunday plan, final version, I promise! So, the school is out: they're resurfacing the playground and the whole block smells of tar, trust me, I jogged past this morning. The café was plan B, but they've got a private party booked — some christening, balloons everywhere. So: the park! We'll meet by the park — the north gate, where the chestnut trees are, eleven sharp. Bring the frisbee and the flask. If I'm three minutes late, the coffee's on me. By the park, north gate! Bye!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By the park (ở công viên).
• Vì sao đúng: Jules chốt "So: the park! We'll meet by the park — the north gate, where the chestnut trees are, eleven sharp" và nhắc lại "By the park, north gate!".
• At school sai: trường đang thi công "they're resurfacing the playground and the whole block smells of tar".
• In the cafe sai: quán đã có tiệc riêng "they've got a private party booked — some christening, balloons everywhere".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HẸN Ở ĐÂU trong tin nhắn thoại, người nói loại từng phương án kèm lý do rồi mới chốt. Nghe câu lặp lại ở cuối lời nhắn — đó luôn là đáp án.

question_text: Aman is ordering a drink. What does he want?
options: Beer
Water
Iced tea
explanation:
What a day at this street festival — my feet are finished and my throat is a desert! Right, the drinks stall. My mates are all waving their beers at me, but I'm the designated driver tonight, so beer is completely off the table. There's free water at the fountain, sensible... but after five hours of walking I deserve better than sensible, surely. What I really want is that iced tea — the fresh one with the mint and lemon they're pouring over mountains of ice. A large iced tea. Maybe two. Definitely two!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Iced tea (trà đá).
• Vì sao đúng: anh nói "What I really want is that iced tea — the fresh one with the mint and lemon they're pouring over mountains of ice. A large iced tea".
• Beer sai: anh là người lái xe tối nay "I'm the designated driver tonight, so beer is completely off the table".
• Water sai: có nước miễn phí nhưng anh muốn thứ ngon hơn "There's free water at the fountain, sensible... but after five hours of walking I deserve better than sensible".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GỌI ĐỒ UỐNG GÌ, bám cụm "What I really want is...". Đồ uống bị loại luôn kèm lý do cá nhân (lái xe, dị ứng, quá nhạt) — nghe ra lý do là loại được ngay.

question_text: A man is calling his friend. Where will they meet?
options: At school
By the park
In the cafe
explanation:
Hey Chris, it's Alex — about tomorrow! Small change: we're NOT meeting at the school gates like usual, the whole street is dug up for pipe works and it's chaos. I also thought about the café, but Saturday mornings there are madness, we'd queue for an hour just for the table. So let's make it simple: meet me by the park — the main entrance, next to the fountain, eleven o'clock. We can decide about lunch from there. Text me if that's a problem!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By the park.
• Vì sao đúng: "So let's make it simple: meet me by the park — the main entrance, next to the fountain, eleven o'clock".
• At school sai: cả con phố đang bị đào để làm đường ống ("the whole street is dug up for pipe works").
• In the cafe sai: sáng thứ Bảy quán quá đông, phải xếp hàng cả tiếng chỉ để có bàn.
👉 Mẹo: tin nhắn đổi kế hoạch luôn mở đầu bằng "we're NOT meeting at..."; địa điểm đúng nằm sau "So let's make it simple".

question_text: A tour guide is talking about the vacation list of activities. What can people do in the afternoon?
options: Visit museums
Play golf
Go swimming
explanation:
Good morning, everyone, let me walk you through today's activity list! The mornings this week are for the museums — the art gallery today, the history museum tomorrow, always before lunch when the rooms are quiet. Now, the afternoons: I know the programme mentioned swimming, but the pool is closed for repairs until Friday, I'm sorry. Instead, the afternoon activity is golf! The hotel course is beautiful, clubs are free for our group, and beginners are very welcome. We meet at the course at two o'clock!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Play golf.
• Vì sao đúng: "the afternoon activity is golf! The hotel course is beautiful, clubs are free for our group" — hẹn ở sân lúc 2 giờ.
• Visit museums sai: đó là hoạt động buổi SÁNG ("The mornings this week are for the museums").
• Go swimming sai: có in trong chương trình nhưng bể đang sửa đến thứ Sáu ("the pool is closed for repairs until Friday").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi lịch trình, khóa mốc thời gian trong câu hỏi (afternoon) trước khi chọn; hoạt động in sẵn trong programme thường đã bị thay đổi.

question_text: A man is talking about his routine after work. What is the man going to do after work?
options: Goes running
Cycles home
Meets his client
explanation:
People ask how I survive the stress of this job, and the answer happens every day at five thirty sharp. First, what I DON'T do: I don't cycle home anymore — I sold the bike, the traffic ruined the fun. And no more evening clients either; I made that rule in January and my doctor approves. What I do is go running. Straight from the office, along the canal, forty-five minutes, every single workday. Rain, wind, doesn't matter. The run washes the whole day off me before I walk through my front door.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Goes running (đi chạy bộ).
• Vì sao đúng: anh nói "What I do is go running. Straight from the office, along the canal, forty-five minutes, every single workday" — chạy ngay sau giờ làm, mỗi ngày.
• Cycles home sai: đã bỏ hẳn "I don't cycle home anymore — I sold the bike, the traffic ruined the fun".
• Meets his client sai: cũng đã cấm "no more evening clients either; I made that rule in January".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi AI LÀM GÌ / thói quen, hãy nghe cấu trúc đối lập "what I DON'T do... What I do is...". Đáp án luôn nằm ở vế khẳng định, và thường được xác nhận bằng tần suất ("every single workday").

question_text: Listen to the man talking. What did he leave in the yard?
options: a laptop
shoes
a shirt
explanation:
Oh no. Oh no, no, no. I knew I'd forgotten something! I was sitting in the yard this afternoon, reading in the sun — took my shoes off to feel the grass, you know how I do. Then the phone rang, and I ran inside to answer it... and now it's pouring with rain, and my shoes — my good leather shoes! — are still out there in the yard, filling up with water. They'll be ruined! Where's the umbrella? I have to rescue them, right now!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – shoes.
• Vì sao đúng: "my shoes — my good leather shoes! — are still out there in the yard, filling up with water".
• a laptop sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• a shirt sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi đồ để quên, tìm câu than "Oh no" rồi bắt danh từ đi cùng "still out there" — đó là món bị bỏ lại.

question_text: Listen to a tour guide introducing the tour. Where will tea be served?
options: In the park
The hotel
The river boat
explanation:
Welcome, everyone, to our city discovery day! A quick outline of the afternoon. We begin with a gentle walk through the old park, then a short stop at the hotel to drop off any shopping. And now the part I'm most excited about: at four o'clock we board the river boat, and that is where tea will be served — sandwiches, scones and a full pot, while the city floats past the windows. Trust me, it's the best table in town. Any questions before we set off?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The river boat.
• Vì sao đúng: "at four o'clock we board the river boat, and that is where tea will be served — sandwiches, scones and a full pot".
• In the park sai: công viên chỉ là chặng đi dạo mở đầu — "We begin with a gentle walk through the old park".
• The hotel sai: khách sạn chỉ là chỗ ghé nhanh để gửi đồ mua sắm — "then a short stop at the hotel to drop off any shopping".
👉 Mẹo: lịch trình tour nêu 3 địa điểm theo thứ tự, nhưng câu hỏi chỉ hỏi nơi diễn ra MỘT hoạt động. Bám cụm "that is where tea will be served".

question_text: Why did she return to the shop?
options: To exchange a shirt
To buy a skirt
To exchange a dress
explanation:
What a morning I've had! Remember the shirt I bought my husband for our anniversary? The striped one, from the shop by the bank? Well, he tried it on last night, and the sleeves ended somewhere around his elbows — completely the wrong fit. So I went back to the shop first thing to exchange the shirt for a bigger size. Luckily they had one left, and the lady even ironed it for me. Disaster averted — the anniversary dinner is saved. Now I just need to hide it until Friday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To exchange a shirt.
• Vì sao đúng: "I went back to the shop first thing to exchange the shirt for a bigger size" — chiếc áo sơ mi kẻ sọc tặng chồng bị ngắn tay.
• To buy a skirt sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• To exchange a dress sai: món đồ là áo sơ mi ("the shirt I bought my husband"), không phải váy.
👉 Mẹo: khi các phương án chỉ khác nhau một danh từ (shirt / skirt / dress), nghe kỹ phụ âm đầu và dựa vào bối cảnh (tay áo, quà cho chồng).

question_text: Listen to a tour guide. Where is the office located?
options: Next to the park
Opposite the hotel
Above a restaurant
explanation:
Everyone, gather round for one practical detail before we split up — where to find me if anything goes wrong! Our tour office is your safety net today. Now, careful: it is NOT next to the park anymore — we moved out of that little kiosk last season. And whoever told you it's above a restaurant is thinking of our old branch across town. Our office is directly opposite the hotel — yes, the very hotel where you're staying! Big blue sign, can't miss it, open until nine tonight. Right — cameras ready, let's explore!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Opposite the hotel (đối diện khách sạn).
• Vì sao đúng: hướng dẫn viên chỉ rõ "Our office is directly opposite the hotel — yes, the very hotel where you're staying! Big blue sign, can't miss it".
• Next to the park sai: là địa chỉ cũ đã bỏ "it is NOT next to the park anymore — we moved out of that little kiosk last season".
• Above a restaurant sai: đó là chi nhánh cũ ở khu khác "whoever told you it's above a restaurant is thinking of our old branch across town".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi VĂN PHÒNG/ĐỊA ĐIỂM Ở ĐÂU, chú ý các từ chỉ quá khứ: "anymore", "last season", "old branch" = loại. Đáp án luôn kèm mô tả nhận diện cụ thể (biển hiệu, màu sắc).

question_text: A man is calling his friend, Maria. When will he see her?
options: at 9 am on Sunday
at 10 am on Saturday
at 8 am on Sunday
explanation:
Maria! It's Leo, confirming the weekend plan — grab a pen, because we've changed this three times! Forget Saturday at ten completely, that was the old plan — my cousin's wedding rehearsal swallowed the whole of Saturday, sorry again. And it's NOT eight on Sunday either — the pool doesn't even open until half past, we'd be standing in the car park like fools. Final answer: Sunday at nine am. Nine o'clock, Sunday, at the pool entrance, towels and coffee in hand. Confirm by text or I'll panic!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – at 9 am on Sunday (9 giờ sáng Chủ nhật).
• Vì sao đúng: Leo chốt hạ "Final answer: Sunday at nine am. Nine o'clock, Sunday, at the pool entrance".
• at 10 am on Saturday sai: là lịch cũ đã hủy "Forget Saturday at ten completely, that was the old plan" vì vướng buổi tổng duyệt đám cưới.
• at 8 am on Sunday sai: bị loại vì bể bơi chưa mở "the pool doesn't even open until half past".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIỜ/NGÀY hẹn thường đổi lịch 2-3 lần. Chỉ ghi nhận mốc đứng sau từ chốt "Final answer", "So it's...", và gạch bỏ mốc đi kèm "Forget...", "that was the old plan", "NOT".

question_text: Doctor’s office is calling about a change in the appointment. When is the new appointment?
options: Thursday 13th
Friday 14th
Wednesday 12th
explanation:
Good afternoon, this is Riverside Medical Centre with an important change to your appointment, please listen fully. Doctor Novak has been called to a training day, so your original booking — Friday the fourteenth — cannot go ahead. We know Wednesday the twelfth was mentioned as a possibility last week; that slot has unfortunately been taken. Your confirmed new appointment is Thursday the thirteenth, at the usual time, nine fifteen. Thursday the thirteenth, nine fifteen, same building, second floor. Press one to confirm, or call us back. Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Thursday 13th (thứ Năm ngày 13).
• Vì sao đúng: phòng khám thông báo "Your confirmed new appointment is Thursday the thirteenth, at the usual time, nine fifteen... same building, second floor".
• Friday 14th sai: là lịch cũ không thể diễn ra "your original booking — Friday the fourteenth — cannot go ahead" vì bác sĩ đi tập huấn.
• Wednesday 12th sai: từng được nhắc nhưng đã có người khác lấy "that slot has unfortunately been taken".
👉 Mẹo: dạng ĐỔI LỊCH KHÁM, ba mốc nằm liền kề nhau (12–13–14) nên phải nghe cả thứ lẫn ngày. Chỉ khoanh mốc đi kèm "confirmed", "your new appointment is".

question_text: Mary is talking to her friend about her new home. What does she ask her friend about?
options: Where to buy a new table
The furniture
Mirror
explanation:
Sofia, it's Mary — I need your shopping wisdom, you're the queen of finding things! The new flat is coming together: the mirror your sister gave us is already up in the hallway, looks perfect, thank her again. And the furniture from the old place fitted better than we feared — sofa, shelves, all in. But we're missing one big thing: a dining table. So my question is — where should I buy a new table? You found that gorgeous oak one of yours somewhere secret. Which shop? Call me back with the address, please!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Where to buy a new table (mua bàn ăn mới ở đâu).
• Vì sao đúng: Mary hỏi thẳng "But we're missing one big thing: a dining table. So my question is — where should I buy a new table?... Which shop?".
• The furniture sai: nội thất cũ đã ổn định "the furniture from the old place fitted better than we feared — sofa, shelves, all in".
• Mirror sai: gương đã treo xong "the mirror your sister gave us is already up in the hallway, looks perfect".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CÔ ẤY HỎI VỀ ĐIỀU GÌ, đừng chọn đồ vật được nhắc nhiều nhất. Tìm đúng câu có dấu hỏi ("So my question is — where...?") vì đó mới là nội dung nhờ vả.

question_text: A man is talking about the city concert. How will the concert end?
options: With a fireworks display
With a famous singer
With the city's favorite group
explanation:
The city concert this Saturday is going to be something special, folks! Let me tell you what I've heard about the programme. The rumour about a fireworks display at the end? Not true, sadly — the park is too close to the hospital for fireworks. And the famous singer everyone hoped for is on tour in Japan, so that's off too. But the real ending is better anyway: the city's favourite group — the band that started right here — will close the show with all their big songs.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – With the city's favorite group.
• Vì sao đúng: "the real ending is better anyway: the city's favourite group — the band that started right here — will close the show with all their big songs".
• With a fireworks display sai: chỉ là tin đồn, không bắn được vì công viên quá gần bệnh viện — "Not true, sadly — the park is too close to the hospital for fireworks".
• With a famous singer sai: ca sĩ đó đang lưu diễn ở Nhật — "the famous singer everyone hoped for is on tour in Japan, so that's off too".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "kết thúc bằng gì", bám động từ "close the show". Ý đi kèm "the rumour", "not true", "that's off" đều là nhiễu.

question_text: Dan is going to university. Where should Dan turn right?
options: At the Main Street
At the hospital
At the traffic lights
explanation:
Dan, listen carefully, the university is easy to find if you follow this exactly. Go straight down Main Street — don't turn there, whatever the sat-nav says, that route takes you through the market and you'll sit in traffic forever. You'll pass the hospital on your left; keep going, don't turn at the hospital either. When you reach the traffic lights — the big junction with the petrol station — turn right there. The campus gates are two hundred metres ahead. Traffic lights, right turn. Good luck on your first day!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – At the traffic lights.
• Vì sao đúng: "When you reach the traffic lights — the big junction with the petrol station — turn right there".
• At the Main Street sai: được dặn đi thẳng, không rẽ ("Go straight down Main Street — don't turn there").
• At the hospital sai: cũng được dặn không rẽ ("keep going, don't turn at the hospital either").
👉 Mẹo: bài chỉ đường luôn cài 2 mốc gắn "don't turn". Chỉ mốc đi kèm "turn right/left there" mới là đáp án.

question_text: Listen to Anna talking about her routine. Where does Anna go for a walk every morning?
options: park
neighborhood
college
explanation:
My name is Anna, and people say my mornings are boringly perfect! Here's the routine. Up at six, tea first — always tea, never coffee. Then my morning walk, and everyone assumes I go to the park, but the park doesn't open its gates until eight, far too late for me. Around the neighbourhood, you ask? Too many dogs chasing my ankles, tried it once. No — every morning I walk around the college. The old campus is open at dawn, the paths are wide, and the ivy walls are beautiful in the early light.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – College.
• Vì sao đúng: "every morning I walk around the college. The old campus is open at dawn, the paths are wide".
• Park sai: công viên 8 giờ mới mở cổng, quá muộn với cô ("the park doesn't open its gates until eight, far too late for me").
• Neighborhood sai: đã thử một lần nhưng nhiều chó rượt ("Too many dogs chasing my ankles, tried it once").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi địa điểm quen thuộc, bỏ nơi gắn với "everyone assumes" và "tried it once"; chọn nơi đi với "every morning I walk".

question_text: Listen to the announcement. When does the train leave?
explanation:
Attention please, passengers for the morning express to the capital. There has been confusion on the boards, so please listen carefully to this correction. The printed timetable in the hall still shows nine thirty — that time changed last month and the poster, regrettably, did not. And this morning's earlier announcement of nine forty-five was an error by our new colleague, our apologies. The correct departure: the train leaves at nine fifteen. Nine one five, platform three. That is in twelve minutes, so please make your way there now. Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – At 9:15.
• Vì sao đúng: thông báo sửa lại "The correct departure: the train leaves at nine fifteen. Nine one five, platform three".
• At 9.30 sai: là giờ trên bảng in chưa cập nhật "The printed timetable in the hall still shows nine thirty — that time changed last month".
• At 9.45 sai: là thông báo nhầm của nhân viên mới "this morning's earlier announcement of nine forty-five was an error by our new colleague".
👉 Mẹo: dạng thông báo CẢI CHÍNH GIỜ, nghe cụm "The correct departure/time is...". Mọi mốc gắn với "printed timetable", "earlier announcement", "error" đều là bẫy dù được đọc trước.

question_text: What did the mother call her daughter to help her buy?
options: eggs
bread
milk
explanation:
Sweetheart, it's Mum — catch this message before you leave the office! Small kitchen emergency: I'm in the middle of baking the birthday cake for Grandpa, and I've just realised I'm short on eggs. I need six more — six large eggs, the free-range ones from the corner shop if they have them. That's all, just the eggs! We have plenty of bread, don't buy more, it'll only go hard. Milk we're fine for too, the fridge is full. Just the eggs, darling — quick as you can! Love you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Eggs.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm short on eggs. I need six more — six large eggs" và mẹ nhắc lại "Just the eggs, darling".
• Bread sai: nhà còn nhiều, mẹ dặn đừng mua thêm kẻo cứng ("We have plenty of bread, don't buy more").
• Milk sai: tủ lạnh vẫn đầy ("Milk we're fine for too, the fridge is full").
👉 Mẹo: dạng nhờ mua đồ, bám cụm giới hạn "just / only"; món đi với "don't buy" hay "we're fine for" là bẫy.

question_text: Dan is going to university. Where should Dan turn right?
options: At the Main Street
At the hospital
At the traffic lights
explanation:
Dan, your first solo drive to campus — deep breath, it's easy! Follow me now. You'll start on Main Street; whatever you do, do NOT turn right there — that's the one-way trap, every new student does it once and meets a very annoyed bus. Further on you'll see the hospital; ignore the turning there too, that only leads to the ambulance bays. Keep going until the big traffic lights — the junction with the bakery on the corner. THAT's your right turn: at the traffic lights. Then the gates are straight ahead. Traffic lights, right. You've got this!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – At the traffic lights (ở chỗ đèn giao thông).
• Vì sao đúng: người chỉ đường nói "Keep going until the big traffic lights — the junction with the bakery on the corner. THAT's your right turn: at the traffic lights".
• At the Main Street sai: rẽ ở đó là vào đường một chiều "do NOT turn right there — that's the one-way trap".
• At the hospital sai: lối rẽ đó chỉ dẫn vào khu xe cấp cứu "ignore the turning there too, that only leads to the ambulance bays".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi RẼ Ở ĐÂU, bài liệt kê các mốc theo thứ tự dọc đường và hai mốc đầu luôn kèm lệnh cấm ("do NOT turn", "ignore the turning"). Chỉ khoanh mốc đi kèm "THAT's your turn" và có vật mốc phụ (tiệm bánh ở góc).

question_text: Listen to an instruction. Which light shows that the computer is on?
options: Green
Red
Blue
explanation:
Welcome to your new computer — let me explain the lights on the front, because they confuse everyone at first. You'll see three small lights. The green one only means the cable is plugged into the wall — the machine can be completely off and green still shows. The red one is a warning light: it blinks when the battery is low. The one that matters is the blue light: when the blue light is shining, your computer is on and ready to use. Blue means on. Simple!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Blue.
• Vì sao đúng: "when the blue light is shining, your computer is on and ready to use. Blue means on."
• Green sai: chỉ báo dây đã cắm vào ổ điện, máy vẫn có thể đang tắt ("the machine can be completely off and green still shows").
• Red sai: là đèn cảnh báo, nháy khi pin yếu ("it blinks when the battery is low").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hướng dẫn thiết bị, ghi nhanh cặp màu–chức năng rồi đối chiếu đúng chức năng câu hỏi hỏi (ở đây là "on").

question_text: Listen to a man talking about the game he is playing. What is the game stopping him from doing?
options: Play
Change characters
Win
explanation:
My brother gave me this puzzle game for my birthday, and it has taken over my life — in the most frustrating way. Don't get me wrong: playing is a joy, I'm on it every lunch break. And the game lets you change characters whenever you like — I switch between the robot and the fox constantly, that part's brilliant. But winning? The game will simply not let me win! Level ninety-nine, the final door, and every single time the bridge collapses. Sixty tries. I dream about that bridge now.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Win.
• Vì sao đúng: "But winning? The game will simply not let me win! Level ninety-nine, the final door" — 60 lần thử đều thua.
• Play sai: anh chơi rất thoải mái, ngày nào cũng chơi giờ nghỉ trưa ("playing is a joy").
• Change characters sai: đổi nhân vật tùy thích và anh còn khen phần đó ("the game lets you change characters whenever you like... that part's brilliant").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "stopping him from doing" là dạng phủ định — chọn việc KHÔNG làm được; hai việc còn lại luôn được khen ngay trước đó.

question_text: A man is calling his wife. Where do the couple meet?
options: At the restaurant
At the station
Outside a shop
explanation:
Darling, it's me — small change to tonight's plan, listen carefully! I know we said we'd meet at the restaurant, but they called: our table isn't ready until eight, so no point standing there hungry. And don't wait at the station like last time — your train gets in too early and it's freezing on that platform. Here's the plan: meet me outside the big bookshop on Mill Street — the one with the green awning. I'll be there at seven. We'll walk to dinner together from there. Kisses!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Outside a shop.
• Vì sao đúng: "meet me outside the big bookshop on Mill Street — the one with the green awning. I'll be there at seven." Hiệu sách chính là một cửa hàng.
• At the restaurant sai: bàn chưa sẵn sàng trước 8 giờ ("our table isn't ready until eight").
• At the station sai: tàu của vợ đến quá sớm và sân ga rất lạnh ("it's freezing on that platform").
👉 Mẹo: phương án có thể diễn đạt KHÁI QUÁT hơn bài nghe (bookshop → a shop). Hiểu nghĩa chứ đừng chỉ dò từ trùng khớp.

question_text: What did he leave at a friend’s house? / What did the man lose?
options: Wallet
Phone
Glasses
explanation:
Hi Dan, it's me — small favour to ask! I got home from your dinner party last night and started reading in bed, and that's when I realised: my glasses are still at your house. I remember taking them off when we watched that video in the kitchen. Could you have a look on the shelf by the window? I feel lost without them — I've been holding the newspaper at arm's length all morning. I can drop by after work to collect them. Thanks a million!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Glasses.
• Vì sao đúng: "my glasses are still at your house. I remember taking them off when we watched that video in the kitchen".
• Wallet sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Phone sai: cũng không được nhắc tới; chi tiết xác nhận là anh phải cầm báo xa tầm tay vì thiếu kính — "I've been holding the newspaper at arm's length all morning".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi đồ bỏ quên, nghe danh từ ngay sau "that's when I realised" hoặc "... is still at your house", rồi kiểm chứng bằng hệ quả kể sau đó.

question_text: A man is giving directions to a friend about how to get to the football club. The football club is near?
options: A river
A park
A shopping mall
explanation:
Alright mate, listen carefully, the football club is easy to find once you know the landmark. Take the number six bus to the last stop, then walk straight down Green Lane for about five minutes. You'll see a big park on your right — the one with the bandstand and the little lake. The club is right next to the park; the entrance faces the park gates. If you reach the supermarket, you've gone too far. Training starts at six, don't be late!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A park.
• Vì sao đúng: "The club is right next to the park; the entrance faces the park gates" — công viên có bandstand và hồ nhỏ.
• A river sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu (bài chỉ có "the little lake" trong công viên).
• A shopping mall sai: bài chỉ nhắc siêu thị, và đó là mốc báo ĐI QUÁ ("If you reach the supermarket, you've gone too far").
👉 Mẹo: bài chỉ đường luôn có một mốc kiểu "thấy X là đi quá rồi". Mốc đó không bao giờ là đáp án — chọn mốc gắn với "next to / right by".

question_text: Listen to a teacher talking about meeting preparations. What is the teacher preparing for the meeting now?
options: Order the food
Print the documents
Arrange the seating
explanation:
Quick update on tomorrow's parents' meeting, so everyone knows where we stand. The documents are done — I printed all forty copies this morning, they're in the blue folder on my desk. The seating is also finished; the caretaker arranged the hall yesterday, five rows, plenty of space. What I'm doing right now is ordering the food — sandwiches, fruit, and coffee for about fifty people. I'm on the phone with the caterer the moment I finish this message. We'll be ready!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Order the food.
• Vì sao đúng: "What I'm doing right now is ordering the food — sandwiches, fruit, and coffee for about fifty people".
• Print the documents sai: đã in xong sáng nay ("The documents are done — I printed all forty copies this morning").
• Arrange the seating sai: bác bảo vệ đã xếp hội trường từ hôm qua ("the caretaker arranged the hall yesterday").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi có "now" thì phải phân biệt thì. Việc chia quá khứ (printed, arranged) là đã xong; chọn việc đi với "right now / I'm ...ing".

question_text: A man is talking about his day. What did he do in the morning?
options: Look at a view
Have breakfast at a cafe
Go for a walk in the park
explanation:
My day started better than any day in months, let me tell you. I was up before the alarm, drove out to the headland — you know, where the lighthouse is — and just stood there looking at the view. The sun coming up over the bay, the fishing boats heading out, the islands still half in mist... I didn't take a single photo. I just looked, for a whole hour. Everything else today — the emails, the meetings — none of it touched me. That view fixed my whole week.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Look at a view.
• Vì sao đúng: "drove out to the headland — you know, where the lighthouse is — and just stood there looking at the view... I just looked, for a whole hour."
• Have breakfast at a cafe sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Go for a walk in the park sai: anh lái xe ra mũi đất chỗ ngọn hải đăng và đứng nhìn, bài không nói đi dạo công viên.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi việc đã làm buổi sáng, bám chuỗi động từ quá khứ trong bài; đừng suy diễn thêm hoạt động bài không nêu.

question_text: A man is talking about his job. What does the man want to do next?
options: Become a writer
Become a chef again
Start teaching history again
explanation:
My working life has been a winding road, let me tell you! Ten years as a chef — good years, but my knees and my weekends finally begged for mercy, and I won't be going back to the kitchen, ever. Then history teaching, which I truly loved... until the paperwork grew taller than the students. Also finished, no return. What's next is the exciting part: I want to become a writer. I've got a drawer full of stories from the restaurant years, and a publisher has already asked for the first three chapters. Wish me luck!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Become a writer (trở thành nhà văn).
• Vì sao đúng: ông nói "What's next is the exciting part: I want to become a writer" — đã có bản thảo và nhà xuất bản hỏi ba chương đầu.
• Become a chef again sai: đã đóng cửa hẳn "I won't be going back to the kitchen, ever".
• Start teaching history again sai: cũng chấm dứt "Also finished, no return" vì giấy tờ hành chính quá nhiều.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi DỰ ĐỊNH TIẾP THEO, nghề cũ luôn được kể trước và dài hơn. Chỉ lấy phần sau mốc "What's next is...", "From now on...", và loại mọi nghề đi kèm "won't be going back", "no return", "finished".

question_text: Listen to the woman talking about her holiday plans. Where is she going next?
options: The east
The north
The south
explanation:
Holiday planning time — my favourite season of the year! Everyone assumes I'll go east again, to the lakes; lovely, but I've done it three years straight and even the ducks recognise me now. My brother keeps pushing the north — the mountains, the cold hikes... he forgets I hate being cold ON PURPOSE. No — this year I'm going to the south! Two weeks on the southern coast: fishing villages, warm sea, oranges straight from the tree. The tickets are booked, the sun cream is bought. South, here I come!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The south (miền Nam).
• Vì sao đúng: cô chốt "this year I'm going to the south! Two weeks on the southern coast: fishing villages, warm sea, oranges" và đã "The tickets are booked, the sun cream is bought".
• The east sai: đó là nơi đã đi ba năm liền "I've done it three years straight and even the ducks recognise me now".
• The north sai: là gợi ý của anh trai nhưng cô ghét lạnh "he forgets I hate being cold ON PURPOSE".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐI ĐÂU (hướng/địa danh), loại ngay nơi đi kèm "again", "three years straight" (đã đi rồi) và nơi do người khác đề xuất. Đáp án có bằng chứng hành động: đã đặt vé, đã mua đồ.

question_text: Which sports is she good at?
options: Running
Swimming
Football
explanation:
Sports day is coming, and my family has opinions about what I should enter. Dad keeps saying running, because he ran marathons — but honestly, I'm the slowest in my class, they time me with a calendar. Mum says swimming, and I do love the pool, but love and skill are different things; I still swallow half the water. No — what I'm actually good at is football. Top scorer two seasons in a row, captain since March. So football it is, and Dad can cheer from the fence!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Football.
• Vì sao đúng: "what I'm actually good at is football. Top scorer two seasons in a row, captain since March."
• Running sai: bố gợi ý nhưng cô chạy chậm nhất lớp ("I'm the slowest in my class").
• Swimming sai: mẹ gợi ý, cô thích bơi nhưng không giỏi ("love and skill are different things").
👉 Mẹo: "good at" khác "like". Bỏ môn chỉ được "love"; chọn môn có bằng chứng thành tích (top scorer, captain).

question_text: Listening to Sarah leaving a message for her friend. When does she want to meet?
options: Two o'clock
Three o'clock
One o'clock
explanation:
Hi Rachel, it's Sarah — voicemail again, we truly are phone-tag champions! About tomorrow's catch-up, I've shuffled my whole day. One o'clock is dead on arrival — that's my dentist slot, immovable, I've begged. Two o'clock I first suggested myself... and then remembered the school bake sale runs till half past two, and I'm on cake duty. So: three o'clock! I want to meet at three, at the garden café, corner table. A full hour, cake included — I'll bring the leftovers from the sale. Text me a yes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Three o'clock (3 giờ).
• Vì sao đúng: Sarah chốt "So: three o'clock! I want to meet at three, at the garden café, corner table".
• One o'clock sai: vướng lịch nha sĩ không dời được "that's my dentist slot, immovable, I've begged".
• Two o'clock sai: chính cô đề xuất rồi tự rút lại "I first suggested myself... and then remembered the school bake sale runs till half past two, and I'm on cake duty".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIỜ HẸN, cẩn thận mốc do chính người nói đề xuất rồi tự hủy ("I first suggested... and then remembered"). Chỉ lấy mốc đứng sau "So:" kèm địa điểm cụ thể.

question_text: An author is talking about her daily routine. When does she usually write?
options: In the afternoons
In the mornings
At night
explanation:
Readers always ask about my writing day, imagining candlelight and midnight inspiration — the truth is less romantic! Mornings? Hopeless. Before eleven I am a coffee-drinking zombie; I answer emails and stare at birds. And night writing, which sounds so poetic — I tried it for a year and produced nonsense I deleted every next day. My real writing happens in the afternoons. From one until six, phone off, same desk, same chair — that's when the sentences finally behave. Every book I've published was written after lunch!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – In the afternoons (vào buổi chiều).
• Vì sao đúng: nhà văn nói "My real writing happens in the afternoons. From one until six, phone off, same desk, same chair" và xác nhận "Every book I've published was written after lunch!".
• In the mornings sai: buổi sáng cô không viết nổi "Mornings? Hopeless. Before eleven I am a coffee-drinking zombie".
• At night sai: đã thử một năm và thất bại "I tried it for a year and produced nonsense I deleted every next day".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi THỜI ĐIỂM TRONG NGÀY, người nói hay bác bỏ hình dung lãng mạn của độc giả trước. Đáp án đi kèm "My real... happens in" và khung giờ cụ thể (from one until six).

question_text: Listen to a person talking about a picnic. What did the speaker bring?
options: Sandwiches
Drinks
Fruit
explanation:
The picnic on Sunday was wonderful — we finally got the whole gang together by the river! Everyone had a job, of course. Maria made her famous sandwiches, three whole boxes, cheese and ham and the fancy ones with salmon. Tom brought the drinks — lemonade and about a hundred bottles of water, he never learns how much is enough. And me? I brought the fruit! Strawberries, grapes, and a watermelon so big I could barely carry it. It was gone in ten minutes. Best picnic of the summer!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Fruit.
• Vì sao đúng: "And me? I brought the fruit! Strawberries, grapes, and a watermelon so big I could barely carry it."
• Sandwiches sai: là phần của Maria ("Maria made her famous sandwiches, three whole boxes").
• Drinks sai: là phần của Tom ("Tom brought the drinks — lemonade and about a hundred bottles of water").
👉 Mẹo: dạng "ai mang gì", ghim tên với món ngay khi nghe; câu hỏi hỏi "the speaker" nên chỉ lấy món sau "And me? I brought...".

question_text: What's the main change managers are going to do?
options: Adjust the schedule
Reduce the budget
Relocate the meeting
explanation:
Everyone, thirty seconds of your attention — news from this morning's management meeting! First, the things NOT changing, because the gossip machine is already running: the budget is safe, nobody is cutting anything this quarter. The meeting location also stays here in the main hall — the idea of moving to the branch office was voted down. The one real change is to the schedule: from next week, team meetings move from Friday mornings to Tuesday mornings, and the monthly review shifts to the first Monday. New calendars are in your inboxes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Adjust the schedule.
• Vì sao đúng: "The one real change is to the schedule: from next week, team meetings move from Friday mornings to Tuesday mornings".
• Reduce the budget sai: ngân sách được giữ nguyên ("the budget is safe, nobody is cutting anything this quarter").
• Relocate the meeting sai: ý chuyển sang văn phòng chi nhánh đã bị bác ("the idea of moving to the branch office was voted down").
👉 Mẹo: thông báo nội bộ hay liệt kê "những gì KHÔNG đổi" trước để gài bẫy. Bám cụm "The one real change is".

question_text: Listen to the man talking. What did he leave in the yard?
options: a laptop
shoes
a shirt
explanation:
You know that sinking feeling when the weather changes? I'm living it right now. This afternoon was glorious, so I did my exercises out in the yard — barefoot on the grass, lovely. Carried everything back inside afterwards: the mat, the water bottle, the towel, the radio... everything except one thing. My shoes! My brand-new running shoes are sitting out there in the yard, and it has just started to absolutely pour. They'll be two little swimming pools by now. Excuse me while I go perform a rescue.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Shoes.
• Vì sao đúng: "everything except one thing. My shoes! My brand-new running shoes are sitting out there in the yard".
• A laptop sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• A shirt sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài; đồ anh mang vào gồm thảm, bình nước, khăn và radio.
👉 Mẹo: bài hay liệt kê một loạt đồ ĐÃ mang vào rồi mới nêu thứ bị bỏ quên. Chờ cụm "everything except".

question_text: Where does Malik want to go?
options: The town hall
The library
The park
explanation:
Excuse me! Sorry to stop you — I'm Malik, I'm new to this neighbourhood, and my phone has just died completely. Could you point me somewhere? I'm trying to get to the town hall — I have an appointment at the residents' office in twenty minutes to register my new address. I know the library is somewhere on this street, and the park is behind me, but the town hall has me completely lost. Is it far? Should I take a bus, or can I walk from here? Thank you so much!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The town hall.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm trying to get to the town hall — I have an appointment at the residents' office in twenty minutes to register my new address."
• The library sai: chỉ là mốc anh đã biết vị trí ("I know the library is somewhere on this street").
• The park sai: cũng chỉ là mốc, đang ở ngay sau lưng anh ("the park is behind me").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi đích đến, chọn nơi đi với "I'm trying to get to"; những nơi người nói đã biết vị trí chỉ là mốc định hướng.

question_text: Listen to David talking about the conference. How long did he talk in the speech?
options: 10 minutes
15 minutes
20 minutes
explanation:
The conference went really well, thanks for asking! Funny thing about my speech, though. The organisers originally gave me twenty minutes — that's what the printed programme said. Then, the evening before, they emailed: too many speakers, could I cut it to ten? I spent half the night shortening my slides. But on the day, the first speaker didn't arrive, so in the end I talked for fifteen minutes exactly — and honestly, it was the perfect length. The audience even laughed at my jokes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 15 minutes.
• Vì sao đúng: "on the day, the first speaker didn't arrive, so in the end I talked for fifteen minutes exactly — and honestly, it was the perfect length".
• 20 minutes sai: là thời lượng ban đầu in trong chương trình — "The organisers originally gave me twenty minutes — that's what the printed programme said".
• 10 minutes sai: là yêu cầu cắt ngắn qua email tối hôm trước, nhưng thực tế không xảy ra — "could I cut it to ten? I spent half the night shortening my slides".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "How long DID he talk?" hỏi thực tế đã diễn ra. Bám cụm "in the end", "on the day"; bỏ số gắn với "originally", "they asked me to cut it to".

question_text: A saleswoman is talking to her customer. How much is the cheapest computer in the shop?
options: 135 pounds
145 pounds
155 pounds
explanation:
Welcome in, and you're asking about our computers — let me give you the honest picture. The one in the window, with the big screen, is one hundred and fifty-five pounds — lovely machine, but that's our top model. The silver one on the middle shelf is one hundred and forty-five. But if you want the best price in the shop, look at this one here: one hundred and thirty-five pounds — our cheapest computer, and honestly, for emails and studying it does everything the expensive ones do. And it comes with a free mouse this week!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 135 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "look at this one here: one hundred and thirty-five pounds — our cheapest computer".
• 145 pounds sai: đó là máy màu bạc ở kệ giữa ("The silver one on the middle shelf is one hundred and forty-five").
• 155 pounds sai: đó là máy trong tủ kính, model cao cấp nhất ("that's our top model").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giá RẺ NHẤT thì phải nghe hết cả ba mức rồi mới chọn; bám tính từ so sánh nhất "cheapest / top model" gắn với từng con số.

question_text: A woman is talking about her family’s holidays. What did the family do last year?
options: Camping
Beach trip
Road trip
explanation:
Our family takes one big holiday every year, and everyone always wants to hear about last year's. We packed the car with tents and sleeping bags and went camping by the big lake in the national park — a full week under the trees. The kids learned to fish, we cooked everything over the fire, and nobody touched a screen for seven days. It rained one night, half the tent got wet, and it's still everyone's favourite story at dinner. Best week we've ever had.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Camping.
• Vì sao đúng: "We packed the car with tents and sleeping bags and went camping by the big lake in the national park — a full week under the trees".
• Beach trip sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu; cả nhà ở bên hồ trong vườn quốc gia.
• Road trip sai: cũng không được nhắc tới; ô tô chỉ dùng để chở lều tới hồ rồi ở nguyên đó suốt tuần.
👉 Mẹo: bài không cài bẫy thì bắt luôn động từ chính "went camping". Các danh từ lều, túi ngủ, nấu ăn bằng lửa trại là bằng chứng phụ để yên tâm chọn.

question_text: A boy is talking about his cat. What does he feed the cat?
options: Mice
Fish
Birds
explanation:
My cat Whiskers is the fussiest animal in the world, honestly. My friend's cat eats anything — leftovers, biscuits, whatever falls on the floor. Not mine. I feed him fish, and only fish. Tuna on Mondays, white fish the rest of the week, slightly warmed, in the blue bowl — the green bowl is apparently an insult. If I'm five minutes late, he sits on my homework in protest. My dad says the cat runs the house. My dad is right.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Fish.
• Vì sao đúng: "I feed him fish, and only fish" — thứ Hai cá ngừ, các ngày còn lại cá trắng, hâm ấm, đựng bát xanh dương.
• Mice sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Birds sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi đồ ăn/đồ vật, bám các từ giới hạn "only", "nothing but" — câu chứa chúng chính là câu chốt đáp án.

question_text: Louis is calling his friend Standar. Where will Luis meet Standar?
options: Outside the station
At the cafe
Near the ticket counter
explanation:
Standar, it's Louis — about meeting tomorrow before the train, final plan, so listen! NOT the café this time; the one at the station closed for renovation last week, there's just a sad curtain where the coffee machine was. And don't stand by the ticket counter either — they've moved it upstairs and the queue blocks the whole corridor, total chaos. Meet me outside the station — by the main doors, next to the big clock. Nine fifteen, outside, big clock. If it rains, I'll have the blue umbrella. See you there!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Outside the station (bên ngoài nhà ga).
• Vì sao đúng: Louis dặn "Meet me outside the station — by the main doors, next to the big clock. Nine fifteen, outside, big clock".
• At the cafe sai: quán đã đóng cửa sửa chữa "NOT the café this time; the one at the station closed for renovation last week".
• Near the ticket counter sai: quầy vé đã chuyển lên tầng và tắc nghẽn "they've moved it upstairs and the queue blocks the whole corridor, total chaos".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HẸN Ở ĐÂU, hai chỗ bị loại thường đi kèm "closed", "moved", "NOT". Đáp án luôn có mốc nhận diện phụ (đồng hồ lớn, cửa chính) — nghe được mốc phụ là chắc chắn đúng.

question_text: A saleswoman is talking to her customer. How much is the cheapest computer in the shop?
options: 135 pounds
145 pounds
155 pounds
explanation:
You're asking about a computer for your daughter's studies — wonderful, let me be straight with you, I hate overselling! This white one everybody photographs is one fifty-five — gorgeous, but you're paying for the colour, frankly. The one next to it is one forty-five, decent middle child of the family. But here — this grey one is our cheapest at one hundred and thirty-five pounds, and between us? Same processor as the white one. For essays and video calls, it's all she needs. One thirty-five, two-year guarantee. Shall I box it up?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 135 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: nhân viên nói "this grey one is our cheapest at one hundred and thirty-five pounds... One thirty-five, two-year guarantee".
• 145 pounds sai: là máy tầm trung "The one next to it is one forty-five, decent middle child of the family".
• 155 pounds sai: là máy trắng đắt nhất "This white one everybody photographs is one fifty-five — gorgeous, but you're paying for the colour".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIÁ RẺ NHẤT, bài đọc đủ 3 mức giá rất gần nhau (135/145/155). Đừng bắt số đầu tiên — chờ tính từ so sánh "our cheapest", "the most expensive" rồi mới ghép với con số.

question_text: What career did he choose?
options: to work in business
to become a teacher
to become a researcher
explanation:
People ask why I'm in a suit these days, so here's the story of my big decision. At university, everyone expected me to become a researcher — I loved the laboratory, but the idea of the same experiments for thirty years... no. My mother, a teacher herself, hoped I'd teach; I tried one term as an assistant and the children ate me alive, honestly. So I chose to work in business. I joined a trading company, and I love it — every day is different, every deal is a puzzle. No regrets!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To work in business.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I chose to work in business. I joined a trading company, and I love it — every day is different."
• To become a teacher sai: mẹ mong vậy nhưng anh thử một học kỳ làm trợ giảng và thất bại ("the children ate me alive").
• To become a researcher sai: mọi người kỳ vọng, anh thích phòng thí nghiệm nhưng không chịu nổi việc lặp lại suốt 30 năm.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi nghề đã chọn, bám động từ quyết định "I chose"; kỳ vọng của người khác ("everyone expected", "my mother hoped") đều là nhiễu.

question_text: A finance expert is giving advice to young people. What shouldn't they do?
options: Spend too much on clothes.
Ask for more money.
Save for emergencies.
explanation:
Young workers, this one is for you — the advice I wish someone had given me at twenty-two! Some habits are perfectly fine: buying a nice outfit now and then won't ruin you, clothes are part of showing up well, enjoy them sensibly. And please DO save for emergencies — three months of expenses in a quiet account; that rule is sacred. But here's what you should NOT do in your first year: ask for more money. Prove yourself first. A raise request before you've delivered results marks you as impatient — and bosses remember. Deliver first, then negotiate from strength.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Ask for more money (đòi tăng lương).
• Vì sao đúng: chuyên gia nói "here's what you should NOT do in your first year: ask for more money. Prove yourself first".
• Spend too much on clothes sai: mua sắm chừng mực vẫn ổn "buying a nice outfit now and then won't ruin you... enjoy them sensibly".
• Save for emergencies sai: đây là việc NÊN làm "please DO save for emergencies — three months of expenses... that rule is sacred".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi KHÔNG NÊN LÀM GÌ, bài luôn trộn 2 việc NÊN và 1 việc KHÔNG NÊN. Khoanh đúng vế sau "you should NOT", "avoid", "never" và cảnh giác với "DO save" (nhấn mạnh khuyến khích, không phải cấm).

question_text: Helen is calling a friend about the place her whole family is standing while seeing her off to college. Where are they standing?
options: library complex
university area
Residential area
explanation:
Hi! It's Helen — yes, THE day is finally here, they're seeing me off to college! The whole family came, all seven of them, Grandma included. Guess where we're all standing right now? Not the library complex — that's closed for renovation, big fences everywhere. And we left the university area itself because Dad said it was too crowded for a proper goodbye. So we're in the residential area just behind the campus — the quiet streets with the little gardens, right by my new student house. Grandma is already crying. Wish me luck!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Residential area.
• Vì sao đúng: "So we're in the residential area just behind the campus — the quiet streets with the little gardens, right by my new student house."
• Library complex sai: đang đóng cửa sửa chữa, rào chắn khắp nơi ("that's closed for renovation, big fences everywhere").
• University area sai: cả nhà đã rời khỏi đó vì bố chê quá đông để chia tay tử tế ("too crowded for a proper goodbye").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi vị trí HIỆN TẠI, bám thì hiện tại "we're in..."; nơi đi với "closed" hoặc "we left" đều đã bị loại.

question_text: Listen to an actor discussing his hobbies. What does the actor like to do in his free time?
options: Drawing
Watching movies
Playing video games
explanation:
Everyone assumes actors spend their evenings watching films — studying the craft, you know. Honestly? After twelve hours on set, the last thing I want is another screen. My nephew keeps trying to get me into video games too, and I'm hopeless, he beats me in about a minute. What I really love is drawing. Give me a pencil, a sketchbook and a quiet café, and I'm happy for hours. I draw the crew, the sets, strangers on trains. It empties my head like nothing else.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Drawing.
• Vì sao đúng: "What I really love is drawing. Give me a pencil, a sketchbook and a quiet café, and I'm happy for hours."
• Watching movies sai: sau 12 tiếng quay phim anh không muốn nhìn màn hình nữa ("the last thing I want is another screen").
• Playing video games sai: cháu trai rủ nhưng anh chơi rất dở ("I'm hopeless, he beats me in about a minute").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi sở thích, câu mở đầu "Everyone assumes..." là dấu hiệu ý đó SAI; đáp án nằm sau "What I really love is".

question_text: A man is calling his colleague about a meeting with clients. When will the meeting start?
explanation:
Hi Karen, it's Marcus — meeting update, and please pass it to the team! So, this morning's chaos, in order: the clients' flight was delayed, which killed our nine fifteen slot — that's definitely off. Their assistant then suggested eleven fifteen, but our conference room is booked from eleven, so that never made sense. We've landed in the middle: the meeting will start at ten fifteen. Ten fifteen, main room, coffee ready by ten. I need the printed contracts on the table before they arrive. Thanks, Karen!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – at 10.15.
• Vì sao đúng: Marcus nói "We've landed in the middle: the meeting will start at ten fifteen. Ten fifteen, main room, coffee ready by ten".
• at 9.15 sai: đã bị hủy vì máy bay khách trễ "the clients' flight was delayed, which killed our nine fifteen slot — that's definitely off".
• at 11.15 sai: chỉ là đề xuất của trợ lý khách và bất khả thi "our conference room is booked from eleven, so that never made sense".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIỜ HỌP, hãy chờ động từ chốt kèm chủ ngữ "we" ("we've landed in", "the meeting will start at"). Mốc bị "killed", "off", "never made sense" thì loại ngay dù được nhắc nhiều lần.

question_text: Listening to a woman's announcement. Where will they wait for the bus?
options: Behind the hotel's main entrance
By the hotel's main entrance
By the hotel's side entrance
explanation:
Good evening, everyone — final details for tomorrow's excursion, please remember them over dinner! The bus situation first. Do NOT wait behind the hotel — I know the shade is lovely back there, but the driver cannot even enter that street, it's pedestrians only. And the side entrance by the pool is locked before nine, so that's no good either. We will wait for the bus by the hotel's main entrance — right by the front steps and the flags. Seven forty-five, main entrance, cameras charged. Sleep well, everyone!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By the hotel's main entrance (ngay cổng chính khách sạn).
• Vì sao đúng: hướng dẫn viên dặn "We will wait for the bus by the hotel's main entrance — right by the front steps and the flags. Seven forty-five, main entrance".
• Behind the hotel's main entrance sai: xe không vào được phía sau "Do NOT wait behind the hotel... the driver cannot even enter that street, it's pedestrians only".
• By the hotel's side entrance sai: cửa hông bị khóa "the side entrance by the pool is locked before nine".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CHỜ Ở ĐÂU, ba phương án chỉ khác nhau một giới từ/vị trí (behind – side – main). Nghe trọn cụm giới từ chứ đừng bắt mỗi chữ "entrance", và ưu tiên câu bắt đầu bằng "We will wait...".

question_text: A person calls a friend about his new car. What is the price of the small car?
options: 3,250 pounds
3,550 pounds
3,000 pounds
explanation:
Mike, you'll never guess where I've been — the car showroom, and I have news! You know I've been torn between the two models for weeks. The big family one is out: they want three thousand five hundred and fifty for it, and that's just beyond me this year. So I focused on the small car. The sticker said three thousand — but wait for it — with the winter tyres and the delivery, the real price of the small one comes to three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds. Signed this morning. I pick it up Tuesday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 3,250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "with the winter tyres and the delivery, the real price of the small one comes to three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds".
• 3,550 pounds sai: là giá chiếc xe gia đình cỡ lớn, vượt khả năng ("that's just beyond me this year").
• 3,000 pounds sai: chỉ là giá trên tem, chưa gồm lốp và phí giao ("The sticker said three thousand — but wait for it").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giá, phân biệt giá niêm yết với giá thực trả; săn các cụm "comes to", "the real price", "final price".

question_text: What area is he describing?
options: A shopping district
A university area
A residential neighborhood
explanation:
Let me describe the area where I've just moved, because it has a very particular energy. Don't picture a shopping district — there's just one small supermarket and a kiosk, that's the whole retail scene. And it's not a quiet residential neighbourhood either, definitely not; nobody here is retired, trust me. This is a university area through and through: three faculties within ten minutes' walk, bookshops and cheap cafés on every corner, bicycles everywhere, and the streets full of students until two in the morning. The average age here must be twenty-two!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A university area.
• Vì sao đúng: "This is a university area through and through: three faculties within ten minutes' walk... the streets full of students until two in the morning."
• A shopping district sai: bị phủ định ngay ("Don't picture a shopping district — there's just one small supermarket and a kiosk").
• A residential neighborhood sai: cũng bị phủ định ("it's not a quiet residential neighbourhood either, definitely not").
👉 Mẹo: dạng miêu tả khu vực, đếm hai câu "Don't picture..." / "it's not..." để loại; đáp án là câu khẳng định "This is a...".

question_text: Jack is phoning his mom. What does Jack need to buy for his sister?
options: Clothes
Chocolates
A toy
explanation:
Mum, it's Jack, I need your advice — it's Emma's birthday on Sunday and I still haven't got her anything! I'm at the shops right now. So I remembered what you said: don't buy her clothes, because I always get the size wrong, and she has enough toys to open a shop already. That leaves your suggestion — the chocolates. The fancy ones in the gold box, from that little shop by the market, right? The ones with the cherries inside? Text me quickly before it closes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Chocolates.
• Vì sao đúng: "That leaves your suggestion — the chocolates. The fancy ones in the gold box" — loại sô-cô-la có nhân anh đào ở tiệm gần chợ.
• Clothes sai: mẹ dặn đừng mua vì Jack luôn chọn sai cỡ ("don't buy her clothes, because I always get the size wrong").
• A toy sai: Emma đã có quá nhiều đồ chơi ("she has enough toys to open a shop already").
👉 Mẹo: dạng "cần mua gì", cụm "That leaves..." báo hiệu quá trình loại trừ đã xong — món đứng ngay sau nó là đáp án.

question_text: A student is talking about housing. Where does he live now?
options: In a small village
In an apartment
In a town hall
explanation:
Student housing stories — everyone has one, but mine wins, listen to this! Back home I lived in a small village, all cows and one bus a week, so I was desperate for city life. First I applied for a normal apartment near campus — the waiting list laughed at me: two years minimum. But then the university offered something strange and wonderful: the old town hall! The council moved out, the building was converted, and now I live in a town hall — my room has a chandelier and a balcony over the market square. Best address in student history!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – In a town hall (trong tòa thị chính cũ).
• Vì sao đúng: cậu sinh viên kể "the university offered something strange and wonderful: the old town hall!... now I live in a town hall — my room has a chandelier and a balcony over the market square".
• In a small village sai: đó là nơi ở TRƯỚC KIA "Back home I lived in a small village, all cows and one bus a week".
• In an apartment sai: có nộp đơn nhưng không được "the waiting list laughed at me: two years minimum".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HIỆN TẠI SỐNG Ở ĐÂU, phân tách thì: "Back home I lived" (quá khứ), "First I applied for" (thất bại), "now I live in" (đáp án). Chỉ khoanh nơi đi kèm thì hiện tại.

question_text: Listen to a man talking. What is not working?
options: The Wifi
The computer
The printer
explanation:
Sarah, it's me from the office — we have a situation this morning. Before you panic: the wifi is fine, I'm on it right now, emails are flying in as usual. The printer is also behaving for once, I tested it with two pages. It's the computer — the main one at reception. It won't start at all: black screen, no sound, nothing. I've tried the cable, tried holding the power button, everything. The computer is completely dead. Can you send the technician before the customers arrive?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The computer.
• Vì sao đúng: "It's the computer — the main one at reception. It won't start at all: black screen, no sound, nothing... completely dead."
• The Wifi sai: vẫn chạy tốt ("the wifi is fine, I'm on it right now, emails are flying in as usual").
• The printer sai: hoạt động bình thường, đã thử in 2 trang ("The printer is also behaving for once").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "What is not working", dùng các cụm khen ("is fine", "is behaving") để loại; thứ đi với "won't start / dead" mới là đáp án.

question_text: Listen to a weather forecast. Where will the weather be best?
options: In the west
In the south
In the east
explanation:
Good morning, here is today's weather for the whole country. Starting in the west: heavy showers all day, so keep the umbrella close. The south won't be much better — grey skies and a cold wind coming in from the sea by lunchtime. But the east is the place to be today: clear skies, sunshine from morning to evening, and temperatures up to twenty-two degrees. So if you're planning a day out, head east — the weather there will be the best in the country.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – In the east.
• Vì sao đúng: "the east is the place to be today: clear skies, sunshine from morning to evening, and temperatures up to twenty-two degrees... the weather there will be the best in the country".
• In the west sai: mưa rào cả ngày — "Starting in the west: heavy showers all day, so keep the umbrella close".
• In the south sai: trời xám và gió lạnh từ biển thổi vào — "grey skies and a cold wind coming in from the sea by lunchtime".
👉 Mẹo: bản tin thời tiết đọc lần lượt từng vùng. Câu hỏi "best" thì chỉ giữ vùng có tính từ tích cực (clear, sunshine) kèm mốc nhiệt độ cao.

question_text: Listen to a woman giving advice on saving money. What advice does she give to save money?
options: Buy in bulk
Use the public transport
Put money into the bank
explanation:
Welcome back to Money Matters! Today: my number one tip for saving, especially for you city listeners. People expect me to say buy in bulk — but honestly, half those giant packets expire before you finish them; I've thrown away more bulk rice than I dare admit. Putting money into the bank is fine, but with these interest rates it's storage, not strategy. My real advice: use public transport! Do the maths — petrol, parking, insurance, repairs... a monthly travel card costs a fraction of a car. Hundreds saved, every single month. Sell the car, buy the card!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Use the public transport (dùng phương tiện công cộng).
• Vì sao đúng: chuyên gia chốt "My real advice: use public transport!" và tính rõ "a monthly travel card costs a fraction of a car. Hundreds saved, every single month".
• Buy in bulk sai: bị bác bỏ vì lãng phí "half those giant packets expire before you finish them; I've thrown away more bulk rice than I dare admit".
• Put money into the bank sai: chỉ là cất giữ, không sinh lời "with these interest rates it's storage, not strategy".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi LỜI KHUYÊN TIẾT KIỆM, người nói luôn nêu cái mọi người TƯỞNG trước ("People expect me to say..."). Đáp án nằm sau "My real advice is..." và kèm con số/phép tính minh chứng.

question_text: A woman is talking about her usual Saturday routine. What does she usually do on Saturdays?
options: Goes shopping
Sees her family
Goes to a birthday party
explanation:
Saturdays in my world are sacred, and everyone knows not to book me! People assume I spend them shopping — wrong; I do the boring food run on Thursday evenings precisely to keep Saturday free. And this week is unusual because there IS a birthday party — my niece turns seven — but that's a one-off, not the routine. My real Saturday tradition: I see my family. Every week: lunch at Mum and Dad's, board games with my brother's kids, the walk with Grandpa at four. Same rhythm for six years — and I protect it like treasure!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Sees her family (gặp gia đình).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "My real Saturday tradition: I see my family. Every week: lunch at Mum and Dad's, board games with my brother's kids, the walk with Grandpa at four" — duy trì suốt sáu năm.
• Goes shopping sai: việc mua sắm được dời sang thứ Năm "I do the boring food run on Thursday evenings precisely to keep Saturday free".
• Goes to a birthday party sai: chỉ là ngoại lệ tuần này "this week is unusual because there IS a birthday party — my niece turns seven — but that's a one-off, not the routine".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi THÓI QUEN THƯỜNG LÀM, câu hỏi có chữ "usually" nên phải loại mọi việc gắn với "this week", "a one-off". Đáp án đi kèm "every week", "tradition", "same rhythm".

question_text: Listen to a man talking about their train journey. What time did the train depart?
explanation:
What a journey that was — let me tell you about the start of it! We'd booked the early train, the nine o'clock, and were very proud of ourselves. Then at the station, the board announced a delay — signal problems up the line. Some passengers panicked and rebooked onto the ten o'clock for extra money. We waited it out with coffee, and good thing too: our train departed at nine thirty, only half an hour behind, and we still made the ferry connection with time to spare. Patience pays, my friend!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 9:30.
• Vì sao đúng: "our train departed at nine thirty, only half an hour behind, and we still made the ferry connection".
• 9:00 sai: là giờ trên vé đã đặt nhưng bị hoãn vì lỗi tín hiệu ("We'd booked the early train, the nine o'clock").
• 10:00 sai: là chuyến mà vài hành khách hoảng loạn đổi sang, phải trả thêm tiền ("Some passengers panicked and rebooked onto the ten o'clock").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giờ khởi hành THỰC TẾ, bỏ giờ in trên vé và giờ của người khác; chọn số đi với động từ quá khứ "departed".

question_text: A tour guide is introducing a famous building. What is this building currently used for?
options: A museum
A department store
A cinema
explanation:
And here we are in front of the most photographed building in our city! A quick history: it opened a century ago as a grand cinema — a thousand seats, red velvet, the works. Between the wars it even served as a museum of science for a decade. But today? Walk through those doors and you'll find six floors of shopping — it's now a department store, one of the biggest in the country. They kept the beautiful old ceiling, though. Shall we go in and look?

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A department store.
• Vì sao đúng: "But today? Walk through those doors and you'll find six floors of shopping — it's now a department store, one of the biggest in the country."
• A museum sai: chỉ là công năng trong thời kỳ giữa hai cuộc chiến ("Between the wars it even served as a museum of science for a decade").
• A cinema sai: đó là công năng khi khánh thành một thế kỷ trước ("it opened a century ago as a grand cinema").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi có "currently" thì phải bắt thì hiện tại. Mọi công năng kể ở quá khứ (opened as, served as) đều là bẫy.

question_text: A tour guide is introducing a famous building. What is this building currently used for?
options: A museum
A department store
A cinema
explanation:
Cameras up, everyone — this façade is the town's favourite postcard! Now, its story in thirty seconds. Your grandparents might remember it as the Grand Cinema — the neon sign, the Saturday queues; that era ended in the eighties. For a short while the council ran it as a museum — lovely idea, empty halls, closed within five years. Today? It's a department store — four floors, from perfumes at the bottom to furniture at the top. The marble staircase is original, do go and walk it. Twenty minutes of shopping — or history — starts now!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A department store (một cửa hàng bách hóa).
• Vì sao đúng: hướng dẫn viên nói "Today? It's a department store — four floors, from perfumes at the bottom to furniture at the top".
• A cinema sai: đó là công năng thời ông bà, đã chấm dứt "Your grandparents might remember it as the Grand Cinema... that era ended in the eighties".
• A museum sai: chỉ tồn tại ngắn rồi đóng "the council ran it as a museum — lovely idea, empty halls, closed within five years".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi TÒA NHÀ NAY DÙNG LÀM GÌ, bài kể lịch sử theo dòng thời gian. Bắt mốc "Today", "Now", "Currently"; mọi công năng đi kèm "used to be", "that era ended", "closed" đều là quá khứ.

question_text: A woman is talking about her family’s weekend. What does the family do most weekends?
options: Go for a walk
Go to the beach
Visit relatives
explanation:
People ask what our family does at the weekend, and the answer is wonderfully simple. Most Saturdays and Sundays, we all put on our boots after breakfast and go for a walk together — the long path along the river, or the trail behind the hill if the weather is fine. The kids race ahead, the dog goes mad with joy, and my husband and I finally get to talk. Two hours later we come home hungry and happy. It never gets old.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Go for a walk.
• Vì sao đúng: "Most Saturdays and Sundays, we all put on our boots after breakfast and go for a walk together — the long path along the river".
• Go to the beach sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Visit relatives sai: cũng không được nhắc tới; bài chỉ kể cả nhà đi bộ, bọn trẻ chạy trước, hai vợ chồng trò chuyện.
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi có "most weekends" thì bắt đúng cụm tần suất "Most Saturdays and Sundays" rồi lấy động từ ngay sau đó.

question_text: An expert is talking about lack of satisfaction at work. What should be the solution?
options: Request a transfer
Take a vacation
Find a new job
explanation:
Today I want to talk about something many workers write to me about: losing satisfaction at work. First, what NOT to do. Don't rush to find a new job — you often carry the same problem to a new desk, plus new stress. And a vacation? It helps for exactly two weeks, then the same emails are waiting. My advice, based on twenty years of research: request a transfer within your company. A new team and new tasks — but with your reputation and relationships intact. It refreshes everything while risking almost nothing.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Request a transfer.
• Vì sao đúng: "My advice, based on twenty years of research: request a transfer within your company. A new team and new tasks — but with your reputation and relationships intact."
• Take a vacation sai: chỉ hiệu quả đúng hai tuần rồi email cũ vẫn chờ ("It helps for exactly two weeks").
• Find a new job sai: chuyên gia cảnh báo bạn mang theo cùng vấn đề sang chỗ mới ("you often carry the same problem to a new desk").
👉 Mẹo: bài kiểu chuyên gia luôn nói "what NOT to do" trước rồi mới tới lời khuyên. Chỉ lấy ý sau "My advice".

question_text: Listen to a woman talking about what she has just bought. What is Dress she wears like?
