options: black and white
long and white
long and red
explanation:
I did it — I finally bought THE dress, and you need to hear about it! The shop had three finalists, let me set the scene. A black and white one, very elegant, very... funeral-meets-chessboard, my mum loved it, which settled that. Then a long white one — dreamy, but I'd stain it within the hour, we all know me. The winner, the one I'm wearing to the reunion: long and red! Floor-length, deep wine red, little sparkles at the hem. I twirled in the changing room like a five-year-old. No regrets!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – long and red (váy dài màu đỏ).
• Vì sao đúng: cô công bố "The winner, the one I'm wearing to the reunion: long and red! Floor-length, deep wine red, little sparkles at the hem".
• black and white sai: bị loại vì trông như đồ tang/bàn cờ và vì mẹ thích "very... funeral-meets-chessboard, my mum loved it, which settled that".
• long and white sai: đẹp nhưng dễ bẩn "dreamy, but I'd stain it within the hour, we all know me".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MÔ TẢ ĐỒ VẬT (màu/kiểu), bài dựng như một cuộc thi 3 ứng viên. Đợi từ "The winner", "the one I bought/I'm wearing" rồi mới ghép đủ cả hai đặc điểm (độ dài + màu).

question_text: What is the woman doing?
options: Cleaning
Swimming
Crying
explanation:
Whoever is at the door, come back later — or roll up your sleeves! I've declared war on this house today. Started at seven with the bedrooms, and I'm now on my knees in the hallway with a brush and a bucket. The carpets are beaten, the mirrors are polished, the fridge is emptied of its... science experiments. Two more hours of cleaning and this place will finally look like humans live here. My sister's family arrives tomorrow, and her house always looks like a magazine. Not this time!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Cleaning.
• Vì sao đúng: "Two more hours of cleaning and this place will finally look like humans live here" — đã đập thảm, lau gương, dọn tủ lạnh.
• Swimming sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
• Crying sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu.
👉 Mẹo: nếu lỡ động từ chính, gom các danh từ đi kèm (brush, bucket, carpets, mirrors) để suy ra hành động đang diễn ra.

question_text: Which room will they study in? / Where will the first lesson of computer science take place?
options: Room 301
Room 101
Room 203
explanation:
Welcome to Computer Science, everyone — your first lesson is tomorrow, so write this down! There's been some confusion about the room, and I want no lost students wandering the corridors. The timetable you printed in summer says Room 101 — that's outdated, the computers were moved out last month. And please ignore Room 203, that's the biology lab; you'll find only frogs there, no keyboards. Your lesson is in Room 301, top floor, next to the library. Room three-oh-one, nine o'clock sharp. Don't be late!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Room 301.
• Vì sao đúng: "Your lesson is in Room 301, top floor, next to the library. Room three-oh-one, nine o'clock sharp."
• Room 101 sai: là thời khóa biểu in hồi hè đã lỗi thời, máy tính đã được chuyển đi ("that's outdated").
• Room 203 sai: là phòng thí nghiệm sinh học ("you'll find only frogs there, no keyboards").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi số phòng, người nói thường đọc lại theo kiểu đánh vần ("three-oh-one"); số đi với "outdated" hay tên môn khác đều sai.

question_text: Listen to a person talking about a picnic. What did the speaker bring?
options: Sandwiches
Drinks
Fruit
explanation:
Sunday's beach picnic — what a day! Fifteen of us in the end, and the food table was a work of art. Elena turned up with two coolers of drinks, enough lemonade to fill the sea. The office boys were on sandwich duty and, surprisingly, delivered — proper ones, with three fillings. My contribution? The fruit! I raided the market at seven am: peaches, cherries, two melons, and a pineapple that I carried like a baby on the bus. Every last piece disappeared. Next time I'm bringing a wheelbarrow!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Fruit.
• Vì sao đúng: "My contribution? The fruit! I raided the market at seven am: peaches, cherries, two melons, and a pineapple".
• Sandwiches sai: do nhóm đồng nghiệp nam phụ trách ("The office boys were on sandwich duty").
• Drinks sai: Elena mang hai thùng đồ uống ("Elena turned up with two coolers of drinks").
👉 Mẹo: dạng "ai mang gì", câu hỏi hỏi "the speaker" nên chỉ lấy món sau "My contribution?" hoặc "I brought".

question_text: A customer is calling the hotline of a department store. Which number to press in order to buy a computer?
options: One
Two
Three
explanation:
Thank you for calling Hartman's Department Store! Please listen to all options, as our menu changed this week. For questions about clothing, shoes and accessories, press one. For furniture, kitchens and home delivery, press two. To speak to our electronics team — including televisions, phones, and computer purchases — press three. That's three for buying a computer. For all other enquiries, please hold the line and one of our assistants will be with you shortly. Thank you!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Three (bấm số 3).
• Vì sao đúng: tổng đài đọc "To speak to our electronics team — including televisions, phones, and computer purchases — press three. That's three for buying a computer" — máy tính thuộc nhóm điện tử.
• One sai: số 1 dành cho "clothing, shoes and accessories".
• Two sai: số 2 dành cho "furniture, kitchens and home delivery".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi BẤM SỐ MẤY, đừng nghe số trước — hãy bắt từ khóa của món cần mua (computer) rồi mới lấy số đi kèm. Menu tổng đài đọc rất nhanh nên ghi nhanh cặp "nhóm hàng – số".

question_text: Listen to a principal talking about new school facilities. What new facility will the school have?
options: A new library
A sports field
A Performance space
explanation:
Good morning, everyone — I have exciting news about our school's future! As you know, we asked for your ideas last term. Many parents suggested a new library, but the town built one just two streets away, so we'd rather not repeat it. The students, of course, voted for another sports field — but we simply don't have the land, I'm afraid. What we WILL have, from next September, is a performance space! A proper stage, lights, two hundred seats — for our plays, our concerts, everything. Construction starts this summer!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – A performance space.
• Vì sao đúng: "What we WILL have, from next September, is a performance space! A proper stage, lights, two hundred seats" — khởi công mùa hè này.
• A new library sai: thị trấn vừa xây một thư viện cách hai dãy phố nên trường không làm lại ("the town built one just two streets away").
• A sports field sai: học sinh bầu chọn nhưng trường không đủ đất ("we simply don't have the land, I'm afraid").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi công trình sẽ có, bám thì tương lai "will have"; ý gắn với "suggested" hay "voted for" chỉ là đề xuất đã bị loại.

question_text: A woman is going home after shopping. What did she buy?
options: A dress
A blouse
A hat
explanation:
I'm on the bus home and I have to tell SOMEONE about my shopping victory! The plan this morning was a blouse for the office — but every single one was either see-through or the colour of sadness, so that mission failed. Then I detoured past the hats, tried on a big summer one, looked like a lost mushroom — photo deleted forever. But THEN, on the last rail by the till: the dress. Simple, navy, fits like a dream, thirty percent off. I bought the dress on the spot! Sometimes the shopping gods just smile at you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – A dress (một chiếc váy).
• Vì sao đúng: cô kể "But THEN, on the last rail by the till: the dress. Simple, navy, fits like a dream, thirty percent off. I bought the dress on the spot!".
• A blouse sai: đó là mục tiêu ban đầu nhưng thất bại "every single one was either see-through or the colour of sadness, so that mission failed".
• A hat sai: chỉ thử chứ không mua "tried on a big summer one, looked like a lost mushroom — photo deleted forever".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐÃ MUA GÌ, phân biệt "the plan was..." / "tried on" (chỉ định mua, chỉ thử) với "I bought". Đáp án đi kèm hành động mua dứt khoát ("bought... on the spot") và chi tiết giá/khuyến mãi.

question_text: A woman is talking about her plan for the holiday. What will she do during the holiday?
options: Go for a run
Go for a bike ride
Go for a walk
explanation:
Two more days until my holiday, and I have made my plans! My sister keeps saying I should go for a run every morning — she's training for a marathon and thinks everyone else should suffer too. My neighbour offered to lend me his bike for a ride along the coast, which was kind, but I haven't cycled in years and I'd like to return from holiday in one piece. No — every morning, I will simply go for a walk. The long path by the sea, slow and peaceful, coffee at the end. Perfect.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Go for a walk.
• Vì sao đúng: "every morning, I will simply go for a walk. The long path by the sea, slow and peaceful, coffee at the end."
• Go for a run sai: đó là ý của chị gái đang tập marathon, cô không nhận ("My sister keeps saying I should go for a run").
• Go for a bike ride sai: hàng xóm cho mượn xe nhưng cô đã lâu không đạp và muốn về nhà nguyên vẹn ("I haven't cycled in years").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi kế hoạch, gạch hết ý do người khác đề xuất; đáp án nằm sau "No —" và đi với chủ ngữ "I will".

question_text: A man wants to buy a new house. What is his biggest problem?
options: Finding the right house
Persuading his family
Getting the financing
explanation:
So, the big house-buying project — everyone asks how it's going. Here's the funny thing: the parts I feared went smoothly. Finding the right house? Done in a month — a lovely place near the school, garden and all. The financing scared me most, but the bank approved the loan in two weeks, no drama. No — my real problem is persuading my own family! My wife says the kitchen is too small, my daughter refuses to change schools, and even the dog seems against it. Wish me luck at dinner tonight — final negotiations!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Persuading his family.
• Vì sao đúng: "my real problem is persuading my own family!" — vợ chê bếp nhỏ, con gái không chịu đổi trường.
• Finding the right house sai: đã xong trong một tháng ("Done in a month — a lovely place near the school").
• Getting the financing sai: ngân hàng duyệt khoản vay trong hai tuần, không rắc rối ("no drama").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "biggest problem", bỏ mọi việc đã hoàn tất; bám cụm "my real problem is" đứng ngay sau "No —".

question_text: An expert is talking about the lack of satisfaction at work. What should be the solution?
options: Raise the salary
Seek a new job
Request a transfer
explanation:
A listener wrote in: 'I'm good at my job, but the joy is gone. What now?' A question half the country recognises! Let's clear away the wrong answers first. A pay rise? Money soothes for a month or two, then the emptiness returns with better shoes. Quitting for a new job entirely? Risky — you lose your network, your history, and often land in the same boredom elsewhere. The solution I've seen work again and again: request a transfer. Same company, different department. New faces, new problems, old security. Try that BEFORE anything drastic.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Request a transfer (xin chuyển bộ phận).
• Vì sao đúng: chuyên gia chốt giải pháp "The solution I've seen work again and again: request a transfer. Same company, different department" — giữ được thâm niên mà vẫn có môi trường mới.
• Raise the salary sai: chỉ đỡ tạm thời "Money soothes for a month or two, then the emptiness returns with better shoes".
• Seek a new job sai: bị đánh giá quá rủi ro "Risky — you lose your network, your history, and often land in the same boredom elsewhere".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIẢI PHÁP/LỜI KHUYÊN, người nói thường "dọn sạch" các phương án sai trước ("Let's clear away the wrong answers first"). Đáp án nằm sau cụm "The solution is...", "What works is...", "I'd recommend...".

question_text: A person calls a friend about his new car. How much does the small car cost him?
options: 3250 pounds
3550 pounds
4250 pounds
explanation:
Tony! Call me back when you hear this — the car saga is OVER. So, the showroom had the two models side by side. The big estate was gorgeous, but they wanted four thousand two hundred and fifty — for that money I'd need to sell a kidney. The salesman started the small one at three thousand five hundred and fifty, and then we had coffee, and we talked, and we walked away twice... Final handshake price: three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds. The small car is MINE, Tony. Collection on Thursday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 3250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "Final handshake price: three thousand two hundred and fifty pounds. The small car is MINE".
• 3550 pounds sai: là giá người bán CHÀO ban đầu cho xe nhỏ, trước khi mặc cả ("The salesman started the small one at three thousand five hundred and fifty").
• 4250 pounds sai: là giá chiếc estate cỡ lớn ("for that money I'd need to sell a kidney").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giá phải trả, phân biệt giá chào và giá chốt; săn "final price", "handshake price", "we settled on".

question_text: Linda is talking about what she likes to eat. What does she have for lunch?
options: Tea
Coffee
Juice
explanation:
People at work tease me about my lunch ritual, so let me explain it properly! My name's Linda, and yes, I'm particular. The others line up at the coffee machine after eating — not me; coffee after midday keeps me wired till two in the morning. Juice? Too sweet with a meal, I find, more of a breakfast thing. What I have with lunch, every single day, is tea. A proper pot of black tea, no sugar, splash of milk, brewed exactly four minutes. My little island of calm in the working day!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Tea (trà).
• Vì sao đúng: Linda nói "What I have with lunch, every single day, is tea. A proper pot of black tea, no sugar, splash of milk".
• Coffee sai: đó là thói quen của đồng nghiệp, còn cô tránh vì mất ngủ "The others line up at the coffee machine after eating — not me; coffee after midday keeps me wired till two in the morning".
• Juice sai: cô cho là không hợp bữa trưa "Too sweet with a meal, I find, more of a breakfast thing".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĂN/UỐNG GÌ, phân biệt "the others" với "me". Đáp án đi kèm cụm chỉ tần suất "every single day" và mô tả chi tiết cách dùng.

question_text: A girl is talking about a show she will attend. What will it end with?
options: A surprise performance
A speech
A firework display
explanation:
I finally got tickets to the summer show on Saturday — best seats, row five! I've been reading everything about the programme. Someone online claimed it ends with a firework display, but that's last year's show — the park banned fireworks after the dry summer. And it's definitely not ending with a boring speech, thank goodness; the director does his talking at the START this year. The real ending is a surprise performance! Nobody knows who it is — a secret guest star. The whole town is guessing. Two more days!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – A surprise performance.
• Vì sao đúng: "The real ending is a surprise performance! Nobody knows who it is — a secret guest star."
• A speech sai: năm nay giám đốc phát biểu ở ĐẦU chương trình ("the director does his talking at the START this year").
• A firework display sai: là chương trình năm ngoái, công viên đã cấm pháo hoa sau mùa hè khô hạn.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi phần KẾT, phân biệt "start" và "end"; thông tin đọc trên mạng hay của năm ngoái đều là bẫy kinh điển.

question_text: Listen to the announcement. When does the train leave the station?
explanation:
Attention, please, passengers for the express service to the capital. There has been a small change this morning, so please listen carefully. The timetable on the board still shows the old departure at nine o'clock — that is no longer correct. And despite the rumour on the platform, the train has NOT been delayed to nine thirty. The train will leave the station at nine fifteen — nine one five, from platform four. Please make your way there now with your tickets ready. Thank you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 9:15.
• Vì sao đúng: "The train will leave the station at nine fifteen — nine one five, from platform four."
• 9:00 sai: là giờ CŨ vẫn hiện trên bảng ("The timetable on the board still shows the old departure at nine o'clock — that is no longer correct").
• 9:30 sai: chỉ là tin đồn trên sân ga ("the train has NOT been delayed to nine thirty").
👉 Mẹo: thông báo nhà ga luôn nêu giờ cũ và tin đồn trước. Bám thì tương lai "will leave" và cách đọc lặp lại từng số ("nine one five").

question_text: Listen to a student talking about his study. What course is the student going to take this year?
options: Math
Computer
Science
explanation:
Course registration week — the eternal student dilemma, and I've finally decided! Everyone pushed me towards math, because my father teaches it... but honestly, we'd end up discussing homework at dinner, no thank you. Science was my second thought — the new lab looks amazing — but the schedule clashes with my part-time job, completely impossible. So this year I'm taking the computer course! Programming, databases, a bit of design — the works. Every company wants these skills, and secretly... I've wanted to build my own game since I was ten. Enrolled this morning!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Computer (khóa học máy tính).
• Vì sao đúng: cậu chốt "So this year I'm taking the computer course! Programming, databases, a bit of design" và đã đăng ký xong "Enrolled this morning".
• Math sai: bị loại vì lý do gia đình "Everyone pushed me towards math, because my father teaches it... but honestly, we'd end up discussing homework at dinner, no thank you".
• Science sai: trùng lịch đi làm thêm "the schedule clashes with my part-time job, completely impossible".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CHỌN KHÓA HỌC NÀO, đừng vội chọn môn được nhắc đầu tiên — đó thường là môn người khác gợi ý ("Everyone pushed me towards..."). Đáp án nằm sau "So this year I'm taking..." và có hành động xác nhận (enrolled, signed up).

question_text: David is in an interview. What was his last job?
options: An engineer
A teacher
An electrician
explanation:
You ask about my last position — an important question, let me be precise. My file mentions engineering, and yes, there's a diploma from long ago, but I went straight from graduation into other work — never held an engineering post, I want to be honest about that. I did teach for a while in my twenties — evening classes, technical drawing — enjoyable, but that chapter closed years back. My last job, the one I held until this spring, was as an electrician. Eight years with the housing company: full installations, safety inspections, apprentice training. Those skills come with me to this role.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – An electrician (thợ điện).
• Vì sao đúng: David nói "My last job, the one I held until this spring, was as an electrician. Eight years with the housing company: full installations, safety inspections".
• An engineer sai: chỉ có bằng chứ chưa từng làm "there's a diploma from long ago, but I went straight from graduation into other work — never held an engineering post".
• A teacher sai: là việc thời trẻ, đã kết thúc "I did teach for a while in my twenties — evening classes, technical drawing... that chapter closed years back".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CÔNG VIỆC GẦN NHẤT trong phỏng vấn, ứng viên sẽ kể cả bằng cấp lẫn nghề cũ. Đáp án đi kèm "My last job was...", "until this spring" — bằng cấp (diploma) không đồng nghĩa với đã làm nghề đó.

question_text: Listen to a woman asking about a flight. How much does the flight in the morning cost?
options: 300 pounds
350 pounds
400 pounds
explanation:
Good afternoon, I'm calling about flights to Dublin next Thursday — and thank you for the patience, I know I ask a lot of questions! So, to repeat what you've told me: the evening flight is three hundred pounds, that's the cheapest, but it lands close to midnight — too late for my meeting. The midday one at four hundred is honestly more than I want to pay. So the morning flight, the eight fifteen — that one is three hundred and fifty pounds, correct? Yes? Then book me the morning one, please. Three fifty it is.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 350 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "So the morning flight, the eight fifteen — that one is three hundred and fifty pounds, correct?... Then book me the morning one".
• 300 pounds sai: là chuyến TỐI, rẻ nhất nhưng hạ cánh gần nửa đêm nên lỡ cuộc họp.
• 400 pounds sai: là chuyến giữa trưa, đắt hơn mức cô muốn trả ("more than I want to pay").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giá của MỘT chuyến cụ thể, ghim cặp buổi–giá (evening 300 / midday 400 / morning 350) rồi mới trả lời.

question_text: The daughter is calling her father. What did she buy?
options: A dress
A pair of shoes
A blouse
explanation:
Daddy! Don't be angry, but I've just used the birthday money — all of it, and it's wonderful! I went in for a pair of shoes, you know, the white ones I showed you — but they only had giant sizes left, like boats. Then I tried a blouse, the silky one, but it looked terrible under the shop lights, all wrong. And THEN I saw it: the dress. Dark blue, knee-length, perfect for Anna's wedding next month. I bought the dress, Daddy, and I look AMAZING. You'll see tonight!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – A dress.
• Vì sao đúng: "And THEN I saw it: the dress. Dark blue, knee-length... I bought the dress, Daddy".
• A pair of shoes sai: cửa hàng chỉ còn cỡ quá to ("they only had giant sizes left, like boats").
• A blouse sai: đã thử nhưng nhìn tệ dưới ánh đèn cửa hàng ("it looked terrible under the shop lights").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi món ĐÃ mua, bám thì quá khứ khẳng định "I bought"; món chỉ được "tried" hay "went in for" là chưa mua.

question_text: Listen to the announcement from a travel agent representative. Why is the air travel cancelled?
options: Staff shortage
Poor weather conditions
Technical issues
explanation:
Ladies and gentlemen, may I have your attention, please. We're very sorry to announce that this afternoon's flights have been cancelled. Let me be clear about the reason, as there are rumours going around. We have a full crew today — this is not a staffing problem — and all aircraft passed their checks this morning, so it's not technical either. The cancellation is due to poor weather conditions: a severe storm is moving across the region, and it is simply not safe to fly. Please see our desk for rebooking.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Poor weather conditions.
• Vì sao đúng: "The cancellation is due to poor weather conditions: a severe storm is moving across the region, and it is simply not safe to fly".
• Staff shortage sai: hôm nay đủ tổ bay — "We have a full crew today — this is not a staffing problem".
• Technical issues sai: toàn bộ máy bay đã qua kiểm tra sáng nay — "all aircraft passed their checks this morning, so it's not technical either".
👉 Mẹo: thông báo hủy chuyến thường dập tin đồn trước rồi mới nêu lý do. Bám cụm "is due to"; hai ý đi kèm "this is not..." là nhiễu.

question_text: A woman is talking about her babysitter. How old is the babysitter?
explanation:
Our new babysitter is an absolute treasure — let me tell you about her! When she first rang the doorbell, I honestly thought she was twenty at most, she has such a young face. Then over coffee she mentioned finishing her second year at university, and my husband guessed twenty-two. Wrong too! We saw her ID when we did the paperwork: she's twenty-one. Twenty-one, studying early childhood education, and the kids adore her — they actually ask when she's coming back. Worth every penny!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 21 tuổi.
• Vì sao đúng: người mẹ dẫn bằng chứng giấy tờ "We saw her ID when we did the paperwork: she's twenty-one. Twenty-one, studying early childhood education".
• 20 sai: chỉ là cảm nhận ban đầu vì cô bé trông trẻ "I honestly thought she was twenty at most, she has such a young face".
• 22 sai: là phỏng đoán của người chồng và bị bác bỏ "my husband guessed twenty-two. Wrong too!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi BAO NHIÊU TUỔI, luôn có 2 con số phỏng đoán ("I thought", "guessed") và 1 con số có bằng chứng (ID, giấy tờ, hồ sơ). Chọn con số gắn với bằng chứng.

question_text: A man is talking about his family trip. What does the man’s wife enjoy?
options: Photography
Shopping
Hiking
explanation:
Our family trip worked because everyone got their own happiness — let me explain the system! Me, I'm the shopper: give me a local market and two hours, I'm in heaven — everyone else groans. The kids demanded hiking, so we did two mountain days, boots, blisters and all — my knees are still filing complaints. But my wife — her joy is photography! She carried that camera everywhere: sunrise over the harbour, old doors, strangers' dogs, four hundred photos of the same lighthouse. The album she's making is genuinely gorgeous. Happy wife, happy trip!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Photography (chụp ảnh).
• Vì sao đúng: người chồng kể "But my wife — her joy is photography! She carried that camera everywhere: sunrise over the harbour, old doors... four hundred photos of the same lighthouse".
• Shopping sai: đó là sở thích của chính người kể "Me, I'm the shopper: give me a local market and two hours, I'm in heaven".
• Hiking sai: là đòi hỏi của lũ trẻ "The kids demanded hiking, so we did two mountain days".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi AI THÍCH GÌ trong gia đình, bài gán mỗi sở thích cho một người. Ghi nhanh cặp "người – sở thích" ngay khi nghe (Me / the kids / my wife) rồi mới trả lời đúng người được hỏi.

question_text: Listening to a man talking about his business trip. What does he like in Dubai?
options: He enjoys shopping
He enjoys his job here
He enjoys the weather
explanation:
People ask how the business trip to Dubai is going, so here's my report from the hotel! It's certainly an experience. The famous shopping? Not for me — the malls are enormous and I get lost and bored in about twenty minutes. And the weather, goodness — forty-two degrees today, I practically run between air-conditioned buildings. But the work! The project here is fascinating, the team is brilliant, and every day brings a new challenge. I genuinely enjoy my job here — so much that I might extend the contract.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – He enjoys his job here.
• Vì sao đúng: "I genuinely enjoy my job here — so much that I might extend the contract" (dự án hay, đội ngũ giỏi).
• He enjoys shopping sai: anh thấy trung tâm mua sắm quá rộng, lạc và chán ("I get lost and bored in about twenty minutes").
• He enjoys the weather sai: 42 độ, anh phải chạy giữa các tòa nhà có điều hòa.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "What does he like", đáp án thường nằm sau "But" ở cuối bài; hai ý trước bị hạ bằng "Not for me" hoặc lời than.

question_text: Listen to a man talking about his journey to work. How does the man usually go to work?
options: By motorbike
By car
By train
explanation:
Ah, the daily commute question — my colleagues argue about this constantly! Here's my situation. I loved my motorbike years ago, but when the second baby arrived my wife made me sell it — too dangerous, and honestly she's right. The train would be lovely except our line only runs once an hour, and one missed connection ruins the whole morning. So I usually go by car. Thirty-five minutes, my own music, my own temperature, and the big car park behind the office. Boring but reliable — like me, my wife says!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By car.
• Vì sao đúng: "So I usually go by car. Thirty-five minutes, my own music, my own temperature, and the big car park behind the office."
• By motorbike sai: đã bán khi có con thứ hai ("my wife made me sell it — too dangerous").
• By train sai: tuyến chỉ chạy một chuyến mỗi giờ, lỡ nối chuyến là hỏng cả buổi sáng.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi thói quen đi làm, bám "usually"; phương tiện gắn với quá khứ ("I loved my motorbike years ago") là bẫy.

question_text: A man is talking to a friend about his family. What is his main problem?
options: Persuading his family
Finding a job abroad
Saving money for the move
explanation:
The big move abroad — everyone asks how it's going, so here's the honest update. The job part? Sorted, actually — the company found me a position in their Lisbon office within a month; finding work abroad was never the issue. Money's fine too — we've saved for three years, the moving fund is healthy. My real problem lives in my own house: persuading the family! My wife worries about her parents, the kids refuse to leave their friends, and Sunday dinners have become negotiation sessions. The visas are easy — it's my own kitchen table that's the battlefield!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Persuading his family (thuyết phục gia đình).
• Vì sao đúng: anh nói "My real problem lives in my own house: persuading the family!" — vợ lo cho bố mẹ, con không muốn xa bạn, "it's my own kitchen table that's the battlefield".
• Finding a job abroad sai: việc làm đã xong "the company found me a position in their Lisbon office within a month; finding work abroad was never the issue".
• Saving money for the move sai: tiền cũng đủ "Money's fine too — we've saved for three years, the moving fund is healthy".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi VẤN ĐỀ CHÍNH, bài sẽ "dọn" các khó khăn đã giải quyết trước bằng "sorted", "fine too", "never the issue". Đáp án đi sau "My real problem is...".

question_text: David is in an interview. What was his last job?
options: An engineer
A teacher
An electrician
explanation:
Thank you for asking about my background — let me walk you through it. People see engineering on my certificate and assume that was my last position, but that degree is from years ago; I never actually worked as an engineer. After university I spent two years as a maths teacher, which taught me patience, believe me. But my most recent job, the one I've just left after six years, was as an electrician — wiring new houses for a building company. That hands-on experience is exactly what I'd bring to this role.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – An electrician.
• Vì sao đúng: "my most recent job, the one I've just left after six years, was as an electrician — wiring new houses for a building company".
• An engineer sai: chỉ là tấm bằng, anh chưa từng làm nghề đó ("I never actually worked as an engineer").
• A teacher sai: là việc cũ hơn, hai năm ngay sau đại học ("After university I spent two years as a maths teacher").
👉 Mẹo: "last job" là hỏi việc GẦN NHẤT. Bám cụm "most recent", "I've just left"; bằng cấp không phải nghề nghiệp.

question_text: Soobin is talking about his favorite room. What is Soobin's favorite room?
options: Kitchen
Living room
Bathroom
explanation:
People always laugh when I tell them my favourite room in our house. It's not the kitchen, even though I love cooking, and it's not the living room with the big TV. It's the bathroom! Sounds strange, I know — but hear me out. It's the only place where nobody follows me, the light is soft, and a long hot bath after work fixes almost any bad day. I've even got a little shelf there for my music player. My private kingdom!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Bathroom.
• Vì sao đúng: "It's the bathroom!... It's the only place where nobody follows me, the light is soft, and a long hot bath after work fixes almost any bad day".
• Kitchen sai: bị loại dù người nói rất thích nấu ăn — "It's not the kitchen, even though I love cooking".
• Living room sai: cũng bị loại ngay — "it's not the living room with the big TV".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "phòng yêu thích", bài thường loại trừ trước bằng chuỗi "It's not... and it's not...". Đáp án nằm ngay sau chuỗi phủ định đó.

question_text: Two colleges talk about meeting. When do they want to meet?
options: On Tuesday
On Sunday
On Saturday
explanation:
M: We need this planning session soon — the deadline won't wait. Which day works?
W: Not the weekend, please. Saturday I'm at my niece's christening — all day, church shoes and everything.
M: Saturday's out then. Sunday? Just the morning?
W: Sunday the office building is locked, remember? No badge access, we learned that the hard way last month.
M: Ah yes, the car park picnic. Never again. So it has to be a weekday...
W: Tuesday! Tuesday my calendar is empty until four, and the meeting room is free — I just checked.
M: Tuesday works for me too. Nine o'clock, big whiteboard, and I'll bring the good coffee.
W: Tuesday at nine, then. And this time we finish the WHOLE plan before lunch!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On Tuesday (thứ Ba).
• Vì sao đúng: cô đề xuất "Tuesday! Tuesday my calendar is empty until four, and the meeting room is free" và cả hai chốt "Tuesday at nine, then".
• On Saturday sai: cô bận lễ rửa tội cả ngày "Saturday I'm at my niece's christening — all day, church shoes and everything".
• On Sunday sai: tòa nhà văn phòng khóa cửa "Sunday the office building is locked, remember? No badge access".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HẸN NGÀY NÀO giữa hai đồng nghiệp, đáp án là ngày duy nhất KHÔNG bị nêu trở ngại và được cả hai xác nhận lại. Nghe câu tổng kết cuối "X at nine, then".

question_text: Two friends are discussing a movie they recently watched. What elements of the film do they agree on?
options: The music
The ending
The characters
explanation:
M: Okay, verdict time — the film last night. Loved it or hated it?
W: Mixed! The music, for a start — that soundtrack carried half the scenes for me.
M: Really? I found the music too loud, honestly — it kept drowning the dialogue.
W: Philistine! Fine — the characters, then. The detective was brilliant, admit it.
M: The detective mumbled his way through two hours! I couldn't connect with any of them.
W: We agree on NOTHING today. Except... be honest about the ending.
M: Ah, the ending. The twist on the train — I did NOT see that coming. Genuinely great.
W: Neither did I! I actually gasped out loud, ask my sister.
M: So there it is: music, no; characters, no; but the ending — the ending we both loved.
W: One out of three. For us, that's harmony!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – The ending (đoạn kết).
• Vì sao đúng: người đàn ông tổng kết "music, no; characters, no; but the ending — the ending we both loved", cả hai đều bất ngờ với "The twist on the train — I did NOT see that coming".
• The music sai: hai người trái ý nhau — cô khen "that soundtrack carried half the scenes", anh chê "I found the music too loud... it kept drowning the dialogue".
• The characters sai: cũng bất đồng — cô khen thám tử xuất sắc, anh chê "The detective mumbled his way through two hours!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HAI NGƯỜI ĐỒNG Ý ĐIỀU GÌ, phải nghe cả hai lượt nói về từng yếu tố. Chỉ khoanh yếu tố mà cả hai cùng khen, thường có từ "both", "Neither did I", "We agree on...".

question_text: What does her sister drink?
options: Water
Tea
Coffee
explanation:
M: I'm doing a coffee run before the meeting — what do you and your sister want?
W: You're a hero! Just a black coffee for me, please.
M: Done. And your sister — water? She had water last time, I remember.
W: Only because she was on that detox thing. That's long over, thankfully.
M: Coffee for her too, then? Two birds, one machine.
W: Oh no, never coffee — it gives her headaches, she hasn't touched it in years. She drinks tea. Green tea if they have it, regular if not.
M: One coffee, one tea. Any cake interest while I'm there?
W: You know us too well. Two of those almond things, please!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Tea.
• Vì sao đúng: "She drinks tea. Green tea if they have it, regular if not."
• Water sai: chỉ vì đợt detox đã kết thúc từ lâu ("Only because she was on that detox thing. That's long over").
• Coffee sai: cà phê làm cô ấy đau đầu, nhiều năm không uống ("it gives her headaches, she hasn't touched it in years").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi hỏi về NGƯỜI THỨ BA (her sister), không phải người đang nói. Tách rõ ai uống gì trước khi chọn.

question_text: Jorge is calling his friend about their plan for the weekend. What time does the football match start?
options: 3pm
5pm
1pm
explanation:
M: Hey, it's Jorge! Are we still going to the football match tomorrow?
W: Absolutely! But I keep hearing different kick-off times. Someone said three?
M: Three was last week's game. This one is different — it's the cup, so they moved everything.
W: Then my brother said five pm. He swears he read it somewhere.
M: He read the OLD poster! They changed it for the TV broadcast. The match starts at one pm sharp.
W: One?! In the middle of lunch! We'll have to eat at the stadium then.
M: Exactly the plan — hot dogs at half twelve, seats by quarter to one.
W: Deal. Pick me up at noon, and don't be late!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 1pm.
• Vì sao đúng: "The match starts at one pm sharp" — giờ bị đổi để phù hợp lịch phát sóng truyền hình.
• 3pm sai: đó là giờ của trận TUẦN TRƯỚC ("Three was last week's game").
• 5pm sai: em trai đọc trên poster CŨ ("He read the OLD poster! They changed it for the TV broadcast").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi giờ, mỗi mốc sai đều kèm dấu hiệu lỗi thời ("last week's", "the OLD poster"); chốt bằng cụm "starts at ... sharp".

question_text: A man is talking to a shop assistant. What does the man buy in the shop?
options: Mugs
Candles
Clothes
explanation:
W: Welcome in! Shopping for yourself today, or a gift?
M: A birthday present for my brother — and I'm hopeless at this, help me.
W: That's my job! These ceramic mugs are popular — we can print his name on one.
M: He works from home with exactly one mug he loves. A second one would just gather dust.
W: Understood. Scented candles, then? The sandalwood set is lovely.
M: He has allergies — one whiff of perfume and he sneezes for a week. Hard no.
W: Then let's look at clothes. What's he like?
M: Outdoorsy, always cold, always in the same worn-out jumper...
W: Say no more — this wool jumper, and the flannel shirts are on offer too.
M: The navy jumper AND a shirt. Perfect — clothes it is, wrapped please!
W: Excellent choice. Brothers always need rescuing from their old jumpers!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Clothes (quần áo).
• Vì sao đúng: anh chốt mua "The navy jumper AND a shirt. Perfect — clothes it is, wrapped please!" sau khi nhân viên gợi ý "this wool jumper, and the flannel shirts are on offer too".
• Mugs sai: em trai đã có cốc ruột "He works from home with exactly one mug he loves. A second one would just gather dust".
• Candles sai: bị từ chối thẳng vì dị ứng "He has allergies — one whiff of perfume and he sneezes for a week. Hard no".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MUA GÌ trong hội thoại bán hàng, nhân viên sẽ chào 3 món. Chỉ tính món khách nói "I'll take/wrapped please"; mọi món bị "Hard no", "would just gather dust" là loại.

question_text: A woman is talking to her friend. Why does she choose to be a doctor?
options: To help people
To make her family proud
To make a lot of money
explanation:
M: So the rumours are true — you got into medical school! What flipped the switch?
W: You'll laugh, but everyone gets my reason wrong on the first guess.
M: Then I'll guess wrong immediately: your parents. They've dreamed of a doctor since you were born.
W: They HAVE — and I love them — but living someone else's dream burns out fast. That's not it.
M: The salary, then. Be honest, doctors do fine.
W: After a decade of loans and night shifts? There are faster roads to money, believe me. No — remember when Grandpa was in hospital last year? One young doctor sat with him — with US — every single evening, explaining everything.
M: I remember. Your whole family calmed down because of her.
W: Exactly. I want to BE that for someone. I chose medicine to help people — full stop.
M: Then medicine is lucky to have you.
W: Tell me that again during my first night shift!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To help people (để giúp đỡ mọi người).
• Vì sao đúng: người chọn ngành y kể về vị bác sĩ trẻ ngồi giải thích cho cả nhà mỗi tối khi ông nội nằm viện, rồi chốt "I want to BE that for someone. I chose medicine to help people — full stop".
• To make his family proud sai: bố mẹ có mơ ước đó nhưng bị bác bỏ "living someone else's dream burns out fast. That's not it".
• To make a lot of money sai: cũng bị loại "After a decade of loans and night shifts? There are faster roads to money, believe me".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi LÝ DO CHỌN NGHỀ, người bạn sẽ đoán 2 lý do phổ biến (gia đình, tiền) và đều bị phủ định. Đáp án thật đi kèm một câu chuyện cá nhân và cụm nhấn "full stop", "that's why".

question_text: What time do they meet?
explanation:
M: Tonight's dinner — what time should we meet at the restaurant?
W: Well, the table is booked for eight, so we could just meet then?
M: Eight is when we SIT, though. If we meet at eight we'll be flustered and hungry.
W: True. Seven, then? That gives us an hour to spare.
M: Seven I can't do — my train only gets in at ten past.
W: Hmm. So... what about half past six — wait, no, that's before your train. Six thirty won't work for YOU.
M: Actually it will! There's an earlier train at five forty — I'll just take that one. Six thirty at the little bar next door, drinks before dinner?
W: Perfect. Six thirty at the bar, eight at the table. It's a plan!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 6.30pm.
• Vì sao đúng: "Six thirty at the little bar next door, drinks before dinner?" — cô chốt "Six thirty at the bar, eight at the table".
• 8.00pm sai: đó là giờ ĐẶT BÀN chứ không phải giờ gặp nhau ("Eight is when we SIT, though").
• 7.00pm sai: tàu của anh 7 giờ 10 mới tới ("my train only gets in at ten past").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "What time do they MEET" khác giờ đặt bàn. Xác định đúng động từ trong câu hỏi rồi mới chọn mốc tương ứng.

question_text: Listen to a woman explaining her morning routine to her friend. Why do women get up early?
options: To go to work
To take care of their kids
To have some quiet time
explanation:
M: You're up at five thirty every day? Seriously? Why do you do that to yourself?
W: Everyone asks me that! They assume it's for work, but I don't start until nine — I could sleep till eight if I wanted.
M: The kids, then? Getting them ready for school?
W: They're teenagers now — they get themselves up, mostly by shouting at each other.
M: So what on earth gets you out of bed at half past five?
W: Peace and quiet! That hour is the only time the house is completely silent. I drink my coffee slowly, I read, I think. Nobody needs anything from me.
M: Huh. When you put it that way... maybe I should try it.
W: Start with six o'clock. Five thirty is for professionals!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – To have some quiet time.
• Vì sao đúng: "Peace and quiet! That hour is the only time the house is completely silent. I drink my coffee slowly, I read, I think. Nobody needs anything from me".
• To go to work sai: cô 9h mới bắt đầu làm, ngủ tới 8h vẫn kịp — "They assume it's for work, but I don't start until nine — I could sleep till eight if I wanted".
• To take care of their kids sai: các con đã là thiếu niên và tự dậy — "They're teenagers now — they get themselves up".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi lý do, người đối thoại thường đưa hai giả định sai trước ("They assume...", "The kids, then?"). Đáp án là câu trả lời sau "So what on earth...?".

question_text: When do they meet each other?
options: On Thursday morning
On Wednesday morning
On monday morning
explanation:
M: We really need to catch up properly — it's been months! When are you free this week?
W: Let me look... Monday morning I have the dentist, sadly. Root canal. Pray for me.
M: Ouch! Monday's out then. Wednesday morning? The café by the bridge does that breakfast you like.
W: Wednesday I'm driving my aunt to the airport at dawn — I'll be a zombie after.
M: Hmm. That leaves... what about Thursday morning? I'm free after nine.
W: Thursday morning is perfect! No dentist, no airport, nothing but coffee.
M: Thursday it is — nine thirty, café by the bridge, first round of pancakes on me.
W: You had me at pancakes. See you Thursday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On Thursday morning.
• Vì sao đúng: "Thursday morning is perfect!... Thursday it is — nine thirty, café by the bridge".
• On Wednesday morning sai: cô phải chở dì ra sân bay từ sáng sớm và sẽ đờ đẫn cả buổi.
• On Monday morning sai: cô có hẹn nha sĩ lấy tủy răng ("Monday morning I have the dentist, sadly").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hẹn lịch, loại dần từng ngày theo lý do bận; ngày đúng đi với "perfect" hoặc cấu trúc chốt "... it is".

question_text: A man is talking to his friend. Why does he choose to be a doctor?
options: To help people
To make his family proud
To make a lot of money
explanation:
W: So, Doctor Matthews! I still remember you in school saying you'd never touch medicine. What changed?
M: Everyone reminds me of that! And they all have theories about why I did it.
W: Your parents, surely. Your mum tells the whole town about her son the doctor.
M: She does, bless her — but making the family proud was never the reason. They'd be proud if I baked bread.
W: The money, then? Doctors don't exactly starve.
M: Ha! After ten years of training and student loans, trust me, there are easier ways to get rich. No — it was the summer I volunteered at the clinic. I watched a nurse calm a frightened old man, and I thought: I want to do THAT. I chose it to help people. Simple as it sounds.
W: That's the best answer you could give.
M: It's the only one I have!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To help people.
• Vì sao đúng: sau mùa hè tình nguyện ở phòng khám anh chốt "I chose it to help people. Simple as it sounds."
• To make his family proud sai: anh phủ nhận ("making the family proud was never the reason. They'd be proud if I baked bread").
• To make a lot of money sai: sau 10 năm học và nợ sinh viên thì có nhiều cách làm giàu dễ hơn ("there are easier ways to get rich").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "Why", nghe đủ 3 lý do rồi mới chốt; lý do do người kia đoán và bị bác bằng "never the reason" đều sai.

question_text: A man is talking to a shopping assistant. What color top is he going to buy?
options: Green
Blue
Black
explanation:
W: Welcome! Looking for something for yourself today?
M: Yes — a decent top, something I can wear to the office and after.
W: Then you're lucky: these green ones came in yesterday, and the colour is THE colour this season.
M: Mm, my colleague has that exact green. We'd look like a uniform. What else?
W: This blue is lovely — soft cotton, and it would suit you. Though... I only have small and extra large left.
M: And I'm neither, story of my life. That dark one on the end rail?
W: The black! Same fabric as the blue, every size, and it never goes out of style.
M: Sold. The black one, medium, please — and could you cut the tag off? I'll wear it out.
W: Of course! The fitting room is just behind you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Black.
• Vì sao đúng: "Sold. The black one, medium, please — and could you cut the tag off? I'll wear it out."
• Green sai: đồng nghiệp của anh đã có đúng màu đó, mặc vào trông như đồng phục ("We'd look like a uniform").
• Blue sai: đẹp nhưng chỉ còn cỡ S và XL, không có cỡ của anh ("I only have small and extra large left").
👉 Mẹo: mua sắm, mỗi màu bị loại vì một lý do riêng (trùng người khác, hết cỡ). Chỉ chốt khi nghe câu đặt hàng kèm cỡ.

question_text: Where are they going to meet?
options: at the park
at the station
at the university
explanation:
M: So, tomorrow's study session — where should we meet before heading in?
W: The station? It's easy for both our buses.
M: True, but it's chaos in the morning — we'd never find each other in that crowd.
W: The university steps, then? Right where the lecture is?
M: The problem is my bus gets in early and I'd just stand there for half an hour.
W: Okay, compromise: the park. It's between the station and the university, five minutes from each.
M: The park is perfect! The bench by the fountain — I'll bring coffees.
W: Nine o'clock at the park, then. If it rains, we run for the library!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – At the park.
• Vì sao đúng: "The park is perfect! The bench by the fountain — I'll bring coffees." và chốt "Nine o'clock at the park, then."
• At the station sai: buổi sáng quá đông, hai người sẽ không tìm được nhau ("we'd never find each other in that crowd").
• At the university sai: xe buýt của anh đến sớm, phải đứng chờ nửa tiếng.
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại hẹn địa điểm luôn chốt ở cuối. Nghe cụm "compromise" hoặc "... is perfect" rồi mới điền đáp án.

question_text: Listen to two friends talking about their plans for the holiday. What are they going to do on this holiday?
options: Going camping
Traveling abroad
Teaching
explanation:
W: Holiday brainstorm, right now! We have ten days and I refuse to waste them.
M: I vote camping — the forest lakes, a tent, total silence...
W: You said that last year, and then it rained for a week and you sulked in the tent. Remember?
M: ...We agreed never to mention that. Fine. Traveling abroad? Flights to Lisbon are cheap right now.
W: I checked yesterday — cheap until you add bags, hotels, and eating out. My savings said no.
M: So what's YOUR big idea then?
W: The language school by the lake — they need volunteers to teach English at their summer camp. Free room, free meals, afternoons off by the water.
M: Teaching kids... on a lake... for free? Actually, that sounds brilliant.
W: Doesn't it? I'll email them tonight — we're teaching this holiday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Teaching.
• Vì sao đúng: "they need volunteers to teach English at their summer camp" và cả hai chốt "I'll email them tonight — we're teaching this holiday!"
• Going camping sai: năm ngoái mưa cả tuần, cô nhắc lại để bác bỏ ("then it rained for a week and you sulked in the tent").
• Traveling abroad sai: vé rẻ nhưng cộng hành lý, khách sạn, ăn uống thì quá tốn ("My savings said no").
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại lên kế hoạch, ý nêu ĐẦU tiên gần như luôn bị bác; đáp án là ý cuối cùng cả hai đồng thuận.

question_text: The woman is discussing her new exercise routine. How much time does she spend cycling?
options: 45 minutes
35 minutes
60 minutes
explanation:
M: You look glowing lately — this new exercise routine is working! What does it involve?
W: A bit of everything, carefully timed — I'm quite proud of the schedule.
M: Give me the breakdown. I've heard you're at the gym for an hour?
W: Sixty minutes is the TOTAL session, yes, but that includes changing and chatting, so it doesn't count as one exercise!
M: Fine — the details, then. How's it split?
W: Forty-five minutes was my cycling target when I started... but honestly, my knees negotiated it down.
M: So what did the knees agree to?
W: Thirty-five minutes of cycling — that's my real number now, every session, plus stretching after. Thirty-five on the bike, and I feel fantastic.
M: Thirty-five minutes, three times a week? I'm officially inspired.
W: Join me Monday! The bikes next to mine are always free at seven am — I wonder why!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 35 minutes.
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "Thirty-five minutes of cycling — that's my real number now, every session, plus stretching after".
• 60 minutes sai: là tổng thời gian cả buổi tập, gồm cả thay đồ và tán gẫu "Sixty minutes is the TOTAL session, yes, but that includes changing and chatting, so it doesn't count as one exercise".
• 45 minutes sai: là mục tiêu ban đầu, đã giảm xuống "Forty-five minutes was my cycling target when I started... but honestly, my knees negotiated it down".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi THỜI LƯỢNG cho MỘT hoạt động, cảnh giác con số chỉ TỔNG buổi ("total session") và con số chỉ mục tiêu ban đầu ("target when I started"). Chỉ lấy số đi kèm chính hoạt động được hỏi.

question_text: Julie is asking her professor about the assignment. When is the work due?
options: On Thursday morning
On Friday morning
On Saturday morning
explanation:
W: Professor! Julie, from the Tuesday seminar — quick question about the essay deadline?
M: Ah, Julie. Good that you asked, because the portal is showing nonsense again.
W: Exactly! Half the class swears it's Thursday morning, and I nearly cancelled my weekend.
M: Thursday is when the topic consultations end — nothing is handed in on Thursday.
W: And Friday morning? That's what the portal says.
M: The portal shows last year's setting; the technicians keep promising to fix it. No — the work is due Saturday morning. Ten o'clock, printed AND uploaded.
W: Saturday morning at ten... so we DO have the extra days. The group chat will celebrate.
M: The group chat should spend those days writing. See you Tuesday, Julie!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – On Saturday morning (sáng thứ Bảy).
• Vì sao đúng: giáo sư khẳng định "the work is due Saturday morning. Ten o'clock, printed AND uploaded" — nộp cả bản in lẫn bản tải lên.
• On Thursday morning sai: thứ Năm chỉ là hạn tư vấn đề tài "Thursday is when the topic consultations end — nothing is handed in on Thursday".
• On Friday morning sai: đó là lỗi hiển thị của hệ thống "The portal shows last year's setting; the technicians keep promising to fix it".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HẠN NỘP trong hội thoại thầy–trò, luôn tin lời người có thẩm quyền (giáo sư) chứ không tin nguồn mà sinh viên nhắc (portal, group chat, bạn cùng lớp) — nguồn đó thường chính là bẫy.

question_text: Listen to a girl calling with her mother. Why did she call her mother to pick up at the airport?
options: Happy
Tired
Sick
explanation:
W2: Mum? Hi, it's me — I've just landed. Can you come and pick me up at the airport?
W1: Sweetheart! Of course, but... you sound strange. Aren't you happy to be home?
W2: I am happy, Mum, really. That's not it.
W1: Then you must be exhausted from the long flight. Twelve hours!
W2: I actually slept the whole way, so I'm not tired either. The thing is... I think I caught something on the plane. My head is burning, my throat hurts, and I've been shivering since we landed. I feel really sick, Mum.
W1: Oh, my poor girl! Stay right there by gate two — I'm leaving now, and I'm bringing you a warm coat and some medicine.
W2: Thank you, Mum. Please hurry.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Sick.
• Vì sao đúng: "My head is burning, my throat hurts, and I've been shivering since we landed. I feel really sick, Mum."
• Happy sai: cô có vui nhưng đó không phải lý do gọi ("I am happy, Mum, really. That's not it").
• Tired sai: cô ngủ suốt chuyến bay ("I actually slept the whole way, so I'm not tired either").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lý do/cảm giác, đếm chuỗi phủ định "That's not it", "I'm not ... either"; đáp án nằm sau "The thing is...".

question_text: A woman shares her job with her friend. Why does she want to become a writer?
options: Help people
Become famous
Earn money
explanation:
M: So I heard the big news — you're really leaving the bank to become a writer?
W: I am! I handed in my notice on Friday. Everyone thinks I've gone mad.
M: Well... a little. Is it the dream of seeing your name everywhere? Becoming famous?
W: Honestly, no — most writers stay completely unknown, and I'm fine with that.
M: It can't be the money either. Books pay terribly, don't they?
W: Terribly! I'll earn half of what I make now, at best. No — remember the letters I got after my article about my mother's illness? People wrote that it helped them through their own worst weeks. That's why. I want to write things that help people.
M: That... is actually a beautiful reason. I'll buy the first copy.
W: You'll get it free. Signed!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Help people.
• Vì sao đúng: sau khi kể về những lá thư độc giả gửi, cô chốt "That's why. I want to write things that help people."
• Become famous sai: cô bác bỏ ngay ("most writers stay completely unknown, and I'm fine with that").
• Earn money sai: thu nhập chỉ bằng một nửa hiện tại ("I'll earn half of what I make now, at best").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lý do trong hội thoại, người kia thường "mớm" 2 lý do sai trước; đáp án là lý do người trả lời tự đưa ra sau "No —".

question_text: A saleswoman is talking to a customer about a house. What is not original?
options: Floor
Furniture
Architecture
explanation:
W: ...and through here is the famous drawing room. Now, you asked earlier what's original — an excellent question for a house this age.
M: I did! This floor, for a start — it looks ancient.
W: It IS! Original oak from seventeen ninety, every board. Walk gently, you're walking on history.
M: Incredible. And the building itself — the walls, those ceilings?
W: All original architecture, even the curved staircase. The family never allowed structural changes, thank goodness.
M: So everything survived? That's rare.
W: Almost everything. I must be honest about the furniture: it's not original. The real pieces were auctioned in the fifties — what you see are fine reproductions, made from the estate photographs.
M: Ah, that's a shame — the desk fooled me completely.
W: It fools everyone! Beautiful work — but yes, the furniture is the one thing that isn't genuine.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Furniture (đồ nội thất).
• Vì sao đúng: người bán thừa nhận "I must be honest about the furniture: it's not original. The real pieces were auctioned in the fifties — what you see are fine reproductions".
• Floor sai: sàn là hàng nguyên bản "It IS! Original oak from seventeen ninety, every board".
• Architecture sai: kiến trúc cũng nguyên bản "All original architecture, even the curved staircase".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CÁI GÌ KHÔNG PHẢI (not original / not included), phải nghe ngược: hai thứ được khen "original", "genuine" là phương án loại. Đáp án đi kèm tín hiệu thú nhận "I must be honest...", "Almost everything, except...".

question_text: Two friends are talking about their trip. What will the weather be like?
options: Cold and wet
Hot and sunny
Mild and dry
explanation:
W: Three days until the trip! Have you checked the forecast? I'm hoping for hot and sunny.
M: I just looked... and you should sit down. Remember last year, when it was mild and dry the whole week?
W: Perfect walking weather, yes. Don't tell me...
M: This year is a different story. Cold and wet, all five days. Rain every single afternoon, and ten degrees at best.
W: Ten degrees! There goes my summer dress plan.
M: Pack the raincoat and the warm jumper instead. And proper boots.
W: Fine — but we're booking somewhere sunny next time. Agreed?
M: Agreed. Somewhere the umbrellas stay at home!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Cold and wet.
• Vì sao đúng: "This year is a different story. Cold and wet, all five days. Rain every single afternoon, and ten degrees at best".
• Hot and sunny sai: chỉ là điều cô mong, không phải dự báo — "Have you checked the forecast? I'm hoping for hot and sunny".
• Mild and dry sai: đó là thời tiết của chuyến đi NĂM NGOÁI — "Remember last year, when it was mild and dry the whole week?".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi dự báo thời tiết, loại ngay cụm gắn với "I'm hoping for" (mong muốn) và "last year" (quá khứ). Đáp án nằm sau "This year is a different story".

question_text: A teacher and a student are talking about transportation. How does the teacher go to school?
options: She drives
She takes the bus
She walks
explanation:
M: Miss? Can I ask you something not about homework? How do you get to school every morning?
W: Ha! Why, are you writing a report on me, Daniel?
M: We're doing a transport survey for geography! Everyone guesses you drive — you always look so punctual.
W: Punctual, yes — driver, no. I don't even own a car; parking here would eat my whole salary anyway.
M: The bus, then? The 42 stops right outside.
W: It does, and it's always so full of my own students that I'd be marking homework on the way! No — I walk. Every morning, thirty minutes along the river path.
M: You WALK? Even in winter?
W: Even in winter — good boots, warm coat. I arrive awake while everyone else is still yawning. Put that in your survey!
M: Walking teacher... you might be our most interesting data point, Miss!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – He walks (đi bộ).
• Vì sao đúng: cô giáo nói "No — I walk. Every morning, thirty minutes along the river path", và xác nhận đi bộ cả mùa đông "Even in winter — good boots, warm coat".
• He drives sai: cô còn không có ô tô "I don't even own a car; parking here would eat my whole salary anyway".
• He takes the bus sai: xe buýt 42 có dừng ngay trước cổng nhưng cô không đi "it's always so full of my own students that I'd be marking homework on the way".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐI LẠI BẰNG GÌ, học sinh/người hỏi thường đoán sai 2 lần trước. Chỉ tính câu trả lời của chính người được hỏi, đặc biệt sau "No — I...".

question_text: A woman is talking to the police. What did she lose?
options: A necklace
A bag
A wallet
explanation:
M: Next, please! Yes, madam — you look like you've had a rough afternoon.
W: Terrible, officer. Something went missing at the shopping centre and I need to report it.
M: We'll take it down. First guess from experience: your wallet? The sales bring out the pickpockets.
W: The wallet is safe — zipped in my inside pocket, I've checked five times.
M: Good. A necklace, then? We've had two chains reported this week.
W: No jewellery today, officer. It's my bag — the small grey one with the long strap. I hung it on the fitting-room hook, tried on a coat, walked out... and only remembered at the escalator. When I ran back, the hook was empty.
M: A grey bag with a long strap, fitting rooms, roughly what time?
W: Around three. My keys and my daughter's birthday money are inside. Please hurry, officer.
M: I'll ring centre security right now — fitting-room finds usually reach lost property within the hour. Take a seat, madam.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A bag (chiếc túi xách).
• Vì sao đúng: bà nói "It's my bag — the small grey one with the long strap. I hung it on the fitting-room hook... When I ran back, the hook was empty".
• A wallet sai: ví vẫn còn "The wallet is safe — zipped in my inside pocket, I've checked five times".
• A necklace sai: hôm đó bà không đeo trang sức "No jewellery today, officer".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MẤT GÌ khi trình báo công an, viên cảnh sát sẽ đoán trước theo kinh nghiệm và bị bác bỏ. Đáp án đi kèm mô tả chi tiết (màu, kích cỡ, quai) và tình huống mất cụ thể.

question_text: A woman is talking about her job. What encouraged her to become a scientist?
options: Her computer
Her mother
A large stone
explanation:
M: Doctor Reyes, my daughter wants to know: what makes a person become a scientist? Was it a computer? She thinks it's always computers.
W: Ha! Tell her computers came much later for me — we didn't even own one until I was at university.
M: Then your mother, perhaps? You mention her in every interview.
W: Mum was wonderful, but honestly, she wanted me to study law — she fainted a little when I chose geology!
M: So what was it?
W: A large stone! I was eight, on a beach holiday, and I found this huge grey stone with a perfect spiral shell pressed inside it. A fossil, millions of years old, in my little hands.
M: And that was the moment?
W: That was everything. I asked a thousand questions nobody could answer — so I spent my life finding the answers myself. That stone still sits on my desk!
M: My daughter will love this story. Maybe I should take her to the beach!
W: Do — and let her pick up every stone she likes!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – A large stone (một hòn đá lớn có hóa thạch).
• Vì sao đúng: nhà khoa học kể "A large stone! I was eight, on a beach holiday, and I found this huge grey stone with a perfect spiral shell pressed inside it" và khẳng định "That was everything".
• Her computer sai: máy tính đến rất muộn "computers came much later for me — we didn't even own one until I was at university".
• Her mother sai: mẹ còn muốn bà học luật "Mum was wonderful, but honestly, she wanted me to study law — she fainted a little when I chose geology!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ĐIỀU GÌ TRUYỀN CẢM HỨNG, người phỏng vấn sẽ đoán hai nguyên nhân "hợp lý" và đều bị bác. Đáp án là một kỷ niệm cụ thể có tuổi tác, địa điểm, chi tiết cảm giác.

question_text: A man is talking to the shopping assistant. What color top does he buy?
options: Red
Blue
Black
explanation:
W: Hello there! Hunting for anything special?
M: A new top — my sister's graduation is Saturday and apparently my wardrobe is 'a disgrace', her words.
W: Sisters keep us honest! This red one is bold — very celebratory?
M: Bold is the word... I'd outshine the graduate, and she'd never forgive me. Safer options?
W: The blue, then — calm, classic. Although I should check the sizes... yes, sadly only extra small left in blue.
M: Definitely not my size! And that one, the dark one on the mannequin?
W: The black — our bestseller. Every size, and it works for graduations, dinners, everything really.
M: Perfect. The black one in large, please — and if my sister disapproves, I'm sending her here.
W: Deal! She'll approve — black never fails. That's twenty-two fifty, please.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Black (màu đen).
• Vì sao đúng: anh chốt "The black one in large, please" sau khi nhân viên giới thiệu "The black — our bestseller. Every size, and it works for graduations".
• Red sai: quá nổi bật trong lễ tốt nghiệp của em gái "I'd outshine the graduate, and she'd never forgive me".
• Blue sai: hết size vừa "sadly only extra small left in blue" — anh đáp "Definitely not my size!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MÀU/MÓN ĐÃ MUA, phương án nhiễu bị loại vì hai lý do kinh điển: không hợp hoàn cảnh hoặc hết size. Chỉ tính màu đi kèm câu đặt hàng có size ("the black one in large, please").

question_text: Lucy is calling her brother. What does the brother have to drink?
options: Tea
Water
Coffee
explanation:
W: Hi, it's Lucy! I'm coming over in ten minutes with the cake. What have you got to drink at yours?
M: Er... let me check the kitchen. Right. So. The tea situation: Mum used the last bags on her book club yesterday.
W: Of course she did. Coffee, then? Cake needs coffee.
M: The jar is... empty. I forgot to buy more, don't shout at me.
W: Brother of the year! So what CAN you offer your favourite sister?
M: Water! Lovely, cold water from the fridge. I have LOTS of water.
W: Water with birthday cake. Wonderful. I'm buying tea on the way, put the kettle on!
M: Knew you would. See you in ten!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Water.
• Vì sao đúng: "Water! Lovely, cold water from the fridge. I have LOTS of water." — đó là thứ duy nhất anh trai còn.
• Tea sai: mẹ đã dùng hết túi trà cuối cùng cho câu lạc bộ sách ("Mum used the last bags on her book club yesterday").
• Coffee sai: hũ cà phê rỗng vì cậu quên mua ("The jar is... empty. I forgot to buy more").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "có gì để uống/ăn", săn các cụm báo HẾT: "used the last", "empty", "run out"; thứ duy nhất còn lại chính là đáp án.

question_text: Listen to a girl calling the cafe. What did she forget, and where did she leave it?
options: on the counter
in the corner
near the door
explanation:
M: Riverside Café, good afternoon!
W: Hi! I was there about an hour ago — table by the big plant — and I think I left my scarf. The blue woolly one?
M: A blue scarf... let me have a look around. On the counter I only see somebody's glasses, I'm afraid.
W: No, not the counter, I never went up there — my friend ordered for us.
M: What about near the door? There's a coat stand — people forget things on it every day.
W: I didn't use the stand... wait, I remember now! We were at the corner table — I hung it on the chair. Could you check in the corner?
M: The corner by the window... one moment... yes! Blue scarf, still on the chair, safe and sound.
W: Wonderful! I'll come by before you close. Guard it with your life!
M: It'll be behind the till with your name on it. See you soon!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – In the corner.
• Vì sao đúng: "We were at the corner table — I hung it on the chair" và nhân viên xác nhận "The corner by the window... yes! Blue scarf, still on the chair".
• On the counter sai: trên quầy chỉ có cặp kính của người khác, và cô chưa từng lên quầy ("I never went up there — my friend ordered for us").
• Near the door sai: cô không dùng giá treo áo cạnh cửa ("I didn't use the stand").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi vị trí đồ bỏ quên, đáp án thường xuất hiện muộn, ngay sau khi người nói chợt nhớ ra ("wait, I remember now!").

question_text: A man and woman are discussing their plans for the evening. What do the man and woman decide to do in the evening?
options: Go to the movies
Make plans later
Stay at home
explanation:
M: So — tonight. Any ideas? There's that new film at the cinema, the one everyone's talking about.
W: I checked already: sold out until the weekend. Every single seat.
M: Ah. Then we could just stay at home? Order food, watch something on the sofa?
W: We've done that three nights in a row! I can't look at that sofa any more.
M: Fair point. So no cinema, no sofa... what's left?
W: Honestly? Let's not decide right now. I finish work at five — let's just see how we feel and make plans then.
M: You know what, that's the best idea. No pressure, no booking.
W: Exactly. I'll call you at five!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Make plans later.
• Vì sao đúng: "Let's not decide right now. I finish work at five — let's just see how we feel and make plans then" — anh đồng ý "that's the best idea. No pressure, no booking".
• Go to the movies sai: phim đã hết vé tới cuối tuần — "I checked already: sold out until the weekend. Every single seat".
• Stay at home sai: bị loại vì đã ở nhà ba tối liên tiếp — "We've done that three nights in a row! I can't look at that sofa any more".
👉 Mẹo: đôi khi đáp án là "chưa quyết" chứ không phải một hoạt động cụ thể. Nếu cả hai phương án cụ thể đều bị loại, nghe kỹ câu chốt kiểu "let's decide later".

question_text: A woman is discussing with her team. How many chairs does she need?
explanation:
W: Right, team — the workshop on Saturday. Let's talk chairs.
M: The big list says twenty-five people registered, so twenty-five chairs?
W: That was Monday's number. Five people cancelled yesterday — the ones from the north office, their train line is closed.
M: Ah, so we're down to twenty. Should we just set out fifteen? People always drop out on the day.
W: Too risky — last time we did that, three people stood for an hour and complained for a week.
M: Fair. So the final number is...?
W: Twenty. Twenty chairs, in four rows of five, facing the screen. I need them set up by nine.
M: Twenty chairs by nine. Consider it done, boss!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 20.
• Vì sao đúng: "So the final number is...? Twenty. Twenty chairs, in four rows of five, facing the screen."
• 25 sai: là số đăng ký hôm thứ Hai, sau đó 5 người ở văn phòng phía bắc hủy ("Five people cancelled yesterday").
• 15 sai: là đề xuất bị bác vì lần trước thiếu ghế ("Too risky — last time we did that, three people stood for an hour").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi số lượng luôn có phép cộng/trừ. Nghe "cancelled", "dropped out" để tính lại, rồi bám cụm "the final number is".

question_text: A woman is talking to the police. What did she lose?
options: A necklace
A bag
A wallet
explanation:
M: Good afternoon, madam. Take a seat — what can we help you with?
W: Thank you, officer. I've lost something on the bus this morning and I'm quite shaken.
M: Let's get the details. A wallet? We've had three handed in today.
W: No — my wallet was in my coat pocket the whole time, thank goodness, cards and all.
M: Good. A necklace, then? Chains snap on crowded buses more often than you'd think.
W: Not that either — I don't wear jewellery on workdays. It's my bag, officer. The brown leather handbag — I set it on the seat beside me, the bus braked hard, and in the confusion I stepped off without it.
M: A brown leather handbag, the number seven route... let me ring the depot; drivers check the seats at the terminus.
W: Please do — my diary and my glasses are in there. My whole week is in that bag!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A bag.
• Vì sao đúng: "It's my bag, officer. The brown leather handbag — I set it on the seat beside me" rồi xuống xe mà quên.
• A necklace sai: cô không đeo trang sức vào ngày đi làm ("I don't wear jewellery on workdays").
• A wallet sai: ví vẫn nằm trong túi áo khoác suốt hành trình ("my wallet was in my coat pocket the whole time").
👉 Mẹo: dạng khai báo mất đồ, cảnh sát sẽ đoán sai vài món trước; chỉ nhận món đi kèm khẳng định của người mất "It's my...".

question_text: A man is talking to his friend. Why does he need to learn to drive?
options: To go on a road trip
To take his family on vacations
He has to drive to work
explanation:
W: I heard you signed up for driving lessons at last! Planning a big road trip?
M: Ha! No, a road trip would be nice, but that's not the reason. I get car sick on long drives anyway.
W: Then it's for the family holidays, surely — driving everyone to the seaside in summer?
M: Also no — we always take the train for holidays, the kids love it.
W: So why now, after all these years?
M: The company is moving to the industrial park next month. There's no bus route out there at all, so I simply have to drive to work. No choice.
W: Ah, that explains it. Well, good luck with the parking test!
M: Don't remind me. I start on Monday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – He has to drive to work.
• Vì sao đúng: "The company is moving to the industrial park next month. There's no bus route out there at all, so I simply have to drive to work. No choice".
• To go on a road trip sai: anh bác bỏ và còn bị say xe đường dài — "a road trip would be nice, but that's not the reason. I get car sick on long drives anyway".
• To take his family on vacations sai: cả nhà luôn đi tàu — "Also no — we always take the train for holidays, the kids love it".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi lý do, đếm số lần người trả lời nói "No". Lý do thật đi kèm ràng buộc bắt buộc: "have to", "no choice", "there's no bus route".

question_text: A mom is talking to her son. What does the son like to study?
options: Art
Math
Science
explanation:
W: Sweetheart, we need to talk about your subjects for next year. Your dad thinks you should focus on math.
M: Mum, we both know I count on my fingers. Math and I are not friends.
W: Science, then? Uncle Pete could help you — he loves his laboratory.
M: The experiments are okay... but honestly, I only enjoy drawing the diagrams, not doing the science.
W: Wait — drawing the diagrams? Is that a hint?
M: It's more than a hint, Mum. What I really like to study is art. It's the only class where three hours feel like ten minutes. My teacher says my portfolio is the best in the year.
W: She actually told me the same at the parents' evening. Alright, my artist — art it is. Your dad will survive.
M: Thanks, Mum! First portrait is of you, I promise.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Art.
• Vì sao đúng: "What I really like to study is art. It's the only class where three hours feel like ten minutes."
• Math sai: bố gợi ý nhưng cậu thừa nhận rất kém ("we both know I count on my fingers").
• Science sai: cậu chỉ thích phần vẽ sơ đồ chứ không thích làm khoa học ("I only enjoy drawing the diagrams, not doing the science").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi môn yêu thích, ý kiến của bố mẹ hay chú bác luôn là nhiễu; chọn môn đứng sau "What I really like to study is".

question_text: Two friends are talking about their favorite activities. What is the woman's favorite form of entertainment?
options: Reading books
Going to the theatre
Playing chess with her cousin
explanation:
M: Long week done! What's your perfect way to switch off?
W: Guess! You've known me two years now.
M: Books. You always have one in your bag — I'd bet on reading.
W: Good guess, but the book in my bag is mostly for the bus, honestly. It's not the thing I LOVE.
M: Then... chess with that cousin of yours? You mentioned your matches once.
W: Ha! Those ended years ago — she moved to Canada and she cheats online anyway. No — my real love is the theatre. I go almost every week: plays, musicals, even the tiny student productions above the pub.
M: Every week? That's dedication!
W: It's the live-ness of it — anything can happen, and you're breathing the same air as the story. Come with me on Friday, there's a comedy on!
M: You know what? Deal. My first play since school!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Going to the theatre (đi xem kịch).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "my real love is the theatre. I go almost every week: plays, musicals, even the tiny student productions" — và giải thích lý do thích: "It's the live-ness of it".
• Reading books sai: sách chỉ để giết thời gian trên xe buýt "the book in my bag is mostly for the bus, honestly. It's not the thing I LOVE".
• Playing chess with her cousin sai: đã dừng từ lâu "Those ended years ago — she moved to Canada".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi SỞ THÍCH, người đàn ông đoán sai 1-2 lần rồi cô gái mới nói thật. Bắt cụm sở hữu mạnh "my real love is...", "the thing I love is..." và loại các hoạt động gắn với quá khứ ("ended years ago") hay lý do phụ ("mostly for the bus").

question_text: Listen to a girl calling with her mother. Why did she call her mother to pick up at the airport?
options: Happy
Tired
Sick
explanation:
W2: Mum, hi — the plane just landed. Could you come get me? Please?
W1: Darling, welcome back! You don't sound like someone back from holiday. Wasn't it wonderful?
W2: It was, Mum, the trip was perfect — I'm not sad, I promise.
W1: Jet lag, then? You must be shattered after that overnight flight.
W2: Weirdly, no — I slept like a rock the whole way, both seats to myself. It's something else... my throat started burning over the ocean, and now I'm all shivery and my head is pounding. I think I'm properly sick.
W1: Oh, sweetheart. Right — arrivals hall, the bench by the flower shop, don't move. I'm bringing paracetamol and your big scarf.
W2: You're the best. Hurry, Mum.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Sick.
• Vì sao đúng: "my throat started burning over the ocean, and now I'm all shivery and my head is pounding. I think I'm properly sick."
• Happy sai: chuyến đi rất vui nhưng đó không phải lý do gọi ("the trip was perfect — I'm not sad, I promise").
• Tired sai: cô ngủ rất ngon suốt chuyến bay ("Weirdly, no — I slept like a rock the whole way").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lý do, người mẹ sẽ đoán sai 2 lần trước; đáp án nằm sau "It's something else...".

question_text: Anna is calling her friend. Where will they meet?
options: At the marketplace
At the mall
At the park
explanation:
W: Hey, it's Anna! Are we still on for Saturday morning?
M: Absolutely! Just tell me where — last time we had three plans at once.
W: Right, let's fix it properly. NOT the mall — it's the first Saturday of the sales, we'd be trampled.
M: Agreed, I value my life. The park? The weather app promises sunshine.
W: The same app promised sunshine at the lake festival, remember? We swam home.
M: Never again. So...?
W: The marketplace! The farmers' stalls are back this week — fresh bread, the cheese man, the flower lady. We'll meet at the marketplace, by the fountain, ten o'clock.
M: Marketplace, fountain, ten. And breakfast at the bread stall is on me!
W: That's why we're friends. See you Saturday!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – At the marketplace (ở khu chợ).
• Vì sao đúng: Anna chốt "The marketplace!... We'll meet at the marketplace, by the fountain, ten o'clock" và bạn cô nhắc lại "Marketplace, fountain, ten".
• At the mall sai: bị loại ngay từ đầu "NOT the mall — it's the first Saturday of the sales, we'd be trampled".
• At the park sai: bị loại vì không tin dự báo thời tiết "The same app promised sunshine at the lake festival, remember? We swam home".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GẶP Ở ĐÂU, đáp án thường được nhắc lại hai lần (một người nói, một người xác nhận). Nghe kỹ câu nhắc lại kèm mốc phụ (đài phun nước, 10 giờ) để chốt.

question_text: Which door do they need to take to get to Edinburgh?
options: Two
Three
Four
explanation:
W: Right, coach station chaos as usual. Which door for Edinburgh, can you see?
M: Give me a second... the big screen shows Edinburgh but the gate number keeps flickering.
W: The man over there is waving people to door four — should we follow?
M: No, wait — door four is boarding for Manchester, I can see the sign on the coach itself.
W: Then three? The queue at three is enormous, that must mean something.
M: That's the London queue — it's always enormous. Look, it's settled: door two. The screen just fixed itself — Edinburgh, half past ten, door two.
W: Door two! Come on, before the queue discovers it too.
M: Right behind you — grab the window seats!
