--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Two.
• Vì sao đúng: "it's settled: door two. The screen just fixed itself — Edinburgh, half past ten, door two."
• Three sai: đó là hàng chờ đi London ("That's the London queue — it's always enormous").
• Four sai: cửa đó đang cho lên xe đi Manchester ("door four is boarding for Manchester").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi cửa/sân ga, ghim từng số với từng điểm đến; thông tin từ đám đông hay người vẫy tay thường sai — bám "it's settled".

question_text: Listen to the conversation between Douglas and Kay. Why does Douglas call Kay?
options: ask for a favor
suggest a meeting
say thank you
explanation:
W: Hello? Douglas! This is unexpected — everything alright?
M: Everything's wonderful, Kay — and this call is overdue, actually.
W: Uh oh. Let me guess: your printer died again and you need mine?
M: Ha! No favours today, I promise — the printer is alive and well.
W: Then you want to set up one of your famous project meetings?
M: Not that either — no agendas, no calendars. Kay, I'm calling to say thank you. Properly, out loud.
W: Thank me? Whatever for?
M: The recommendation letter you wrote — I got the position! They told me yesterday your letter is what tipped the scales. You changed my whole year with one page, Kay.
W: Douglas, that's WONDERFUL news! But your work did the real talking.
M: We'll argue about that over dinner — my treat, Friday, no refusals. It's the least a grateful man can do!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – say thank you (để nói lời cảm ơn).
• Vì sao đúng: Douglas nói rõ "Kay, I'm calling to say thank you. Properly, out loud" — cảm ơn lá thư giới thiệu đã giúp anh trúng tuyển "The recommendation letter you wrote — I got the position!".
• ask for a favor sai: bị phủ định "No favours today, I promise — the printer is alive and well".
• suggest a meeting sai: cũng bị phủ định "Not that either — no agendas, no calendars".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MỤC ĐÍCH CUỘC GỌI, người nghe sẽ đoán sai 2 lần và bị bác bỏ liên tiếp. Đáp án nằm ở cấu trúc "I'm calling to + V" — nghe kỹ ngay sau hai lần "No".

question_text: What color top is he going to buy?
options: Green
Red
Black
explanation:
W: Good afternoon! Can I help you find something?
M: Yes — I need a new top for the weekend. Something simple but sharp.
W: This green one is very popular right now — fresh colour, twenty percent off this week.
M: Green's not really me, to be honest. My girlfriend says it clashes with everything I own.
W: Understood! What about red, then? This one is pure cotton, lovely quality.
M: Red is a bit... loud for me. I'd feel like a traffic light. What's that darker one behind you?
W: Ah, the black one — same cut as the red, and we have every size in stock.
M: Perfect. Black goes with everything. I'll take the black one in a medium, please.
W: Great choice! That's eighteen pounds at the till.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Black.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'll take the black one in a medium, please."
• Green sai: anh không hợp màu xanh lá ("Green's not really me... it clashes with everything I own").
• Red sai: quá chói với anh ("Red is a bit... loud for me. I'd feel like a traffic light").
👉 Mẹo: mua sắm hỏi màu/cỡ, chỉ chốt khi nghe "I'll take..."; khuyến mãi hay lời khen của nhân viên chỉ là nhiễu.

question_text: Listen to a conversation. What is the woman's most important task for the upcoming conference?
options: Organizing an informal event
Sending out invitations
Giving a formal address
explanation:
M: The conference is only two weeks away! How's your list looking?
W: Long! But let's sort out what matters most.
M: Well, there's the welcome dinner on the first evening — you're organizing that, aren't you?
W: The informal dinner, yes, but honestly the restaurant does most of that work — I just confirm the numbers.
M: And the invitations to the guest speakers?
W: Already sent, weeks ago — all confirmed except one professor. No, my biggest task is something else entirely: the opening day speech. I'm giving the formal address to the whole conference — four hundred people, all the sponsors, the cameras...
M: THE main speech? That's huge!
W: Exactly why I practise every evening. If that goes well, the whole event goes well.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Giving a formal address.
• Vì sao đúng: "my biggest task is something else entirely: the opening day speech. I'm giving the formal address to the whole conference — four hundred people".
• Organizing an informal event sai: tiệc tối chào mừng do nhà hàng lo phần lớn, cô chỉ chốt số lượng ("the restaurant does most of that work").
• Sending out invitations sai: đã gửi từ nhiều tuần trước và gần như đủ xác nhận ("Already sent, weeks ago").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi việc QUAN TRỌNG NHẤT thì bỏ việc đã xong và việc nhẹ; bám so sánh nhất "my biggest task is".

question_text: What will they bring to the picnic?
options: Drinks
Food
Snacks
explanation:
W: The neighbourhood picnic is Sunday! Did you see the list of what's left for us?
M: Just looked. I was praying for drinks — drinks is just carrying bottles.
W: Dream on — the Novak twins grabbed drinks within five minutes of the list going up.
M: Of course they did. Snacks, then? Crisps and those little biscuits?
W: Mrs. Lee took snacks AND salads — she's treating it as a competition, as always.
M: So that leaves us with...
W: The food! The main course for twenty people — sausages, burgers, bread, the lot.
M: The biggest job on the whole list. Naturally.
W: But we have the biggest grill! You shop Saturday morning, I marinate Saturday night.
M: Deal. By Sunday evening we'll be neighbourhood legends — again!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Food.
• Vì sao đúng: "The food! The main course for twenty people — sausages, burgers, bread, the lot."
• Drinks sai: cặp sinh đôi nhà Novak đã nhận ngay khi danh sách vừa dán ("The Novak twins grabbed drinks within five minutes").
• Snacks sai: bà Lee đã lấy cả snacks lẫn salad ("Mrs. Lee took snacks AND salads").
👉 Mẹo: dạng chia phần việc, gạch tên người đã nhận từng món; phần còn lại sau "So that leaves us with..." chính là đáp án.

question_text: How many weeks did they spend in India?
options: Three weeks
Two weeks
One week
explanation:
W: You two are finally back from India! It felt like you were gone a whole month.
M: Everyone says a month! Our photos do make it look that way.
W: So it wasn't? Your sister told me three weeks.
M: She's wrong too — she never listens. We originally planned just one week, you know, a quick city trip.
W: One week for India? Impossible.
M: Exactly what we realised! So before flying we changed the tickets, and in the end we spent two weeks there. Two full weeks — north the first, south the second.
W: Two weeks... and was it enough?
M: Not even close. Next time, we're doing the full month everyone already believes in!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Two weeks.
• Vì sao đúng: "in the end we spent two weeks there. Two full weeks — north the first, south the second."
• Three weeks sai: là lời chị gái nói lại và bị bác ngay ("She's wrong too — she never listens").
• One week sai: chỉ là kế hoạch BAN ĐẦU, họ đã đổi vé trước khi bay ("We originally planned just one week").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi thời lượng thực tế, bỏ số gắn với "planned", "someone told me"; chọn số đi với "in the end / actually".

question_text: When did they decide to meet?
options: 7am on Friday
9am on Sunday
9am on Saturday
explanation:
M: We still haven't fixed a time for the pottery class visit! This week, yes?
W: Yes! I looked at the schedule. There's an early slot — Friday at seven in the morning.
M: Seven am?! Before work? I'd be shaping clay with my eyes closed.
W: Ha! Fine. They also run Saturday at nine.
M: Saturday's no good — it's my nephew's football final, I promised to be there with the banner.
W: You and that banner! Okay, last option: Sunday at nine.
M: Sunday at nine is actually perfect. Coffee at eight thirty first, next door?
W: Deal — Sunday, nine o'clock, and don't you dare cancel!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 9am on Sunday.
• Vì sao đúng: "Sunday at nine is actually perfect" và chốt "Deal — Sunday, nine o'clock, and don't you dare cancel!"
• 7am on Friday sai: quá sớm, trước giờ làm ("Seven am?! Before work? I'd be shaping clay with my eyes closed").
• 9am on Saturday sai: vướng trận chung kết bóng đá của cháu trai.
👉 Mẹo: phương án ghép GIỜ + NGÀY thì phải khớp cả hai. Đừng chọn vội khi nghe "nine" vì bài có tới hai mốc 9 giờ ở hai ngày khác nhau.

question_text: Two friends are talking with each other. What did they both buy?
options: Clothes
Shoes
Books
explanation:
W: You went to the big sale too? Show me what you got!
M: I couldn't resist. I went in for books, actually — but the queue at the bookshop was out the door.
W: Same with the shoes for me! Nothing left in my size but bright orange trainers.
M: So in the end I went to the clothes floor — two jumpers and a winter coat, half price.
W: No way — I bought clothes as well! Three shirts and a jacket. Great minds think alike.
M: So we both came home with clothes. The bags gave us away, I suppose.
W: The sale is on until Sunday, you know. Round two for the books?
M: Tempting. Very tempting.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Clothes.
• Vì sao đúng: anh mua "two jumpers and a winter coat, half price", cô mua "Three shirts and a jacket", và họ tổng kết "So we both came home with clothes".
• Books sai: anh định mua sách nhưng hàng người xếp dài ra tận cửa — "I went in for books, actually — but the queue at the bookshop was out the door".
• Shoes sai: cô không mua được vì hết size — "Nothing left in my size but bright orange trainers".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "What did they BOTH buy?" là hỏi điểm CHUNG. Đừng chốt sau lượt nói đầu tiên — nghe hết cả hai người rồi bắt câu tổng kết "we both...".

question_text: A man is seeking advice on future career. What is he going to do?
options: To work in business
To become a teacher
To study at college
explanation:
M: Thanks for making time — I need your honest advice about my next step. Everyone has an opinion and I'm drowning.
W: That's what mentors are for! Tell me the options on your table.
M: Teaching, first. My mother's dream for me, and I did enjoy tutoring...
W: But?
M: But two weeks of classroom practice showed me the patience required — and mine ran out by Wednesday morning.
W: Honest, good. And more studying? College?
M: I looked at it, truly — but four more years of lectures and loans, at my age? My savings said absolutely not.
W: So that leaves the thing your eyes light up about...
M: Business. I'm going to work in business — the trading firm offered me a junior position, and every cell in me says yes.
W: Then trust that. You've thought it through better than you realise.
M: Signing the contract Monday. Thank you — I just needed to hear myself say it!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – To work in business (đi làm trong ngành kinh doanh).
• Vì sao đúng: anh khẳng định "Business. I'm going to work in business — the trading firm offered me a junior position, and every cell in me says yes", và "Signing the contract Monday".
• To become a teacher sai: anh tự thấy không đủ kiên nhẫn "two weeks of classroom practice showed me the patience required — and mine ran out by Wednesday morning".
• To study at college sai: loại vì tiền và tuổi "four more years of lectures and loans, at my age? My savings said absolutely not".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HƯỚNG NGHỀ NGHIỆP, mỗi phương án sai đều kèm một chữ "But". Đáp án là lựa chọn duy nhất KHÔNG bị phản bác và có hành động cụ thể (được mời làm, ký hợp đồng).

question_text: Tom is talking with his friend about his teachers. What is his favourite teacher?
options: Miss Taylor
Mr. Styles
Miss Brown
explanation:
W: So how's the new school year, Tom? Any good teachers this time?
M: Mixed bag, honestly. Everyone loves Miss Taylor, the music teacher.
W: But not you?
M: She's nice, but singing isn't my thing — I just mime at the back. And then there's Mr. Styles for sport.
W: You love sport! Surely he's your favourite?
M: He makes us run in the rain! In JANUARY! No — my favourite is Miss Brown, the science teacher.
W: Science? You? Since when?
M: Since her! She does actual experiments — last week we made a tiny volcano, and she let ME light it. She makes you feel clever instead of stupid when you ask questions.
W: A teacher like that is worth gold. Invite her to teach maths too!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Miss Brown.
• Vì sao đúng: "my favourite is Miss Brown, the science teacher" — cô cho làm thí nghiệm thật và khiến học sinh thấy mình thông minh.
• Miss Taylor sai: cả trường thích cô giáo nhạc nhưng Tom không hợp ("singing isn't my thing — I just mime at the back").
• Mr. Styles sai: thầy bắt chạy dưới mưa giữa tháng Một ("He makes us run in the rain! In JANUARY!").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi người yêu thích, ghim từng tên với từng môn ngay khi nghe; đáp án đứng sau "my favourite is".

question_text: Tom is talking with his friend about his teachers. What is his favourite teacher?
options: Miss Taylor
Mr. Styles
Miss Brown
explanation:
W: Tom! How's the new term? Your mum says you actually LIKE school now — I demand an explanation.
M: Ha! It's true, and it's entirely one teacher's fault.
W: Let me guess — Miss Taylor? Everyone adores her music lessons.
M: Everyone except me — she made me sing a solo once and I still hear the laughter in my dreams.
W: Poor thing! Mr. Styles, then? You live in your football boots.
M: On the PITCH, yes — but his lessons are just running laps in the rain while he shouts encouragement from under an umbrella.
W: So who's the miracle worker?
M: Miss Brown, science! Last week we grew crystals, the week before we built a battery from lemons. She answers every question like it's the best question ever asked.
W: A lemon battery! Now I want to join her class.
M: Get in line — half the school suddenly loves science. Miss Brown is the reason I do my homework FIRST now.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Miss Brown (cô Brown dạy Khoa học).
• Vì sao đúng: Tom nói "Miss Brown, science! Last week we grew crystals, the week before we built a battery from lemons" và "Miss Brown is the reason I do my homework FIRST now".
• Miss Taylor sai: gắn với kỷ niệm xấu hổ "she made me sing a solo once and I still hear the laughter in my dreams".
• Mr. Styles sai: Tom mê bóng đá nhưng chê tiết học "his lessons are just running laps in the rain while he shouts encouragement from under an umbrella".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIÁO VIÊN YÊU THÍCH, đừng chọn theo môn mà học sinh thích ngoài đời (bóng đá). Chọn giáo viên được kể kèm ví dụ tiết học cụ thể và câu khen trực tiếp.

question_text: Listen to the conversation about the directions. Where is the library located?
options: On the left of the square
In front of the square
Behind the square
explanation:
M: Excuse me — I'm completely lost. Could you point me to the public library?
W: Of course! You're actually very close. You know the main square, with the fountain?
M: I just came from there — I walked all around it and saw no library!
W: Everyone does that! People expect it in front of the square, where the big white building is — but that's the courthouse.
M: Ah! And I did wander behind the square too, past the church...
W: That's just the old school back there. No — face the fountain, then look to your left. The library is on the left of the square — the red brick building with the round windows and the book statue outside.
M: On the LEFT! The red one — I must have looked straight past it twice.
W: Happens every day. Tell them Marta sent you — my sister works at the front desk!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – On the left of the square (bên trái quảng trường).
• Vì sao đúng: người phụ nữ chỉ đường "face the fountain, then look to your left. The library is on the left of the square — the red brick building with the round windows and the book statue outside".
• In front of the square sai: tòa nhà trắng phía trước là tòa án "People expect it in front of the square, where the big white building is — but that's the courthouse".
• Behind the square sai: phía sau chỉ là trường học cũ "That's just the old school back there".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi CHỈ ĐƯỜNG, mỗi vị trí sai đều được gán cho một tòa nhà khác (courthouse, old school). Ghi nhanh cặp "vị trí – tòa nhà" và chọn vị trí gắn với đúng tên nơi cần tìm.

question_text: Adam is calling his friend. When will he need the computer?
options: Friday
Thursday
Tuesday
explanation:
M: Hey, it's Adam! Big favour to ask — could I borrow your computer this week?
W: Probably! Mine's free most days. When exactly do you need it?
M: So, my presentation for the club was supposed to be Tuesday...
W: Was? What happened?
M: The hall is being painted, so Tuesday is cancelled. Then they offered Thursday, but the chairman can't make Thursday.
W: This club of yours is chaos. So when is it actually happening?
M: Friday! Confirmed this morning, seven o'clock. So I'd need the computer on Friday — I'll pick it up after lunch and return it the same night.
W: Friday works. It'll be charged and ready for you.
M: You're a lifesaver. Pizza's on me next week!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Friday.
• Vì sao đúng: "Friday! Confirmed this morning, seven o'clock. So I'd need the computer on Friday".
• Thursday sai: có được đề nghị nhưng chủ nhiệm câu lạc bộ bận ("the chairman can't make Thursday").
• Tuesday sai: buổi ban đầu bị hủy vì hội trường đang sơn ("The hall is being painted, so Tuesday is cancelled").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ngày, săn từ khóa xác nhận "Confirmed", "It's settled"; ngày đi với "cancelled" hay "can't make" luôn bị loại.

question_text: Two colleagues talk about meeting. When do they want to meet?
options: Monday
Wednesday
Tuesday
explanation:
M: We need to schedule the planning meeting this week. Any preferences?
W: Not Monday, please. Mondays are chaos — my inbox alone takes until lunch.
M: Agreed, Monday is survival day. I'd say Wednesday, but the director booked the meeting room all day for interviews.
W: The whole day? With the good chairs and everything?
M: The whole day. So that leaves Tuesday. Morning or afternoon?
W: Tuesday afternoon, two o'clock? Reports done, coffee had, brains working.
M: Tuesday at two works perfectly. I'll book the small room and send the invites.
W: Done deal. And Tuesday means we'll actually be prepared for once!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Tuesday.
• Vì sao đúng: "So that leaves Tuesday... Tuesday at two works perfectly. I'll book the small room and send the invites."
• Monday sai: đầu tuần quá bận, riêng hộp thư đã ngốn cả buổi sáng ("Mondays are chaos").
• Wednesday sai: giám đốc đã đặt phòng họp nguyên ngày để phỏng vấn.
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại chọn lịch thường loại 2 ngày rồi mới chốt; nghe "So that leaves..." là biết câu ngay sau chứa đáp án.

question_text: What elements of the film do they agree on?
options: the soundtrack
the characters
the ending
explanation:
M: So — the film last night! Where do we even start?
W: The soundtrack, obviously. That piano theme was gorgeous, it carried every scene.
M: See, I barely noticed the music — for me it was all about the characters. The old captain? Best character in years.
W: Really? I found him overacted, honestly. And the sister was so flat.
M: We clearly watched different films! Is there ANYTHING we agree on?
W: Hmm... what about the ending? That last scene on the bridge, with no dialogue at all...
M: Okay, YES. The ending was perfect. I actually sat in silence through the credits.
W: Same! So: soundtrack, no. Characters, no. But the ending — the ending we both loved.
M: Agreed. And that's rarer than it sounds with us!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – The ending.
• Vì sao đúng: "Okay, YES. The ending was perfect." và cô tổng kết "the ending — the ending we both loved".
• The soundtrack sai: cô khen nhạc piano nhưng anh gần như không để ý ("I barely noticed the music").
• The characters sai: anh khen ông thuyền trưởng còn cô lại chê diễn quá ("I found him overacted, honestly").
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi "agree on" cần ý mà CẢ HAI cùng khen. Nghe các câu phản bác ("Really? I found him...") để loại, rồi bắt "YES / Same!".

question_text: Alice is calling her friend. What did she lose?
options: Book
Phone
Laptop
explanation:
W: Hi, it's Alice — thank goodness you picked up! I need your eyes.
M: You sound stressed. What's happened?
W: I can't find my phone anywhere! I'm calling from my mum's.
M: Your phone? But you had it at the café this afternoon — you showed me the holiday photos on it.
W: Exactly, that's the last time I remember holding it! My book is here, my laptop is here, but the phone is gone.
M: Okay, don't panic. I'll call the café — they usually keep things behind the counter.
W: Would you? I feel lost without it, honestly. My whole life is in that phone.
M: Give me two minutes. If it's there, I'll pick it up on my way over.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Phone.
• Vì sao đúng: "I can't find my phone anywhere!" và "My book is here, my laptop is here, but the phone is gone".
• Book sai: sách vẫn ở chỗ cô, nhà mẹ — "My book is here".
• Laptop sai: máy tính cũng còn nguyên — "my laptop is here".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi đồ bị mất, bài thường liệt kê những món VẪN CÒN để gây nhiễu. Bám cấu trúc "X is here, Y is here, but Z is gone".

question_text: The woman is calling a friend about meeting for dinner. How long does it take to get to the station?
options: 30 minutes
40 minutes
50 minutes
explanation:
W: Hi! About dinner tonight — I'm trying to time everything. How long to get to the station from yours?
M: Depends who you ask! The taxi app promises thirty minutes.
W: Thirty? That sounds suspiciously optimistic for a Friday evening.
M: Exactly — that's thirty on an empty Sunday morning, maybe. And my neighbour claims he once did it in... well, he says twenty-five, but he drives like a maniac.
W: So what's the honest number for tonight?
M: With Friday traffic and the roadworks on the bridge: forty minutes. I've done it every week this month — forty, reliably.
W: Forty it is. So if dinner is at eight, you leave at quarter past seven.
M: Already setting the alarm. Station café at eight — first one there orders the wine!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 40 minutes.
• Vì sao đúng: "With Friday traffic and the roadworks on the bridge: forty minutes. I've done it every week this month — forty, reliably."
• 30 minutes sai: là con số ứng dụng gọi xe hứa, chỉ đúng khi đường vắng ("that's thirty on an empty Sunday morning, maybe").
• 50 minutes sai: không được nhắc tới trong bài, chỉ là phương án gây nhiễu (bài chỉ có thêm con số 25 phút của ông hàng xóm).
👉 Mẹo: hỏi thời gian di chuyển thật, bỏ số của app và của người khác; chọn số kèm điều kiện thực tế ("with Friday traffic").

question_text: What do they need to repair for the building?
options: Windows
Doors
Gate
explanation:
M: Right, the inspection report for the building came back. Want the good news first?
W: Always. This building is a hundred years old — I fear the bad news.
M: Good news: the doors are fine. All of them — the inspector even praised the big oak ones at the front.
W: Wonderful. And the gate? It squeaks like a horror film.
M: Squeaky but solid — it just needs oil, that's not a repair. No, the real problem is the windows.
W: All of them?
M: Eleven of the twenty. The frames are rotten, two don't close at all, and the heating bill shows it. The windows need repairing before winter — that's the priority.
W: Windows it is, then. Get three quotes, and let's start with the north side.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Windows.
• Vì sao đúng: "The windows need repairing before winter — that's the priority" — 11 trong 20 khung bị mục, 2 cái không đóng được.
• Doors sai: tất cả đều ổn, còn được khen ("the doors are fine. All of them").
• Gate sai: chỉ kêu cót két, tra dầu là xong ("Squeaky but solid — it just needs oil, that's not a repair").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi hạng mục cần SỬA, phân biệt "bảo dưỡng nhẹ" với "hư hỏng thật"; bám cụm "that's the priority" và số liệu cụ thể.

question_text: Lucy is calling her friend. What is her sister like?
options: She is taller than Lucy
They have similar characters
She is very different from Lucy
explanation:
M: Lucy! How was the weekend with your sister? I've still never met her, you know.
W: Wonderful, as always. People are so surprised when they finally meet her.
M: Why? Is she taller than you? You always say she gets noticed first.
W: Ha! No, we're exactly the same height, actually. It's not about looks at all.
M: Then what surprises everyone?
W: How alike we are inside. We have similar characters — same silly jokes, same stubbornness, we even finish each other's sentences. Mum says raising us was like raising one person twice.
M: That's lovely. So if I like you, I'll like her.
W: Exactly. Double trouble, they call us!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – They have similar characters.
• Vì sao đúng: "How alike we are inside. We have similar characters — same silly jokes, same stubbornness, we even finish each other's sentences."
• She is taller than Lucy sai: hai chị em cao bằng nhau ("we're exactly the same height, actually").
• She is very different from Lucy sai: ngược lại hoàn toàn — "Mum says raising us was like raising one person twice".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ngoại hình/tính cách, chú ý cặp đối lập "looks vs inside"; câu "It's not about looks at all" đã loại sạch nhóm ngoại hình.

question_text: A man is talking to a waiter. What drink does the man choose?
options: Milk tea
Hot tea
Iced tea
explanation:
W: Good afternoon, sir! Ready to order, or shall I give you a minute?
M: Just drinks for now, please — I'm melting after that walk.
W: Then may I suggest our milk tea? House specialty, very popular.
M: Tempting, but milk and this heat don't mix for me, I'm afraid.
W: Understood! Hot tea, perhaps? Some say it actually cools you down.
M: My grandmother says that too — I've never believed either of you! No... something COLD.
W: Then you want our iced tea: fresh-brewed, lemon, mint, and a glass full of ice.
M: THAT's the one. A large iced tea, please — and keep them coming.
W: One large iced tea, right away. The refills are free until four, sir — you picked the right day!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Iced tea (trà đá).
• Vì sao đúng: khách chốt "THAT's the one. A large iced tea, please" sau khi phục vụ mô tả "our iced tea: fresh-brewed, lemon, mint, and a glass full of ice".
• Milk tea sai: bị từ chối vì trời nóng "Tempting, but milk and this heat don't mix for me".
• Hot tea sai: khách không tin trà nóng làm mát "My grandmother says that too — I've never believed either of you!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GỌI MÓN GÌ, phục vụ sẽ chào 2-3 món và khách từ chối dần. Đợi câu xác nhận dứt khoát "That's the one", "I'll have..." kèm size — đó mới là món được chọn.

question_text: Listen to the speaker talking about their weekly schedule. When is the meeting scheduled?
options: Monday morning
Friday afternoon
Wednesday afternoon
explanation:
W: New quarter, new schedule! Have you seen the team calendar yet?
M: Just opened it. Please tell me they didn't keep the Monday morning meeting.
W: They did NOT — mercy exists! Monday mornings are now protected focus time, no meetings allowed.
M: Finally! So when did the big weekly land? Someone mentioned Friday afternoon...
W: Friday afternoon was proposed, and the whole office rebelled — nobody's brain works after Friday lunch, and management actually listened.
M: Miracles everywhere. So...?
W: Wednesday afternoon! The meeting is every Wednesday at two — middle of the week, everyone's alive, reports ready.
M: Wednesday at two... that's actually sensible. Who ARE these new managers?
W: Ones who drink enough coffee! Block your calendar — first one is this Wednesday.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Wednesday afternoon (chiều thứ Tư).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "Wednesday afternoon! The meeting is every Wednesday at two — middle of the week, everyone's alive, reports ready".
• Monday morning sai: đã bị bỏ hẳn "They did NOT — Monday mornings are now protected focus time, no meetings allowed".
• Friday afternoon sai: từng được đề xuất nhưng bị phản đối "Friday afternoon was proposed, and the whole office rebelled — nobody's brain works after Friday lunch".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi LỊCH HỌP HÀNG TUẦN, phải nghe cả THỨ lẫn BUỔI. Loại mốc đi kèm "was proposed", "no meetings allowed"; đáp án có giờ cụ thể ("at two") và lý do hợp lý.

question_text: Listen to a conversation. What is the woman's most important task for the upcoming conference?
options: Organizing an informal event
Sending out invitations
Giving a formal address
explanation:
M: Two weeks to the conference! Give me your status — I promised the board an update.
W: Then write this down. The welcome evening — the informal barbecue — is basically done; the venue handles everything, I just approve the menu Friday.
M: Good. Invitations?
W: Went out three weeks ago. Two hundred and ten confirmed, including all the keynote guests. Done and dusted.
M: So what's keeping you up at night?
W: The same thing that would keep YOU up: the opening address. I'm giving the formal speech this year — the full welcome, in front of every partner and sponsor we have.
M: Ah yes. THE speech. How's it coming?
W: Fourth draft. By the conference it'll be perfect — it has to be. Everything else is details; that speech is the event.
M: Then I'll tell the board the important thing is in the best possible hands.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Giving a formal address.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'm giving the formal speech this year — the full welcome, in front of every partner and sponsor we have" và cô chốt "that speech is the event".
• Organizing an informal event sai: tiệc nướng chào mừng do đơn vị tổ chức lo hết, cô chỉ duyệt thực đơn ("the venue handles everything").
• Sending out invitations sai: đã gửi ba tuần trước, 210 người xác nhận ("Done and dusted").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi việc quan trọng nhất, loại ngay việc "done and dusted"; bám câu chốt kiểu "Everything else is details".

question_text: Two friends are talking about their school days. What was the woman good at?
options: Swimming
Plays football
Running
explanation:
M: Look at this — my old school sports day photo! Were you sporty back then?
W: Very! Though not at what people guessed.
M: Let me try: swimming? You're always at the pool these days.
W: That's a NOW thing — at school I could barely float, embarrassing but true.
M: Running, then? You've got the build for it.
W: Terrible at it! Last in every race — I once got overtaken by a girl with her shoelaces untied.
M: So what WAS it?
W: Football! I played football, and I was genuinely good — captain of the girls' team two years running, top scorer in the county cup. The boys begged me to join their lunchtime games.
M: Captain AND top scorer? I'm impressed!
W: Ask my dad — he still keeps the little trophy on his shelf!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Plays football (chơi bóng đá).
• Vì sao đúng: cô khẳng định "Football! I played football, and I was genuinely good — captain of the girls' team two years running, top scorer in the county cup".
• Swimming sai: đó là chuyện hiện tại, không phải hồi đi học "That's a NOW thing — at school I could barely float".
• Running sai: cô tự nhận rất tệ "Terrible at it! Last in every race".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi HỒI ĐI HỌC giỏi gì, chú ý mốc thời gian: "now" ≠ "at school". Đáp án đi kèm bằng chứng cụ thể (chức đội trưởng, cúp, giải thưởng), còn phương án nhiễu đi kèm lời tự chê ("terrible", "barely").

question_text: Tom is calling his friend. What time will they meet?
options: 6 PM
5 PM
7 PM
explanation:
M: Hey, it's Tom! About tonight — when are we actually meeting? Everyone's asking me.
W: I thought we said five pm at the bowling place?
M: Five was the FIRST plan, but Marek's shift ends at five — he'd never make it across town.
W: Right, poor Marek. Six, then? That was the second suggestion in the chat.
M: Six almost worked... except the lanes are fully booked till later, I called them this afternoon.
W: So we're at...?
M: Seven pm. The lane is booked, under my name, seven o'clock sharp. Everyone can make seven.
W: Seven it is! I'll forward it to the group before someone invents an eighth plan.
M: Please do. And tell them: losers buy the pizza!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – 7 PM.
• Vì sao đúng: Tom chốt "Seven pm. The lane is booked, under my name, seven o'clock sharp. Everyone can make seven".
• 5 PM sai: là kế hoạch đầu tiên, bị bỏ vì ca làm của Marek "Five was the FIRST plan, but Marek's shift ends at five".
• 6 PM sai: là đề xuất thứ hai, bị loại vì hết làn bowling "the lanes are fully booked till later, I called them this afternoon".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MẤY GIỜ GẶP, đếm thứ tự các phương án: "first plan", "second suggestion" đều là mồi. Đáp án là mốc cuối cùng, đi kèm bằng chứng đã đặt chỗ ("the lane is booked, under my name").

question_text: Pierre and Emma are talking together about the picnic on the weekend. What will they bring to the picnic?
options: Drinks
Salads
Food
explanation:
M: Emma, the picnic list went up — did you see what's left for us?
W: Just checked, Pierre. The choices were drinks, salads, or the main food.
M: Please say drinks. Drinks is just carrying bottles!
W: Exactly why they went first — the Novak twins claimed drinks within a minute.
M: The salads, then? Your garden tomatoes are famous.
W: Kind of you, but Mrs. Lee took salads — she's doing three kinds, apparently it's a competition now.
M: So we're left with...
W: The food! The main course for twenty people — sausages, burgers, the bread, all of it.
M: That's the biggest job on the list!
W: It is — but we have the biggest grill. Saturday morning, you shop, I marinate. We'll be legends by sunset!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Food (đồ ăn chính).
• Vì sao đúng: Emma chốt "The food! The main course for twenty people — sausages, burgers, the bread, all of it" vì hai mục kia đã có người nhận.
• Drinks sai: bị nhận mất ngay "the Novak twins claimed drinks within a minute".
• Salads sai: đã có người khác lo "Mrs. Lee took salads — she's doing three kinds".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MANG GÌ/PHÂN CÔNG, hãy nghe theo kiểu loại trừ: mỗi món bị "claimed/took/already has someone" là loại một. Món còn lại cuối cùng, thường đi kèm câu than "That's the biggest job", chính là đáp án.

question_text: What do they need to repair for the building?
options: Windows
Doors
Gate
explanation:
W: The building survey arrived this morning. Shall I give you the summary?
M: Please. And start with the gate — that thing groans like a ghost every time it opens.
W: Funny you say that: the gate passed! It needs grease, not repairs — five minutes with an oil can.
M: Small mercies. The doors, then? The back one sticks in the rain.
W: Sticking, yes, but structurally the doors are all sound — the surveyor barely mentioned them.
M: So what's the bad news? There's always bad news.
W: The windows. Nearly half the frames have rot, and three panes are cracked. The report says repair them before the cold season or the heating costs will double.
M: Windows first, then. Get the carpenter in this week — north side before the frost.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Windows.
• Vì sao đúng: "The windows. Nearly half the frames have rot, and three panes are cracked. The report says repair them before the cold season".
• Doors sai: về kết cấu vẫn tốt, chỉ hơi kẹt khi trời mưa ("structurally the doors are all sound").
• Gate sai: chỉ cần tra dầu, không phải sửa chữa ("It needs grease, not repairs — five minutes with an oil can").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi hạng mục cần SỬA, phân biệt "bảo dưỡng nhẹ" với "hư hỏng thật"; bám các từ hư hại rot, cracked.

question_text: Listen to a friend talking about selling her music player. How much did she sell it for?
options: 50 dollars
60 dollars
40 dollars
explanation:
M: Hey, did you ever sell that old music player of yours? The little silver one?
W: I did! This weekend, at the flea market. Sold it in the first hour.
M: Nice! You wanted sixty for it, didn't you? That was your big plan.
W: Sixty was my dream price, yes — the young collector guy looked at it, but he walked away laughing.
M: Ouch. So down to forty? That's what your brother said it was worth.
W: My brother undervalues everything I own! No — a lovely woman offered forty-five, we haggled the OTHER way for once, and we settled on fifty. Fifty dollars, cash.
M: Selling UP from the offer? Teach me your ways!
W: Charm and a working pair of headphones, my friend. That's the secret!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 50 dollars.
• Vì sao đúng: "a lovely woman offered forty-five, we haggled the OTHER way for once, and we settled on fifty. Fifty dollars, cash."
• 60 dollars sai: là giá cô mơ ước, người sưu tầm trẻ xem rồi bỏ đi ("Sixty was my dream price, yes — but he walked away laughing").
• 40 dollars sai: là mức em/anh trai cô định giá ("That's what your brother said it was worth"), cô bác bỏ ngay.
👉 Mẹo: hỏi giá bán cuối, bám "we settled on"; giá mơ ước và giá người khác định đều khác giá chốt.

question_text: Jane is calling her friend Martha. What time are they going to meet?
explanation:
W: Martha! It's Jane — about our gallery evening, we need to fix the time properly.
W2: Finally! Weren't we saying four o'clock at some point?
W: Four was the plan before my shift changed — I'm at the clinic until five now, no escape.
W2: Right. Then straight to six? The gallery closes at eight, that still gives us two hours.
W: Six cuts it fine, though — the guided tour starts at six and we'd miss the introduction rushing in.
W2: True, and you HATE missing introductions. So...?
W: Half past five! I finish at five, fifteen minutes to get there, fifteen minutes for coffee in the courtyard first.
W2: Five thirty with courtyard coffee — now THAT's a plan. I'll buy the tickets online today.
W: Perfect. Five thirty, gallery steps. Wear the comfortable shoes this time!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 5.30 (5 giờ rưỡi).
• Vì sao đúng: Jane chốt "Half past five! I finish at five, fifteen minutes to get there, fifteen minutes for coffee in the courtyard first" và kết lại "Five thirty, gallery steps".
• 4.00 sai: là kế hoạch trước khi đổi ca "Four was the plan before my shift changed — I'm at the clinic until five now, no escape".
• 6.00 sai: quá sát giờ tour "Six cuts it fine, though — the guided tour starts at six and we'd miss the introduction rushing in".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GẶP LÚC MẤY GIỜ, đáp án có thể là mốc "rưỡi" nằm GIỮA hai mốc chẵn đã nêu. Đừng chỉ nghe số giờ — nghe cả "half past", "quarter to" và câu nhắc lại ở cuối.

question_text: How many weeks have they been in India?
options: 2 weeks
4 weeks
3 weeks
explanation:
W: So! How is India treating you both? It feels like you left ages ago.
M: That's what everyone says! People think we've been here a month already.
W: Haven't you? Your photos could fill four weeks easily — the palaces, the markets, that train ride...
M: Ha! We're just very fast tourists. Some friends even guessed three weeks.
W: So how long has it actually been?
M: Exactly two weeks today. We landed on the eighth — two weeks, and it honestly feels like two days.
W: Two weeks and all THAT? I need your energy.
M: Come join us for the last month — we'll wear you out in a weekend!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – 2 weeks.
• Vì sao đúng: "Exactly two weeks today. We landed on the eighth — two weeks, and it honestly feels like two days."
• 4 weeks sai: chỉ là suy đoán của mọi người khi xem ảnh ("People think we've been here a month already").
• 3 weeks sai: cũng là phỏng đoán của bạn bè ("Some friends even guessed three weeks").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi khoảng thời gian, bỏ mọi con số đi kèm "think", "guessed", "told me"; chỉ lấy số có "Exactly" hoặc "actually".

question_text: Two people are talking about meeting for dinner. What time does Ahmed meet Rose?
options: half past seven
quarter past seven
quarter to eight
explanation:
M: Rose, it's Ahmed — about dinner tonight. When shall we say?
W: I finish work at seven, so... quarter past seven at the restaurant?
M: Quarter past is tight for me — my last meeting ends at seven, and it's across town.
W: Hmm. Half past seven, then? That's what we did last time.
M: Last time you sat waiting fifteen minutes because my bus vanished, remember. Let's be honest with ourselves.
W: Ha! True. So what's realistic?
M: Quarter to eight. That gives me a real chance to arrive calm, on time, and with flowers.
W: Flowers! Well then, quarter to eight it is. I'll move the booking.
M: Quarter to eight, table by the window. I won't be late this time — I promise!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Quarter to eight (7 giờ 45).
• Vì sao đúng: "Quarter to eight. That gives me a real chance to arrive calm, on time" — cô đồng ý "quarter to eight it is. I'll move the booking."
• Half past seven sai: là giờ của lần trước và Rose đã phải chờ 15 phút ("Last time you sat waiting fifteen minutes").
• Quarter past seven sai: quá gấp vì họp của Ahmed 7 giờ mới xong và ở đầu kia thành phố ("Quarter past is tight for me").
👉 Mẹo: học chắc cách nói giờ kiểu Anh — "quarter past" là hơn 15, "half past" là rưỡi, "quarter to" là kém 15. Nghe nhầm past/to là mất điểm ngay.

question_text: Listen to the conversation. Who is she taking a photo of?
options: The girl's team
The boys' team
The coaches
explanation:
M: You've had that camera out all morning! Who are you photographing?
W: I'm on a mission for the school website. They need one good team photo from today.
M: The boys' team just won their match — they're doing a victory dance over there. Perfect moment!
W: Tempting, but no — the boys had their photo taken last month, remember the big poster?
M: True. What about the coaches, then? All four of them are standing together by the bench for once.
W: The coaches hate cameras, they'd never smile. No — I'm taking a photo of the girls' team. They just won the cup, and they're not even on the website yet!
M: Fair enough. They've lined up already — go, go!
W: Wish me luck. Everybody say cheese!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The girl's team.
• Vì sao đúng: "No — I'm taking a photo of the girls' team. They just won the cup, and they're not even on the website yet!".
• The boys' team sai: đội nam đã được chụp từ tháng trước — "the boys had their photo taken last month, remember the big poster?".
• The coaches sai: các huấn luyện viên ghét máy ảnh, không chịu cười — "The coaches hate cameras, they'd never smile".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "chụp ai", người kia sẽ gợi ý hai đối tượng và cả hai đều bị từ chối. Bám câu "No — I'm taking a photo of..." của chính người cầm máy.

question_text: A woman is talking to a shop assistant. Why does the woman return the dress?
options: Because of its size
Because of its color
Because of its pattern
explanation:
M: Welcome back to the boutique! Oh — you have one of our bags. A return?
W: I'm afraid so. This dress, from Tuesday. I'd like my money back, please.
M: Of course, let me just note the reason. Was it the colour after all? You did hesitate between the green and this one.
W: No, no — the colour is perfect, it's exactly the shade I wanted for the party.
M: Then perhaps the pattern? These leaves are quite... enthusiastic.
W: The pattern I love — it's why I chose it over the plain ones! The problem is the size. At home, in honest daylight, it simply doesn't fit — too tight across the shoulders, and the zip surrenders halfway. And your size chart says the next one up is out of stock everywhere.
M: I'm sorry — this cut does run small, we've had a few returns. A full refund, then?
W: Yes, please. And maybe a note to the factory: real shoulders exist!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Because of its size (vì kích cỡ không vừa).
• Vì sao đúng: cô nói "The problem is the size. At home, in honest daylight, it simply doesn't fit — too tight across the shoulders, and the zip surrenders halfway"; nhân viên cũng thừa nhận "this cut does run small".
• Because of its color sai: cô khen màu "the colour is perfect, it's exactly the shade I wanted for the party".
• Because of its pattern sai: cô còn thích họa tiết "The pattern I love — it's why I chose it over the plain ones!".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi LÝ DO TRẢ HÀNG, nhân viên sẽ đoán sai vài lý do và khách bác bỏ bằng lời khen. Đáp án nằm sau "The problem is..." và có bằng chứng vật lý (chật vai, kéo khóa không lên).

question_text: A man and a woman are going shopping. What does he buy in the store?
options: A T-shirt
A suit for the office
A hat
explanation:
W: Right, we're here — now remind me what you actually need?
M: Something for the new job. First impressions and all that.
W: Ooh, look at these T-shirts! This blue one would suit you.
M: For the office? On day one? I'd be sent home before lunch!
W: Fair. Oh — and look at these hats! Try the grey one, go on.
M: You're not taking this seriously at all. I'm not buying a hat.
W: Fine, fine. The suits are over there. That navy one looks sharp.
M: Now we're talking. Navy suit, white shirt... yes. This is the one — I'm buying the suit.
W: Very handsome. Can we look at the hats again now?
M: You buy a hat. I'll wait outside!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – A suit for the office.
• Vì sao đúng: "Navy suit, white shirt... yes. This is the one — I'm buying the suit." — mua cho công việc mới.
• A T-shirt sai: không hợp ngày đầu đi làm ("For the office? On day one? I'd be sent home before lunch!").
• A hat sai: anh từ chối thẳng ("I'm not buying a hat") và bảo cô bạn tự mua nếu thích.
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại mua sắm, đáp án là món đi kèm câu quyết định ở hiện tại tiếp diễn hoặc "I'll take..."; món chỉ được ướm thử đều là nhiễu.

question_text: A woman is talking about her old manager. Why did she like George?
options: He looked after his staff
He was friendly
He taught her a lot
explanation:
A lot of people don't like their managers, but that wasn't the case for me. My manager George was really good at his job — he helped me know what to do in difficult times. He was a friendly manager, and he looked after his staff, too. But those aren't the main reasons I liked him. He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – He taught her a lot.
• Vì sao đúng: "He taught me a lot, and he was like a teacher to me. That's what mattered most".
• He was friendly / He looked after his staff sai: đều được nhắc nhưng bị gạt — "those aren't the main reasons".
👉 Mẹo: dạng "nhắc cả 3 rồi loại 2" — đáp án nằm sau "But... the main reason" / "That's what mattered most".

question_text: Lalia is talking to her friend about her upcoming trip. How much does she think the bus fare will be?
explanation:
W: Three days until my trip! I'm budgeting every penny tonight.
M: Very organised, Lalia! What's left to figure out?
W: The bus fare to the coast, mainly. My cousin took that route last year and paid four fifty.
M: Four pounds fifty? That was the summer festival price — they double everything in festival week.
W: That's what I hoped! The website mentions three pounds for peak times...
M: Peak is weekday mornings, but you're travelling Saturday afternoon, aren't you?
W: Exactly — off-peak. So with my student card on top... I think the fare will be two pounds fifty. Two fifty, I'm almost sure.
M: Two fifty sounds right for off-peak with the discount. Budget three, to be safe!
W: Two fifty in the plan, three in the pocket. See — THIS is why I budget with a friend!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – £2.5 (hai bảng rưỡi).
• Vì sao đúng: Lalia tự tính ra "So with my student card on top... I think the fare will be two pounds fifty. Two fifty, I'm almost sure" và bạn cô xác nhận "Two fifty sounds right for off-peak with the discount".
• £4.5 sai: là giá người chị họ trả trong tuần lễ hội "That was the summer festival price — they double everything in festival week".
• £3 sai: là giá giờ cao điểm, còn cô đi chiều thứ Bảy "Peak is weekday mornings, but you're travelling Saturday afternoon".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi GIÁ VÉ, ba con số gắn với ba điều kiện khác nhau (mùa lễ hội / giờ cao điểm / off-peak + giảm giá sinh viên). Xác định điều kiện của CHÍNH người nói trước rồi mới chọn số.

question_text: A woman is talking to a shop assistant. Why does the woman return the dress?
options: Because of its size
Because of its color
Because of its pattern
explanation:
M: Good morning! How can I help you today?
W: I'd like to return this dress, please. I bought it on Saturday.
M: Of course. May I ask what the problem is? Is it the colour? Some customers find this red quite strong.
W: Oh no, the colour is gorgeous — it's exactly why I picked it off the rail.
M: The pattern, perhaps? The flowers are quite bold...
W: The pattern is lovely too, honestly. No — the problem is the size. I took my usual size, but this dress comes up far too small; I couldn't even close the zip. And you don't have it in the next size up, I already checked.
M: Ah, I see — this range does run small, I'm sorry. Would you like a refund, then?
W: Yes, please. And a little warning sign on that rail wouldn't hurt!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Because of its size.
• Vì sao đúng: "the problem is the size. I took my usual size, but this dress comes up far too small; I couldn't even close the zip."
• Because of its color sai: cô khen màu ("the colour is gorgeous — it's exactly why I picked it off the rail").
• Because of its pattern sai: cô cũng khen họa tiết ("The pattern is lovely too, honestly").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lý do trả hàng, nhân viên sẽ đoán 2 lý do sai trước; đáp án nằm sau "No — the problem is...".

question_text: Listen to a conversation between the teacher and a parent. What will the father do?
options: Change schools
Arrange private classes
Enroll in after-school programs
explanation:
W: Thank you for coming in, Mr. Collins. I wanted to talk about Ben's maths — he's fallen behind this term.
M: I know, we've seen it in his homework too. My wife even wondered about moving him to another school.
W: Honestly, I wouldn't. He's happy here, his friends are here — changing schools would solve nothing.
M: That's what I told her. What about the after-school programme, the homework club?
W: It's full until January, I'm afraid — there's a waiting list.
M: Hmm. Then we'll go with the other option we discussed at home: I'll arrange private classes for him. My colleague knows an excellent maths tutor, two evenings a week.
W: That would be ideal — one-to-one attention is exactly what Ben needs right now.
M: I'll call the tutor tonight. Thank you, Miss Reed.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Arrange private classes.
• Vì sao đúng: "I'll arrange private classes for him. My colleague knows an excellent maths tutor, two evenings a week."
• Change schools sai: cô giáo khuyên không nên và người bố đồng ý ("changing schools would solve nothing").
• Enroll in after-school programs sai: câu lạc bộ làm bài tập đã kín chỗ đến tháng Một ("It's full until January, there's a waiting list").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi "What will the father do", chỉ chọn việc do CHÍNH người bố hứa làm ("I'll..."), không chọn ý được gợi ý rồi bị bác.

question_text: How much can Max pay for the computer?
options: 200 pounds
250 pounds
300 pounds
explanation:
M: So, Max — you said you're finally replacing that ancient laptop. What's the budget?
W: Wait, I heard the good ones start at three hundred pounds. Can you even afford that?
M: Three hundred is the shop price for the new model, yes — completely out of my league right now.
W: What about that refurbished one your cousin offered? Two hundred, wasn't it?
M: It was, but he sold it last week — I was too slow, story of my life.
W: So what CAN you actually spend?
M: I've done the maths this morning: with my savings plus selling the old one, I can pay two hundred and fifty. That's my absolute ceiling — two fifty, not a penny more.
W: Two fifty is workable! The computer fair is on Saturday — you'll find something good for that.
M: Saturday it is. Come with me and stop me from overspending!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 250 pounds.
• Vì sao đúng: "with my savings plus selling the old one, I can pay two hundred and fifty. That's my absolute ceiling — two fifty, not a penny more."
• 200 pounds sai: là giá chiếc máy tân trang của người anh họ nhưng đã bán mất ("he sold it last week").
• 300 pounds sai: là giá máy mới ngoài cửa hàng, vượt khả năng ("completely out of my league right now").
👉 Mẹo: "How much CAN he pay" là hỏi khả năng chi trả, không phải giá niêm yết; bám cụm "I can pay", "my ceiling".

question_text: A woman is talking to a police officer. What did she lose?
options: Wallet
Phone
Car
explanation:
M: Good evening, madam. You look worried — how can I help?
W: Officer, I've lost something in the market square this afternoon, and I'm going out of my mind.
M: Let's sort it out. Your wallet? We've had two handed in within the hour.
W: No, thankfully — my wallet was zipped in my inside pocket the whole time, cards and all.
M: Good. Then... not the car, I hope? The square parking is chaos on market day.
W: The car is fine, parked right outside your station, actually. It's my phone! I set it down at the flower stall while I paid, got distracted, and walked away without it. Every photo of my grandchildren is on that phone, officer.
M: A phone at the flower stall — let me call the market office; the stall holders are honest folk. Take a seat, madam.
W: Thank you. Oh, I do hope the flower lady found it!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Phone (điện thoại).
• Vì sao đúng: bà nói "It's my phone! I set it down at the flower stall while I paid, got distracted, and walked away without it".
• Wallet sai: ví vẫn an toàn "my wallet was zipped in my inside pocket the whole time, cards and all".
• Car sai: xe không mất "The car is fine, parked right outside your station".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi MẤT ĐỒ GÌ, cảnh sát sẽ đoán trước 1-2 món và bị bác bỏ ngay ("No, thankfully...", "The car is fine"). Đợi câu bật ra với dấu chấm than "It's my..." — đó mới là món bị mất.

question_text: A man is reading the news about a housing development plan. How many new houses are going to be built?
explanation:
M: Have you read this? The big housing development plan for the north fields — it's finally approved!
W: I saw the headline! The numbers kept changing though — what did they settle on?
M: Well, the first proposal said fifteen hundred houses, remember? The council rejected that as too few — wouldn't solve the waiting lists.
W: And then the developers swung the other way — twenty-five hundred, wasn't it? The neighbours went to war over that.
M: Exactly, petitions and everything — too much traffic, not enough schools. So the final compromise, signed yesterday: two thousand new houses.
W: Two thousand... with the new school and the park included?
M: Both included — that was the deal. Two thousand homes, building starts in spring.
W: My sister's been on the housing list for three years. This might finally be her chance!
M: Tell her to apply early — half the town is thinking the same thing.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – 2000 (hai nghìn căn).
• Vì sao đúng: người đàn ông nói "the final compromise, signed yesterday: two thousand new houses" và nhắc lại "Two thousand homes, building starts in spring".
• 1500 sai: là đề xuất đầu tiên bị hội đồng bác vì quá ít "the first proposal said fifteen hundred houses... The council rejected that as too few".
• 2500 sai: là con số chủ đầu tư đưa ra sau đó và bị dân phản đối "The neighbours went to war over that... too much traffic, not enough schools".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi SỐ LƯỢNG trong tin tức, ba con số theo trình tự đề xuất – phản đề – thỏa hiệp. Chọn số đi kèm "final", "compromise", "signed/approved", thường nằm ở giữa hai số kia.

question_text: What country will they study next semester?
options: Germany
Spain
France
explanation:
W: Did you hear? They announced the country study for next semester!
M: Finally! Please tell me it's Germany — I've been practising my German for nothing otherwise.
W: Sorry to break your heart... Germany was LAST year's programme, remember? The exchange students told us all about it.
M: Right. Then Spain? Someone in the canteen swore it was Spain.
W: That rumour started because of the new Spanish teacher — but no, she's teaching language, not the study programme.
M: So what IS it then? Don't make me beg.
W: France! The whole semester — French history, French cinema, and a two-week trip to Paris in May!
M: PARIS? Okay, forget German. Where do I sign up?
W: The list opens Monday morning. I'm queueing at eight, join me!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – France.
• Vì sao đúng: "France! The whole semester — French history, French cinema, and a two-week trip to Paris in May!"
• Germany sai: là chương trình của NĂM NGOÁI ("Germany was LAST year's programme").
• Spain sai: chỉ là tin đồn vì trường có giáo viên tiếng Tây Ban Nha mới ("That rumour started because of the new Spanish teacher").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi kế hoạch kỳ tới, loại ngay ý gắn với "last year's" và "rumour"; đáp án thường được reo lên kèm chi tiết cụ thể.

question_text: The woman is walking into a local store. How much are the cleaning products?
options: Two pounds
One pound fifty
Three pounds
explanation:
M: Good morning! Looking for anything in particular?
W: Yes — cleaning products. The spray and the wipes, the ones in the green bottles.
M: Ah, good timing! They were three pounds each last month, if you remember.
W: I do — that's why I stopped buying them, to be honest.
M: Well, the regular price came down to two pounds this spring. But this week is even better...
W: Go on, make my day.
M: They're on special offer: one pound fifty each. This week only.
W: One fifty? Wonderful! I'll take four, then — that barely costs more than two used to.
M: Four it is. That's six pounds exactly, please.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – One pound fifty.
• Vì sao đúng: "They're on special offer: one pound fifty each. This week only" — cô mua 4 chai và trả đúng 6 bảng.
• Three pounds sai: là giá của tháng trước, đắt tới mức cô ngừng mua — "They were three pounds each last month"; "that's why I stopped buying them".
• Two pounds sai: là giá NIÊM YẾT thường từ mùa xuân, không phải giá tuần này — "the regular price came down to two pounds this spring. But this week is even better...".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi giá, tách rõ ba mốc: giá cũ, giá thường, giá khuyến mãi. Lấy số sau "on special offer" và kiểm tra lại bằng phép nhân (4 × 1.50 = 6 pounds).

question_text: What did she advice for people who lack motivation at work?
options: Attend a time management workshop
Request a transfer
Take on additional responsibilities
explanation:
M: Half my team has gone flat lately — no fire, no ideas. You handled this last year, didn't you?
W: I did, and I tried everything, so learn from my scars.
M: The time management workshop? Everyone recommends that first.
W: We ran one. Beautiful calendars, same empty eyes. Planning doesn't create motivation, it only organises it.
M: Then maybe I should give them bigger challenges — more responsibilities?
W: To demotivated people? You'll just drown them and they'll resent you. No — what actually worked was simpler: I helped my two most bored people request a transfer. New department, same company.
M: And it worked?
W: Both of them woke up within a month — one got promoted by spring. Movement creates energy, trust me.
M: A transfer... alright, I'll talk to HR tomorrow.
W: Do it gently — and keep the door open for them to come back!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Request a transfer.
• Vì sao đúng: "what actually worked was simpler: I helped my two most bored people request a transfer. New department, same company." — cả hai hồi sinh trong một tháng.
• Attend a time management workshop sai: đã thử và vô ích ("We ran one. Beautiful calendars, same empty eyes").
• Take on additional responsibilities sai: cô bác bỏ vì sẽ khiến họ quá tải và bực bội ("You'll just drown them and they'll resent you").
👉 Mẹo: hỏi lời khuyên, chọn giải pháp người nói khẳng định ĐÃ hiệu quả ("what actually worked was"), không chọn ý bị phản bác ngay sau khi nêu.

question_text: According to the reviewer, what is one benefit of school sports?
options: They are designed to limit physical exertion.
They help promote students' overall health.
They primarily focus on academic competition.
explanation:
In my review of modern school programmes, physical education keeps earning its place, and I want to explain why. First, let us discard two misunderstandings. School sports are not designed to limit physical exertion — quite the opposite; the whole point is to get young bodies moving hard and often. Nor do they primarily exist for academic competition; the league table mentality belongs to exams, not to the playground. The benefit my findings highlight above all is health: school sports promote students' overall health by building regular activity into the week. Stronger hearts, better sleep, steadier moods — the data repeats itself in every school I visit. A teenager who plays twice a week is measurably healthier than one who only studies, and the difference shows up in the classroom as much as on the field.
But the benefits do not stop at the physical, and this is the part schools undervalue. Critics worry that sport encourages extreme specialisation, turning children into single-skill machines. Others claim it prioritises individual glory over team success. Watch an actual school season and you will see neither. What sport truly provides is balance. It offsets the long sitting hours, gives the overworked mind a place to rest, and teaches lessons — patience, cooperation, losing gracefully — that no examination can measure. A school timetable without sport is like a diet without vegetables: survivable, but never healthy.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: They help promote students' overall health. Bẫy: "limit physical exertion" và "academic competition" đều bị phủ định.
2. Đáp án: It provides balance. Bẫy: "extreme specialization" và "individual over team" — "you will see neither".

question_text: Four people are talking about their restaurant experiences. Match each person to the correct information.
explanation:
Speaker A: I chose that restaurant because friends kept telling me how beautiful the decoration was, and honestly, they were right. The service was quick as well, so I have nothing bad to say about that. The problem was the food itself. The portion was so small that when I got home I had to make myself a sandwich. I walked out of there still hungry.

Speaker B: The atmosphere was lovely and the waiters brought our dishes out very quickly, so I really cannot complain about the service. What shocked me was the bill at the end of the evening. Every single dish cost far more than I had expected, and I ended up paying almost double what I had planned to spend on dinner.

Speaker C: I am allergic to peanuts, so eating out always makes me a little nervous. One of the waiters went through the entire menu with me, explained exactly how each dish was cooked, and then suggested something that was completely safe for me. He was so patient and never once made me feel like I was being difficult. That is what I remember most about the evening.

Speaker D: I did not go there for the food, to be honest, and the dishes were nothing special. I went because there was live music that night. The singer and the band were absolutely fantastic. I listened to every song carefully and I could not find a single mistake anywhere. It was, without doubt, the best evening of music I have had in years.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ---

A — was still hungry after dinner: A mở đầu bằng lời khen trang trí đẹp và phục vụ nhanh, rất dễ khiến người nghe chọn nhầm. Nhưng đó chỉ là phần dẫn; ý chính nằm ở cuối: "The portion was so small that when I got home I had to make myself a sandwich. I walked out of there still hungry."

B — paid a high price: B cũng khen phục vụ ("I really cannot complain about the service") để gài bẫy. Ý chính là hóa đơn: "Every single dish cost far more than I had expected, and I ended up paying almost double what I had planned."

C — met the helpful staff: C bị dị ứng đậu phộng, và một nhân viên đã giải thích cả thực đơn, nói rõ cách chế biến từng món rồi gợi ý món an toàn. C tự chốt: "That is what I remember most about the evening."

D — watched a perfect performance: D nói thẳng không đến vì đồ ăn ("the dishes were nothing special") mà vì nhạc sống. "I could not find a single mistake anywhere" — không một lỗi nào, tức màn trình diễn hoàn hảo.

Mẹo: cả A và B đều mở đầu bằng lời khen tích cực về trang trí và tốc độ phục vụ. Nghe câu đầu rồi chọn ngay là dính bẫy — luôn chờ tới câu chốt của mỗi người.

question_text: Describe the picture.
explanation: In this picture I can see a man and a woman decorating the living room of their house. The man is standing on the left, reaching up to hang a framed picture of a plant on the wall, while the woman is standing on the right and pointing at the wall, probably telling him where to put it. There are already several frames hanging above the sofa, so they seem to be creating a gallery wall. The room looks warm and comfortable, with a green sofa, cushions, a wooden coffee table and a large plant near the window. Sunlight is coming in from the right, which makes the whole room feel bright and welcoming.

question_text: Four people are talking about reading books. Match each person to the correct information.
explanation:
Speaker A: My reading happens between two train stations. Forty minutes into college, forty minutes home — that is a solid chapter and a half each day, bookmarked precisely as we pull into the platform. The carriage rocks, the pages turn, and the crowd around me disappears entirely. My friends complain the commute steals their day. Mine gave me back reading; I finished twenty-three books last year without ever sitting in an armchair.
Speaker B: I keep buying books and life keeps cancelling them. Between the double shifts at the restaurant, the baby, and the house that never stays clean, my bedside pile has become furniture. I open a novel on my rare free evening and my eyes surrender within a page. My sister sends me her favourites with little notes inside, and I add them to the tower guiltily. One day the pile and I will have our year. Not this year.
Speaker C: I've got shelves full of books at home — novels, biographies, travel writing, the lot — and for years I read every single evening. Then in January I joined the fitness club near my office, and everything changed. Now my evenings are spin classes and lengths in the pool, and honestly I'd rather be moving than sitting still with a paperback. The books are still there on the shelves, waiting. I just prefer doing something active these days.
Speaker D: When I was small, my parents read to me every night — one story, then lights out — and the habit never left me. Even now I can't fall asleep without a chapter under the lamp, propped up on my pillows. And I've passed it on: every evening I sit on my daughter's bed and we read a book together, taking turns with the pages. Her teacher says it has helped her reading at school no end, and it's the best part of my day.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
A = read when travelling to school ("between two train stations... into college"). B = don't have time to read ("life keeps cancelling them... bedside pile has become furniture"). C = prefer another activity to reading books ("joined the fitness club... I'd rather be moving than sitting still with a paperback"). D = read on their beds ("can't fall asleep without a chapter... propped up on my pillows", đọc cùng con gái trên giường). Nhiễu: on phones, in the library.
👉 Đề thật 16/9: C = thích hoạt động khác (fitness club), D = đọc trên giường (bố mẹ kể chuyện trước ngủ, giờ đọc cùng con).

question_text: What is the speaker's opinion on this script?
options: The characters' background are not adequately explored
The setting feels too unrealistic
The dialogue is too complex for viewers
explanation:
Thank you for inviting me to review this script, and I will be honest with the writing team, because that is the only useful kind of review. Let me start with what is not wrong. The setting is not the problem — the small coastal town feels completely believable, right down to the ferry timetable on the harbour wall. Nor is the dialogue too complex; the conversations are natural, and viewers will follow them without any effort. The real weakness lies with the characters: their backgrounds are not adequately explored. We watch the heroine make a life-changing decision in episode two, but we know almost nothing about her past, her family, or what shaped her fears. Without that foundation, her choices feel random rather than moving, and the audience stays at arm's length from people it should love.
Why does this keep happening to promising scripts? Because of the industry itself. Studios like to claim that today's fast production cycles increase audience engagement, and streaming platforms insist their model gives more creative freedom to writers. From where I sit, the truth is the opposite: the new industry demands have a negative influence on script production. Writers are pushed to follow whatever trend is popular this quarter, to deliver drafts on impossible deadlines, and to satisfy commercial checklists before creative ones. Under that pressure, the slow work — building a character's history layer by layer — is always the first thing cut. And it shows on the screen.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: The characters' backgrounds are not adequately explored. Bẫy: "setting unrealistic" và "dialogue too complex" đều bị phủ định ("not the problem").
2. Đáp án: The new industry demands have a negative influence. Bẫy: "increase audience engagement" và "more creative freedom" là tuyên bố của studio/platform bị bác ("the truth is the opposite").

question_text: What does the radio MC say about how the research on happiness has been covered by the media?
options: It has been accurately reported by the media
It has not been accurately reported by the media
It has been ignored completely by the media
explanation:
Good morning, listeners, and welcome back to the show. Today we are talking about that big new research study on happiness — the one you have probably seen in every newspaper this week. Now, you might assume that with all this coverage, the study has been accurately reported by the media. Sadly, the opposite is true. And it certainly has not been ignored — you cannot open a website without seeing it. The problem is different: the media has not reported it accurately at all. The papers chose the most dramatic lines, cut away all the careful details, and turned a serious piece of science into shocking headlines. As a result, many of you now believe the study says money cannot buy happiness, or that married people are always happier — and it says neither of those things.
So what does the research actually tell us? Here I want to be honest about the limits of science. These studies can help people think about their personal happiness, and they certainly give the media something to discuss. But if you are hoping researchers will one day find a conclusive answer — a final formula for a happy life — that is the one thing that is unlikely ever to happen. Happiness is personal and complicated. What fills one person's life with joy leaves another person empty. The research can light the path a little, but each of us still has to walk it in our own way.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
1. Đáp án: It has not been accurately reported by the media. Bẫy: "accurately reported" bị phủ định trực tiếp, "ignored completely" bị phủ định ("you cannot open a website without seeing it").
2. Đáp án: To find a conclusive answer — điều KHÔNG THỂ xảy ra. Bẫy: "personal happiness" và "discuss in the media" đều được công nhận là khả thi; chỉ "conclusive answer" là "unlikely ever to happen".

question_text: What is the speaker's opinion on this script?
options: The characters' background are not adequately explored
The setting feels too unrealistic
The dialogue is too complex for viewers
explanation:
The producers asked for my honest notes on this script, so here they are. First, what I am not worried about. The setting is fine — the mountain hotel where the story unfolds feels real and atmospheric, exactly as written. The dialogue is not too complex either; the lines are clean and viewers will follow every scene without strain. My concern is the people. The characters' backgrounds are not adequately explored, and it damages everything built on top of them. The lead makes an enormous sacrifice in the third act, yet the script never shows us the history that would make such a sacrifice believable. Who raised her? What has she lost before? Why does she fear what she fears? Without those foundations, her big moment plays as a plot requirement rather than a human choice, and the audience watches instead of feeling.
Why do scripts keep arriving with this same weakness? Look at the business around them. The studios tell us their rapid production model increases audience engagement, and the platforms advertise how much creative freedom their writers enjoy. I have worked under both systems, and I can tell you the truth is the reverse: the new industry demands have a negative influence on script production. Deadlines shrink, trend-chasing rules the notes process, and commercial boxes must be ticked before human ones. Writing a believable past for a character takes time — and time is exactly what the modern industry refuses to pay for.

--- GIẢI THÍCH ĐÁP ÁN ---
(Bản variant của Đề 25 bài 1.)
1. Đáp án: The characters' backgrounds are not adequately explored. Bẫy: "setting unrealistic" và "dialogue too complex" đều bị loại ("what I am not worried about").
2. Đáp án: The new industry demands have a negative influence. Bẫy: "increase audience engagement" và "creative freedom" là quảng cáo của studio/platform bị bác.
