And I know that you don't like maths or languages. I know you're into art, but you shouldn't spend so much time drawing and painting in your room.

question_text: A woman is talking about her gym. What does the woman complain about?
options: The gym was too crowded
The membership fee increased
Her yoga class was cancelled
explanation:
I went to the gym yesterday evening after finishing work because I had been looking forward to my regular yoga class all day. When I arrived, everything seemed normal at first, and there weren't many people around, so I thought it would be a relaxing session. However, as I walked towards the studio, I saw a notice on the door saying that the class had been cancelled because the instructor was ill. I was quite disappointed, especially since nobody had sent us a message or email to let us know beforehand. If I had known earlier, I probably would have stayed at home instead of making the journey.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án: Her yoga class was cancelled. "there weren't many people around" → không đông (loại A); không nhắc phí (loại C). "a notice on the door saying that the class had been cancelled".

question_text: Two college students are talking. When does the football match usually take place?
options: On Thursday afternoon
On Wednesday afternoon
On Friday afternoon
explanation:
M: This is my first week here, so I don't know much about the timetable.
W: Lessons are from Monday to Friday, in the mornings.
M: What about Thursday afternoon?
W: That's for private study.
M: I really like playing football. Is there a football team?
W: Yes, and we've even won some cups. There's a football match every week.
M: Oh, when is it?
W: On Wednesday afternoon.
M: Don't we have to study then?
W: No, lessons finish at noon.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – On Wednesday afternoon
• Vì sao đúng: Cô gái nói trận đấu diễn ra "On Wednesday afternoon". Chiều thứ Năm là giờ tự học; thứ Sáu chỉ học buổi sáng.

question_text: A man is talking about buying a house. What is the man's main problem?
options: Rising house prices
Finding a pleasant area
Persuading his family
explanation:
My ambition is to buy a new house. The market is really expensive at the moment. Experts predict that prices will fall, but they're wrong — prices just keep going up. I'd also like to live somewhere with a pleasant atmosphere and friendly people, and that's not easy to find. Of course, nobody wants to move to a new place and end up with a reduced income. But my main problem is my wife and children. I don't even know if they want to move. First of all, I have to persuade them.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Persuading his family.
• Vì sao đúng: "But my main problem is my wife and children... First of all, I have to persuade them".
• Rising house prices sai: giá nhà tăng là một khó khăn được nhắc, nhưng không phải "main problem".
• Finding a pleasant area sai: tìm khu ở dễ chịu cũng khó, nhưng người nói nhấn mạnh vấn đề chính là gia đình.
👉 Mẹo: bài liệt kê nhiều khó khăn thì nghe cụm "my main problem is..." — đáp án đứng ngay sau.

question_text: Mark is leaving a message for Helen. What is he going to do to prepare for the event?
options: Change the time of the meeting
Invite more guests
Buy new office equipment
explanation:
Hi Helen, it's Mark. Regarding the upcoming event, Sarah is already handling the order to buy new office equipment, and John is in charge of inviting more guests. As for me, my main job today is to change the time of the meeting on the official calendar, because the main hall is unavailable in the morning. I'll notify everyone once it's done.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án: Change the time of the meeting. Bẫy: cả 3 việc đều được nhắc nhưng A là việc của Sarah, B là của John. "As for me, my main job today is to change the time of the meeting".

question_text: Listen to an announcement at a train station. Which platform should passengers to Edinburgh go to?
options: Platform 2
Platform 3
Platform 5
explanation: Attention, passengers. The twelve forty-two train to King's Cross will be arriving shortly. The twelve twenty train to Edinburgh will be late because of an electrical failure, and passengers should wait for it on platform three instead of platform two. The train to York will leave from platform five as usual.

question_text: A father is talking to his son's teacher. What does the teacher offer to do?
options: Give the boy extra exercises
Help find a private teacher
Teach the boy herself
explanation:
M: Hi, I'd like to talk to you about my son's progress at school.
W: Of course. I'm afraid he's finding the lessons quite difficult at the moment.
M: Is there anything we can do? Could you give him some extra exercises?
W: I don't think that's the best idea. His basic knowledge isn't strong enough yet, so more exercises might just confuse him. I'm too busy to teach him myself after class, but why not give him some private lessons?
M: That's a good idea, but I don't know any private teachers.
W: Don't worry. I have the contact details of a very good private teacher near here. I'll send them to you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Help find a private teacher.
• Vì sao đúng: "I have the contact details of a very good private teacher near here. I'll send them to you".
• Give the boy extra exercises sai: đó là đề nghị của phụ huynh, cô giáo từ chối ("I don't think that's the best idea").
• Teach the boy herself sai: cô nói "I'm too busy to teach him myself after class".
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi hỏi CÔ GIÁO đề nghị gì — bỏ qua đề xuất của người cha, nghe câu "I'll..." của cô.

question_text: Two friends are arranging to meet. When will they meet?
options: On Wednesday
On Friday
On Thursday
explanation:
W: Hi, are you free to meet sometime this week?
M: I'm not sure. I'm really busy with work at the moment.
W: How about Wednesday?
M: I'm afraid I'm too busy with work that day.
W: OK. What about Thursday?
M: Thursday might work for me.
W: Actually, no. I'm not free on Thursday.
M: No problem. How about Friday?
W: Friday is fine for me.
M: Great. Let's meet at nine o'clock at the café in the square.
W: Sounds good. See you there.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – On Friday
• Vì sao đúng: Thứ Tư anh bận, thứ Năm cô bận; cả hai chốt "Friday is fine for me".

question_text: A professor is talking to his student. What does he want the student to do?
options: Do more research for him
Write a report for him
Speak at a conference
explanation:
M: I read your report and it was really interesting. I'd like you to talk about it in front of everyone.
W: Oh, thanks. But where?
M: At a conference next month.
W: Oh. My final exam is the month after, and my project for Dr Jones is due soon.
M: I understand, but it will be a great experience for you.
W: OK, but could you look over my presentation first?
M: Yes, I'd be glad to.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Speak at a conference
• Vì sao đúng: Giáo sư muốn sinh viên trình bày báo cáo "At a conference next month". Báo cáo cô đã viết xong rồi; cũng không ai nhắc tới nghiên cứu thêm.

question_text: Two friends are talking about a trip. How long did Nate stay in India?
options: 2 weeks
3 weeks
4 weeks
explanation:
W: Nate! How was your trip to India?
M: It was great, but I wish I could have spent one more week there. I only stayed for two weeks, and people said it would take about three weeks to visit all the places.
W: Hmm, but we only have four weeks for the autumn break.
M: Yeah, I know, and long holidays are more expensive. So one or two weeks sounds about right.

question_text: A man is buying shoes. What colour shoes did he choose?
options: Red
White
Blue
explanation:
W: How can I help you today, sir?
M: I'm looking for new sneakers. Do you have these in white?
W: I'm afraid we only have red and blue left in that model.
M: Oh, I already have a red pair at home. I'll take the blue ones, then.
W: Great choice! I'll bring them to the counter for you.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án: Blue. White: hết hàng ("only have red and blue left"). Red: đã có ở nhà. "I'll take the blue ones".

question_text: Two friends are talking about sports. What was the woman good at?
options: Football
Swimming
Fitness
explanation:
M: Do you remember doing sports at school?
W: Yes, I have good memories of it.
M: What sport did you play?
W: I was in the school football team.
M: Wow. I tried football, but I didn't really like it. I also tried fitness training, but I wasn't strong enough.
W: I tried swimming, but I was a really slow swimmer.
M: Swimming is what I was good at. I won a few competitions.
W: Oh wow! Well, I won a few prizes with my football team too.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – Football.
• Vì sao đúng: cô ở đội bóng đá của trường và "I won a few prizes with my football team too".
• Swimming sai: cô bơi chậm ("I was a really slow swimmer"); bơi là môn giỏi của người ĐÀN ÔNG.
• Fitness sai: người đàn ông thử tập thể lực nhưng không đủ sức, cô không nhắc tới.
👉 Mẹo: hội thoại 2 người, ghi nhanh môn nào của ai — câu hỏi chỉ hỏi người phụ nữ.

question_text: A tour guide is talking about the group's traveling schedule. Where will the group wait for the bus?
options: In the lobby
By the hotel's main entrance
At the train station
explanation:
Good evening, everyone — important details for tomorrow's excursion, so listen carefully! Now, about the meeting point. It is NOT the lobby — I know we met there today, but tomorrow the lobby is closed for cleaning until nine. And please don't go to the train station like the group last week; our tour doesn't use the train at all. The bus will collect us by the hotel's main entrance — the big glass doors facing the fountain — at eight o'clock sharp. Main entrance, eight o'clock. Sleep well!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – By the hotel's main entrance.
• Vì sao đúng: "The bus will collect us by the hotel's main entrance — the big glass doors facing the fountain — at eight o'clock sharp".
• In the lobby sai: hôm nay có gặp ở đó nhưng mai sảnh đóng cửa để dọn dẹp — "It is NOT the lobby — I know we met there today, but tomorrow the lobby is closed for cleaning until nine".
• At the train station sai: tour không dùng tàu, đó là nhầm lẫn của nhóm tuần trước — "our tour doesn't use the train at all".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi điểm hẹn, hướng dẫn viên hay nhấn mạnh "It is NOT...". Chốt ở nơi có mô tả nhận diện cụ thể (cửa kính lớn, đài phun nước) kèm giờ.

question_text: A man is asking a colleague about a report. When will the woman write the report?
options: In the morning
In the afternoon
In the evening
explanation:
M: Are you free to help me with the report this morning?
W: I'd love to, but I'm tied up with work until lunch.
M: Oh, I see. When do you think you can work on it?
W: I'll have some free time after lunch, so I'll sit down and write it then.
M: Will you be able to finish it today?
W: Yes. My husband gets home at five, and I want to have it finished before he walks through the door.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – In the afternoon
• Vì sao đúng: Cô bận đến trưa và sẽ viết "after lunch", xong trước 5 giờ, tức là buổi chiều.

question_text: A man is giving directions to a football club. What is the club next to?
options: A park
A hospital
Traffic lights
explanation: Hello, I'm calling from the football club. You asked how to get to the club. You should take the number one-three-two bus and get off at the hospital. Walk down the street, and then turn left when you see the traffic lights. The football club is next to the park.

question_text: A man is talking about his career. What would he like to be?
options: A writer
A teacher
A chef
explanation:
I'd like to try a different kind of job now. I used to be a chef, and I worked in several hotels. After that, I worked at the post office, and my time there was amazing. I've also been a teacher. But now I'm interested in becoming a writer. I know it's a job where you have to be really creative, but I'd really like to give it a try.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – A writer.
• Vì sao đúng: "But now I'm interested in becoming a writer... I'd really like to give it a try".
• A teacher sai: là công việc anh đã từng làm ("I've also been a teacher").
• A chef sai: cũng là việc cũ ("I used to be a chef").
👉 Mẹo: phân biệt quá khứ (used to, have been) với mong muốn hiện tại (now I'm interested in, I'd like to).

question_text: A student is talking to her teacher. When is the assignment due?
options: Thursday
Friday
Saturday
explanation:
W: Excuse me, sir. Can I talk to you for a moment?
M: Sure. What would you like to talk about?
W: It's about the assignment you gave us. I don't think I can finish it by Thursday.
M: But I said you had until the end of the week to hand it in.
W: Oh, right. So we have one more day, until Friday? I think I can finish it by then.
M: No, you don't have to hand it in until Saturday, so you have two more days.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Saturday.
• Vì sao đúng: thầy chốt "you don't have to hand it in until Saturday, so you have two more days".
• Thursday sai: là ngày học sinh tưởng phải nộp.
• Friday sai: học sinh đoán thêm một ngày, thầy sửa lại "No...".
👉 Mẹo: khi có "No," ở lượt cuối, đáp án là thông tin người nói sửa lại ngay sau đó.

question_text: Lucy is calling her friend. What is her sister like?
options: She is taller than Lucy
She is very different from Lucy
They have similar characters
explanation:
M: Lucy! How was the weekend with your sister? I've still never met her, you know.
W: Wonderful, as always. People are so surprised when they finally meet her.
M: Why? Is she taller than you? You always say she gets noticed first.
W: Ha! No, we're exactly the same height, actually. It's not about looks at all.
M: Then what surprises everyone?
W: How alike we are inside. We have similar characters — same silly jokes, same stubbornness, we even finish each other's sentences. Mum says raising us was like raising one person twice.
M: That's lovely. So if I like you, I'll like her.
W: Exactly. Double trouble, they call us!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – They have similar characters.
• Vì sao đúng: "How alike we are inside. We have similar characters — same silly jokes, same stubbornness, we even finish each other's sentences."
• She is taller than Lucy sai: hai chị em cao bằng nhau ("we're exactly the same height, actually").
• She is very different from Lucy sai: ngược lại hoàn toàn — "Mum says raising us was like raising one person twice".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi ngoại hình/tính cách, chú ý cặp đối lập "looks vs inside"; câu "It's not about looks at all" đã loại sạch nhóm ngoại hình.

question_text: A woman is calling her friend. How does she get to work?
options: She drives to work.
She goes to work by train.
She walks to work.
explanation:
Hi there. I've just started my new job this week, and I'm really happy because the new school is really close to my house. It's in the next street, so every morning I walk to work. That wasn't possible when I worked at my old school, which was ten miles away from my house. I chose this job because the environment is great and it's near my house. Call me back and I'll tell you more about it.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – She walks to work.
• Vì sao đúng: Cô nói "every morning I walk to work". Trường cũ cách 10 dặm mới phải đi xe; tàu không được nhắc tới.

question_text: Listen to the weather forecast. Where is the weather best?
options: In the west
In the east
In the south
explanation: There will be heavy showers in the south because of an area of low pressure. There will be fewer showers in the west. The best weather will be in the east, where we expect no rain and some sunshine. In the north, it will be dry and windy, so it may feel cold there.

question_text: A man is talking to his wife. Where will he meet her?
options: At home
At the restaurant
At her office
explanation:
M: Hi, love. How's your day going? Are we still meeting later?
W: Yes, definitely. I've just got quite a lot to finish at work today.
M: No problem. What time do you think you'll be ready?
W: Probably around six.
M: That's fine. I'll take the car and come over to your office. We can go somewhere for dinner afterwards.
W: Perfect. I'll see you there.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – At her office
• Vì sao đúng: "I'll take the car and come over to your office." Nhà hàng là chỗ đi ăn sau khi đã gặp nhau.

question_text: Greg is talking about a working day in his life. How does he go to work?
options: By bus
By car
By bike
explanation:
People often ask how I manage my mornings, so here's my working day. I used to drive, but since the office moved to the centre, the car just sits in traffic for an hour, so that's finished. My wife keeps saying I should cycle — good exercise, she says — but with our winters, I'd arrive soaked three days out of five. So now I go to work by bus. Twenty minutes, a warm seat, and I read my book the whole way. Best decision I've made in years.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – By bus.
• Vì sao đúng: "So now I go to work by bus. Twenty minutes, a warm seat, and I read my book the whole way".
• By car sai: đã bỏ vì văn phòng chuyển vào trung tâm, xe kẹt cả tiếng — "I used to drive, but since the office moved to the centre, the car just sits in traffic for an hour, so that's finished".
• By bike sai: chỉ là gợi ý của vợ, bị loại vì mùa đông — "My wife keeps saying I should cycle... but with our winters, I'd arrive soaked three days out of five".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi phương tiện đi lại, bám cụm "So now I...". Phương tiện gắn với "I used to" (quá khứ) hay "my wife says I should" (ý người khác) đều là nhiễu.

question_text: A woman is talking about her plans. What will she do on Saturday?
options: Go to Spain
See her family
Stay at home
explanation:
This year I was planning to go to Spain, but it's far too expensive, so I've decided to go to Wales instead. I'm taking my family there this Saturday. During the week, everyone is so busy that it's really hard to spend time together. My husband works late most evenings, and the kids have after-school clubs almost every day, so we usually only see each other at dinner. I did think about just staying at home and relaxing this weekend, but I think a few days away together will do us all good.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – See her family.
• Vì sao đúng: thứ Bảy cô đưa cả nhà đi Wales vì trong tuần "it's really hard to spend time together" — cuối cùng cũng được ở bên gia đình.
• Go to Spain sai: Tây Ban Nha quá đắt nên cô đã đổi kế hoạch ("far too expensive").
• Stay at home sai: cô có nghĩ tới nhưng bỏ ý đó ("I did think about just staying at home..., but").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi KẾ HOẠCH, các phương án bị loại thường đi kèm "but" hoặc "instead".

question_text: A woman is talking about activities at a hotel. Which outdoor activity is available in the afternoon?
options: Dance classes
A city tour
Playing golf
explanation: Good morning. There's a variety of activities on offer for you today. The swimming session runs from seven to nine a.m., but the pool closes at noon for cleaning. In the afternoon there are other activities as well. The city tour is already sold out, but the golf course is available for you to enjoy, and you can rent clubs at the front desk. The clubhouse opens at two p.m. Apart from that, there are dance classes in the studio all day.

question_text: A woman is calling from a clinic. When is the new appointment?
options: Thursday the 13th
Thursday the 30th
Friday the 13th
explanation: Hello, I'm calling from the clinic. Your appointment is on Monday, but the doctor will be at a conference that day, so I'm calling to change your appointment. Does Thursday the thirteenth sound OK for you? Please call me back as soon as possible.

question_text: A woman is leaving a message for her friend. What does she usually do in the evenings?
options: Reading
Watching films
Walking
explanation:
Hi Anna, it's Lily. I'm only doing a half day at school today, so I've got a lot of free time. Do you want to meet up? We could go to the park. I usually go for a walk there in the evenings, which is really nice now that the evenings are lighter. Call me back. Bye!

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – Walking
• Vì sao đúng: Lily nói "I usually go for a walk there in the evenings".

question_text: A woman is talking about her plan for the holiday. What will she do during the holiday?
options: Go for a run
Go for a walk
Go for a bike ride
explanation:
Two more days until my holiday, and I have made my plans! My sister keeps saying I should go for a run every morning — she's training for a marathon and thinks everyone else should suffer too. My neighbour offered to lend me his bike for a ride along the coast, which was kind, but I haven't cycled in years and I'd like to return from holiday in one piece. No — every morning, I will simply go for a walk. The long path by the sea, slow and peaceful, coffee at the end. Perfect.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – Go for a walk.
• Vì sao đúng: "every morning, I will simply go for a walk. The long path by the sea, slow and peaceful, coffee at the end."
• Go for a run sai: đó là ý của chị gái đang tập marathon, cô không nhận ("My sister keeps saying I should go for a run").
• Go for a bike ride sai: hàng xóm cho mượn xe nhưng cô đã lâu không đạp và muốn về nhà nguyên vẹn ("I haven't cycled in years").
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi kế hoạch, gạch hết ý do người khác đề xuất; đáp án nằm sau "No —" và đi với chủ ngữ "I will".

question_text: A woman is talking about her job. How is being an artist different from other jobs?
options: She deals with money
She meets clients
She works irregular hours
explanation:
Being an artist isn't as different from other jobs as people think. I still have to deal with money — paying bills, paying taxes. Sometimes I feel like I'm working in an office rather than a studio. I also have to go and meet clients, the people who want to buy my work. But there's one thing I love about being a painter: I don't have to get up early. And if I feel inspired in the middle of the night, I can start painting right away.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – She works irregular hours.
• Vì sao đúng: cô không phải dậy sớm và có thể vẽ lúc nửa đêm khi có cảm hứng — tức là làm việc giờ giấc thất thường.
• She deals with money sai: trả hoá đơn, đóng thuế giống mọi công việc khác ("like I'm working in an office").
• She meets clients sai: gặp khách hàng cũng là điểm giống các nghề khác.
👉 Mẹo: câu hỏi hỏi điểm KHÁC — các ý "I still have to..." là điểm giống, đáp án nằm sau "But there's one thing...".

question_text: A man is talking about his family's weekends. What does the family do most weekends?
options: They go out with friends
They go bowling
They go for a walk
explanation:
I think we should go bowling this weekend, for a change. We go for a walk together almost every weekend, so this time let's do something different, and just let the children go with their friends afterwards. That would be nice for everyone.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án C – They go for a walk.
• Vì sao đúng: "We go for a walk together almost every weekend" — câu hỏi hỏi thói quen (MOST weekends).
• They go bowling sai: chỉ là đề xuất cho tuần NÀY ("this weekend, for a change").
• They go out with friends sai: là kế hoạch cho bọn trẻ tuần này, không phải thói quen.
👉 Mẹo: phân biệt "this weekend" (kế hoạch) và "almost every weekend" (thói quen) — câu hỏi hỏi cái nào thì chọn cái đó.

question_text: Listen to a radio man talking about a new popular song. Which is the most attractive part of the song?
options: The words
The rhythm
The melody
explanation:
The song of the summer, listeners — let's talk about why it owns every radio! Musicians praise the melody, sweet but honestly nothing revolutionary, you've heard that tune's cousins before. The rhythm gets the clubs moving, sure, a solid beat, nothing more. But the words — the words are why grandmothers and teenagers both cry to this song! Poetry about going home after years away, every line a little knife. People tattoo these lyrics, print them at weddings. The words, my friends. That's the magic.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án A – The words.
• Vì sao đúng: "the words are why grandmothers and teenagers both cry to this song! Poetry about going home after years away... The words, my friends. That's the magic".
• The melody sai: bị chê là bình thường, không có gì mới — "the melody, sweet but honestly nothing revolutionary, you've heard that tune's cousins before".
• The rhythm sai: chỉ ở mức tạm ổn — "The rhythm gets the clubs moving, sure, a solid beat, nothing more".
👉 Mẹo: dạng hỏi "phần hay nhất", nghe cụm hạ giá trị "nothing revolutionary", "nothing more". Yếu tố được khen bằng từ mạnh ("that's the magic") mới là đáp án.

question_text: An estate agent is talking about a living room. What is not original?
options: The windows
The door
The furniture
explanation: As you can see, the owners have tried to keep most of the Victorian features in this house, especially here in the living room. The windows are made of the original stained glass, which lets light and warmth into the room. The patterned furniture makes the room even more attractive, although it was actually made half a century after the house was built. And the sliding door has been kept exactly as it was for nearly two centuries.

question_text: Two colleagues are talking about their day. What time does the train leave?
explanation:
M: So, what are you doing today?
W: I've got a meeting in the city this morning. What about you?
M: I'm going with you, aren't I? We've got the meeting together.
W: Oh, yes! I nearly forgot. What time are we leaving?
M: The train leaves at nine fifteen, so we'd better get to the station early.
W: Nine fifteen. Got it.
M: And don't forget the presentation. Have you finished it?
W: Yes, I finished writing it last night.

--- GIẢI THÍCH: Đáp án B – At 9.15
• Vì sao đúng: "The train leaves at nine fifteen."
